jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer II
jobs.description: Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery\-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight. **Backend Software Engineer II** Parallel Systems is seeking a Software Engineer II to help build the train control software that lets our autonomous rail vehicles operate safely on the rail network. You'll work on the backend systems, written primarily in Rust, that model how trains are authorized to move: movement authorities, bulletins, switches, and signals, implemented in our system as motion rules and Parallel blocks. This is a hands\-on role with a clear growth path. You'll start by closing edge cases in our existing train control logic, move on to owning new features end to end (from reading railroad specs through technical design, backend, and UI changes), and grow into a core contributor on our path to supporting Positive Train Control (PTC). Prior rail experience is not required; curiosity and a willingness to learn a deep domain are. **Responsibilities:** * Implement and extend backend features for critical train control applications, adding support for new train control concepts with guidance from senior engineers. * Develop and maintain system\-level software written primarily in Rust. * Improve the reliability and correctness of existing code by finding and fixing edge cases in train control logic. * Write and test code that meets our safety, security, and compliance standards. * Debug and diagnose issues in simulation and on real hardware, escalating complex problems when needed. * Participate in code reviews and technical discussions and help write technical specs for the features you build. **What Success Looks Like:** * **After 30 days:** You understand the core concepts behind train control (movement authorities, bulletins, switches, and signals) and how they're implemented technically in our system through motion rules and Parallel blocks. You've added support for one or two missing edge cases in train control. * **After 60 days:** You've added support for a new train control feature, such as movement authorities that are only valid depending on the movement of other trains. You analyzed the requirements from specs, wrote a technical spec covering the necessary backend and UI changes, and implemented them in our codebase. You've also begun learning the concepts behind PTC and reading the associated specs. * **After 90 days:** You've added support for several new train control features and have a solid understanding of the gap between what's required to support PTC and what exists in our system today. **Basic Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of experience in backend or systems\-level software development. * Experience in C, C\+\+, Rust, or other systems programming languages. * Proficiency with Linux environments, low\-level system interactions, and memory management. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with Rust in production or a strong desire to work with Rust. * Experience in safety critical application spaces such as autonomous vehicles, industrial control equipment, or aerospace. * Experience in or knowledge of rail control systems is greatly preferred. * Familiarity with cloud\-based architectures and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes). *Parallel Systems is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any discriminatory factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. We work to build an inclusive environment in which all people can come to do their best work.* *Parallel Systems is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Parallel Systems will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact your recruiter.*

jobs.title: Crystal Growth Process Engineer
jobs.description: From smartphones to solar panels, innovative technology is needed to create the devices we use every day. Silfex’s silicon components help make that technology a reality. Silfex Inc., A Lam Research Company is the leading provider of precision silicon components used to make and operate semiconductor tools, which enable the trillion\-dollar global electronics industry. Our company’s products are integral to the semiconductor equipment and optical markets. The outstanding team at Silfex makes that possible – through our people, we are advancing the world. The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams’ achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone’s contribution and voice has value. We evaluate and evolve our offerings, so our people receive the support and empowerment to do meaningful things for their lives, careers, and communities. **Our Perks and Benefits** At Silfex, our people make amazing things possible. That’s why we invest in you throughout the phases of your life with a comprehensive set of outstanding benefits that start on your first day of employment. Discover more at Lam Benefits **Job Description:** As a Crystal Growth Process Engineer you will develop innovative and scalable solutions for silicon crystal manufacturing, from applied research to mass production. As a process engineer, you will use applied research, data analysis and machine learning tools to continuously push the boundaries of process performance, equipment intelligence and manufacturing efficiency. In addition, this position provides technical oversight of crystal growing equipment and manufacturing processes, and cross\-functional work with operations, maintenance and other stakeholders to achieve production goals. The process engineering role requires strong technical fundamentals, a learning mindset, a high level of initiative, effective communication skills and a methodical and organized approach to managing multiple project elements. Individuals who enjoy materials science, systems engineering, and manufacturing will find this role exciting and challenging as it allows you to think creatively and develop novel ideas from theory to mass production, reinventing processes for a new era of manufacturing where artificial intelligence, and human judgement work in a complimentary manner. This is a unique opportunity to combine operational responsibility with research and development, and this work is critical to the process performance, supply chains and competitiveness of our company and our customers. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Conduct process engineering research, development and evaluation in support of silicon crystal manufacturing. * Utilize multi\-physics simulations, materials testing and characterization techniques to establish the impact of manufacturing processes on critical material specifications and performance in customer applications. * Conduct data analysis for process development and manufacturing, using and further developing novel approaches including machine learning and AI. * Study scientific literature, research best practices from the semiconductor and other industries to develop novel ideas to improve manufacturing yield, quality and efficiency. * Collaborate internally in a matrixed organization to support research and development and manufacturing. * Effectively communicate technical information, manufacturing process performance and project plans. * Provide technical leadership on the manufacturing floor, collaborating with manufacturing technicians. * Adjust work schedule occasionally to support time\-critical work. **Qualifications:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. * Bachelor’s degree with 5\+ years of experience; or Master’s or PhD in materials science, chemical engineering, physics or related field; or equivalent experience. * Experience doing hands\-on experimental work in a laboratory, machine shop or industrial setting. * Familiarity with microscopy and materials characterization methods such as optical and electron microscopy, x\-ray diffraction and surface characterization techniques. * Knowledge or experience with multi\-physics simulations, including interpretation of data. * Understanding of statistical process control and design of experiments. * Strong data analysis skills, experience with statistical tools, basic knowledge of the applications of machine learning and AI models. * Experience working in a collaborative or matrixed environment with diverse teams. **Our Commitment** We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results. Silfex Inc., A Lam Research Company ("Silfex" or the "Company"), is an equal opportunity employer. Silfex is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non\-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

jobs.title: Data Operations Associate - AI & Energy Data
jobs.description: **About Parisi Labs** --------------------- Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions. Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators. We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for a Data Operations Associate on a contract or full\-time basis to source, clean, and validate energy data. Your initial focus will be Ask The Grid, our live product for exploring the power grid, its markets, and its assets. You will use AI\-assisted research and coding to turn scattered information into dependable records and repeatable workflows. Judgment is central: you should be able to explain where a value came from, catch incorrect matches or unsupported claims, and decide what to verify, correct, or escalate. You will scope work with the founders and data engineering team, own sourcing and validation tasks, and collaborate with engineers on integrating the results into our products. Students, recent graduates, and early\-career candidates are welcome; projects, independent research, and freelance work can demonstrate the skills we need. **What you'll own** ------------------- * Find and evaluate public datasets, reports, websites, and APIs; document their coverage, definitions, freshness, and limitations. * Research and enrich energy\-asset records with traceable sources and clear treatment of unknowns. * Clean, standardize, deduplicate, and reconcile names, identifiers, units, and locations across sources. * Investigate missing or inconsistent data, trace the cause, and make corrections or escalate unresolved questions with evidence. * Build lightweight Python, SQL, or AI\-assisted extraction and validation workflows that another team member can inspect and run. * Maintain clear documentation and follow\-through on data requests, checks, and completed work. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Hands\-on AI use: you already use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or AI coding assistants to complete real work and can explain your contribution and checks. * Sound judgment about source reliability, entity matching, conflicting evidence, and uncertainty. * The ability to break an ambiguous task into steps, investigate discrepancies, and ask focused questions when needed. * Practical Python or SQL skills for cleanup, investigation, and simple automation, including with AI assistance. * Careful documentation and clear communication about decisions, quality checks, and limitations. * Curiosity about energy, infrastructure, geography, or complex real\-world systems. No particular degree or minimum number of years of experience is required. We care about evidence of useful work, clear thinking, and independent follow\-through. **First 90 days** ----------------- * 30 days: Understand our data conventions and complete an agreed research or cleanup task with traceable sources and documented checks. * 60 days: Deliver a repeatable sourcing or validation workflow and show how you verify its output. * 90 days: Own a recurring data workflow, communicate its limitations clearly, and propose a practical improvement to quality or efficiency. For contract work, we will agree milestones, acceptance criteria, and timing based on the scope and available hours. **Why join** ------------ You will work directly with a small technical team, see your work used in a live energy product, and build experience in AI\-assisted research, data quality, and practical automation. You will have responsibility for useful outcomes and room to grow as your skills and the work develop. **Location and compensation** ----------------------------- **Engagement:** Contract or full\-time employment. We can consider a full\-time hire from the outset or start with a part\-time contract. Contract work may grow into full\-time employment based on performance, company needs, and mutual fit. **Contract:** $30–$40 USD per hour, initially approximately 10–15 hours per week. Scope, hours, and schedule will be agreed before work begins. Remote contractors may be considered. **Full\-time:** $65,000–$85,000 USD annual base salary. Location: New York City or Boston/Cambridge, with in\-person collaboration three days per week, consistent with our other full\-time roles. Compensation within each range depends on demonstrated skills and agreed scope. No equity is included in contract work; any full\-time equity would be discussed separately as part of the offer. **How to apply** ---------------- Share a resume or relevant project links, an example of real work completed with AI, and how you verified the result. Include your location, availability, preferred contract or full\-time arrangement, and compensation expectations. Our process includes a short conversation, a paid 60–90\-minute practical data exercise with AI encouraged, and a discussion of your sources, decisions, and quality checks.

jobs.title: GenAI Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Would you like to work in a position that provides exceptional benefits and a flexible working environment, using your attention to detail, strong sense of accountability, and ability to communicate with others in your career? Do you want an opportunity for strong work/life balance and career growth while working on a variety of projects with diverse groups of people companywide? If you are looking to make a difference and drive your success, you have come to the right place, and Golden Pear Funding is looking for you! Our world\-class culture is shaped by dedicated Team Members who share a drive to succeed as professionals and together as a company. A great product, amazing people and our stable financial history make Golden Pear a great place to work. We are hiring a GenAI Engineer/Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) and this is a fully remote position, and you can live anywhere in the US. Are you an engineer who loves both deep technical architecture and getting your hands dirty with real users? We are hiring a GenAI Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to build and ship production\-grade GenAI systems—and sit directly alongside the teams using them. This is a high\-autonomy hybrid role combining deep software engineering with hands\-on field work. #### **What You’ll Do** * Build for Production: Design and deploy multiagent applications using CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock, and modern cloud architectures. * Embed with Stakeholders: Work directly with business teams to translate messy, halfdefined operational workflows into functional agent designs. * Own EndtoEnd Delivery: Take broad operational challenges from initial scoping to monitored, evaluated agent teams running live in production. * Drive Measurable ROI: Iterate rapidly with short feedback loops to align agent performance with business KPIs. Who You Are: You aren't looking for a pure research or platform role—you want to see your code solve real\-world problems today. You excel at bridging technical architecture with operational needs, thrive on direct user feedback, and take pride in making AI actually land inside an organization. #### **Golden Pear Funding Offers:** * Salary range $160$210 annually DOE * Competitive PTO plus 40 hours of sick leave yearly wellness days and Holiday pay * Life, Dental, Vison, EAP, ST and LT disability * Medical for the employee and family, partial company paid * EAP * Summer Fridays * 401k match up to 4% #### **Position Summary** Under the guidance and direction of the Chief Technology, Product \& AI Officer, the GenAI Engineer / FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer) builds and ships production GenAI systems while working closely with the people who use them. The role is a hybrid of deep engineering and field work: the GenAI Engineer / FDE designs and builds agentic applications using CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock, and other platforms as appropriate, and is embedded directly with business stakeholders to understand their workflows, deploy into their environment, and iterate in alignment with defined KPIs. This is neither a research role nor a pure platform role; it requires a builder who takes ownership, works well with domain experts, and drives projects to deliver measurable results. #### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the following satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Production Agent Delivery: Design, build, and deploy multiagent GenAI applications using CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock, and modern Python tooling, moving beyond pilots and proofsofconcept into live production. * Deployed Field Work: Embed with business teams and end users to scope ambiguous problems, map existing workflows, and translate them into agent designs with clear autonomy boundaries and humanintheloop checkpoints. * AWS Architecture: Architect solutions on AWS using Bedrock, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, and Aurora PostgreSQL. * RAG Systems: Build retrievalaugmented generation (RAG) systems using Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, or pgvector, including chunking, embedding, and retrieval pipeline optimization. * Evaluation \& Quality: Define and build evaluation harnesses, regression suites, and quality metrics so agent behavior can be measured and improved rather than guessed at. * Guardrails \& Security: Implement guardrails, promptinjection defenses, PII filtering, and security controls appropriate to a regulated business environment. Implement secure authentication and authorization using Amazon Cognito, IAM, Secrets Manager, and KMS, following leastprivilege and secure coding practices. * Observability \& Cost Control: Instrument agents for observability and cost control using OpenTelemetry, AWS CloudWatch, structured tracing, and token/spend monitoring dashboards. * System Integration: Integrate agents with internal systems and e gn decisions, and runbooks; mentor other team members on GenAI patterns, tool usage, and best practices. #### **Qualifications** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. #### **Education \& Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). o5\+ years of software engineering experience building production systems in Python. * 2\+ years of experience building and deploying GenAI applications, LLM pipelines, and/or multi\-agent systems. oHands\-on experience with CrewAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or similar agentic frameworks. * Proven experience with AWS AI/ML infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and AWS serverless technologies. #### **Technical Skills:** * Advanced Python proficiency (Pydantic, AsyncIO, FastAPI, pytest). oStrong expertise with AWS services (Bedrock, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, Step Functions, DynamoDB, S3, OpenSearch, IAM, Cognito). * Deep understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval strategies. oHands\-on experience with evaluation tools and methodologies (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval, or custom evaluation frameworks). * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and tool\-calling patterns. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK) and CI/CD automation. #### **Soft Skills \& Field Competencies:** * Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical details to non\-technical business stakeholders. oStrong product mindset and empathy for end users; ability to translate operational pain points into practical software solutions. * High degree of autonomy, adaptability, and comfort navigating ambiguous, fast\-moving environments. Physical Demands \& Work Environment * Work Environment: 100% remote working environment. Must maintain a reliable home office setup with highspeed internet. * Physical Demands: Requires prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to communicate effectively via video conferencing, chat, and email. * Effort: The employee must be able to occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds (e.g., laptops, monitors, peripherals). Note This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. Incumbents will follow any other instructions and perform related duties as assigned by their supervisor. Golden Pear Funding is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. #### **About Golden Pear Funding OPCO LLC** Golden Pear Funding is the leading consumer litigation funding firm in the country. We are world\-class specialty finance platform deploying over $1B in capital—and we’re investing heavily in AI, data infrastructure. We work with law firms of all sizes to fund personal injury plaintiffs as quickly and efficiently as possible, offering the service, speed, and ease of use attorneys need to focus on pursuing better case outcomes and larger settlements for their clients. Why choose us: • High ownership, low bureaucracy your work actually matters • Work\-life balance that’s real sustainable pace, no burnout culture • People\-first culture you’re a contributor, not a cog. We don’t treat people like cogs in a wheel. We hire strong individuals, give them ownership, and expect them to make meaningful contributions. Come as your full self and join a diverse, talented, and fun team.

jobs.title: Junior Software QA Engineer
jobs.description: Junior Software QA Engineer **Location:** Chicago, Illinois **Work arrangement:** Hybrid — three office days and two remote days per week **Employment:** Full\-time **Salary:** $68,000–$82,000 per year **Reports to:** QA Lead About the role Common Kite Learning is hiring a Junior Software QA Engineer to help test our web\-based training platform across desktop and mobile browsers. You will manually test new features, document defects, verify fixes, and gradually learn API and automated testing with support from experienced engineers. This is an entry\-level position suitable for someone with internship, bootcamp, coursework, freelance, or personal\-project experience in software testing. What you’ll do * Test new features before they are released to customers. * Create and follow clear test cases based on product requirements. * Check the platform across supported browsers, devices, and screen sizes. * Report bugs with reproducible steps, screenshots, videos, and relevant technical details. * Retest resolved issues and perform regression testing before releases. * Work with developers and product designers to clarify expected behavior. * Help maintain the team’s test\-case library and release checklists. * Learn to test REST APIs and contribute to basic automated tests. * Participate in sprint planning, product demonstrations, and QA reviews. What we’re looking for * Up to 2 years of software testing experience, including internships, coursework, bootcamps, freelance work, or personal projects. * Basic understanding of manual testing, test cases, regression testing, and defect reporting. * Strong attention to detail and the ability to explain problems clearly. * Comfort learning new software and investigating unexpected behavior. * Clear written and verbal communication skills. * Authorization to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship. A college degree is not required for this position. **Helpful, but not required:** * Experience with Jira, Linear, TestRail, or a similar tool. * Basic knowledge of browser developer tools, SQL, Postman, or REST APIs. * Familiarity with JavaScript, Playwright, Cypress, or another testing framework. * Experience testing accessibility or responsive web interfaces. Schedule This is a 40\-hour, Monday\-through\-Friday position with flexible start times between 8:00 and 10:00 a.m. Team members should generally be available during the shared collaboration period from 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Central Time. The team works from the Chicago office Tuesday through Thursday and remotely on Monday and Friday. Occasional release testing may take place outside regular hours, typically no more than once per quarter, with equivalent time off provided during the same week. Compensation and benefits * Base salary of $68,000–$82,000\. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) with a 4% company match. * 15 days of paid time off, plus 11 company holidays. * Five paid sick days. * 12 weeks of paid parental leave. * Company\-provided laptop and home\-office equipment allowance. * Professional development budget of $1,500 per year. * Paid access to software testing courses and certification materials. * Public\-transit reimbursement for office days. * Annual performance and compensation review. Hiring process * A 20\-minute conversation with the recruiter. * A 45\-minute video interview with the QA Lead. * A structured testing exercise completed during a live interview. * A final conversation with members of the engineering and product teams. Candidates will not be asked to complete an unpaid take\-home project. Pay: $68,000\.00 \- $82,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60618

jobs.description: **Role Description** : The Lead Full Stack Developer (Microsoft Fullstack Engineer \- Professional) will design, develop, and maintain end\-to\-end web applications using Microsoft technologies in a full\-time, on\-site role based in Pennsylvania, United States. Responsibilities include leading technical design, implementing front\-end and back\-end features, integrating databases and APIs, and ensuring performance, security, and scalability. This role requires familiarity with a County’s processes, with a focus on quality assurance and user acceptance across Finance, Purchasing, and Budget modules. The ideal candidate will possess strong problem\-solving skills, a commitment to quality, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment. **Examples of Duties and Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** ---------------------------------------------------------- Duties/Responsibities * Coordinate and execute Functional Testing Suites for Oracle Cloud ERP/Fusion applications. * Lead test\-to\-prod functional testing and validate system readiness across Finance, Purchasing, and Budget modules. * Manage and perform comprehensive quarterly patch testing to evaluate and confirm functional updates. * Collaborate with business users and functional leads to build, update, and maintain robust test scenarios. * Diagnose, document, and track functional defects identified during testing cycles through resolution. * Assist with user acceptance testing (UAT) coordination and support end\-user validation sessions. * Develop and maintain functional test execution plans, test scripts, and QA documentation. * Work closely with technical teams and Oracle support to escalate, verify, and re\-test patch fixes. * Report test execution progress, regression findings, and quality metrics to project stakeholders. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **About DeweyLearn** DeweyLearn exists to help organizations preserve and scale expert judgment. We believe the most valuable knowledge in any organization doesn’t live in manuals or policies, it lives in the decisions experts make every day. Our platform captures that expertise, transforms it into scalable AI systems, and applies it to authentic assessment, coaching, certification, quality assurance, and any workflow where human judgment matters. DeweyLearn is an AI\-powered human assessment and evaluation platform. Our multimodal system analyzes audio and video of real learning, training, and coaching sessions using observational frameworks developed with domain experts, then turns what it sees into structured insight for assessment, coaching, certification, and quality assurance. Our partners span higher education, corporate training, clinical practice, and K\-12 education. DeweyLearn won the GSV Cup grand prize at the 2026 ASU\+GSV Summit as the world’s best edtech startup, and recently closed a Series A led by SJF Ventures. **Tasks** --------- **About the role** You own end\-to\-end product management across existing verticals, new verticals, and internal tooling. Working with the Head of Product, you take a focused approach to understanding the problem, and building, validating, launching, and improving a solution that people actually use. Use cases might include a nursing simulation workflow, a repeatable solution for an existing customer need, or an internal tool that helps our team deliver faster. This is a hands\-on building role. You use agentic tools to compose existing DeweyLearn and third\-party capabilities, configure workflows, and test working solutions. You partner with Customer Success and domain experts to understand the use case, and with Engineering and Product Delivery to deliver it successfully. You own the assigned product’s outcomes, then take on new opportunities as the solution becomes repeatable, and ongoing ownership is clear. **Requirements** ---------------- **What you'll do** Understand the use case: Partner with Sales, Customer Success, customers, and domain experts to identify the problem, current process, and evidence of value. * Build the complete solution. Configure workflows, prompts, evaluation frameworks, and integrations using existing capabilities and agentic tools. Work with Engineering when platform changes are needed. * Validate in real use. Test the full customer or internal workflow against agreed quality criteria, review failures with relevant domain and technical owners, and iterate. * Launch and drive adoption. Coordinate readiness, onboarding, and handover with Product Delivery. Partner with Customer Success and Product Marketing on demos, enablement, and feedback. * Own the outcomes. Track useful adoption, quality, time to first value, and commercial contribution. For internal tools, demonstrate time savings, improved throughput, or reduced errors. * Make it repeatable. Reduce bespoke setup and support, build reusable workflows, and turn user learning into product improvements and roadmap input for the Head of Product. **About the Candidate** * Curiosity and adaptability: You learn new domains quickly and recognize when to involve specialists or engineers. You can move between industries and internal use cases while staying focused on outcomes. Experience in education, assessment, workflow automation, integrations, or AI evaluation is helpful, not required. * Agentic building: You use AI tools to build working solutions, inspect outputs critically, troubleshoot failures, and improve them. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you enjoy making things work. * Ownership and judgment: You can show useful things you have built and shipped, and explain your decisions and results. You may be early in your career; demonstrated ownership matters more than years in a PM title. Personal, academic, internal, and customer projects all count. * Customer\-close learning: You seek out users and domain experts, test assumptions in real workflows, and turn what you learn into concrete changes. You follow through beyond a demo and communicate tradeoffs clearly. **What this role is not** * Not a role with a ready\-made playbook—you won’t always have a defined roadmap, established tools, or an existing solution. The Head of Product sets priorities; you take ownership of figuring out how to achieve the outcome. * Not a coordination\-only role — you build working solutions and own product outcomes, rather than only writing specs or tracking delivery. * Not a solo engineering or domain\-expert role — you work hands\-on with agentic tools while partnering with customers, Customer Success, specialists, Engineering, and Product Delivery. **How we hire** We care about what you can do and how you think, not where you've done it. We're hiring for talent that amplifies the team. We evaluate candidates on concrete examples, demonstrably deep knowledge, and real work samples — and on the judgment and self\-direction that come from having done work like this before, without a manager scripting the moves. **The team you're joining** DeweyLearn is a small, close\-knit team, moving fast, with a deep conviction in the impact DeweyLearn can have on learning and learners. We emphasize fun and a high level of collaboration, while holding each other accountable to our shared outcomes. We hire on ability and judgment, not pedigree, and we trust deeply once we do. We bias toward straight talk, deliver on what we said we would, and treat play and curiosity as part of how the team discovers what to build. We refuse to ship work we wouldn't be proud of. **Benefits** ------------ **Compensation \& logistics** Medical benefits and flexible PTO. Remote\-first, with occasional travel for customer visits and team events. DeweyLearn, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs. The Company does not unlawfully discriminate against, nor does it tolerate unlawful harassment by any person, on the basis of race, color, religion or creed, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Research Associate I/II (Cell-Based Assay Development)
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Research Associate I/II (Cell\-Based Assay Development)**Department:** Research \& Development **Reports to:** Principal Scientist I, Analytical Development **Location:** Onsite 5 days a week \- HQ\- Berkeley, CA **Employment Type:** Full\-time **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Bonus/Equity:** Eligible About Azalea**Azalea Therapeutics enabling precision genome engineering directly inside the body, with an initial focus on creating cancer immunotherapies** ***in vivo*****.** Azalea is pioneering a new way to turn a person’s own T cells into a powerful cancer therapy — directly inside the body. Instead of removing cells and manipulating them in a lab, we use precision genome editing tools to engineer T cells where they already live. At the center of our approach are Enveloped Delivery Vehicles, or EDVs. As highly selective couriers, EDVs are designed to specifically locate T cells within the patient and deliver our genome engineering cargo. Once inside the cell, the anti\-cancer agent is inserted into a precise site in the genome, ensuring safe and potent modifications to fortify the T cells against cancers. **Why this matters:*** We aim to make cell therapy faster and more accessible by avoiding complex manufacturing outside the body. * Our platform is designed for precision, so the right cells are safely programmed to effectively fight cancer. * This technology has the potential to treat a wide range of cancers with a streamlined, scalable process. **Our goal is simple:** develop next\-generation delivery technologies to bring genetic engineering and cell therapies to more patients. How We Work Azalea is building ambitious science in a fast\-moving environment. The people who thrive here are accountable, adaptable, rigorous, humble, and direct. Across roles and functions, we look for team members who demonstrate the following:* **Outcome Ownership \-** We own results, close loops, and follow through without needing to be prompted. We take responsibility for moving work forward and making sure important decisions, deliverables, and handoffs do not fall through the cracks. * **Comfort with Ambiguity \-** We operate in an early\-stage environment where information may be incomplete and priorities may evolve. We clarify quickly, make thoughtful decisions with the information available, and adapt without unnecessary drama. * **High Standards, Low Ego \-** We care deeply about the quality of the work and the impact it can have for patients. We raise the bar while staying humble, direct, and open to feedback. * **Collaboration and Candor \-** We share context early, communicate clearly, partner across functions, and operate with transparency. We believe strong collaboration requires both trust and direct communication. The Opportunity Azalea Therapeutics is seeking a Research Associate I/II to join its Research \& Development team. This hands\-on laboratory role will support the advancement of AZA\-2509 and Azalea’s next\-generation delivery platform by developing, optimizing, and executing robust cell\-based assays, generating high\-quality data, and maintaining rigorous laboratory records. The successful candidate will work closely with scientists and colleagues across research, process development, analytical development, and preclinical functions to evaluate EDV delivery, genome editing, T\-cell engineering, and candidate performance. The position will be filled at the Research Associate I or Research Associate II level based on the candidate’s experience, technical depth, and demonstrated independence. Key Responsibilities* Execute and support development of cell\-based assays evaluating EDV delivery, genome editing, T\-cell engineering, cellular activity, and candidate performance. * Culture, expand, and maintain mammalian cell lines and primary immune cells using aseptic technique; monitor cell health, viability, density, and passage history. * Perform cell\-based functional and potency assays using relevant readouts such as ddPCR for editing, multicolor flow cytometry, plate\-based viability or reporter assays, and cytotoxicity. * Optimize assay conditions, including cell seeding density, stimulation parameters, dose range, incubation time, controls, and acceptance criteria, to improve sensitivity, dynamic range, robustness, and reproducibility. * Prepare test articles, samples, reagents, controls, and assay plates according to approved protocols and experimental plans. * Collect, analyze, and summarize assay data using appropriate software; evaluate assay performance, identify trends and outliers, and document deviations. * Maintain complete, accurate, and timely records in electronic laboratory notebooks and other controlled systems, following applicable procedures and data\-integrity expectations. * Prepare experimental summaries and communicate results at team meetings; contribute data and figures to technical reports and presentations. * Troubleshoot routine assay and cell\-culture issues, esc y factors such as experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job\-related factors permitted by law. * Benefits offered include paid time off, paid holiday’s, medical, dental, vision, 401k with Company match, and other employee benefits and perks. Azalea’s Commitments **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO):** Azalea Therapeutics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. **Reasonable Accommodation:** We will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities and to individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, consistent with applicable law. To request accommodation, email HR at \[HR email]. Applicant Privacy: Azalea collects and uses applicant personal information for recruiting and employment purposes. If applicable, Azalea will provide a California applicant privacy notice describing categories of information collected, purposes, retention, and rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA).**Job Description Disclaimer:** This job description may change at any time based on business needs. It is not a contract and does not create a promise of employment for any particular duration. **Notice to Recruiters/Staffing Agencies:** Recruiters and staffing agencies should not contact Azalea Therapeutics through this page. jobs.description: **Job Title:** Research Associate I/II (Molecular Biology)**Department:** Research \& Development **Reports to:** Senior Scientist I, Analytical Development **Location:** Onsite 5 days a week \- HQ\- Berkeley, CA **Employment Type:** Full\-time **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Bonus/Equity:** Eligible About Azalea**Azalea Therapeutics enabling precision genome engineering directly inside the body, with an initial focus on creating cancer immunotherapies** ***in vivo*****.** Azalea is pioneering a new way to turn a person’s own T cells into a powerful cancer therapy — directly inside the body. Instead of removing cells and manipulating them in a lab, we use precision genome editing tools to engineer T cells where they already live. At the center of our approach are Enveloped Delivery Vehicles, or EDVs. As highly selective couriers, EDVs are designed to specifically locate T cells within the patient and deliver our genome engineering cargo. Once inside the cell, the anti\-cancer agent is inserted into a precise site in the genome, ensuring safe and potent modifications to fortify the T cells against cancers. **Why this matters:*** We aim to make cell therapy faster and more accessible by avoiding complex manufacturing outside the body. * Our platform is designed for precision, so the right cells are safely programmed to effectively fight cancer. * This technology has the potential to treat a wide range of cancers with a streamlined, scalable process. **Our goal is simple:** develop next\-generation delivery technologies to bring genetic engineering and cell therapies to more patients. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: **About RADICL** As the leading provider of Cybersecurity\-as\-a\-Service (CSaaS), RADICL is revolutionizing advanced cyberthreat protection for small and medium\-sized businesses (SMBs) in the U.S. Defense Industrial Base (DIB) and other regulated industries. No longer should SMBs be satisfied with lack luster solutions delivering lack luster protection. RADICL is ushering in a new era of turn\-key and affordable cyberthreat protection via its AI\-powered virtual SOC platform that allows human and digital agents to quickly and seamlessly become SMBs’ day\-to\-day compliance and security operations team. RADICL’s turn\-key CSaaS offering uniquely combines compliance management with AI and expert\-driven 24/7 security operations. We guide customers to regulatory and best practice adherence with standards like CMMC and NIST CSF while also delivering 24/7 threat monitoring, deep\-spectrum™ threat hunting, incident response, vulnerability management, and security awareness training. With RADICL, customers can stay mission focused, confident their front, rear, and flank are protected, affordably and without compromise. If you’re excited about working with industry experts to help SMBs focus on growing their businesses without the constant worry of security and compliance risks, we invite you to join us in our mission to protect American businesses and drive innovation in cybersecurity. **About the role** We are seeking a **Senior Product Designer** who has been part of a high\-performance engineering team building innovative products and exceptional UIs. You will work directly with security service providers using our vSOC platform and with end\-users who operate it self\-service—ensuring the product is discoverable, delightful, and highly productive for both user groups. You will partner with Product Management and Engineering to shape experience concepts, rationalize feasibility and cost, and bring solutions to market quickly in an iterative, evidence\-driven manner. **About You** You enjoy fast\-paced environments, bring a positive attitude, and excel at getting things done. You enjoy being part of a high performing team and are also able to self\-direct and self\-start. You consider yourself to be top tier talent and are eager to help others raise their game. You enjoy working with customers, are an excellent communicator, and able to engage and interact with people of various backgrounds and skill levels. You want your work to have meaning, to be important. You want to be part of creating something great. **As a RADICL Senior Product Designer, you will:** * **Human \+ Agent Experience Design** * + Design workflows where humans and intelligent agents collaborate to solve problems, troubleshoot threats, and complete security tasks efficiently. + Lead UX for distributed SOC operations—supporting high\-urgency, high\-clarity decision flows. * **Dual\-Persona UX Research \& Design** * + Work directly with **service provider analysts** to deeply understand their workflows and how a vSOC platform enables scale. + Engage with **SMB end\-users** to ensure the product is easy to adopt, onboard, navigate, and realize value from without expert knowledge. * **Design Delivery** * + Create **wireframes, information architecture, interaction models,** and **low\- to high\-fidelity prototypes** (clickable and testable). + Translate conceptual workflows into clear, testable UX solutions. * **Rapid User Testing \& Validation** * + Facilitate usability tests, discovery interviews, and structured feedback loops. + Turn user insights into hypotheses and iterative design improvements. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * + Work hand\-in\-hand with engineers to ensure solutions are actionable, performant, and mindful of technical constraints. + Partner with Product to prioritize the right problems, validate assumptions early, and rationalize decisions against cost and complexity. * **Establish UX Standards** * + Contribute to the growing design system, accessibility standards, design patterns, and UX guidelines for an AI\-driven security platform **What You Bring:** * 6\+ years in a design role for a B2B SaaS company dealing with high data volume, complex workflows, and ideally, a multi\-product platform. * Proven background embedded within a high\-performance engineering team, building innovative products where the UI is a core competitive and commercial differentiator. * Strong portfolio demonstrating: * + Effective workflow and interaction design + Data\-dense or operational tool UI + Design \+ engineering collaboration + Research insight prototype shipped solution lifecycle * Proficiency with leading design tools such as **Figma** (preferred), **FigJam**, and prototyping frameworks with Figma Make or Claude Design. * Strong capability in translating complex technical processes into clear, intuitive experiences. * A strong systems thinker who obsesses over usability, clarity, and measurable outcomes. * Experience working in **agile** and **fast\-moving** startup environments. **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Familiarity with SOC operations, cybersecurity tooling, or IT service management products * Experience designing **agentic or AI\-assisted workflows** * Understanding of analytics\-driven UX and user onboarding frameworks * Experience contributing to or coding in front\-end environments (React, TypeScript) **Why Join Us:** * Build the future of security operations—where **AI augments human defenders** * Contribute to a mission that protects critical industries and innovative SMBs * Significant ownership of product direction and user experience outcomes * Work in a high\-trust, high\-impact culture built for execution, craft, and creativity within a product\-led company. **About the Workplace** At RADICL, we prioritize our culture and believe the strongest teams are built through daily, side\-by\-side collaboration and experiential sharing. We also value individual freedom and flexibility. For this reason, we have a hybrid work model. As a team, we are in office M/W/Th with work\-from\-home on Tuesdays and Fridays. For remote positions, periodic travel to Boulder will be expected to participate in company events and meaningful side\-by\-side collaboration opportunities. RADICL offices are in downtown Boulder, Colorado with easy\-to\-access employee parking provided by the company. We offer comprehensive, competitive benefits including health, dental, and vision as well as 401K and a responsible PTO plan. We encourage motivated, talented, mission\-oriented, and fun people to apply. **Let’s do this!** **The pay range for this role is:** 140,000 \- 180,000 USD per year(Boulder, CO)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – SpacetimeDB Core
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer – SpacetimeDB Core** Clockwork Labs is a remote\-first technology company building infrastructure for massive real\-time distributed applications. Our flagship product, SpacetimeDB, is a high\-performance serverless database and platform for real\-time, large\-scale shared\-state systems. It is battle\-tested through our own cross\-platform MMO, BitCraft Online, and is now expanding beyond games to demanding web and real\-time applications. We are a small, highly skilled team that values ownership, a flat structure, and close collaboration. We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to join the team working on the core of SpacetimeDB: the transaction engine, storage and commitlog, and the client protocols. This is a role for someone with deep Rust and database\-internals experience. **Role Responsibilities** **Hands\-on engineering** * Design, build, and maintain core components of SpacetimeDB. * Investigate and resolve bugs in the database: deadlocks, race conditions, data\-store and commitlog inconsistencies, and performance regressions. * Review pull requests thoroughly. * Set expectations for how the team uses AI tooling without lowering the bar for correctness, testing, or maintainability. * Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions. **Community and operations** * Engage with the SpacetimeDB developer community and support users and customers directly when needed. * Participate in a weekly on\-call rotation. **Qualifications** **Required** * Expert\-level Rust and Cargo, including a deep understanding of ownership, lifetimes, and memory allocation. * Solid understanding of database internals: MVCC, transactions, write ahead logs, and storage engines. * Ability to reason about concurrency and systems\-level problems such as deadlocks, lock contention, and I/O issues. * Strong knowledge of Linux internals: system calls, how they affect user programs, and how the kernel, file system, and storage layer (including network\-attached storage) affect disk I/O. * Experience managing breaking changes, versioning, and backward compatibility in systems with existing users. * Proficiency with Git, GitHub, and GitHub Actions, and a track record of rigorous code review and testing. * A pragmatic view of AI in software development: you know where the tools help and where they fall short, and you can review AI\-generated code critically without dismissing it outright. * Clear written and verbal communication with a multidisciplinary team. * Comfort supporting external developers and customers in a public community. **Preferred** * Distributed systems and networking experience (TCP, HTTP, WebSocket). * Familiarity with WebAssembly runtimes. * Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud providers such as DigitalOcean or AWS. * Open\-source contribution or maintenance. * Experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux. **Working at Clockwork Labs** Clockwork Labs is a fully remote global team. We meet daily, so successful applicants will need to be available during our core collaboration hours. Our goal is to provide fair and equitable compensation based on market location as well as an individual candidate's specific qualifications for an open role. Consequently, high cost of living areas may expect offers in the higher end of the range whereas lower cost of living areas may expect offers in the lower end of the range. Offers may also be adjusted based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to the same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include equity awards, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if a candidate receives an offer of employment.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Linux Kernel
jobs.description: Efficient Computer is rethinking computing from the ground up to solve one of AI's biggest challenges: energy. Our Fabric architecture delivers a 10–100x improvement in energy efficiency for general\-purpose computation, including AI, while supporting familiar programming languages and software frameworks—unlocking new possibilities for autonomous machines, intelligent infrastructure, wearables, and space systems. With our first processor, Electron E1, now shipping in volume and more than $97 million in Series B financing recently announced, we're accelerating customer deployments and scaling our architecture to data center performance. Join us to build the hardware and software that bring intelligence wherever it's needed and help shape the next generation of computing. Efficient Computer is building the next generation of energy efficient, general\-purpose processors designed around the Fabric architecture, a novel spatial dataflow design spun out from decades of fundamental SOC research at CMU. We are looking for a Senior Staff Linux Kernel Driver Engineer to own the kernel\-mode driver that brings our Fabric to life. You will bring up new silicon from the very first boot, often before the silicon exists, working in QEMU, functional simulation, emulation, and FPGA environments to make sure our runtime software layers work on day one. This is a key role for the System Software team: you will work closely with architecture, micro\-architecture, verification and compiler teams during pre\-silicon development and bring\-up. **Key Responsibilities** ### **Own the Kernel Driver** * Design, implement, and maintain the Linux kernel\-mode driver for the Fabric accelerator. This includes device discovery and probe, MMIO register interfaces, interrupt handling, command and completion queue management, power management, firmware, chip diagnostics, logging and device health, as well as abstracting the user\-space ABI with a HAL that the runtime depends on. * Define how custom hardware accelerators are exposed to Linux: ioctl and sysfs interfaces, and the submission and synchronization model between application cores and the Fabric. * Keep the driver clean, upstreamable in style, and portable across kernel and device versions. * Implement the unified memory model between ARM cores and the Fabric accelerator. * Own SMMU (IOMMU) integration: stream and context configuration, tensor pool allocation, page table management, stage\-1 and stage\-2 translation, shared virtual addressing, and fault handling. ### **Drive Pre\-Silicon Bringup and Platform Enablement** * Build and maintain QEMU device models and board definitions for the Fabric and its SoC so that the kernel, driver, and runtime can be developed and tested before silicon. * Own the Linux boot path on new platforms: boot firmware handoff, device tree, kernel configuration, early console, and root filesystem, from the first boot in emulation through FPGA prototypes to production silicon. * Lead kernel\-side bring up on first silicon: validating MMIO map, interrupts, clocks, resets, and memory against the hardware specification, and turning what you find into bug reports and design feedback for the hardware team. * Be the go\-to engineer for kernel debugging across the stack: crash dumps, KGDB and JTAG, ftrace and perf, lockdep and KASAN, and the hard\-to\-reproduce hangs and memory corruptions that only show up on real hardware. * Establish kernel\-level test coverage, including driver unit tests, emulation\-based regression suites, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop validation. **Required Qualifications** * B.S. in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent; M.S. a plus. * **7\+ years** of systems software experience, including **significant hands\-on Linux kernel\-mode driver development** for complex devices (accelerators, GPUs, NPUs, networking, or storage). * Deep understanding of Linux kernel memory management, including cache coherence, IOMMU/SMMU configuration, and unified or shared virtual memory between CPU and accelerators. * Hands\-on experience with QEMU, emulation, or simulation environments, including writing or extending device models and board definitions. * Experience with pre\-silicon hardware bring up and first\-silicon enablement, working from hardware specifications and register maps before the platform is stable. * Experience designing runtime interfaces between kernel and user space: ABI and HAL design, synchronization, memory sharing, and error handling. * Strong kernel debugging skills across crash analysis, tracing, hardware debuggers, and race and memory\-corruption diagnosis. * Fluency with memory\-mapped I/O: register\-level programming, ordering and barrier semantics, and interrupt handling. * Experience interfacing custom hardware accelerators to Linux. * Strong experience with ARM cores and the ARM architecture (AArch64, exception levels, GIC, SMMU, cache and memory attributes). * Solid understanding of the Linux boot flow: boot firmware, device tree, kernel initialization, and early platform enablement. * Expert C and strong scripting skills; comfortable working with AI\-assisted development tools for code, analysis, and debugging. **Desired Qualifications** * Experience with FPGA prototyping and hardware emulation platforms (Palladium, Zebu, Veloce, or similar). * Knowledge of dataflow, spatial, or other novel compute architectures, and of how compilers and runtimes target them. * Experience on a first\-generation silicon product, where the software stack and the hardware matured together. * Experience working on a CUDA, ROCm, or other language runtime software stack. We offer a competitive base salary for this role, generally ranging from $220,000 to $270,000, plus a 10% annual bonus, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits. Final compensation will depend on experience, level, and location, with flexibility for the right candidate. **Why Join Efficient?** Build what's next. At Efficient, you'll tackle big challenges with room to take ownership and make an impact. We back you with competitive pay, equity, a 401(k) match, company\-paid benefits, paid parental leave, and flexibility—plus opportunities to grow your skills and career as we scale.

This includes device discovery and probe, MMIO register interfaces, interrupt handling, command and completion queue management, power management, firmware, chip diagnostics, logging and device health, as well as abstracting the user\-space ABI with a HAL that the runtime depends on. * Define how custom hardware accelerators are exposed to Linux: ioctl and sysfs interfaces, and the submission and synchronization model between application cores and the Fabric. * Keep the driver clean, upstreamable in style, and portable across kernel and device versions. * Implement the unified memory model between ARM cores and the Fabric accelerator. * Own SMMU (IOMMU) integration: stream and context configuration, tensor pool allocation, page table management, stage\-1 and stage\-2 translation, shared virtual addressing, and fault handling. ### **Drive Pre\-Silicon Bringup and Platform Enablement** * Build and maintain QEMU device models and board definitions for the Fabric and its SoC so that the kernel, driver, and runtime can be developed and tested before silicon. * Own the Linux boot path on new platforms: boot firmware handoff, device tree, kernel configuration, early console, and root filesystem, from the first boot in emulation through FPGA prototypes to production silicon. * Lead kernel\-side bring up on first silicon: validating MMIO map, interrupts, clocks, resets, and memory against the hardware specification, and turning what you find into bug reports and design feedback for the hardware team. * Be the go\-to engineer for kernel debugging across the stack: crash dumps, KGDB and JTAG, ftrace and perf, lockdep and KASAN, and the hard\-to\-reproduce hangs and memory corruptions that only show up on real hardware. * Establish kernel\-level test coverage, including driver unit tests, emulation\-based regression suites, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop validation. **Required Qualifications** * B.S. in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent; M.S. a plus. * **7\+ years** of systems software experience, including **significant hands\-on Linux kernel\-mode driver development** for complex devices (accelerators, GPUs, NPUs, networking, or storage). * Deep understanding of Linux kernel memory management, including cache coherence, IOMMU/SMMU configuration, and unified or shared virtual memory between CPU and accelerators. * Hands\-on experience with QEMU, emulation, or simulation environments, including writing or extending device models and board definitions. * Experience with pre\-silicon hardware bring up and first\-silicon enablement, working from hardware specifications and register maps before the platform is stable. * Experience designing runtime interfaces between kernel and user space: ABI and HAL design, synchronization, memory sharing, and error handling. * Strong kernel debugging skills across crash analysis, tracing, hardware debuggers, and race and memory\-corruption diagnosis. * Fluency with memory\-mapped I/O: register\-level programming, ordering and barrier semantics, and interrupt handling. * Experience interfacing custom hardware accelerators to Linux. * Strong experience with ARM cores and the ARM architecture (AArch64, exception levels, GIC, SMMU, cache and memory attributes). * Solid understanding of the Linux boot flow: boot firmware, device tree, kernel initialization, and early platform enablement. * Expert C and strong scripting skills; comfortable working with AI\-assisted development tools for code, analysis, and debugging. **Desired Qualifications** * Experience with FPGA prototyping and hardware emulation platforms (Palladium, Zebu, Veloce, or similar). * Knowledge of dataflow, spatial, or other novel compute architectures, and of how compilers and runtimes target them. * Experience on a first\-generation silicon product, where the software stack and the hardware matured together. * Experience working on a CUDA, ROCm, or other language runtime software stack. We offer a competitive base salary for this role, generally ranging from $220,000 to $270,000, plus a 10% annual bonus, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits. Final compensation will depend on experience, level, and location, with flexibility for the right candidate. **Why Join Efficient?** Build what's next. At Efficient, you'll tackle big challenges with room to take ownership and make an impact. We back you with competitive pay, equity, a 401(k) match, company\-paid benefits, paid parental leave, and flexibility—plus opportunities to grow your skills and career as we scale.

This role combines hands\-on vehicle testing, technical troubleshooting, data analysis, programming, and technical report development to support customer validation and testing activities. Responsibilities** Responsibilities: Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following: Other duties may be assigned or requested.* Vehicle Testing and Validation: + Conducts track tests on vehicles to assess their performance including precision driving maneuvers, and the operation of various specialized track equipment such as steering robots, braking robots, robotic platforms, soft targets, etc. + Drives vehicles in various stages of production and development according to strict speed and position tolerances. + Checking and troubleshooting instrumentation and data collection systems + Understands requirements of existing test procedures and protocols. + Understands and complies with testing procedures and ensures the quality of the test output * Data Analysis and procedures + Complete required safety training, attending scheduled meetings. + Using equipment properly, and wearing appropriate PPE as required (face covers, ear plugs, gloves etc.) ### **What are vehicle maintenance knowledge – jump starting vehicles, changing tires, etc. * Working knowledge of physics, electronics, dynamics, mechanical design and assembly, data protocols such as CAN, ethernet, etc. * Experience with MATLAB or other coding language. * Experience with MS Office products including Excel and Word * Strong attention to detail, ability to maintain client confidentiality, and excellent communication skills. **Physical Demands and Work Environment:** Must be able to walk, bend, reach, and lift, if necessary 50 pounds or more. As an innovative and dynamic company, we foster a supportive and collaborative work environment where employees are encouraged to grow and excel. Along with competitive salaries, we offer a range of benefits designed to promote your well\-being and work\-life balance. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive, equal\-opportunity workplace for all employees and applicants. We will consider all qualified applicants consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for hiring. *We use AI to help us assess applications fairly and objectively.* ### **About Dynamic Research Inc. jobs.description: CFSA requires a senior, deeply hands\-on Solution Architect resource to serve as the technical design authority for STAAND (Stronger Together Against Abuse and Neglect in DC), the District's federally certified Comprehensive Child Welfare Information System (CCWIS). STAAND is a person\-centric, AI\-enabled platform built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform hosted in a Government Community Cloud (GCC) tenant, with Azure services operating in Microsoft's commercial cloud. It supports CFSA social workers, supervisors, private agency partners, providers, resource parents, and District sister agencies across nine functional modules — Intake and Investigations, Case Management, ICPC, Finance (Contracts, Service Logs, and Fiscal), Provider, Eligibility and Subsidy, Placement, Services, and Management Reports — plus six external portals (Mandated Reporter, MPD, NYTD, OSSE, Resource Parent, and Community). STAAND also fields CORA, an AI assistant supporting natural\-language search and AI\-assisted contact notes among other use cases. The Resource will own architecture, security design, AI engineering, and the platform\-release change cadence required to keep STAAND current and improving. This is a build\-and\-design role, not an advisory or oversight role. The Resource is expected to personally configure, code, prototype, review, and troubleshoot in the platform while serving as the credible technical voice to CFSA executive leadership, STAAND Product Team, OCTO, Microsoft, and Federal Partners (ACF/Children's Bureau). sign off on solution designs before build. * Diagnose deep platform issues: performance degradation, API and service\-protection limits, plug\-in execution ordering, solution layering conflicts, storage growth, portal rendering. * Maintain architecture artifacts sufficient to satisfy CCWIS review, federal audit, and District IT governance. **3\.2 Cross\-Cloud Architecture: GCC and Commercial Azure** * Design, document, and harden the boundary between the GCC Dynamics/Power Platform tenant and Azure commercial\-cloud services. * Define what data may traverse that boundary, in what form (de\-identified, tokenized, aggregated, or full record), under what authorization, and with what logging — including explicit architectural boundaries for protected data categories such as Medicaid Enrollment. * Implement cross\-tenant identity, managed identities, service principals, Key Vault secret lifecycle, private networking, and API gateway patterns. * Maintain a defensible position on data residency and FedRAMP authorization boundaries for every commercial\-cloud service in use, and present that position to auditors and federal reviewers. **3\.3 AI and Agentic Development** * Serve as hands\-on technical lead for CFSA's AI capability, including CORA and its expansion into agentic workflows. * Design, build, evaluate, and productionize agents in Azure AI Foundry and Copilot Studio: tool and function calling, orchestration and multi\-agent patterns, grounding and retrieval over Dataverse and document stores, prompt and context engineering, structured output, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints. * Own AI evaluation discipline: golden datasets, automated evals, groundedness and hallucination measurement, regression testing on model or prompt changes, latency and cost benchmarking, controlled rollout. * Manage the AI model lifecycle — track model releases and deprecations, run comparative evaluation before adopting a new model, execute migrations without regression to worker\-facing quality. * Implement responsible AI controls appropriate to a child welfare setting: content safety, PII/PHI handling, bias and fairness testing, explainability, audit logging of AI\-influenced actions, and clear framing of AI output as decision support rather than decision making. * Support predictive and analytic capability aligned to agency mission priorities, ensuring models are validated, monitored for drift, and governed. * Build reusable AI platform assets — prompt libraries, agent templates, evaluation harnesses, observability dashboards. **3\.4 controls, duplicate person detection and merge integrity, and reconciliation with legacy records. **3\.7 Stakeholder and Senior Leadership Engagement** * Translate between social work practice and technical architecture; observe real workflow with intake workers, investigators, case managers, placement staff, and fiscal teams before designing for it. * Brief the CFSA IT Steering Committee
