jobs.title: AI Engineer 4 (Gen AI Platform Services: Agentic AI, Agent Guardrails, Agent Evaluation, Agent Memory)
jobs.description: AI Engineer 4 (Gen AI Platform Services: Agentic AI, Agent Guardrails, Agent Evaluation, Agent Memory) At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi\-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Own the end\-to\-end architecture for complex AI systems \- ensuring maintainability, observability, and ethical alignment * Define and maintain service\-level objectives (SLOs) for AI reliability, including latency, uptime, and model performance drift * Collaborate with infrastructure engineering to optimize GPU/TPU utilization and accelerate model inference pipelines * Lead cross\-functional technical reviews for new AI system deployments, ensuring security, data governance, and compliance standards are met * Mentor Principal and Senior Associates on scalable design, performance tuning and research\-to\-production translation **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good * Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven * You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss * You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 4 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 2 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies * At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, CUDA, or Java **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience leading development AI systems with tradeoff decisions around cost, latency, throughput and accuracy * 6\+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI , throughput, and cost * Experience in building agentic AI systems and agentic workflows * Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * Proficiency in designing distributed systems for model training, evaluation, and online inference at petabyte scale * Experience defining AI model governance processes, including producibility, lineage tracking, and automated retaining schedules * Demonstrated ability to influence architectural decisions across multiple AI product lines or platforms ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. Cambridge, MA: $197,300 \- $225,100 for AI Engineer 4 McLean, VA: $197,300 \- $225,100 for AI Engineer 4 New York, NY: $215,200 \- $245,600 for AI Engineer 4 San Francisco, CA: $215,200 \- $245,600 for AI Engineer 4 San Jose, CA: $215,200 \- $245,600 for AI Engineer 4 Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter. This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan. Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well\-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part\-time status, exempt or non\-exempt status, and management level. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non\-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug\-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23\-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901\-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries. If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1\-800\-304\-9102 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third\-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site. Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp. (COPSSC).

jobs.title: Principal Associate, Data Scientist - Capital One Personal Loan
jobs.description: Principal Associate, Data Scientist \- Capital One Personal Loan Data is at the center of everything we do. jobs.description: Senior Associate, Product Management \- Applied AI**Product Management** Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry. Do you dream of well\-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? jobs.description: Sr. Business Analyst \- People Strategy \& Analytics People Strategy \& Analytics is an emerging field where Capital One is on the leading front. Our team brings data, analytics, and insights to shape critical talent decisions and workforce strategy at Capital One. We work closely with HR partners and senior executives in shaping talent policy, automating real\-time data and improving talent decision\-making. jobs.title: Technical Delivery Manager (Client-Facing TPM)
jobs.description: **Location:** Remote, United States **Travel:** Approximately one to three trips per year to Irvine, California, or a client location **Employment type:** Full\-time **Compensation:** $100,000–$150,000 base salary, depending on experience and location **Travel:** Occasional travel to Irvine, California, and client locations ***About Cappital*** Cappital is a product strategy and software development firm. We help organizations define, design, build, and continuously improve custom digital products. We are a small, highly collaborative U.S.\-based team that works closely with a long\-standing engineering organization in India. People here work across functions, stay close to the work, and take personal responsibility for helping clients succeed. ***About the role*** We are hiring a hands\-on Technical Delivery Manager to support one of our largest and most strategically important client relationships. You will serve as a stateside bridge among the client’s product and engineering stakeholders, other technology vendors, and Cappital’s engineering team in India. You will frequently participate in client meetings with engineers when no Cappital engineer is present. You must be able to understand the discussion, ask useful questions, identify dependencies and unresolved decisions, represent established engineering positions accurately, and keep work moving without making unsupported technical commitments. This is a client\-facing technical program and delivery role. It is not a software engineering or architecture position, but it is also not a nontechnical project\-management role. What this role is—and is not * It is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role. You will personally lead meetings, clarify requirements, document decisions, maintain delivery details, and follow up with stakeholders. * It is not a portfolio\-governance, executive\-oversight, or large\-team management position. * You will not independently set software architecture or override the engineers responsible for technical decisions. * You will be expected to understand technical issues well enough to improve the discussion, recognize missing information, and accurately communicate what engineering has decided. * Success depends on creating clarity in an environment where priorities, processes, and stakeholder expectations may change frequently. **What you will do** Lead client\-facing technical delivery * Serve as a trusted and responsive technical\-delivery contact during U.S. business hours. * Facilitate discussions involving requirements, integrations, implementation status, technical constraints, risks, incidents, and delivery tradeoffs. * Build productive relationships with client engineers, product stakeholders, other vendors, and Cappital team members. * Communicate uncertainty candidly without losing credibility, creating unnecessary alarm, or implying commitments that engineering has not made. * Identify emerging concerns and expectation gaps before they become escalations. Translate between stakeholders and engineering * Translate client objectives, questions, and concerns into clear technical and delivery inputs. * Translate engineering constraints, dependencies, risks, and recommendations into language appropriate for the audience. * Represent established engineering decisions accurately while recognizing when an engineer or specialist needs to participate directly. * Ask technically informed questions that expose assumptions, missing requirements, failure modes, and decision boundaries. * Adapt your communication for engineers, product leaders, executives, and external partners. Create and maintain delivery clarity * Maintain a dependable source of truth across roadmap documents, technical decisions, tickets, milestones, and client commitments. * Identify contradictions among product goals, architecture decisions, delivery plans, and implementation status; bring the right people together to resolve them. * Proactively trace the likely technical and operational implications of new requests. Understand the platform well enough to recognize when a change to one feature, integration, data flow, analytics implementation, or workflow may affect another system or team; involve the appropriate stakeholders before incomplete or conflicting direction reaches engineering. * Distinguish among proposed, decided, implemented, tested, approved, released, and operationally ready. * Turn ambiguous requests into sufficiently defined problems, requirements, acceptance criteria, owners, dependencies, and next actions. * Maintain clear records of decisions, assumptions, risks, unresolved questions, and follow\-up commitments. * Keep handoffs moving between U.S. stakeholders and the India engineering team with minimal avoidable delay. Support reliable delivery and handoffs * Maintain visibility into milestones, risks, dependencies, approvals, and delivery health. * Coordinate handoffs involving code, CMS content, assets, configuration, analytics, env livery, implementation, consulting, or client leadership and still enjoys hands\-on coordination. * Solutions engineer or implementation architect whose responsibilities extended beyond presales into delivery and stakeholder ownership. * Technical consultant or application leader who personally coordinated complex integrations, releases, and distributed engineering teams. * Delivery leader from a digital product agency, technology consultancy, or enterprise\-software implementation organization. ***Working style that succeeds here*** * You listen carefully and get to the point. * You separate facts, assumptions, decisions, and unresolved questions. * You can disagree or surface risk without becoming combative or dramatic. * You are comfortable saying, “I need to confirm that with engineering,” and then reliably closing the loop. * You notice details, prepare for meetings, and follow through without repeated reminders. * You use enough process to create clarity but do not add ceremony for its own sake. * You adapt when the client changes priorities or working practices rather than insisting that everyone adopt your preferred system. * You care about both the client’s outcome and the sustainability of the engineering team. ***What success looks like*** During the first 30 days * Learn the client environment, current platform, active work, major stakeholders, and established decision boundaries. * Join the relevant client and engineering meetings, ask strong questions, and begin maintaining clear follow\-up and decision records. * Accurately route or respond to client requests while being transparent about what still requires engineering input. * Establish a dependable communication rhythm with Cappital’s engineering lead and CTO. Within 60–90 days * Independently facilitate routine client discussions involving technical delivery. * Recognize contradictions, missing decisions, and emerging risks early enough to act. * Help technical questions and delivery decisions move efficiently across teams and time zones. * Improve the clarity of requirements, ownership, acceptance criteria, and commitments. * Reduce the routine coordination and escalation burden on senior Cappital leaders without reducing technical accuracy. ***Compensation and benefits*** The anticipated base salary range is $100,000–$150,000, depending on relevant experience, technical background, geographic location, and demonstrated client\-delivery capability. The position also includes Cappital’s standard employee benefits. ***Working environment*** This is a remote position open to candidates authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. Occasional travel—generally one to three trips per year—may be required for client meetings, team planning, or visits to our Irvine, California, office. ***Our client environment*** Our clients include commercial businesses, nonprofit organizations, faith\-based organizations, and organizations working in political media. Their missions, viewpoints, cultures, and meeting practices may differ from your own. Employees are not required to share a client’s beliefs, make statements of faith, lead prayer, or participate in religious observances. This role does require respectful and professional service to every client and colleague. ***Equal opportunity*** Cappital is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Vision insurance Experience: * software engineering: 4 years (Preferred) * technical delivery: 4 years (Preferred) * solutions engineering: 4 years (Preferred) * technical program management: 4 years (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Irvine, CA 92618

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Mid Level
jobs.description: **Location:** Dallas, Texas. In office 4 days out of 5\. Local candidates only. NO relocation assistance is offered. **Team:** Product Development **Reports to:** Platform Architect **Experience:** 2\+ years of professional software development **About the role** ------------------ Our engineering team builds Optimize, an energy analysis SaaS platform. The platform monitors utility consumption, identifies savings opportunities, and tracks energy conservation measures across building portfolios. You will work across all of Optimize: web apps, mobile apps, internal admin tools, and the backend services behind them. We build software with AI coding agents every day. We expect you to be a strong engineer **and** a skilled user of agentic coding tools. We test both in depth during the interview. **What you will do** -------------------- * Design, build and ship features end to end: API, data model, web UI and, when needed, mobile UI. * Work in the Node.js / TypeScript backend that all other apps use to communicate. * Build and maintain React front ends. * Write automated tests and keep the existing test suites healthy. * Use AI coding agents to plan, write, refactor and test code. * Review agent output with the same care you give to a colleague’s pull request. * Take part in sprint planning, backlog refinement and code review. * Work closely with the Platform Architect, the UX designer, and the testing engineers who own QA for each app. * Investigate and fix production issues that product support escalates. **What you bring** ------------------ ### **Required skills** * 2\+ years of professional experience building web applications. * TypeScript and JavaScript. * React, including hooks and component design, with React Query and React Hook Form, or similar. * Node.js with Express. * PostgreSQL: schema design, SQL and handling database migrations. * Unit and integration testing with Vitest and Jest, or similar. * Git, pull requests and code review on GitHub, or similar. * Hands\-on experience with Docker, Redis and AWS S3 on real projects. * Building and deploying containerized applications, on AWS ECS or similar. * Message queues for background and async work, such as sending jobs to workers and handling retries, with AWS SQS or similar. * The ability to read and change a large codebase that you did not write. ### **Agentic coding** * You use an AI coding agent (for example, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Copilot) in your daily work, not only for autocomplete. Our team uses Claude Code exclusively. * You can break a task into steps an agent can execute, give it the right context, and steer it when it goes off course. * You review, test, and verify what the agent produces. You own the correctness of every line you merge, whoever or whatever wrote it. * You know when to stop the agent and write the code yourself. * You can explain how you give an agent context, for example with CLAUDE.md files, rules, or skills. * You can explain how you check agent output, and you can describe where your agentic workflow has failed and what you changed. We assess this hands\-on in the interview. ### **Nice to have** You do not need these on day one. We will give you the opportunity to learn them. * React Native and Expo. * Elasticsearch or OpenSearch. * Vite and webpack. * AWS DynamoDB, Athena, and Bedrock. * Python. * Prisma. * Experience with energy, utilities, facilities, or building\-management data. **Interview process** --------------------- ### **Step 1: Technical screening** A 30\-minute video call with someone from our development team. You walk us through your recent work and the projects that you built or owned. The call may also include a code review exercise. ### **Step 2: On\-site interview** If the screening is successful, we invite you to a 2\-hour on\-site interview. It has two parts: * **Technical deep dive:** up to 90 minutes. * **Interview with our leadership:** up to 30 minutes. This role requires deep technical knowledge and agentic coding skills, so the 90\-minute session tests both: * You use Claude Code to build a full\-stack solution to a problem on a laptop that we provide. Then you explain what you built. * While the agent works on the problem, we talk with you about your technical expertise, your work experience, and other topics.

jobs.title: Clinician-Developer: Cloud & Integrations
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** Charleston Children's Therapy Center is a pediatric therapy practice offering occupational, physical and speech therapy. We built our own practice management platform because off\-the\-shelf software kept failing our therapists and families. It's HIPAA\-compliant and runs our clinics every day: scheduling, documentation and goal tracking, intake, authorizations, insurance claims and payments, fax intake, payroll, reporting and AI\-assisted workflows. We use modern AI\-assisted development tools, so much of the code is drafted quickly. Automated checks enforce security and HIPAA rules on every change. What we need now is a person who brings two things the tools can't: clinical judgment and hands\-on cloud and integration skills. **WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** Our founder covers product direction and the practice. The gaps are: 1\. Clinical reality checks. Does a workflow make sense to a therapist with a full caseload? Is a note, goal, plan of care or billing rule clinically and payer\-correct? 2\. AWS and production operations. Deployments, monitoring, access control, cost, and responding when something breaks. 3\. Third\-party APIs. Insurance clearinghouse (EDI claims, remittance, eligibility), e\-fax, SMS, payments and email, plus the webhooks that connect them. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** \- Own the AWS side. Keep production healthy, including servers, the managed database, file storage, encryption, monitoring and AI services. Tighten access controls, watch costs, and help write and follow runbooks. \- Integrations and APIs. Debug failed webhooks and API calls, read request/response logs, and work with vendor support. Help add or harden integrations with clearinghouses, fax, SMS and payment providers. \- Clinical product partner. Review new features as a clinician would. Catch workflows that would frustrate therapists or break documentation, billing or compliance rules. Turn real clinic pain points into clear, actionable tickets. \- Review and ship. Review AI\-drafted code changes for correctness, especially clinical logic, billing math and data handling. Test changes in the running app and help get them into production. \- Be the first responder for production issues, with clear notes so nothing gets lost. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** Must have: \- A clinical background: OT, PT, SLP, ABA/BCBA, nursing, or clinical informatics. Pediatric or outpatient therapy experience is a strong plus. Current licensure is not required. \- Hands\-on AWS experience (any of EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Lambda). You should be comfortable in the console and the command line. \- API experience. You've called REST APIs, read JSON payloads, handled authentication and webhooks, and debugged why an integration failed. \- Working knowledge of Python, the terminal and Git/GitHub. \- A HIPAA mindset: you treat patient information carefully, by default. Nice to have: \- Healthcare billing knowledge: CPT/ICD\-10, claims, ERAs/EOBs, authorizations, payer rules, or EDI X12\. \- Flask, SQLAlchemy or PostgreSQL experience. \- Experience with therapy EMR/practice management systems (WebPT, Fusion, TheraNest, etc.) from the clinician side. \- Experience with AI coding assistants, and the habit of checking their output critically. \- CI/CD or Docker experience. Who this fits: a therapist who moved into tech or informatics, a clinician who taught themselves cloud and coding, or a health\-tech engineer with real clinical experience. jobs.title: OT / ICS SOC Analyst
jobs.description: Overview: **OT/ICS SOC Analyst** **Huntsville, Alabama** Are you ready to enhance your skills and build your career in a rapidly evolving business climate? Are you looking for a career where professional development is embedded in your employer’s core culture? If so, Chenega Military, Intelligence \& Operations Support (MIOS) could be the place for you! Join our team of professionals who support large\-scale government operations by leveraging cutting\-edge technology and take your career to the next level! Chronos Operations (CO) is a wholly\-owned subsidiary of Chenega Corporation, an Alaska Native Corporation based in Anchorage, AK. Belonging to the Military, Intelligence, and Operations Support (MIOS) Strategic Business Unit (SBU), Chronos has a culture rooted in integrity, respect, and exceptional performance. Chronos is headquartered in Colorado Springs, CO, and provides mission\-critical services in Advanced Analytics \& AI, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, and Intelligence. We deliver essential cyber services to our customers in support of their missions to sustain the national security and economic interests of our nation. The **OT / ICS SOC Analyst** performs advanced monitoring, threat hunting, anomaly investigation, incident response coordination, and threat analysis across converged IT/OT environments, Industrial Control Systems (ICS), Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) platforms, Distributed Control Systems (DCS), and mission support networks. Operating with increased autonomy within established operational authorities and rules of engagement, the analyst correlates telemetry across the Purdue Model (Levels 1–3\+), evaluates physical process anomalies alongside digital indicators, ensures response measures prioritize personnel safety and process reliability, and continuously improves OT\-specific detection mechanisms, playbooks, and defensive readiness. Responsibilities: * Monitor and analyze security telemetry across network, endpoint, identity, cloud, application, email, and other enterprise sources using approved SIEM, XDR, NDR, and security analytics platforms. * Investigate escalated or complex cybersecurity events to determine validity, scope, affected assets and identities, potential mission impact, and required response actions. * Correlate alerts with asset criticality, vulnerability information, threat intelligence, user behavior, and historical activity to develop evidence\-based analytical conclusions. * Lead or perform incident triage and analysis; collect, preserve, and document relevant evidence in accordance with established procedures and evidence\-handling requirements. * Execute authorized containment and response actions, including host isolation, account restriction, indicator blocking, or other approved measures, and coordinate eradication and recovery activities with responsible stakeholders. * Develop clear incident records, analytical findings, timelines, and technical reports; communicate status, risk, and recommended actions to SOC leadership and mission stakeholders. * Apply threat intelligence, indicators of compromise, adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, and frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK to identify related activity and support defensive recommendations. * Review and validate findings, recommendations, and summaries generated by automated analytics, machine learning, or AI\-enabled cybersecurity capabilities before operational use. * Tune alerts and detection logic, recommend telemetry improvements, and help reduce false positives, coverage gaps, and analyst workload in coordination with detection engineering or platform owners. * Develop, test, maintain, and improve incident response playbooks, standard operating procedures, queries, dashboards, and repeatable analytical workflows. * Participate in or facilitate post\-incident reviews and lessons\-learned activities; translate findings into corrective actions and measurable operational improvements. * Mentor SOC Analyst I personnel, provide quality reviews of escalated cases, and share technical knowledge across shifts and teams. * Support cyber exercises, readiness assessments, recovery validation, and continuous improvement activities as directed by the SOC Lead. * Perform additional duties as assigned. Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field and 3\+ years of relevant experience. * Or applicants may meet one of the following substitutions: + Associate's degree and 5\+ years of relevant experience. + High school diploma or GED equivalent and 7\+ years of relevant experience. + Relevant experience must include cybersecurity operations, security monitoring, network defense, incident response, threat analysis, system administration, or a closely related information technology discipline. At least 2\+ years must involve SOC, cyber   Defense (GRID) + GIAC Critical Infrastructure Protection (GCIP) + ISA/IEC 62443 Cyber Security Specialist/Expert + GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or CISSP Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: * OT/ICS Protocol Analysis: Demonstrated ability to dissect and analyze industrial protocol traffic (Modbus TCP/RTU, DNP3, CIP, Ethernet/IP, OPC, BACnet, PROFINET, S7comm) and identify anomalies such as unauthorized command functions or out\-of\-spec register writes. * Purdue Model \& Boundary Defense: Advanced understanding of industrial network segmentation, IDMZs, jump hosts, dual\-homed servers, unidirectional security gateways (data diodes), and boundary firewall rulebases separating Level 4/5 IT from Level 0–3 OT. * Safe Operational Response: Strict appreciation of the primacy of safety, physical reliability, and process availability over data confidentiality, understanding that standard IT containment methods (e.g., abrupt host isolation or aggressive vulnerability scanning) can cause equipment trips or physical hazards. * Adversary Tradecraft in ICS: Knowledge of real\-world OT/ICS threat actors, destructive malware families (e.g., Industroyer/CrashOverride, TRITON/Trisis, INCONTROLLER/Pipedream), living\-off\-the\-land techniques in engineering environments, and supply chain threats. * Packet \& Tooling Competency: Advanced proficiency in Wireshark, tcpdump, and specialized dissectors, combined with scripting capabilities (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and query building (KQL, SPL, Lucene). * Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Proven ability to bridge the cultural and technical gap between cybersecurity teams and operational plant/controls engineers, translating cyber events into operational and physical consequences. **How you’ll grow** At Chenega MIOS, our professional development plan focuses on helping our team members at every level of their careers to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands\-on experience in the global, fast\-changing business world. From on\-the\-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their careers. **Benefits** At Chenega MIOS, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our team members and offer them a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Chenega MIOS can mean for you. **Chenega MIOS’s culture** Our positive and supportive culture encourages our team members to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well\-being programs and continuously look for new ways to maintain a culture where we excel and lead healthy, happy lives. **Corporate citizenship** Chenega MIOS is led by a purpose to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our team members, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill\-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Chenega’s impact on the world. Chenega MIOS News\- https://chenegamios.com/news/ **Tips from your Talent Acquisition Team** We want job seekers exploring opportunities at Chenega MIOS to feel prepared and confident. To help you with your research, we suggest you review the following links: Chenega MIOS web site \- www.chenegamios.com Glassdoor \- https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working\-at\-Chenega\-MIOS\-EI\_IE369514\.11,23\.htm LinkedIn \- https://www.linkedin.com/company/1472684/ Facebook \- https://www.facebook.com/chenegamios/ \#Chronos Operations, LLC Teleworking Permitted?: false

Working within the Data \& Analytics team, the Analytics Knowledge Lead establishes standards and patterns that make analytics assets machine\-readable and contextually rich \- not just cataloged for human browsing, but structured for AI consumption. This role partners closely with data engineers, analytics developers, operational data stewards, and IT security to embed context\-building practices into the analytics development lifecycle and to ensure that data access governance is applied consistently across Microsoft Fabric lakehouses, Power BI reporting assets, and other enterprise tools like Epic SlicerDicer.**Experience** * 3 years of experience in analytics, data engineering, information science, or related technical roles with demonstrated involvement in data catalog, metadata, or knowledge management initiatives * Experience designing or implementing metadata frameworks, data dictionaries, business glossaries, or semantic data models in an enterprise environment * Experience with or strong understanding of knowledge representation concepts such as ontologies, taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, or knowledge graphs * Experience with data access governance including role\-based access control (RBAC), row\-level security (RLS), or similar security models within a modern cloud data platform * Experience collaborating with cross\-functional stakeholders including technical and non\-technical audiences to translate business concepts into structured data definitions **Education** * Bachelor's degree in information science, computer science, data science, library science, health informatics, or related field **Preferred Qualifications** * 3 years of experience in an analytics or data platform role with significant metadata, knowledge management, or semantic modeling responsibilities * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouses, and Fabric workspaces * Experience with Epic Cogito stack including SlicerDicer, Radar dashboards, and Analytics Catalog * Experience implementing or administering a data catalog platform (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Alation, Collibra, or equivalent) * Familiarity with knowledge graph technologies, ontology languages (e.g., OWL, RDF, SKOS), or graph database platforms (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune) * Understanding of how large language models (LLMs) consume structured metadata, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) patterns, and AI grounding techniques * Familiarity with metric layer or semantic layer concepts (e.g., dbt metrics, Power BI calculation groups, or similar) * Experience in a healthcare or other regulated industry with exposure to clinical terminologies (e.g., SNOMED, ICD, LOINC) or HIPAA data handling requirements * Experience leading projects or initiatives without formal management authority * Microsoft certifications (e.g., DP\-600 Fabric Analytics Engineer, PL\-300 Power BI) * Master's degree (or higher) in information science, computer science, data science, library science, health informatics, or related field **Certification Summary** * No professional certifications required **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Deep understanding of metadata concepts including data lineage, business glossaries, data dictionaries, semantic models, and data catalog taxonomies * Working knowledge of knowledge representation frameworks including ontologies, taxonomies, and controlled vocabularies, and how they enable AI tools to reason over structured data * Familiarity with AI grounding techniques including retrieval ent context for large language models to return accurate, trustworthy answers to natural language queries. * Leads implementation and ongoing administration of the data catalog platform (e.g., Microsoft Purview), ensuring analytics assets are cataloged, classified, and linked to authoritative sources with machine\-readable context. * Establishes lineage documentation standards connecting source tables, transformation logic, semantic models, and downstream reporting assets in a format consumable by both humans and automated systems. * Partners with analytics developers and data engineers to embed catalog contributions and ontology tagging into the standard development workflow. **Metric Library, Semantic Definitions \& AI Grounding** * Designs and governs the enterprise metric library, establishing templates and standards for metric definitions, business rules, calculation logic, and links to authoritative reporting assets \- structured to serve as a trusted grounding layer for AI and natural language query tools. * Architects the semantic layer strategy that connects business terminology and clinical concepts to underlying data structures, enabling AI systems to map natural language questions to the correct data assets without ambiguity. * Collaborates with operational data stewards, clinical informatics, and analytics consumers to validate metric definitions, build shared vocabulary, and resolve conflicts between competing definitions. * Coordinates with analytics developers to ensure semantic model measures and Power BI calculations align with approved metric definitions and are exposed with sufficient context for AI consumption. * Establishes a review and change management process for metrics and definitions to ensure they remain current and that changes are propagated to dependent AI and reporting systems consistently. **Data Security \& Access Control** * Designs the access control framework for analytics assets across Microsoft Fabric Lakehouses, semantic models, and Power BI workspaces, including RBAC, RLS, and object\-level security patterns. * Collaborates with IT Security and Compliance to ensure the access model meets HIPAA requirements and Children's data handling policies, including appropriate constraints on AI tool access to sensitive data. * Serves as the subject matter authority on data security architecture for the analytics platform, advising analytics developers on appropriate access patterns during build. * Leads periodic access reviews and supports audit activities by maintaining clear documentation of security configurations and access policies. **Standards, Documentation \& AI Enablement** * Establishes and maintains code and asset documentation standards for the analytics team, including pipeline documentation, semantic model documentation, and report\-level context structured for both human review and AI indexing. * Develops reference materials, playbooks, and training resources to enable analytics team members to contribute to the context infrastructure with AI readiness in mind. * Partners with analytics and technology leadership to define the roadmap for AI\-assisted analytics discovery, including natural language query capabilities, intelligent data recommendations, and AI\-powered data stewardship. * Tracks adoption and completeness of context, ontology, and documentation practices across the analytics portfolio and reports progress to analytics leadership. * Mentors and provides technical guidance to the Analytics Knowledge Engineer, reviewing work and supporting professional development. *Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, sex, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic covered by applicable law.* **Primary Location Address** 1575 Northeast Expy NE**Job Family** Business Intelligence

jobs.description: **Class Concept** ----------------- We’re looking for a **hands\-on Network Engineer who wants to own real infrastructure that matters**—not just design it on paper. In this role, you’ll lead in person day\-to\-day operations of a complex, mission\-critical environment supporting public safety, 911 systems, and enterprise services across the City of Dublin. You’ll be the one people count on when things break—diagnosing tough issues, driving root\-cause resolution, and continuously modernizing the network to improve reliability and resilience. This is not a back\-office, ticket\-only role—it’s for someone who thrives in production environments, is confident about troubleshooting under pressure, and takes pride in keeping critical systems running. If you’re an experienced operator who wants meaningful ownership, visible impact, and the ability to shape infrastructure that directly serves a community, we want to talk. The City of Dublin is seeking an experienced, hands\-on Network Engineer to support and evolve a highly reliable, mission\-critical technology environment serving City operations, public safety systems, and community services. This role is responsible for maintaining a citywide network infrastructure that supports enterprise systems, modern cloud\-integrated services, mobile workforce, and a regional 911 dispatch center. The ideal candidate is a seasoned technologist and problem\-solver who thrives in complex environments. The position works closely with the Network Operations Manager to support daily operations, align work with strategic priorities, and plan for future infrastructure needs. The Network Engineer collaborates with IT staff, the Information Security Administrator, vendors, and business units to deliver scalable, resilient, and secure solutions that support City operations, public safety systems, and critical services. **Supervisory Responsibilities** None. **Examples of Duties** ---------------------- **Essential Functions** Monitor and maintain the daily operation of network systems, server and storage infrastructure, backup and recovery systems and procedures, and associated services such as Active Directory. Troubleshoot and resolve complex network, system, and application issues across LAN, WAN, wireless, and telecommunications systems. Provide support for mission\-critical environments, including transportation, utility and public safety systems, 911 communications, remote connectivity (VPN), cloud resources (Azure, Office 365\), and mobile computing environments. Respond to outages and high\-priority incidents, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions. Escalate issues and risks as appropriate to ensure timely resolution and service continuity. Design, implement, and maintain network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless systems, and fiber\-optic networks. Lead lifecycle management efforts, including hardware/software upgrades, end\-of\-life (EOL) replacements, infrastructure consolidation and retirement initiatives, supporting high\-availability configurations and redundancy designs (e.g., firewall HA, core network resiliency), participate in network expansion projects supporting new facilities, events, and infrastructure needs, and collaborate on infrastructure planning and long\-term modernization initiatives. Implement and maintain network and email security controls, including firewalls, VPNs, endpoint protections, and authentication systems. Support security initiatives such as email security (DKIM, DMARC, SPF), identity and access control systems, vulnerability remediation and system hardening. Collaborate on incident response and the mitigation of security events, and ensure alignment with City security policies and best practices. Lead or contribute to IT infrastructure projects, including network migrations, cloud transitions, security enhancements, and system integrations. Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external vendors, consultants and service providers to ensure successful project execution and support of network systems. Assist in planning and supporting large\-scale events and operational initiatives requiring IT infrastructure. Align project work with departmental priorities and objectives. Coordinate troubleshooting and escalation efforts with third\-party support organizations. Participate in vendor evaluations and solution design discussions. Collaborate with and provide mentorship to the IT support team on issue resolution and special projects. Engage with internal departments to gather requirements and deliver solutions aligned to operational needs. Participates in an on\-call rotation to support our fellow staff and community at\-large. **Typical Qualifications** -------------------------- **Minimum Qualifications** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or other relevant fields. 5\+ years of progressive, hands\-on experience supporting enterprise network environments or   processes; listens and checks before acting; tries to understand the people and the data before making judgments and acting; waits for others to catch up before acting; sensitive to due process and proper pacing; follows established process. **Action\-Oriented:** This person enjoys working hard, is action\-oriented, and is full of energy for the things they see as challenging. They do not fear acting with minimum planning and seizing more opportunities than others. **Learning on the Fly:** Learns quickly when facing new problems; a relentless and versatile learner; open to change; analyzes both successes and failures for clues to improvement; experiments and will try anything to find solutions; enjoys the challenge of unfamiliar tasks; quickly grasps the essence and the underlying structure of anything. **Priority Setting:** Spends their time and the time of others on what’s important; quickly zeros in on the critical few and puts the trivial many aside; can quickly sense what will help or hinder accomplishing a goal; eliminates roadblocks; creates focus. **Drug\-Free Workplace** The City of Dublin is a drug\-free workplace (AO 2\.35\) which prohibits the use of controlled substances including marijuana. As permitted by law and in accordance with City Policy, new hires must pass a pre\-employment drug test before appointment to any City position. Please note, this position may be subject to additional restrictions pursuant to Administrative Orders 2\.38, or as outlined in the posting. **EEO Statement** The City of Dublin is committed to establishing and maintaining an inclusive and equitable community. We work to ensure equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. We actively celebrate colleagues’ differences, support them through their careers with us, and prohibit discrimination and harassment. We strive to ensure equitable access to resources and opportunities that allow individuals and groups to feel safe, respected, motivated, and valued. Creating a culture of equity and belonging helps to ensure we meet the needs of all residents, visitors, and City of Dublin employees. **HEALTH BENEFITS** The City of Dublin offers a high deductible health care plan through United Healthcare that provides 100% coverage for preventative care. Employee or family coverage is available. Additionally our integrated wellness program, Healthy by Choice (HBC), allows employees to earn a waiver of all or a portion of the medical plan premiums. **HEALTH SAVINGS ACCOUNT/HEALTH REIMBURSEMENT ACCOUNT** Annually, the City will deposit 75% of your health insurance deductible amount into an HSA account in your name. **VISION AND DENTAL** The City pays 100% of the premium for dental and vision. Coverage levels will be explained in further detail at time of hire. **LIFE INSURANCE** The City pays 100% of the premium for 1\.5 times your salary up to $150,000 term life insurance coverage for the employee. Supplemental insurance is available. **RETIREMENT PENSION** The City contributes 14% monthly toward retirement benefits offered through the Ohio Public Employee Retirement System. The employee pension payment share is 10% of gross salary. **VACATION** New employees accrue two weeks of paid vacation their first year. Vacation time increases with length of service time. Prior public service may be honored as service credit for vacation accrual. **PERSONAL LEAVE** Employees receive five prorated days of personal leave annually. **SICK LEAVE** Employees are advanced three sick days at the time of hire and accrue nine sick days in total annually. **OTHER** Eleven (11\) paid holidays per year, employer paid short term disability, tuition/certification reimbursement of up to $7,000 annually, recreation membership and longevity pay after four years of full time completed service with the City of Dublin.

The Lead Software Engineer will provide guidance and technical direction of software development projects and ensure successful delivery of high\-quality software solutions **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS** * Provides technical leadership and mentorship to software engineers and developers. * Designs, develops, and maintains robust and scalable software solutions. * Defines and oversees the software architecture, ensuring alignment with project goals and long\-term organizational objectives. * Conducts regular code reviews to ensure high\-quality code standards are maintained. * Establishes and enforces best practices in coding, testing, and documentation. * Oversees the technical aspects of projects, ensuring adherence to timeliness, quality standards, and project requirements. * Collaborates with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. * Collaborates with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to ensure cohesive and successful project ou oyee working hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. jobs.title: Senior Applications Developer (eGOV)
jobs.description: **THE POSITION** ---------------- **With supervisor approval, incumbents may be eligible for intermittent remote work; however, they must physically reside within the Sacramento region or have the ability to regularly report to a City of Sacramento physical worksite with little notice.** This position is located within the Enterprise Applications Division of the Information Technology Department and is responsible for the development, configuration, customization, integration, support and maintenance of enterprise on premise and cloud applications. This position requires specialized technical skills and knowledge of system architecture, object\-oriented programming and databases. The incumbent will work closely with end users and business stakeholders and be able to drive projects independently with minimal supervision/direction. This position is also responsible for recommending and/or implementing technical solutions to improve and streamline business processes and procedures that support City priorities and initiatives. Under general supervision, the Senior Applications Developer performs a variety of professional, technical, and analytical duties involving requirements analysis, design, development, testing, implementation, administration, and support of new and existing small\- and large\-scale systems in a multi\-platform environment that includes premise and cloud systems. **IDEAL CANDIDATE STATEMENT** The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in the following: * Thorough understanding of system design and development. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Fluency with front\-end web technologies such as HTML, JavaScript, and CSS. * Fluency with back\-end technologies such as C\#, Java. * Object\-oriented programming experience. * Proficiency in database management systems such as MS SQ, Oracle. * Proficiency in enterprise system customization, configuration and support. Additional experience with the following is preferred but not required: * Microsoft Azure Cloud computing platform. * .NET framework, .NET core, and related programming languages. * SaaS and/or Commercial off\-the\-shelf software experience. * Imaging and Document Management System. Under general supervision, the Senior Applications Developer performs a variety of professional, technical, and analytical duties involving requirements analysis, design, development, testing, implementation, administration and support of new and existing small and large scale systems and databases in a multi\-platform environment that includes mainframe, client server, distributed and web based systems. DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS This is an advanced journey\-professional classification populated with multiple incumbents. The Senior Applications Developer's work involves advanced concepts in the performance of their duties. The incumbents in this classification may provide oversight to other Applications Developers. The Senior Applications Developer is distinguished from that of the Applications Developer classification by the increased degree of difficulty of the work assignments, the greater level of business and technical knowledge required to perform the tasks and the potential consequences of errors by the incumbent. The work of this classification is distinguished from that of the Principal Applications Developer classification in that the latter classification is the highest level technical expert. SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED General supervision is provided by an Information Technology Supervisor or other high\-level manager. The Senior Applications Developer does not supervise. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** ----------------------------------------- TYPICAL DUTIES * Plans and manages information technology related projects involving critical applications, large systems and sophisticated processes. * Provides team leadership, guidance, business, and technical expertise on assigned projects involving citywide computer systems. * Designs and/or creates database structures, data migration/conversion techniques for system(s) conversions or upgrades. * Monitors and tunes databases in order to obtain optimum performance. * Applies analytical and advanced design techniques in developing new programs or systems or modifying existing ones. * Codes and/or tests programs and resolve related problems in large, complex systems. * Provides technical guidance to lower\-level IT personnel and contractors through training, mentoring, and coaching. * Performs other or related duties as assigned. **QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------ Knowledge of: * Principals and concepts of business process and software design; relational and distributed database technology; networks and communications; and project management. * Software development methodologies and life cycles. * Current trends in information technology software, business systems, hardware, networks, and communications. * Commonly used programming languages, database  If "see resume" is noted in the "Work Experience" section; a resume will not substitute for the information required in the "Work Experience" section. * Position/job titles will not be considered in determining eligibility for meeting the minimum qualifications for this position. * Proof of education such as, but not limited to, university/college transcripts and degrees should be submitted online with your application. Proof of education **will be** **required** **at time of appointment.** **2\. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: About the Role T. Mark Fay Consulting, Inc. (Claim Toolkit) builds software that enterprise property and casualty carriers across the US and Canada rely on for claims audit, compliance, total loss, and auto liability work. We are hiring a full\-time, remote, US\-based Full Stack Developer. You will be the in\-house technical owner of our production applications. That means keeping them running, secure, and compliant day to day, delivering enhancements our carrier clients request, and helping lead the modernization of our legacy Classic ASP applications. You will work alongside a small internal team and our external development partner, with wide latitude to design, build, test, and release your solutions. Products You Will Support You will support all four Claim Toolkit product lines, with the heaviest day\-to\-day load in Total Loss and Compliance. * **Total Loss:** calculates state\-specific taxes and fees on total loss vehicle settlements. Main touchpoints are monthly tax and fee updates, state programming, vendor rate issues, new clients, Notice to Owner, and form letters. * **Compliance:** tracks claims handling against state regulatory requirements. Main touchpoints are MFA and login reporting, SSO, new customer setup, and enhancements such as an interest calculator. * **Audit:** supports carrier claim file audits. Main touchpoints are SFTP, Guidewire integration, SSO, enhancements, and product redesign. * **Auto Liability:** supports auto liability claim evaluation. Main touchpoints are SFTP, Guidewire integration, SSO, enhancements, and product redesign. Key Responsibilities **Production support and incidents (all products)** * Own incident response for all products, including 500 errors and failed scheduled jobs, with same\-day diagnosis and resolution * Write programming specs in real time when issues are found, and follow them through to release * Manage the code deployment and release process * Keep UAT documentation current, including server screenshots * Contribute to hardware and infrastructure discussions **Total Loss system** * Complete monthly tax and fee updates and program future\-dated changes * Program state\-specific rules in CORE and maintain them as regulations change * When tax rate issues surface, retrieve XML files and work directly with vendors such as Thomson Reuters to investigate * Set up new clients, modify vehicle types and categories, and add user access for select clients * Maintain address validation, form letters, and Notice to Owner PDFs * Rotate Dealertrack/Vitu credentials securely * Produce client tax and fee reports on request (for example, all first\-party claims finalized in a date range, with all taxes and fees) * Explain how calculations are programmed so internal staff can answer client questions * Support billing setup, invoices, and billing\-related emails **Security and compliance** * Prepare for and respond to the annual penetration test, and implement remediation * Keep MFA compliance reporting accurate and troubleshoot compliance reports * Research enterprise SSO gaps, such as logins not captured when users reach Compliance through Total Loss * Evaluate and, if approved, implement the Shibboleth upgrade * Finish the WAF (Sucuri) rollout: confirm which sites are protected, add the remaining sites, and update .asp pages to prevent false blocking * Set up new Compliance customers, in\-house and external, using the onboarding checklist **Integrations, SSO, and SFTP** * Install and maintain SSO for all products, including annual certificate renewals, and coordinate rollouts with developers * Manage SFTP and Guidewire integrations for Audit and Auto Liability **Enhancements** * Review enhancement requests with the Account Manager and help set priorities * Define and run the enhancement process: intake, mockup, customer approval, customer review, build, release * Build project timelines and keep work on schedule **Product modernization** * Help choose the target language and framework for rewriting legacy products, working with outside experts as needed * Redesign products collaboratively with the team, translate designs into clear specs, and build with the development team **Customers and team** * Work directly with new and existing carrier clients when technical context is needed * Mentor assigned team members and attend meetings as needed Technical Qualifications **Required** * Hands\-on production experience with Classic ASP/VBScript, plus ASP.NET, React and C\#,GitHub * Strong Microsoft SQL Server skills: complex queries, stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, jobs, and database design * SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and Integration Services (SSIS) for reports and automated data imports * JavaScript, jQuery, and React for front\-end work * RESTful API design and integration * SSO implementation and certificate management (SAML, Shibboleth, or similar) * IIS and Windows Server administration, including SFTP * Full software development life cycle: requirements, specs, development, testing, deployment, and support * Proven ability to troubleshoot production issues quickly **Preferred** * Node.js or other modern React frameworks * Experience modernizing or rewriting legacy applications * Web application firewall (WAF) configuration, MFA, and penetration test remediation * Guidewire integrations * P\&C insurance or claims industry experience, especially total loss taxes and fees or state regulatory rules The Successful Candidate The right person is accurate, transparent about status, and disciplined about process, because our carrier clients depend on calculations and compliance data being right the first time. * **Accurate and honest about status.** You report exactly where work stands, including what is not done or not yet validated. You never present something as complete before it is. * **Respects the QA process.** Every fix goes through QA before anyone tells a client it is resolved. You keep incidents assigned and tracked through resolution. * **Flags blockers early.** If testing is incomplete or something is blocking a release, you say so the same day rather than leaving it for someone to discover. * **Precise with regulated logic.** You treat tax, fee, and compliance calculations as near\-zero\-error work and test against every affected state, client, and vehicle type. * **Documents as you go.** You comment code to our standard, write clear specs and procedures, and turn undocumented knowledge of state rules and client setups into written reference material. * **Security\-minded.** You handle credentials, certificates, and server access carefully and raise anything that looks wrong, such as unexpected remote access or unfamiliar IPs. * **Responsive with clients and vendors.** You engage directly with client questions and vendor escalations instead of passing them along, and you write in plain, direct language that leaves a clear paper trail. * **Applies feedback.** You take feedback, change how you work, and do not repeat the same issue. * **Flexible and organized.** You shift priorities when a production issue lands and still manage scope and timelines on longer projects. * **Curious about AI and automation.** You are comfortable using AI tools in development and interested in our work on automated reporting, natural language queries, and AI\-assisted workflows. * **Lives our core values:** Excellence, Challenging Goals, and Kindness. Work Requirements This role must be US\-based and available during US business hours, because production issues and client escalations need same\-day response. * Must reside and work in the United States; some client contracts require US\-based development * Available during core US business hours for incidents, vendor calls, and client escalations * Able to respond to production issues, such as a 500 error at 2:00 PM, the same day * Willing to pass a background check and follow our data access, credential, and security policies, since the role involves sensitive client data and production system access Benefits and How to Apply * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Paid time off * Holiday Paid time off * Fully remote work Send your resume to Info@ClaimToolkit.com. Strong candidates will be invited to a conversation and a real\-world business and technical skills test. Pay: $96,700\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) 4% Match * Bereavement leave * Health insurance * Paid holidays * Paid jury duty * Paid time off * Work from home Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior HPC Developer - RDMA Networking
jobs.description: #### **About Clockwork Systems** **Clockwork.io – Software Driven Fabrics to increase GPU cluster utilization** Clockwork Systems was founded by Stanford researchers and veteran systems engineers who share a vision for redefining the foundations of distributed computing. As AI workloads grow increasingly complex, traditional infrastructure struggles to meet the demands of performance, reliability, and precise coordination. Clockwork is pioneering a software\-driven approach to AI fabrics by delivering **cross\-stack observability** to catch and quickly resolve problems, **workload fault tolerance** to keep jobs running through failures, and **performance acceleration** that dynamically routes and paces traffic to avoid congestion. #### **To learn more, visit** **www.clockwork.io****.** **About the Role** We're looking for a **Senior Systems Engineer – RDMA Networking \& Storage** to help build and optimize high\-performance infrastructure for AI and HPC systems. You'll work across **RDMA networking and storage data paths**, spanning compute hosts, NICs, **DPUs, smart switches**, storage systems, and the Linux software stack. The work includes RoCE networking, NVMe\-over\-Fabrics, congestion control, performance optimization, programmable network hardware, and debugging complex interactions across hardware and software. This role is ideal for an experienced systems engineer who enjoys working close to the hardware, diagnosing difficult performance problems, and building reliable systems where latency, throughput, and network behavior matter. **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and optimize **high\-performance RDMA networking and storage systems** * Work with **RoCE, RDMA Verbs, and NVMe\-over\-Fabrics** * Develop systems that leverage **DPUs, SmartNICs, and programmable switches** for packet processing, telemetry, control, and data\-path acceleration * Develop and optimize software using queue pairs, completion queues, memory registration, zero\-copy I/O, and other RDMA primitives * Debug performance and reliability issues across applications, Linux kernel, drivers, NICs, DPUs, switches, and storage systems * Analyze network and storage behavior including latency, throughput, queueing, congestion, packet loss, retransmissions, and flow control * Develop mechanisms to improve network performance and congestion behavior in high\-bandwidth RDMA fabrics * Build tooling and instrumentation to understand end\-to\-end performance across compute, network, and storage * Profile and tune systems across PCIe, NUMA, CPU, memory, NIC, DPU, network, and storage boundaries * Own major components from design through implementation, performance validation, and deployment **What You Bring** * **5\+ years of experience** in systems, networking, storage, HPC, or other performance\-critical software development * Strong proficiency in **low\-level C/C\+\+** * Strong understanding of **RDMA networking**, including **RoCE and RDMA Verbs** * Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including packet processing, queues, congestion, and flow control * Experience debugging low\-level Linux networking, storage, or driver behavior * Familiarity with concepts such as DMA, memory registration, queue pairs, completion queues, interrupts/polling, and zero\-copy I/O * Experience profiling and optimizing latency\- and throughput\-sensitive systems * Ability to reason across hardware and software boundaries and independently debug complex system\-level problems * Strong ownership and comfort working in a small, fast\-moving engineering team **Bonus Points** * Experience with **DPUs, SmartNICs, or programmable network hardware** * Experience with platforms such as **NVIDIA BlueField** or programmable switch environments * Experience with **P4, switch SDKs, or in\-network packet processing** * Experience with **NVMe, NVMe\-oF, NVMe/RDMA, or NVMe/TCP** * Experience with **SPDK**, DPDK, or other userspace I/O frameworks * Experience with Linux NVMe and RDMA subsystems * Experience with **congestion control**, including DCQCN, ECN, PFC, or related mechanisms * Experience tuning NVIDIA/Mellanox ConnectX NICs and RoCE fabrics * Experience working with high\-performance switches and data\-center network fabrics * Experience with PCIe, NUMA, huge pages, DMA, or CPU affinity optimization * Experience with performance profiling, tracing, or observability tooling * Background in AI infrastructure, HPC clusters, distributed storage, or large\-scale data\-center systems **Enjoy** * Challenging, technically deep projects * A friendly and inclusive workplace culture * Competitive compensation * A great benefits package * Catered lunch jobs.title: Drone Piloting & Technology Instructor - K-12 Enrichment
jobs.description: **Work Setting:** In\-person at partner schools and community\-based locations **Schedule:** Part\-time; typically 1\-4 instructional hours per week **Typical Program Length:** Approximately 8\-10 weeks per assignment **Start Dates:** Rolling opportunities throughout the school year based on partner schedules **Compensation:** Most assignments fall between $50\-$65 per instructional hour, although rates vary by assignment. The applicable compensation range for the specific opportunity and geographic location is provided in the posting and/or assignment details. #### **Share What You Know. Inspire Students.** Concorde Education partners with schools and community organizations to provide engaging enrichment experiences for elementary, middle, and high school students. We are expanding our network of instructors with experience in **drone piloting, unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), aviation, robotics, engineering, STEM education, aerial photography, or related technology fields** for current and upcoming independent contractor instructional assignments. Traditional classroom teaching experience is not required for every program. We welcome applicants whose experience may come from professional drone operation, aviation, teaching, coaching, tutoring, mentoring, STEM programs, camps, youth organizations, military experience, photography/videography, engineering, or other relevant settings. Opportunities vary throughout the year and are offered based on school\-partner needs, instructor qualifications, subject expertise, geographic location, and scheduling availability. #### **Drone Piloting Programs** Depending on the assignment and student grade level, programs may introduce students to topics such as: Drone flight fundamentals and controls Safe and responsible drone operation Pre\-flight preparation and equipment checks Basic aviation and aeronautical concepts Flight planning, navigation, and maneuvering Manual and automated flight modes Drone coding and programmable flight activities Mission\-based flight challenges and obstacle courses Aerial photography and videography Engineering and technology behind unmanned aircraft systems Real\-world drone applications, including mapping, inspections, agriculture, emergency response, media, and other industries Career pathways involving drones, aviation, engineering, and emerging technologies Introductory FAA and Part 107 concepts when appropriate for the assignment and age group Specific curriculum, equipment, drone platforms, grade levels, and program objectives vary by assignment. #### **What You'll Do** Depending on the assignment, instructors may: Deliver engaging, age\-appropriate drone piloting and technology instruction Introduce students to safe drone operation, flight mechanics, navigation, and aviation concepts Lead hands\-on flight exercises, challenges, demonstrations, and STEM activities Prepare for sessions using provided curriculum, approved lesson plans, or appropriate instructor\-developed activities Adapt instruction for students with different ages, abilities, and levels of drone experience Create a positive, respectful, inclusive, and appropriately supervised learning environment Maintain appropriate classroom management and student supervision Follow applicable school policies, site procedures, safety expectations, and drone\-operation requirements Communicate professionally with designated school personnel and Concorde Education representatives regarding attendance, scheduling, equipment, and program needs Arrive prepared and on time for all accepted instructional sessions #### **Instructor Qualifications** Qualified applicants generally have a combination of relevant technical knowledge, experience working with young people, and strong professional skills. Qualifications may include: At least 60 completed college credits, or equivalent relevant professional experience when appropriate for the assignment Experience operating drones or working with unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) Knowledge of drone safety, flight fundamentals, and responsible operation FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certification is highly valued and may be required for certain assignments Experience teaching, coaching, tutoring, instructing, mentoring, or leading youth programs Experience working with children or adolescents in schools, camps, community organizations, STEM programs, private instruction, or similar environments Strong communication, leadership, and group\-management skills Dependable, organized, and professional work habits Relevant professional backgrounds may include drone pilots, FAA\-certified remote pilots, aviation professionals, STEM educators, engineers, robotics instructors, photographers/videographers, surveyors, public\-safety professionals, military veterans with UAS experience, and others with applicable drone or aviation expertise. #### **Important Position Information** These are **part\-time, independent contractor instructional opportunities**. Specific assignments vary based on school and program needs, including subject matter, location, schedule, grade level, enrollment, equipment availability, and program duration. Compensation and assignment details are provided before an instructor accepts an assignment. Submitting an application or completing screening and onboarding does not guarantee an assignment, minimum hours, future work, or continued engagement. Assignment offers may be contingent upon program availability, qualifications, scheduling compatibility, school\-partner requirements or approval, and completion of any legally required screening or clearance process. Applicants should not provide criminal history information unless specifically requested through an applicable, legally compliant screening process. #### **Equal Opportunity** Concorde Education provides equal opportunity in the selection of independent contractors and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Where applicable, qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered in accordance with applicable Fair Chance and Ban\-the\-Box requirements.
