jobs.title: Lighting Quotations
jobs.description: Position Summary The Lighting Quotations Specialist is responsible for preparing accurate and competitive lighting quotations for commercial, industrial, and residential projects. This role works closely with customers, sales teams, manufacturers, and project managers to ensure lighting solutions meet project specifications, budgets, and timelines. The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and knowledge of lighting products and industry standards. Key Responsibilities * Review project plans, specifications, and lighting schedules to determine project requirements. * Prepare detailed and accurate lighting quotations for contractors, end users, engineers, and design professionals. * Analyze project drawings and identify opportunities for value engineering and alternative product solutions. * Coordinate with lighting manufacturers and agents to obtain pricing, lead times, and product recommendations. * Develop project bills of material and ensure all required products are included in quotations. * Work closely with sales representatives to support project pursuits and customer requests. * Follow up on quotations and assist customers with product selections, revisions, and technical questions. * Maintain organized records of project bids, quotations, and correspondence. * Monitor project deadlines and ensure timely completion of quotations. * Stay current on lighting technologies, controls, energy codes, and industry trends. * Assist with project order entry, submittals, and project management activities as needed. * Support branch profitability by maximizing gross margin opportunities while remaining competitive in the marketplace. Qualifications Required * High school diploma or equivalent. * 2\+ years of experience in electrical distribution, lighting sales, quotations, project management, or a related field. * Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and Outlook. * Excellent organizational and time management skills. * Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Detail\-oriented with strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. Preferred * Experience with lighting design software (AGi32, Visual, or similar). * Knowledge of electrical distribution and commercial construction markets. * Experience working with lighting manufacturers and agency representatives. * Associate's or bachelor's degree in business, engineering, construction management, or related field. Core Competencies * Customer Focus * Attention to Detail * Technical Product Knowledge * Project Coordination * Communication and Collaboration * Time Management * Problem Solving * Negotiation and Pricing Analysis Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Travel reimbursement * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Fort Collins, CO 80525

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in customer\-facing environments, takes ownership of outcomes, and has a proven track record of exceeding sales goals. As a trusted technical advisor, you'll help customers understand the value of our solutions, partner closely with Sales to accelerate opportunities, and provide valuable feedback that helps shape the future of our Storage \& Analysis product offering. **As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…** * Help customers understand the value of Cribl's Storage \& Analysis products during the entire sales jobs.title: Engineer III, Cloud - CTIO (Hybrid)
jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** We’re building the next generation technologies which will power CrowdStrike for the next ten years. You’ll join a fast\-moving team taking a blank\-slate approach to scaling our systems and using AI to stop breaches. **Note:** This is a hybrid role based out of our offices in Redmond, WA, Sunnyvale, CA, Austin, TX, NYC, or Toronto with an expectation of being in the office at least 2 days per week. **What You’ll Do:** * Lead efforts in defining and implementing significant components of our new cloud architecture, collaborating with our most senior technologists * Deliver low\-latency and highly scalable services * Partner closely with our desktop agent and AI teams * Drive continuous improvement in hiring, design reviews, post mortems, and growing the technical skills our team needs to excel. **What You’ll Need:** * B.S. Degree in Computer Science or related field * 6\+ years of experience building and operating high\-volume, highly resilient Tier\-1 cloud services and systems * Strong knowledge of Go, Java, or similar technologies * Skill at finding simply elegant solutions to complex problems * Ability to move fast and deal with ambiguity while leading collaboration across teams * Ability to communicate complex technical ideas in writing and verbally * Experience driving technical decisions across groups and stakeholders * Strong sense of ownership in what you build * Passion for developing teams through code reviews, design reviews and mentorship * Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. \#LI\-DR1 **Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:** * Market leader in compensation and equity awards * Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs * Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge * Paid parental and adoption leaves * Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role * Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections * Vibrant office culture with world class amenities * Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Junior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: D’Addario \& Company is the largest manufacturer and distributor of musical instrument accessories in the world. As a US based manufacturing company, we pride ourselves on high automation machinery and innovative technology, as well as our commitment to environmentally sustainable practices. Through our work with the D'Addario Foundation we are committed to helping make music education accessible and ensuring hundreds of thousands of students can participate in music\-making programs worldwide, regardless of instrumentation, genre, or life circumstance. Most importantly, we pride ourselves on our diverse team of individuals who commit to the embodiment of our core values of curiosity, passion, candor, family and responsibility and translate them into action every day. D'Addario is seeking a motivated **Junior Full Stack Engineer** to help develop and support modern enterprise applications that power our manufacturing, supply chain, distribution, finance, customer service, and eCommerce operations. **This hybrid position is based in Farmingdale, NY and requires onsite attendance Tuesday through Thursday.** This role is ideal for an early\-career software engineer with experience building web applications using modern technologies such as React or Next.js, TypeScript, .NET, REST APIs, and SQL databases. You'll work alongside experienced developers and business stakeholders on high\-impact projects involving enterprise application modernization, ERP integrations, cloud technologies, AI\-enabled automation, and customer\-facing platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing to the digital transformation of a global manufacturing organization. At D’Addario, we don’t just offer a job—we offer a career with one of the most iconic names in the music industry. We’re passionate about innovation, craftsmanship, and creating a workplace where diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and ideas thrive. This position is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, in accordance with company policy. Responsibilities: ### **Full Stack Application Development** * Develop, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise web applications. * Build responsive user interfaces using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and reusable components. * Develop REST APIs and backend services using C\#, ASP.NET Core, and .NET. * Support secure authentication, authorization, logging, and exception\-handling patterns. * Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and continuous improvement activities. * Support integrations across ERP, WMS, Shopify B2B/D2C, EDI, and third\-party platforms. * Collaborate with senior developers to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability. ### **Database Development** * Develop and maintain database schemas, queries, stored procedures, and data\-access layers using PostgreSQL and SQL Server. * Assist with indexing, profiling, and query tuning to improve application performance. * Support data migration, synchronization, and integration efforts. ### **Cloud \& DevOps** * Support Azure application deployments and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. * Manage source control using Git and GitHub. * Assist with Docker configuration of applications and use automated deployment practices where applicable. ### **AI \& Automation** * Use AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude or Codex to improve productivity. * Participate in workflow automation, proof\-of\-concept, and innovation initiatives involving AI technologies. Qualifications: ### **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * 1\-3 years of software development experience, including internships, co\-ops, or professional experience * Experience with modern frontend development using React or Next.js * Experience developing APIs or backend services using C\#, .NET, or similar technologies * Working knowledge of SQL databases * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills * Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly ### **Preferred** * Experience with TypeScript * Experience with PostgreSQL and/or SQL Server * Experience with Microsoft Azure * Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and DevOps practices * Experience working with ERP systems, integrations, or manufacturing\-related applications * Exposure to Docker, microservices, and cloud\-native application development **Technologies You'll Work With:** **Frontend** * React * Next.js * TypeScript * JavaScript * HTML5 * CSS3 * Tailwind CSS **Backend** * C\# * ASP.NET Core * .NET * REST APIs * Entity Framework Core **Databases** * PostgreSQL * SQL Server **Cloud \& DevOps** * Azure * Git * GitHub * Azure DevOps * GitHub Actions * Docker \#LI\_HYBRID

jobs.title: Construction Inspector
jobs.description: Job Description: **DLZ** currently has an opportunity for a **Construction Inspection / Construction Observer** throughout **North\-Central****Ohio, including the Marion, Bucyrus, Upper Sandusky, and Delaware areas.** This position is well\-suited for an experienced utility inspector, ODOT construction inspector, or a recent civil engineering graduate seeking hands\-on experience in construction inspection and infrastructure projects. **Duties \& Responsibilities:*** Perform all phases of field inspection assignments in accordance with project specifications, plans, and applicable standards. * Interpret construction plans and specifications and communicate design intent to contractors. * Monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with project requirements, plans, specifications, and quality standards. * Document field activities and prepare daily inspection reports using laptops, tablets, and other project software. * Communicate daily with contractors, project managers, engineers, and office personnel regarding project progress and issues. * Coordinate effectively with residents, property owners, and stakeholders affected by construction activities. * Work with project staff to review and document field changes and design revisions. * Measure and record installed quantities to support progress tracking and contractor payment estimates. * Maintain assigned vehicles, equipment, and inspection tools in proper working condition. * Follow all health, safety, and environmental requirements and maintain compliance with established safety procedures. * Perform other duties as assigned. Minimum Qualification \- One of the following is required:* Associate degree in Civil Engineering Technology, Construction Technology, or a related field, plus two (2\) years of relevant construction inspection experience; or * High school diploma or equivalent with a minimum of five (5\) years of relevant construction inspection experience. Preferred Qualifications:* Certifications in asphalt, concrete, aggregate, compaction testing, or related construction materials inspection. * Experience inspecting water main installation, residential water service connections, underground utilities, roadway reconstruction, concrete construction, and asphalt paving. * ODOT Construction Inspection Prequalification. * NICET Highway Construction Inspection Level II or higher certification. * Experience performing ODOT, municipal, or utility construction inspection. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic field reporting software. Physical \& Working Conditions* Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions and on active construction sites. * Ability to safely traverse uneven terrain, excavation areas, and construction zones while complying with all applicable safety requirements. * Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record. * Successful completion of a criminal background check and drug screening is required.

jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engineer / Architect
jobs.description: We are looking for a highly experienced **Salesforce Marketing Cloud professional** to lead the design, implementation, integration, and ongoing management of our Marketing Cloud environment. This is a hands\-on senior role for someone who has **real\-world experience building and managing Salesforce Marketing Cloud at scale**. The ideal candidate must be able to take ownership from requirements and architecture through implementation, integrations, automation, deployment, and optimization. Responsibilities * Design and implement Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions from end to end. * Build complex **Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, and Contact Builder** solutions. * Develop advanced **SQL queries, data extensions, segmentation, and customer journeys**. * Build and maintain integrations between Marketing Cloud, Salesforce CRM, APIs, and external systems. * Develop personalized and dynamic email campaigns using **AMPscript and HTML/CSS**. * Manage data architecture, subscriber management, consent, and data quality. * Troubleshoot complex Marketing Cloud, integration, automation, and data issues. * Establish best practices for scalability, security, deliverability, and performance. * Work closely with sales, marketing, IT, and engineering teams. * Provide technical leadership and documentation for the Marketing Cloud environment. Must\-Have Experience * **7\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce experience**, with significant experience specifically in **Salesforce Marketing Cloud**. * Proven experience designing and implementing **enterprise\-level Marketing Cloud solutions**. * Strong experience with **Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Contact Builder, and Data Extensions**. * Advanced **SQL** skills. * Strong **AMPscript, HTML, CSS, and email development** experience. * Experience integrating Marketing Cloud with **Salesforce Sales Cloud and external APIs/systems**. * Strong understanding of data architecture, segmentation, personalization, automation, and email deliverability. * Experience troubleshooting and optimizing large\-scale marketing automation environments. * Ability to independently lead projects from **architecture → development → testing → deployment → production**. Required Certifications **Must have:** * **Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Email Specialist** * **Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Administrator** **Strongly preferred:** * **Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Developer** * **Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Consultant** * **Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant** or equivalent Data Cloud experience Certifications are important, but **hands\-on enterprise Marketing Cloud experience is mandatory**. We will prioritize demonstrated experience building and operating complex Marketing Cloud environments over certifications alone. jobs.title: Learning Solution Architect - Data Engineering
jobs.description: **About DataCamp** DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st\-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over **20 million learners** and **6,000\+ companies**, including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage. **About the role \+ Responsibilities** The Learning Solutions Architect is a customer\-facing technical trainer who helps organizations build data and AI capabilities with DataCamp. You'll deliver engaging live training (virtual and onsite) and create tailored learning materials on the DataCamp platform—think custom courses, projects, certifications and assessments that map to each customer's roles, tools, and outcomes. You'll partner with Customer Success, Sales, Product and Content to scope blended learning paths, teach high\-impact sessions, and publish reusable, high\-quality content that accelerates adoption and measurable skill uplift for some of our most high\-value customers. **Qualifications** * Loves to teach. Comfortable spending multiple hours weekly in front of a virtual or onsite classroom. * Broad Data Engineering experience with Snowflake/Databricks expertise. * 2\+ years in technical training, data science/analytics education, solutions engineering, or similar instructor roles. * Learns new tools quickly; enjoys tailoring content to different personas (analyst, engineer, business user, exec). * Strong communicator who can simplify complex topics for technical and non\-technical audiences. * Detail\-oriented and process\-driven; delivers sessions and materials with substance. * Flexible schedule to support time zones (this is not a 9 to 5\); occasional travel for onsite delivery. **Some of your key metrics will be:** * Customer satisfaction: survey, engagement, repeat bookings * Professional services revenue (with a success based component of your salary tied to this) **Why Datacamp?** Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start\-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you'll love being on our team: * Exciting challenges: Face new technical challenges daily, keeping your work engaging and rewarding. * Competitive compensation: We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits. * Flexibility: Benefit from flexible working hours because the future is flexible! * Continuous learning: Access a yearly learning budget for conferences \& training to support your professional growth. * Global retreats: Participate in international company retreats, fostering a global team spirit. * Equipment: Yearly refreshment of your IT Equipment budget for your home working setup. * Amazing team: Collaborate with a truly exceptional team—seriously, we're awesome! **Compensation** The base salary for this position may vary based on several factors, including the approved job level. The base salary range for this role is $130,000 \- $190,000 (Total OTE: $145,000 \- $220,000\) Salary is one component of our total compensation package. This position also qualifies for equity (i.e., stock options). The benefits available for this position include flexible time off, a 401K retirement plan \+ matching, insurance (medical, dental, vision, life). We also provide paid sick time as required by state and local law. Additional benefits and perks contained in our standard employee benefits package are also offered for this position. At DataCamp, we value diverse experiences and perspectives. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. We believe skills can be developed and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. Your unique talents and perspectives are what make our team great!

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **San Francisco, CA · On\-site · Full\-time** **Compensation:** $165K–$250K \+ equity **About the Company** --------------------- Our client is a Series A AI company modernizing how insurance claims get processed, one of the largest and least automated workflows in a multi\-hundred\-billion\-dollar industry. Their agentic platform blends computer vision, sensor and telematics interpretation, document understanding, and LLM reasoning to handle real claims for large enterprise customers. They are backed by leading venture investors, built strong revenue traction in their first year, and currently have more customer demand than they can serve. Founded 2024 · \~50 people · Industry: Insurance, AI **The Role** ------------ We are looking for a hands\-on engineer who enjoys sitting at the intersection of code and customers. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will take our client's AI systems into production at major enterprise accounts, owning each deployment from first scoping conversation to go\-live. You will be among the first engineers in this function, so you will help shape how it runs as the team grows. **What you'll be doing** * Leading customer deployments of multimodal, agent\-based AI systems from scoping through launch, as the main technical contact for senior stakeholders * Building trusted relationships with customer leadership, understanding their priorities, and helping them expand their use of AI * Designing and refining AI agents, including prompt engineering, model integration, and rapid prototyping with AI\-assisted coding tools * Scoping and building new features that help customers scale and improve outcomes * Working directly with customer engineering teams to integrate the platform into their systems and APIs * Partnering with the core platform team to deliver smoothly and turn field insights into product improvements * Documenting what works in internal playbooks so the function can scale **Tech stack:** Python **Requirements** ---------------- * You have shipped production software in a fast\-moving environment, such as a venture\-backed startup, a founding engineering role, or a high\-growth public tech company * You have solid computer science foundations across data structures, algorithms, and system design * You communicate clearly and confidently, and can explain technical work to customers and non\-technical audiences * You bring roughly 1 to 5 years in a hands\-on technical role working in Python, ideally with some customer exposure * You hold a degree in a STEM discipline * You write strong, production\-quality Python * You have practical familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, and agent\-based AI systems * You can work from the San Francisco office five days a week **Nice to Haves** ----------------- * A degree from a top\-ranked program in your field **Why Join** ------------ * Join a well\-funded team with clear product\-market fit and runway to focus on building * Work on challenging, applied AI problems that run in production every day * Learn alongside an unusually strong team of engineers and published AI researchers * Own your work end to end and ship to production from your first week * Get broad exposure across backend, infrastructure, applied AI, and customer\-facing work, with a path toward leadership as the function grows **Details** ----------- * **Location:** San Francisco, CA * **Work policy:** On\-site five days a week, with occasional customer site visits * **Compensation:** $165,000–$250,000 \+ equity * **Visa sponsorship:** Open to visa transfers (e.g. OPT, H\-1B transfers); new sponsorship not available * **Employment type:** Full\-time

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **San Francisco, CA · Hybrid (4 days/week in office) · Full\-time** **Compensation:** $180K–$285K \+ equity **About the Company** --------------------- Our client is a Series B healthcare AI company whose platform lets health systems build, share, and deploy AI agents for clinical and operational work. The product is already live in production at some of the most respected health systems in the US, and the business grew dramatically over the past year. The team is small, well funded, and recognized as one of the leaders in applied healthcare AI. Founded early 2020s · \~25–30 people · Industry: Healthcare, AI, Enterprise **The Role** ------------ We're helping our client hire Forward Deployed Engineers who will sit between clinical teams and a production AI platform. You'll take rough ideas from physicians and hospital teams, shape them into real AI agents, ship them, and keep them working. This is an early, high\-ownership seat on a fast\-moving team. **What you'll be doing** * Work directly with physicians, hospital IT, and clinical leads to understand how their workflows run and where they break * Turn loosely defined clinical needs into well\-scoped, production\-ready AI agents * Build and deploy agents end to end, including the evaluations that prove they work * Keep deployed use cases delivering value by iterating on agents as clinical guidance and operational feedback evolve * Own problems from report to fix, often closing the loop in days **Tech stack:** Python, React, TypeScript, Rust, Kubernetes, AWS, FHIR, LLMs, AI agents, EHR integrations **Requirements** ---------------- * 1 to 6 years of professional engineering experience in full\-stack or forward deployed roles (this isn't a new\-grad opening) * A bachelor's or master's in computer science, computer engineering, or another STEM field * A clear standout signal in your background, such as a degree from a leading CS program, rapid promotion, an early or founding engineering role at a well\-known company, or time on a highly selective team * Hands\-on experience at a fast\-growing, venture\-backed startup or a company known for its forward deployed engineering model; for more senior candidates, a path from a large tech company into an early\-stage or high\-growth startup is ideal * Solid Python for backend work, plus working frontend skills in React and TypeScript * Comfort working directly with customers and owning deployments from discovery through production * A stable track record, with meaningful time spent in your recent roles * Able to work from the San Francisco office four days a week **Nice to Haves** ----------------- * Experience as an early employee at a venture\-backed startup * Background in healthcare or health tech * Exposure to Rust and to infrastructure tooling like Kubernetes, Helm, and AWS **Why Join** ------------ * Competitive base salary plus equity, with relocation support available * Real, end\-to\-end ownership as one of the first engineers in this role * Production AI running inside major health systems, with direct impact on patient care * A small, fast\-growing team with strong backing and clear momentum **Details** ----------- * **Location:** San Francisco, CA * **Work policy:** Hybrid, 4 days per week in office * **Compensation:** $180,000–$285,000 \+ equity * **Visa sponsorship:** Available (visa transfers and new sponsorship considered) * **Employment type:** Full\-time

jobs.title: AI and Data Science Engineer III
jobs.description: Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. Recruiting for this role ends on December 5, 2026 **Work you'll do** As an AI and Data Science Engineer III on the Advertising, Marketing \& Commerce team, you will be responsible for... * Translating business goals into machine learning use cases and model design approaches. * Performing exploratory data analysis to identify relationships, opportunities to influence outcomes, and cross\-channel attribution patterns. * Applying clustering, sampling, feature transformation, and predictive modeling techniques to develop and refine solutions. * Building proofs of concept, interpreting model results, and validating that solutions perform as intended. * Collaborating with clients and cross\-functional teams, including analytics and data engineering teams, throughout solution development and delivery. A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The team** Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing \& Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer\-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in\-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead\-to\-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth. **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's degree in engineering, mathematics, physics, machine learning, statistics, computer science, or another quantitative field * 5\+ years of industry experience outside of academia applying data science or machine learning methods * Experience translating business goals into machine learning use cases and model design * Experience performing exploratory data analysis and developing predictive models * Ability to travel 30%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Master's degree in engineering, mathematics, physics, machine learning, statistics, computer science, or another quantitative field * Experience manipulating large marketing data sets and performing extract, transform, and load activities * Experience with boosted trees, logistic regression, classification techniques, unsupervised models, large language models, or experimental design * Experience with data sets generated in advertising technology or marketing technology environments * Experience presenting complex data insights to non\-technical audiences * Experience with deep learning architectures or reinforcement learning The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $137,500 \- $193,600\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. This position is aligned with the Core Talent Model. To view the associated benefit package, please reference this document https://resources.deloitte.com/:b:/r/sites/dnet\-tod\-us/Shared Documents/Benefits/USBenefitsJourneyCDandETAM.pdf?csf\=1\&web\=1\&e\=pKjS1C . \#Customer\_US \#AMC\_US

jobs.title: Banking Product Forward Deployed Engineer - Innovation_Delivery_Transformation
jobs.description: **The Team** Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start\-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented individual with an innovative mindset to join the Converge for FSI team in our mission to develop differentiated financial services products that achieve product\-market fit. This role is focused on BankingSuite, a managed composable banking platform that helps regional, universal, and community banks launch new digital product propositions \& services and transform the digital customer experience. This is a great opportunity to be on the frontlines of Deloitte's innovation \& product strategy while staying close to industry/sector priorities. **Position Summary** We are looking for a highly skilled and client\-facing Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to sit at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer partnership. In this role, you will embed directly with our most strategic clients \- particularly in the financial services sector \- to understand their toughest technical challenges and help them design and implement world\-class solutions using our platform. This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role with direct influence on product direction. You are equally comfortable whiteboarding microservices architecture with a client's principal engineer, running a hands\-on technical workshop for a team of developers, and standing up a compelling proof\-of\-concept in days. You thrive in fast\-moving, high\-stakes environments and know how to earn the trust of deeply technical stakeholders. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026\. **Work you'll do** * Serve as a technical point of contact for strategic client accounts, building deep relationships with architects, engineers, and technical leaders * Lead discovery sessions to understand client architectures, pain points, and business objectives * Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non\-technical audiences * Collaborate with client architects and internal engineering teams to design scalable, production\-ready solutions * Provide authoritative guidance on microservices architecture, event\-driven systems, and cloud\-native deployment patterns * Review and advise on client system designs, identifying risks and recommending best practices * Rapidly prototype and build POCs that demonstrate platform value in the context of a client's real\-world use cases * Own and deliver polished, technically rigorous demos tailored to the client's specific technology stack and business domain * Maintain a library of reusable demo assets and reference implementations * Design and facilitate deep\-dive technical workshops, hackathons, and onboarding bootcamps for client engineering teams * Produce high\-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and integration guides * Accelerate client time\-to\-value by enabling their teams to build confidently and independently * Act as the voice of the customer \- surface product gaps, integration friction, and feature requests to internal product and engineering teams * Partner with Sales, Solutions Architecture, and Product to shape the technical go\-to\-market strategy The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot, including building production\-grade microservices * Strong understanding of event\-driven architecture \- Kafka, event sourcing, CQRS, async messaging patterns * Hands\-on experience with microservices design principles: service decomposition, API design, resiliency patterns, observability * Proficiency across multi\-cloud environments, with AWS as a primary platform; working knowledge of Azure and GCP * Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) * Exposure to Agentic AI frameworks and tooling \- including LangGraph, LangChain, or similar orchestration frameworks * Practical understanding of LLM integration patterns, prompt engineering, and AI\-powered application design * Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client\-relevant use cases * Exceptional communicator \- able to lead technical conversations with senior engineers and C\-suite stakeholders alike * Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions * Self\-directed, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously * Natural curiosity and a bias for building \- you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing or equivalent field. MBA a plus. * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent in client\-facing, solutions engineering, or field engineering roles * Ability to travel 20\-30%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Background in financial services, specifically banking, payments, or fintechs strongly preferred * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices * Contributions to open\-source projects or public technical content (talks, blogs, repos) * Prior experience in a startup or high\-growth SaaS environment * Relevant cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional, etc.) The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400\-$207,800\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. This is a great opportunity to be on the frontlines of Deloitte's innovation \& product strategy while staying close to industry/sector priorities. **Position Summary** We are looking for a highly skilled and client\-facing Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to sit at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer partnership. In this role, you will embed directly with our most strategic clients \- particularly in the financial services sector \- to understand their toughest technical challenges and help them design and implement world\-class solutions using our platform. This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role with direct influence on product direction. You will bring the client's data products to life and solve real problems that only surface when a platform meets production data. You are equally comfortable whiteboarding microservices architecture with a client's principal engineer, running a hands\-on technical workshop for a team of developers, and standing up a compelling proof\-of\-concept in days. You thrive in fast\-moving, high\-stakes environments and know how to earn the trust of deeply technical stakeholders. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026\. **Work you'll do** * Serve as the primary technical point of contact for strategic client accounts, building deep relationships with architects, engineers, and technical leaders * Lead discovery sessions to understand client architectures, pain points, and business objectives * Translate complex functional concepts into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non\-technical audiences * Look at trends in the market and experiment, bringing new ideas into the Product roadmap * Collaborate with client architects and implementation teams to configure and publish data products * Work hands\-on with implementation teams to define data product structure including schema, ownership, SLAs, quality expectations, and governance attributes * Independently structure and clean large\-scale financial data and load into the tool's models * Enable implementation teams to self\-serve data product creation over time and increase the configurability in the process * Run office hours, enablement sessions, and targeted training to help teams build confidence independently * Review and advise on client system designs, identifying risks and recommending best practices * Experience coordinating across time zones and operating on a onshore, near shore, offshore model * Produce high\-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and integration guides * Accelerate client time\-to\-value by enabling their teams to build confidently and independently * Act as the voice of the customer \- surface product gaps, integration friction, and feature requests to internal product and engineering teams The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, bonus Java Springboot, ReactJS * Understanding of data product concepts including schema design, data ownership, SLAs, quality frameworks, and governance * Experience building LLM\-powered agentic systems that use tools, execute multi\-turn workflows, manage state, and recover from errors, with a strong understanding of token economics and how to optimize cost and latency across model calls. * Hands\-on experience with microservices design principles: service decomposition, API design, resiliency patterns, observability * Experience working with structured data and unstructured data * Experience with data governance, data cataloguing, metadata management platforms, and data quality validation frameworks * Proficiency across multi\-cloud environments, with AWS as a primary platform; working knowledge of Azure and GCP. Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client\-relevant use cases * Exceptional communicator \- able to lead technical conversations with senior engineers and C\-suite stakeholders alike * Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions * Self\-directed, pro\-active, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client implementations simultaneously * Natural curiosity and a bias for building \- you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent field. * 6\+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent in client\-facing, solutions engineering, or field engineering roles specifically in the Investment Management industry * Ability to travel 20\-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Familiarity with concepts like AUM, NAV, positions/transactions, Reg Reporting or portfolio accounting is a strong plus, though not required to start. * Familiarity with financial data platforms * Experience with **AWS\-based data infrastructure** (EMR, S3, Glue) or **Snowflake** * Experience working in a start\-up or product company with a strong sense of building reusable but configurable Products. This is a great opportunity to be on the frontlines of Deloitte's innovation \& product strategy while staying close to industry/sector priorities. **Position Summary** Are you energized by both winning the deal and delivering on it? As a Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE), you'll be the GTM \& Delivery engine for Signals, a priority product in the Converge for FSI portfolio. Signals is a proprietary set of data assets coupled with AI, data science, and statistical models that help our clients drive business growth and power decisions in a dynamic and chaning market. You'll bring core consulting skills, financial services industry knowledge, and the ability to work with key stakeholders (product managers, technical / engineering teams, and Market Makers) to qualify product fit, pitch / demo products to clients, shape \& commercialize opportunities, and deliver work by managing scope, timeline, and client outcomes. You'll be expected to be equally comfortable pitching and demoing to a C\-suite leader as you are working with product / engineering teams to deliver on a proof of concept. As the pFDE, you will be responsible for developing the strategy, vision, and operations of the FDE function for the Signals product. You will drive commercial success by defining commercialization models, working with internal teams to enable licensing, and making it easier for Market Makers to sell products to clients. You will be part of the General Manager's leadership team, responsible for proactively bringing ideas that push the business forward, weighing in on key decisions, and helping junior resources across the team overcome hurdles. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026\. **Work you'll do** As a Product Forward Deployed Engineer, you will split your time between winning new product business and delivering on it once sold. You will: **Pre\-Sale:** * Build and maintain relationships with market makers, buyer decision\-makers, and Deloitte account teams to identify and shape product opportunities * Prepare and deliver pitches and product demos to client executives (including C\-suite), translating Signals for FSI product value into a clear business case * Develop go\-to\-market materials \- pitch decks, demo scripts, one\-pagers, case studies \- that Sales and Product teams can reuse across engagements * Partner with Market Makers and Product Managers to scope, price, and staff delivery engagements (incl. building scoping documents, pricing models, and commercial agreements) * Enable commercialization of products, create standardized license agreements, and be an advisor to Market Makers less familiar with taking Products to market **Post\-Sale:** * Lead delivery of scoped proofs of concept (POCs) and in\-market testing, working hands\-in\-hand with engineering and data science teams to deliver the product to the client to drive outcomes for their business * Serve as the client's primary point of contact post\-sale, managing scope, timeline, and outcomes, and escalating/resolving issues that put delivery at risk * Translate client requirements and product gaps back to Product Managers to inform the product feature backlog, distinguishing custom delivery needs from core product enhancements * Build, maintain, and scale reusable delivery assets, demo patterns, and implementation playbooks that accelerate the sales and deployment cycle for future engagements * Provide a continuous feedback loop between clients and the product team, and support knowledge transfer to delivery teams * Operate within defined engagement guardrails \- scoped, time\-boxed, and outcome\-oriented \- to protect capacity and ensure clean handoffs at the end of each deployment/delivery The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Comfortable moving fluidly between client\-facing selling conversations and hands\-on delivery oversight, without needing to write the underlying code * Strong executive presence and communicator, able to translate technical product capability into a business case for client executives and internal stakeholders alike * Able to work effectively alongside engineering and technical delivery teams \- understanding enough of the tech cope, sequence, and troubleshoot delivery without being the hands\-on engineer or data scientist * Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry sufficient to speak credibly to industry\-specific client problems across banking, insurance, and investment management * Ability to deliver work within scope / timelines and take an "outcomes" mindset to ensure client receives maximum value * Comfortable working through hard, ambiguous problems that require critical thinking, resourcefulness, and grit * Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client\-relevant use cases * Deep understanding of customer data science, segmentation, and behavioral insights that can be leveraged for sales and marketing across consumer and business customers * Knowledge and experience across the marketing, sales and distribution of financial services products and services * Deep understanding of customer data platforms, use of market research survey data and data science modeling to project insights and findings to larger populations * Understanding of data transfer protocols \- SFTP, Cloud Bucket to Bucket transfers, Clean Rooms and CRMs, and Martech Customer Data Platforms * Awareness and depth of knowledge of 1 st and 3 rd party data uses to drive marketing and sales. * Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions * Self\-directed, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously * Natural curiosity and a bias for building \- you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Data Science or equivalent field. MBA a plus. * 3\+ years of client\-facing management or technology consulting / professional services experience, including leading delivery of technology\-enabled engagements * 2\+ years of experience within, or delivering consulting/technology engagements to, the financial services industry * Demonstrated experience working alongside engineering, data science, or technical delivery teams to scope, sequence, and troubleshoot data / technology implementations, without requiring hands\-on coding * Demonstrated experience contributing to sales and business development activities (e.g., client pitches, proposals, demos) in addition to delivery * Ability to travel 20\-40%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I\&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future. Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start\-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented individual with an innovative mindset to join the Converge for FSI team in our mission to develop differentiated financial services products that achieve product\-market fit. This is a great opportunity to be on the frontlines of Deloitte's innovation \& product strategy while staying close to industry/sector priorities. **Position Summary** Are you energized by both winning the deal and delivering on it? As a Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE), you'll be the GTM \& Delivery engine for Signals, a priority product in the Converge for FSI portfolio. Signals is a proprietary set of data assets coupled with AI, data science, and statistical models that help our clients drive business growth and power decisions in a dynamic and chaning market. You'll bring core consulting skills, financial services industry knowledge, and the ability to work with key stakeholders (product managers, technical / engineering teams, and Market Makers) to qualify product fit, pitch / demo products to clients, shape \& commercialize opportunities, and deliver work by managing scope, timeline, and client outcomes. You'll be expected to be equally comfortable pitching and demoing to a C\-suite leader as you are working with product / engineering teams to deliver on a proof of concept. As the pFDE, you will be responsible for developing the strategy, vision, and operations of the FDE function for the Signals product. You will drive commercial success by defining commercialization models, working with internal teams to enable licensing, and making it easier for Market Makers to sell products to clients. You will be part of the General Manager's leadership team, responsible for proactively bringing ideas that push the business forward, weighing in on key decisions, and helping junior resources across the team overcome hurdles. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026\. **Work you'll do** As a Product Forward Deployed Engineer, you will split your time between winning new product business and delivering on it once sold. You will: **Pre\-Sale:** * Build and maintain relationships with market makers, buyer decision\-makers, and Deloitte account teams to identify and shape product opportunities * Prepare and deliver pitches and product demos to client executives (including C\-suite), translating Signals for FSI product value into a clear business case * Develop go\-to\-market materials \- pitch decks, demo scripts, one\-pagers, case studies \- that Sales and Product teams can reuse across engagements * Partner with Market Makers and Product Managers to scope, price, and staff delivery engagements (incl. building scoping documents, pricing models, and commercial agreements) * Enable commercialization of products, create standardized license agreements, and be an advisor to Market Makers less familiar with taking Products to market **Post\-Sale:** * Lead delivery of scoped proofs of concept (POCs) and in\-market testing, working hands\-in\-hand with engineering and data science teams to deliver the product to the client to drive outcomes for their business * Serve as the client's primary point of contact post\-sale, managing scope, timeline, and outcomes, and escalating/resolving issues that put delivery at risk * Translate client requirements and product gaps back to Product Managers to inform the product feature backlog, distinguishing custom delivery needs from core product enhancements * Build, maintain, and scale reusable delivery assets, demo patterns, and implementation playbooks that accelerate the sales and deployment cycle for future engagements * Provide a continuous feedback loop between clients and the product team, and support knowledge transfer to delivery teams * Operate within defined engagement guardrails \- scoped, time\-boxed, and outcome\-oriented \- to protect capacity and ensure clean handoffs at the end of each deployment/delivery The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Comfortable moving fluidly between client\-facing selling conversations and hands\-on delivery oversight, without needing to write the underlying code * Strong executive presence and communicator, able to translate technical product capability into a business case for client executives and internal stakeholders alike * Able to work effectively alongside engineering and technical delivery teams \- understanding enough of the tech cope, sequence, and troubleshoot delivery without being the hands\-on engineer or data scientist * Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry sufficient to speak credibly to industry\-specific client problems across banking, insurance, and investment management * Ability to deliver work within scope / timelines and take an "outcomes" mindset to ensure client receives maximum value * Comfortable working through hard, ambiguous problems that require critical thinking, resourcefulness, and grit * Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client\-relevant use cases * Deep understanding of customer data science, segmentation, and behavioral insights that can be leveraged for sales and marketing across consumer and business customers * Knowledge and experience across the marketing, sales and distribution of financial services products and services * Deep understanding of customer data platforms, use of market research survey data and data science modeling to project insights and findings to larger populations * Understanding of data transfer protocols \- SFTP, Cloud Bucket to Bucket transfers, Clean Rooms and CRMs, and Martech Customer Data Platforms * Awareness and depth of knowledge of 1 st and 3 rd party data uses to drive marketing and sales. * Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions * Self\-directed, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously * Natural curiosity and a bias for building \- you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Data Science or equivalent field. MBA a plus. * 3\+ years of client\-facing management or technology consulting / professional services experience, including leading delivery of technology\-enabled engagements * 2\+ years of experience within, or delivering consulting/technology engagements to, the financial services industry * Demonstrated experience working alongside engineering, data science, or technical delivery teams to scope, sequence, and troubleshoot data / technology implementations, without requiring hands\-on coding * Demonstrated experience contributing to sales and business development activities (e.g., client pitches, proposals, demos) in addition to delivery * Ability to travel 20\-40%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Experience selling and/or delivering licensable software/data products or productized services, as distinct from custom SOW\-based or traditional consulting delivery * Prior experience in a startup, high\-growth SaaS or data/insights environment * Prior experience using AI and LLMs to rapid prototype in a sales, business development or product demonstrations The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400\-$207,800\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

with taking Products to market **Post\-Sale:** * Lead delivery of scoped proofs of concept (POCs) and in\-market testing, working hands\-in\-hand with engineering and data science teams to deliver the product to the client to drive outcomes for their business * Serve as the client's primary point of contact post\-sale, managing scope, timeline, and outcomes, and escalating/resolving issues that put delivery at risk * Translate client requirements and product gaps back to Product Managers to inform the product feature backlog, distinguishing custom delivery needs from core product enhancements * Build, maintain, and scale reusable delivery assets, demo patterns, and implementation playbooks that accelerate the sales and deployment cycle for future engagements * Provide a continuous feedback loop between clients and the product team, and support knowledge transfer to delivery teams * Operate within defined engagement guardrails \- scoped, time\-boxed, and outcome\-oriented \- to protect capacity and ensure clean handoffs at the end of each deployment/delivery The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Comfortable moving fluidly between client\-facing selling conversations and hands\-on delivery oversight, without needing to write the underlying code * Strong executive presence and communicator, able to translate technical product capability into a business case for client executives and internal stakeholders alike * Able to work effectively alongside engineering and technical delivery teams \- understanding enough of the tech cope, sequence, and troubleshoot delivery without being the hands\-on engineer or data scientist * Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry sufficient to speak credibly to industry\-specific client problems across banking, insurance, and investment management * Ability to deliver work within scope / timelines and take an "outcomes" mindset to ensure client receives maximum value * Comfortable working through hard, ambiguous problems that require critical thinking, resourcefulness, and grit * Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client\-relevant use cases * Deep understanding of customer data science, segmentation, and behavioral insights that can be leveraged for sales and marketing across consumer and business customers * Knowledge and experience across the marketing, sales and distribution of financial services products and services * Deep understanding of customer data platforms, use of market research survey data and data science modeling to project insights and findings to larger populations * Understanding of data transfer protocols \- SFTP, Cloud Bucket to Bucket transfers, Clean Rooms and CRMs, and Martech Customer Data Platforms * Awareness and depth of knowledge of 1 st and 3 rd party data uses to drive marketing and sales. * Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions * Self\-directed, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously * Natural curiosity and a bias for building \- you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Data Science or equivalent field. MBA a plus. * 3\+ years of client\-facing management or technology consulting / professional services experience, including leading delivery of technology\-enabled engagements * 2\+ years of experience within, or delivering consulting/technology engagements to, the financial services industry * Demonstrated experience working alongside engineering, data science, or technical delivery teams to scope, sequence, and troubleshoot data / technology implementations, without requiring hands\-on coding * Demonstrated experience contributing to sales and business development activities (e.g., client pitches, proposals, demos) in addition to delivery * Ability to travel 20\-40%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Experience selling and/or delivering licensable software/data products or productized services, as distinct from custom SOW\-based or traditional consulting delivery * Prior experience in a startup, high\-growth SaaS or data/insights environment * Prior experience using AI and LLMs to rapid prototype in a sales, business development or product demonstrations The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. Essentially, this role operates at the intersection of technical execution and stakeholder clarity—converting solution designs into built, tested, deployed capabilities while keeping teams coordinated, risks visible, and stakeholders informed. **RESPONSIBILITY AREAS** **Sprint Planning \& Execution** -------------------------------- * Own sprint planning for assigned workstream(s); propose workarounds or mitigation strategies; drive resolution with urgency * Coordinate dependencies across parallel workstreams; align timing and handoffs to prevent downstream delays * Facilitate cross\-team sync meetings when dependencies require real\-time coordination or decision\-making * Track high\-risk dependencies; flag to engagement leadership for escalation if resolution is stalled **Quality \& Technical Standards** ---------------------------------- * Define and enforce acceptance criteria for all deliverables; ensure quality is non\-negotiable * Conduct or facilitate code/design reviews; ensure work aligns with architectural intent and technical standards * Partner with QA to ensure comprehensive test coverage; identify and track defects; manage rework efficiently * Maintain visibility into technical debt and archit ional lines * Coaching mindset: ability to mentor junior team members and help them grow into stronger technical professionals * Presence and credibility: command respect from both technical and non\-technical stakeholders ### **Problem\-Solving \& Adaptability** * Strong problem\-solving and critical thinking; jobs.title: System Test Technician
jobs.description: **System Test Technician** **Department:** Engineering **Reports To:** Systems Engineering Director **Location:** On\-site **Position Summary** Digital Dynamics, Inc. is seeking an experienced, hands\-on, and detail\-oriented **System Test Technician** to support the testing, integration, troubleshooting, and modification of hardware systems and products. This position will work closely with Systems, Electrical, Software, Manufacturing, and Quality Engineering teams to execute test procedures, troubleshoot hardware issues, perform component\-level rework, collect and analyze test data, and support product development and validation activities. The ideal candidate has extensive experience working with electronic hardware, PCBAs, schematics, bench test equipment, and system\-level testing. This individual should be comfortable independently troubleshooting technical issues, identifying root causes of failures, and clearly documenting and communicating test results in a laboratory environment. **Key Responsibilities** * Perform hardware system integration, functional, and validation testing in accordance with established test plans and procedures. * Follow and accurately execute established test plans, procedures, and engineering instructions. * Set up, configure, operate, and maintain test equipment and hardware required for system\-level testing. * Test and troubleshoot electronic hardware, including **power conversion circuits and timing\-related circuitry**. * Execute test procedures and accurately collect, record, organize, and report test data and results. * Identify, reproduce, troubleshoot, and document hardware and system\-level issues discovered during testing. * Perform root\-cause troubleshooting of hardware and system failures using schematics, test procedures, and appropriate diagnostic equipment. * Clearly document and communicate test results, failure conditions, observations, and identified root causes. * Support corrective\-action investigations and verify implemented solutions through testing. * Read, interpret, and **update electrical schematics** and related engineering documentation. * Prepare and process **Engineering Change Orders (ECOs)** as required to support hardware changes and corrections. * Perform **component\-level rework in accordance with applicable IPC standards**. * Operate bench test equipment such as oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, analyzers, and other diagnostic tools. * Support the assembly, configuration, modification, and maintenance of test setups, fixtures, cables, PCBAs, and related equipment. * Track identified issues and communicate test status and findings to the appropriate engineering teams. * Follow established engineering, quality, ESD, IPC, and safety procedures while performing testing and rework activities. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support system integration, product development, troubleshooting, and release activities. * Provide feedback to engineers regarding test procedures, testability, recurring failures, and opportunities to improve testing efficiency. * Maintain an organized laboratory and ensure test equipment, tools, and documentation are properly maintained. **Qualifications** * Associate degree, technical certification, or equivalent hands\-on experience in Electronics, Electrical Engineering Technology, Computer Engineering Technology, or a related technical field. * **10\+ years of experience in electronics, hardware testing, or system testing.** * Strong understanding of **electronic components, printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs), schematics, and hardware systems**. * Proven ability to **read and update electrical schematics and prepare Engineering Change Orders (ECOs)**. * Demonstrated ability to **perform component\-level rework in accordance with IPC standards**. * Experience **testing and troubleshooting power conversion circuits and timing\-related circuitry**. * Extensive hands\-on experience using common bench test equipment, including oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, and analyzers. * Ability to read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, test procedures, technical drawings, and engineering documentation. * Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills with the ability to methodically identify and isolate hardware and system\-level failures. * Ability to **clearly report test results, failure conditions, and root causes of identified issues**. * Demonstrated ability to **follow and execute established test plans and procedures**. * Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. * Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a cross\-functional engineering team. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Experience working in a hardware development, electronics manufacturing, semiconductor equipment, or mission\-critical systems environment is a plus. * Experience supporting engineering teams during product development, system integration, or verification and validation testing is preferred.

jobs.title: z/OS Automations Scheduling Support Technician
jobs.description: Diné Development Corporation (DDC) is seeking a highly skilled **z/OS Automations Scheduling Support Technician** to provide advanced automation, scheduling, monitoring, and operational support for IBM z/OS mainframe environments. This position is responsible for identifying opportunities to improve manual processes through automation, supporting enterprise job scheduling and monitoring solutions, implementing software upgrades, and ensuring the stability, security, and performance of mission\-critical mainframe systems. The successful candidate will work closely with system programmers, engineers, government personnel, and technical teams to develop automated solutions, manage system resources, support disaster recovery activities, maintain documentation, and ensure compliance with Department of Defense (DoD), Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), U.S. Cyber Command, and organizational policies and procedures. **Responsibilities:** * Provide the analytical ability to identify problem areas in manual processes and develop automated solutions. * Utilize IBM System z/OS automation, job scheduling, system monitoring and alerting products from vendors to include BMC Software, CA Technologies, and IBM. * Provide customer support (internal and external) on questions and incidents relating to automation on the mainframe systems, to include changes, upgrades, new and discontinued features, and known problems. * Ensure that all system resources required for automation are available for successful implementation. * Ensure shared resources and the tools used to manage resource sharing are properly configured. * Develop test plans, test cases, and test data for each release test effort. Test plans will include security compliance, functional, integration, performance, and regression testing to detect and resolve flaws that may impact the security, integrity, and stability of the automation. * Coordinate with other system programmers and managers whenever a change in automation interfaces with another mainframe component that and may require changes to, or have an impact on, that component. * Ability to work in a team environment and share developed solutions for approval and implementation. * Adhere to and participate in this organization’s Change Management and CAB policies and procedures. * Provide support using standard tools (currently BMC Control Products Suite) for scheduling to include building, maintaining, and scheduling batch processing (to include complex system abend (error) recovery techniques). Provide real\-time accurate monitoring and troubleshooting of multiple mainframe systems and applications. * Use government documented processes and procedures to download and install application releases. * Develop and deliver detailed documentation, using government specified documentation software and processes.
