jobs.title: Senior Product Manager | Applied AI
jobs.description: We are growing a product\-management team that runs AI\-powered products and applies AI across the whole product lifecycle. As a **Senior Product Manager \| Applied AI**, you will own the vision, strategy, roadmap and delivery of one or more products — at least one of them AI\-powered — while using AI day to day to work faster and make sharper decisions and mentoring other Product Managers as you do. What "Applied AI" means here. This is a product role, not an engineering role. We expect confident, practical command of AI as a product manager — using it across the lifecycle and shaping AI\-powered features — not the ability to build, train or tune machine\-learning models as an ML engineer or data scientist would. Req.\#1100334046 **Responsibilities** * Own the vision, strategy, roadmap and end\-to\-end delivery of one or more products, including at least one that is AI\-powered * Define requirements and use cases for AI features, treating them as probabilistic products — scoping data and use\-case fit, and setting evaluation criteria, quality bars, guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop review as acceptance criteria * Identify where AI can improve the product, the customer experience, internal processes or business outcomes — and build and size the case for it * Use AI tools productively and with discipline across discovery, research synthesis, analysis, documentation, user stories, prototyping and planning — verifying outputs before relying on them * Prioritise features, own the backlog and manage release cycles, using AI\-assisted analysis to support (not replace) your decisions * Manage the full product lifecycle, including the added considerations of AI features — model/version changes, quality drift and human oversight * Work closely with engineering, data, design and AI/ML teams, translating product intent into requirements they can act on and their constraints into product decisions * Set realistic expectations with clients and stakeholders about what AI can and cannot do, and communicate benefits, limitations and risks in plain language * Mentor Product Managers and raise the team's practical AI capability by example **Requirements** * 5\+ years in Product Management, having managed one or more products end to end, including post\-launch maintenance and support * Launched more than one product (or key capability) to market, with at least one experience delivering or materially improving an AI\-powered product or feature (e.g. GenAI, ML, recommendations, search or automation) * Solid ownership of product strategy, vision and roadmap; market analysis and product visioning — including identifying and justifying where AI adds value * Experience owning backlogs, cross\-product dependencies and release cycles, and managing product lifecycle and support models * Familiarity with product profitability, competitive positioning and pricing — including the cost, latency and quality trade\-offs that shape AI\-feature economics * Expertise across multiple (3\+) business domains, able to act as a business\-domain SME * Working AI literacy — what current AI (including GenAI/LLMs) can and cannot do reliably, common patterns and typical failure modes — enough to make sound product decisions and hold credible conversations with technical teams. Deep model\-building knowledge is not required * Able to influence stakeholders up to and including VP level, and to lead all critical aspects of a product launch * Able to lead a team of Product Owners and/or Product Managers across a product line or family, guiding them through the full lifecycle * Raises the team's practical AI proficiency — sharing verified ways of working and coaching on requirements and evaluation criteria for AI features * Practical, daily use of AI across research, discovery, analysis, documentation, user stories, prototyping and planning — with verification of outputs * Ability to identify and justify AI opportunities in products, processes, CX and business outcomes * Working AI literacy — concepts, terminology, capabilities and limitations at PM depth * Experience defining requirements and use cases for AI features, including evaluation criteria, quality bars, guardrails and human oversight * Ability to evaluate AI outputs for quality, accuracy, risk, limitations and user impact * Responsible\-AI awareness — privacy, bias, security, transparency and human oversight * Ability to work effectively with engineering, data, design and AI/ML teams * Adaptability and continuous learning as AI tools and capabilities evolve **Nice to have** * Hands\-on prototyping with AI builder tools to near\-production fidelity * Building PM agents / multi\-step automations across research, backlog, analytics and comms * Understanding of AI\-feature economics (cost, latency, unit economics) and model lifecycle (drift, versioning, vendor change) * Familiarity with AI regulation (e.g. EU AI Act) and relevant sector rules * Prior experience taking an AI\-powered product to production at scale **We offer** * Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance (Subsidized) * Health Savings Account * Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter) * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability (Company Provided) * Life and AD\&D Insurance (Company Provided) * Employee Assistance Program * Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions * Matched 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan * Paid Time Off – the employee will be eligible to accrue 15\-25 paid days, depending on specific level and tenure with EPAM (accrual eligibility may change over time) * Paid Holidays \- nine (9\) total per year * Legal Plan and Identity Theft Protection * Accident Insurance * Employee Discounts * Pet Insurance * Employee Stock Purchase Program * If otherwise eligible, participation in the discretionary annual bonus program * If otherwise eligible and hired into a qualifying level, participation in the discretionary Long\-Term Incentive (LTI) Program **For remote work in New York City only.** EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our clients, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential. Engineer the Future with a Career at EPAM This posting includes a good faith range of the salary EPAM would reasonably expect to pay the selected candidate. The range provided reflects base salary only. Individual compensation offers within the range are based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to: geographic location, experience, credentials, education, training, the demand for the role; and overall business and labor market considerations. Most candidates are hired at a salary within the range disclosed. Salary range: *$150,000\-$220,000* USD. This position is also eligible for variable compensation incentives. In addition, the details highlighted in this job posting above are a general description of all other expected benefits and compensation for the position. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. EPAM will not provide new H\-1B visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates with existing transferable H\-1B status may be considered. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: EZETech is hiring a senior engineer who builds with AI every day and can still read, defend, and secure every line that ships. You will take our internal security and compliance platforms from single\-builder projects to multi\-tenant SaaS that regulated clients can trust. About EZETech EZETech is a managed security service provider on Florida's Treasure Coast. Our nine\-person team secures roughly 600 endpoints for dental, medical, and financial clients, and we operate under HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, CMMC 2\.0, and ISO 27001\. We build our own tooling: our internal platforms cover compliance automation, vulnerability and exposure management, endpoint application control, and service operations, and we are building a combined CRM and EHR for behavioral health clinics. The next step is selling these platforms to other providers as SaaS. Today they are built largely by our founder using AI coding agents. This role adds the engineering depth that turns working software into products that survive audits, attackers, and paying tenants. What you will build and own (reporting directly to the founder) \- Product engineering: multi\-tenant SaaS features across our security and compliance platforms, front end to database \- AI\-assisted delivery with accountability: use coding agents such as Claude Code, then review, test, and own the output. If you cannot explain a change, it does not merge \- Agent and LLM systems: agent workflows, tool integrations, and retrieval pipelines on hosted APIs and local inference, defended against prompt injection, data leakage, and excessive agent permissions \- Security architecture: authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, secrets management, encryption, audit logging, and threat modeling \- Infrastructure and networking: deployments, CI/CD, DNS, TLS, reverse proxies, private mesh networking, firewalls, backups, and tested restores \- Regulated data handling: systems for protected health information with controls that hold up in a HIPAA or SOC 2 audit \- Hardening existing code and operational ownership: fix weak points in priority order, monitor what you ship, respond when it breaks, write the postmortem Required qualifications \- 5\+ years building production software, including at least one SaaS product you helped ship and then operate \- Strong in TypeScript/Node, Python, or Go, plus a modern front\-end framework such as React \- Solid PostgreSQL (or equivalent) skills: schema design, migrations, indexing, row\-level access control \- Disciplined with Git, code review, automated tests, and CI/CD; able to find bugs and security flaws in unfamiliar and AI\-generated code \- Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10; has correctly implemented OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, SSO, MFA, session handling, and role\-based access \- Understands multi\-tenant isolation, secrets, keys, and encryption in transit and at rest; thinks in least privilege, logging, and recoverability \- Understands TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP, reverse proxies, VPNs, and firewall rules well enough to debug with a packet capture \- Has run services on Linux with containers, designed backups, and performed a real restore \- Daily, fluent user of AI coding agents with a clear verification process; has built with LLM APIs beyond a chat wrapper (tool use, agents, structured output, retrieval, or evaluation) and understands hallucination, prompt injection, and context limits \- Authorized to work in the United States and able to pass a background check (you will access systems protecting patient and financial data) \- Clear written communication: you document decisions, risks, and how to recover Preferred qualifications \- Experience at an MSP, MSSP, or security software vendor \- Built software under HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, CMMC, or ISO 27001, or answered the questions in an audit \- Healthcare software experience: EHR or practice management, HL7 or FHIR \- Endpoint/systems work: Windows internals, agents and services, Active Directory, PowerShell \- Local model inference (Ollama or similar), GPU hosts, and workflow automation such as n8n \- Offensive security exposure: penetration testing, CTFs, bug bounty, or OSINT tooling \- Security certifications are welcome but do not replace shipped work Who this role is not for \- You prompt until it runs and ship it without reading the diff \- You cannot explain how your last project handled authentication, tenant separation, or secrets \- You treat security and compliance as someone else's job or a final checklist \- You want a large team, a narrow lane, and a product manager writing your tickets. We are nine people and you will own outcomes end to end How we hire 1\. Application: resume plus links to code or products you built. Tell us which parts you wrote, which parts an AI wrote, and how you verified the AI's work 2\. Technical conversation (45 minutes): walk us through a system you built 3\. Paid work sample (about 3 hours): review a small AI\-generated application with planted security and networking flaws, report findings in priority order, and fix the top issues. AI tools are allowed and expected 4\. Founder interview 5\. References and background check How to apply Use our resume form at https://ezetech.com/submit\-resume/ (full details at https://ezetech.com/jobs/senior\-ai\-software\-engineer/). In its Message box, name this role and include the links and notes described in step 1 above. You can also apply here on Indeed, but please still send the step 1 links and notes. EZETech is an equal opportunity company and welcomes applicants of all backgrounds. People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Deputy Fire Marshal - Plans Reviewer
jobs.description: **Position Title:** Deputy Fire Marshal – Plans Reviewer **Division:** Fire Prevention Bureau **Reports To:** Assistant Fire Marshals / Fire Marshal **Status:** Civilian Position, Non\-Exempt, Union Represented **POSTING DATE:** September 24, 2026 **DEADLINE TO APPLY:** October 18, 2026 **EMAIL INQUIRIES:** **careers@esf\-r.org** **HIRING SCHEDULE:** **October 19\-20** Review of Applications and Schedule Interviews **October 26\-29** Interviews **November 1\-15** Candidate Selection \- Pre\-Hire Background and Requisites Check **December 1** Expected Hire Date **JOB DESCRIPTION \& ADDITIONAL BENEFITS / PREHIRE REQUISITES INFORMATION** **General Summary**: The Deputy Fire Marshal – Plans Reviewer, under the direction and supervision of the Assistant Fire Marshals and Fire Marshal, performs technical fire and life safety plan reviews for development projects within ESFR’s service area and contracted jurisdictions. Duties include reviewing building and fire protection system plans for compliance with adopted fire and life safety codes, coordinating with municipal departments and project stakeholders, conducting inspections related to development projects, and providing technical assistance regarding fire code requirements and permit processes. Performance evaluations are conducted in accordance with Agency policy. **Essential Job Functions:** Responsible for conducting fire prevention and plans review services, including, but not limited to, plan review, code enforcement, inspections, permit coordination, and technical consultation with city and county departments, contractors, developers, architects, engineers, and the public. **Plan Review:** * Reviews/checks building plans submitted to the Agency for compliance with local, state, and federal fire and life safety regulations and nationally recognized standards. * Reviews fire protection system plans, including fire alarms, fire sprinklers, fire access, hydrant placement, fire flow, water supply, hazardous materials systems, and related fire/life safety features. * Coordinates plan review comments and correction notices with municipal planning, building, engineering, and public works departments. * Participates in development review and pre\-application meetings as assigned. * Responds to inquiries regarding proposed development projects and permit requirements. * Educates customers on permit processes and fire code requirements. * Manages multiple projects simultaneously to ensure timely and effective review completion. **Fire Inspections:** * Conducts inspections associated with assigned plan reviews to verify approved plans, correction items, fire protection systems, and applicable fire code requirements. * Assists with fire and life safety inspections of commercial, institutional, manufacturing, and other occupancies. * Maintains records of inspections, permits, plan reviews, and related documentation. * Assists Agency personnel with fire code interpretation and enforcement/compliance issues. **Knowledge of:** * Currently adopted International Fire Code (IFC), International Building Code (IBC), International Residential Code (IRC), and applicable NFPA standards. * Local, state, and federal regulations governing fire and life safety. * Building construction methods, materials, and fire protection systems. * Fire inspection techniques and code enforcement practices. * Hazardous materials recognition and hazardous conditions. * Municipal development and permitting processes. **Skills and Ability To:** * Read and interpret technical building plans, specifications, and construction documents. * Effectively communicate technical requirements both orally and in writing. * Prepare clear correction notices, reports, and recommendations. * Work effectively with municipal departments, contractors, developers, architects, engineers, and the public. * Exercise sound judgment related to the application and enforcement of adopted Fire and Building Codes. * Work independently with limited supervision. * Maintain professional and respectful relationships with internal and external customers. * Respond to customer requests in a timely and professional manner. * Operate computer systems, permitting software, and office equipment. * Teach and/or impart technical knowledge to others. * Manage competing priorities and workload demands. **Education and Experience****:** * Must possess a high school diploma or GED. * Associate degree or higher in Fire Prevention, Fire Science, Fire Protection Engineering, Building Construction, or related field preferred. * Must possess the following International Code Council (ICC) Certifications or obtain within one (1\) year of hire: + Fire Inspector I + Fire Plans Examiner * Minimum of two (2\) years of experience in plans review, fire prevention, fire inspections, construction, code enforcement, or related field preferred. * Experience with permit processing and electronic permitting systems preferred. * Maintain a Washington State driver's license and a good driving record as identified in Agency policy. * Maintain EVIP certification to drive Agency\-assigned vehicle(s). * Maintain CPR and Basic First Aid certification. **Physical Requirements****:** * Read a computer screen, plans, reports, letters, documents, and training materials. * Drive personal and Agency vehicles. * Communicate, express oneself, convey, converse, and exchange information. * Frequent movement is necessary in office settings, meetings, conferences, and field inspections. * Occasionally ascends/descends stairs; occasionally positions self to reach high/low workspaces; occasionally kneels; seldom stoops, crouches, or crawls. * Move, transport, and/or position materials up to 25 pounds. * Frequently works in an indoor office setting; occasionally required to work prolonged periods during emergencies or inclement weather. * Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. * Successfully pass annual respiratory mask fit test as applicable. * Successfully pass the Agency’s pre\-hire background check, medical, drug screen, and psychological testing. **Working Conditions****:** Normally works a 40\-hour week as a uniformed employee. The normal working hours are defined in a separate Collective Bargaining Agreement between the employer and the employee. The work schedule may be adjusted to meet the needs of the Agency. Attendance at meetings, development review meetings, inspections, standby at incidents, and responses to emergencies during evening hours, weekends, and holidays may be required. The employee may be exposed to adverse weather conditions, hazardous chemicals, heat, cold, light, dark, and atmospheres immediately dangerous to life and health (IDLH). Work is performed in both office and field environments. Work utilizes standard office software, hardware, and equipment. **Emergency/Alternate Work Schedule****:** To ensure the Agency workforce is protected, and to ensure continuity of operations, the employee may be required to work an alternate work schedule (e.g., telework) in the case of an emergency (i.e., epidemic, severe weather conditions, or other emergency situations). An alternative work schedule may also be utilized in place of a traditional fixed work schedule to help balance work and personal responsibilities. **General:**The employee is required to adhere to all Agency policies, regulations, and procedures. The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees but are not a complete list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the Agency. **Pre\-Hire Requisites:** * Successfully pass the Agency’s pre\-hire background investigation, psychological evaluation and drug screening * Applicant hired may become a member of Local 1762 of the International Association of Firefighters * Employees are on probation the first 12 months of employment **Benefits:** Eastside Fire \& Rescue provides employees with excellent benefits including: * Medical, Vision, RX and Dental Insurance for employees and dependents \- Employer pays all premiums * Employer funded VEBA HRA account (health reimbursement account) * Employer contribution to 457 Deferred Compensation Retirement Savings Plan * Membership into the Public Employees Retirement System (PERS) Pension Plan * Paid Sick Leave, vacation, thirteen paid holidays plus two additional personal holidays per year * Education incentive \& tuition assistance **Application Requirements:** Candidates are required to submit the following to be considered: * Online Application Form * Resume * Cover Letter Describing Plan Review and Inspection Experience

jobs.title: Data Center Chief Engineer

jobs.title: Transmission Line Design Engineer - New Grad - Civil - Reno
jobs.description: **Transmission Line Design Engineer – Entry Level (Reno, NV)** ENTRUST Solutions Group is seeking a Transmission Line Design Engineer new grad to join our team in Reno, NV. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and analyzing transmission line structures, conductors, and foundations, and supporting the construction of transmission lines that deliver electricity from power plants to homes and businesses. You'll start on projects in northern Nevada and grow into work for utility clients across the United States, learning the broader U.S. grid along the way. You will work closely with a diverse team of experienced engineers and PEs who will train you, along with project managers and stakeholders, to ensure safe and efficient delivery of power. This role is a great fit for December 2026 and May 2027 graduates. **You'll make periodic field visits to project sites, so you must live in the Reno area.** **Why Transmission Line Engineering?** The U.S. power grid is one of the most stable and in\-demand fields in engineering, and it's only growing. Much of the country's transmission infrastructure is decades old and due for replacement. At the same time, electricity demand is rising fast, driven by data centers, AI, and electrification. Utilities need engineers who can design the lines that make that growth possible, and that need isn't going away. Transmission line engineering is a unique, specialized niche within civil engineering, and it tends to pay well compared with many other civil disciplines. You'll also pick up a working knowledge of electrical engineering, and you may be surprised how familiar it feels. Electricity flowing through a line behaves a lot like water flowing through a pipe, so the hydraulics and fluids concepts you learned in school carry over. **Responsibilities:** * Design and analyze transmission line systems, including structures, conductors, and foundations. * Prepare detailed engineering drawings, material lists, calculations, specifications, and reports. * Conduct site visits and inspections to ensure compliance with design standards and safety regulations. * Collaborate with utility clients, project managers, contractors, and other engineers to ensure successful project execution in Nevada and across the U.S. * Utilize advanced software tools for modeling and simulation of transmission line performance (PLS\-CADD and PLS\-POLE – we'll train you). * Stay up to date with industry trends, standards, and best practices. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering (completed, or expected by May 2027\). * EIT or plans to pass the FE exam within the first year * Comfortable working outdoors and traveling to project sites * Valid driver's license **Preferred Qualifications:** * Structural or geotechnical coursework * Internship or co\-op experience in civil, structural, or utility work * Any exposure to transmission line design and analysis software (e.g., PLS\-CADD, PLS\-POLE). **What We Offer:** * A supportive and inclusive work environment that values diversity and encourages innovation. * Opportunities for professional growth and career development. * Hands\-on mentorship from licensed PEs and a clear path to your PE license. * Experience with utility clients across the U.S. and a broad understanding of the national grid. * Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including generous paid time off, 401(k) with company match, tuition reimbursement, and flexible work schedules. **Why Join Us?** At ENTRUST Solutions Group, a Leidos company, we are driven by a commitment to innovation, technical excellence, and delivering the critical infrastructure that powers and connects communities. Together with Leidos, we are building a scaled, end\-to\-end energy and infrastructure organization focused on modernizing the grid, improving reliability, and helping utilities and network providers meet rising demand. As an ENR top ranked firm, our team of more than 5,000 professionals brings deep technical expertise and advanced technology across electric, gas, and telecommunications infrastructure. We solve complex challenges for clients across North America and expanding markets, helping them strengthen reliability, expand capacity, and adapt to evolving infrastructure needs. We foster a culture where innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement are expected, and where people are empowered to challenge convention, think boldly, and make an impact. Whether you are looking to grow your expertise, lead transformative projects, or help shape the future of infrastructure, you will find opportunities to thrive here. If you are ready to outthink the status quo, tackle meaningful challenges, and build what is next, we would love to hear from you. **Explore More Opportunities:** Not quite the right fit? Check out all our openings at ENTRUST Solutions Group Careers (https://entrustsol.com/careers/). To learn more about ENTRUST Benefits and Culture, please visit our company LinkedIn page and follow us at: https://www.linkedin.com/company/entrustsolutionsgroup (https://www.linkedin.com/company/entrustsolutionsgroup) *ENTRUST Solutions Group is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.* *Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. jobs.title: Senior Security Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** **WHO WE ARE** Equinox is a category of one, setting the global standard for luxury health, wellness, and hospitality. Our spaces are intentionally elevated, our standards uncompromising, and our expectations high. We attract people who take pride in excellence, care deeply about quality, and want to be part of something that feels different the moment you walk through the door. We are builders, operators, and innovators who believe great environments and meaningful human connection change lives. Diversity, belonging, and ownership aren’t slogans here, they’re how we work. At Equinox, colleagues don’t just support the business; they shape the future of wellness. Because for us, it’s not fitness. It’s life. **WHAT WE DO** We create premium, immersive experiences where performance, hospitality, design, and human connection converge—and every detail matters. This is not a traditional fitness environment. It is a place where high standards, accountability, and pride in craft define the work. Fueled by an entrepreneurial mindset, we trust our people with real responsibility and real impact. Growth is earned through action, learning is hands‑on, and careers are built by those who want to operate at the highest level. At Equinox, we don’t just offer opportunities—we offer long‑term pathways for people who want to do meaningful work in an environment that expects more and delivers more. **Job Description** We are looking for a senior engineer who can operate at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and security operations. This is a hybrid role for an engineer who is equally comfortable debugging a Terraform module, tuning a SIEM detection rule, and leading an incident response investigation. You'll be a primary technical escalation point for both platform reliability and security incidents across all cloud environments. What You'll Do Cloud Infrastructure \& Platform Engineering * Own and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code across (e.g., Terraform) cloud providers, including shared modules used by application teams org\-wide * Manage IAM users, keys, and secrets lifecycle (rotation, storage in Parameter Store/Secrets Manager, cross\-environment consistency) * Diagnose and resolve production networking and infrastructure issues: load balancer health checks, security groups, WAF rules, CDN and origin access, DNS, and container orchestration * Administer access across supported platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, GitHub, etc.) and internal developer tooling * Evaluate and integrate third\-party platform/security tooling (e.g., CSPM, code security scanners) * Support CI/CD pipelines and troubleshoot build/deploy failures SIEM \& Detection Engineering * Own and operate the organization's Elastic Security (SIEM) platform end\-to\-end: cluster upgrades, agent/integration management, and log ingestion pipelines (cloud audit logs, identity provider logs, payment/fraud logs, WAF logs) * Design, build, and tune detection rules and alerting workflows, including integrating SIEM alerts into team communication channels (e.g., Slack) * Continuously improve signal quality by resolving log parsing errors, refining index patterns, and reducing false positives * Maintain technical documentation for logging architecture and detection rule logic Security Operations \& Incident Response * Provide technical leadership and day\-to\-day oversight for the SOC team, including prioritization, escalations, investigation quality and mentoring * Serve as a senior escalation point for the SOC, guiding and mentoring analysts through investigations * Lead investigations into anomalous authentication activity, account compromise, and suspicious network traffic, including coordinating remediation (session revocation, credential resets, user outreach) * Develop and maintain incident response runbooks and reference documentation * Build and maintain WAF\-based detection and mitigation capabilities (e.g., fingerprint\- and IP\-based blocking of malicious/fraudulent traffic) Identity, Access \& Compliance * Drive identity governance initiatives, including cloud identity reconciliation (e.g., managed vs. unmanaged accounts) and license/access audits * Design and implement authentication hardening measures: conditional access policies, MFA/authentication strength requirements, and legacy protocol deprecation (e.g., legacy SMTP auth) * Partner with IT/security leadership on identity provider strategy and vendor licensing decisions Application, AI \& Code Ownership * Hold end\-to\-end security ownership across the organization's core application stack, spanning front\-end (React Native, React Web), back\-end (Node.js, Spring Boot/Java, Python/Flask), and AI/ML systems * Review code and architecture for security vulnerabilities (e.g., dependency/supply\-chain risk, secrets handling, authN/authZ flaws, insecure API design) across mobile, web, and service layers * Partner with application engineering teams to embed securi zation\-wide adoption * Define and maintain security guardrails/review processes for teams building AI\-powered features or agents, including monitoring for anomalous or abusive usage patterns Fraud \& Payments Security * Partner with risk and payments teams to investigate and mitigate payment fraud (e.g., card\-testing/BIN attacks, risk\-scoring anomalies in third\-party payment platforms) * Analyze and recommend changes to fraud risk rules, allow\-lists, and risk profiles * Track and help prioritize security remediation tickets related to payment endpoints **Qualifications** Required: * 5\+ years of experience in infrastructure/platform engineering, with hands\-on production ownership in multi\-account cloud environments * Strong Terraform/IaC experience, including authoring and maintaining shared modules * Experience operating a SIEM platform (Elastic Security preferred) — log ingestion, detection engineering, and alerting * Solid networking fundamentals: load balancers, security groups, WAF, DNS, CDN * Experience with identity providers (Entra ID/Azure AD, Okta, or similar) and authentication/authorization concepts (SSO, SAML, MFA, conditional access) * Demonstrated experience leading or heavily contributing to security incident response * Comfortable being a hands\-on technical escalation point across multiple teams simultaneously * Working familiarity with application security practices across modern web/mobile and backend stacks (e.g., React/React Native, Node.js, Java/Spring Boot, Python/Flask) — able to read code, understand architecture, and identify security risk even if not writing production application code day\-to\-day Preferred: * Proven experience with AWS, GCP and Azure * Familiarity with payments security concepts (fraud scoring, PCI\-adjacent systems, payment gateway risk tools such as Adyen) * Experience with container orchestration (ECS or similar) * Experience mentoring SOC analysts or junior engineers * Familiarity with CSPM/vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, CrowdStrike) * Hands\-on development or code review experience in React Native, React Web, Node.js, Spring Boot/Java, or Python/Flask * Experience with SAST/SCA tooling (e.g., GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk, SonarQube) and integrating security scanning into CI/CD * Familiarity with AI/LLM security concepts (prompt injection, data leakage, model access control) and securing AI\-powered product features or internal AI tooling What Success Looks Like * Production infrastructure incidents are diagnosed and resolved quickly, with root cause identified and preventive fixes (module/PR updates) shipped * SIEM coverage expands reliably with high\-quality, low\-noise detections * Security incidents are triaged and resolved with clear communication and documented runbooks * Identity and access posture continuously improves (reduced legacy auth, tighter conditional access, cleaner account governance) * Cross\-functional partners (data, application, payments teams) see this role as a trusted, responsive technical partner Pay Transparency: $145K \- $175K **Additional Information** **AS A MEMBER OF THE EQUINOX TEAM YOU WILL RECEIVE:** * We offer competitive salaries, benefits, and industry leading commission opportunities for club employees * Complimentary Club membership * Perks and incentives with our products and services including Personal Training, Pilates, Spa and Shop This job description is intended to describe the general requirements for the position. It is not a complete statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. Other duties not listed here may be assigned as necessary to ensure the proper operations of the department. **Equinox is an equal opportunity employer. For more information regarding our career opportunities, please visit one of our clubs or our website at** ***https://careers.equinox.com/*** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Must have a legal right to work in the United States.

opportunity when things don't quite go to plan — not only for you, but for how we **continuously improve** as a team. * You take a hypothesis\-driven approach — knowing how to source, create and **leverage data** to inform **decision making**, using data to **drive how we improve**, to shape how we **evaluate** and make platform **recommendations.** ### **So, what is important to us?** Above all, **you'll get stuff done.** More importantly, you'll collaborate to **do the right things**, in the **right way** to achieve the **right outcomes**. * + **Proficient** with a high order object oriented language (especially Python or TypeScript \- open to Go, Java, Scala, C\# etc.) and **proficient** with JavaScript ES6\+ (we are open to React, Vue.js, AngularJS etc.). + Delivery focused with solid exposure to event driven architectures and high volume data processing. + **Practical exposure** of CI/CD pipelines for your **production services.** + Familiarity with **public cloud** service platforms. + Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product managers and designers, to define project requirements and features. + **Proven track record** in learning new technologies and applying that learning quickly. + Experience building **observability** and **monitoring** into applications. ### **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, jobs.title: Fleet Software Lead
jobs.description: **About Etched** Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co\-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best\-in\-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on **inference**. Backed by hundreds of millions from top\-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history. **Job Summary** We’re hiring a Fleet Systems Lead to join our Supercomputing organization. This team builds the software that enables Etched to deploy inference clusters at gigawatt\-scale. This role presents an opportunity to shape how frontier inference hardware is deployed, managed, and orchestrated for our customers. We co\-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing methods so frontier models can run with best\-in\-class throughput, latency, cost, and power efficiency for both prefill and decode workloads. Fleet Software enables deployments of these systems at scale through configuration management, safe software and firmware rollouts, and software recovery, while partnering with other engineering teams to drive product improvements as we ramp production at unprecedented speed. The team also builds the monitoring and analysis systems that connect signals across the rack. Engineers and their agents use this data to investigate failures, spot patterns and continually improve the performance and reliability of the inference fleet. We’re looking for a leader to drive technical direction while building the best team in the industry. Someone who has built infrastructure and owned it through real deployments in the field. This team’s work will shape how Etched scales to a computing platform that customers depend on at massive scale. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead and develop the Fleet Software team. Set priorities, hire and mentor engineers, and give team members clear ownership. * Set the architecture and roadmap for fleet provisioning, configuration, updates and recovery across labs and customer deployments. * Establish the team’s approach to safe software and firmware rollouts, including validation, staged deployment and handling partial failures. * Guide the design of telemetry and log pipelines, including decisions around storage, retention and query performance. * Lead the development of monitoring, alerting and analysis tools that help engineers and customers understand fleet behavior and investigate failures. * Partner with our Node Systems Systems team to define the interfaces and validated configurations needed to manage hardware across the fleet. * Work with deployment teams to support customer environments, including local monitoring and customer telemetry analysis. * Turn lessons from deployments and incidents into engineering priorities, and decide where to adopt existing tools versus building our own. * Stay involved through design reviews, code contributions and hands\-on debugging, particularly on the team’s hardest technical problems. **You may be a good fit if you have (Must\-have qualifications)** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, including leading projects or managing engineers. * Experience building infrastructure software and owning it in production, including deployments, incidents and the changes that followed. * A strong background in fleet management, provisioning, configuration or observability for compute infrastructure or connected devices. * Solid distributed systems and Linux fundamentals. You understand how systems behave under load, during upgrades and when components fail. * Strong coding and debugging skills. You can work through a difficult problem with an engineer and contribute to the implementation. * Experience setting technical direction, mentoring engineers and getting work shipped across team boundaries. **Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice\-to\-have qualifications)** * Telemetry and log pipelines, including storage, retention and query performance. * Bare metal servers, accelerator clusters, robotics or other hardware fleets. * Firmware updates, hardware diagnostics and automated recovery. * Software that runs in customer environments as well as internal infrastructure. **Benefits** * Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage + $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits * Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office * Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row) * Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more * Daily lunch and dinner in our office * Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification **How we’re different** Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference\-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer\-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors. We are a fully in\-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

With more than **58,000 employees across 900 laboratories in over 54 countries**, Eurofins provides a broad range of analytical testing and scientific services that support innovation, quality, and regulatory compliance worldwide. From advancing life\-saving medicines to safeguarding food and water supplies, our teams play a critical role in improving public health and protecting our environment. Joining Eurofins means becoming part of a global scientific organization that values technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and professional growth. If you're looking to apply your expertise in a meaningful way while working alongside talented scientists and engineers, we'd love to hear from you. **Job Description** Are you looking for an opportunity to combine your programming skills with science in a regulated laboratory environment? In this role, you'll work closely with laboratory and quality teams to create and enhance spreadsheet\-based applications, automate data workflows, and ensure systems meet regulatory and client requirements. jobs.description: Playing an essential role in the U.S. economy, Fannie Mae is foundational to housing finance. Join Fannie Mae to grow your career and help people find a place to call home. jobs.title: NetSuite Developer
jobs.description: Description: **About Us** ============ Since 1935, Ferguson Electric has been providing the Western New York region with exceptional electrical repair and construction services. We have the experience and skill to be our customer’s “connection to quality.” Our professional team has handled a majority of the construction and service contracts for the commercial and industrial facilities in the area. We have the skill, experience, and the dedication to properly address all electrical repair and construction needs. **About the Role** ================== Ferguson Electric’s NetSuite Developer designs, develops, and engineers solutions on the Oracle NetSuite platform that support project management, financials, job costing, procurement, inventory, billing, and operational reporting. This is a hands\-on engineering role. The developer owns the technical design of customizations, writes production SuiteScript, builds workflows and data structures, and delivers integrations that connect NetSuite to the rest of the business. The ideal candidate partners with project managers, accounting, pre\-construction, operations, and leadership to turn business requirements into scalable, maintainable NetSuite solutions tailored to commercial electrical contracting. The role offers the chance to engineer core systems that field crews and office staff rely on every day, and to raise the quality of how those systems are designed, deployed, and supported. **What You Will Do** ==================== **NetSuite Design and Engineering** ----------------------------------- * Design NetSuite solutions end to end, including custom records, forms, fields, roles, saved searches, and data model decisions that fit project\-based electrical contracting workflows. * Engineer customizations with SuiteScript 2\.x (User Event, Client, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Suitelet, RESTlet, and Portlet scripts), applying object\-oriented design, modular structure, and governance\-aware patterns. * Build and maintain automated processes with SuiteFlow and SuiteBuilder, and package, version, and deploy customizations through the SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF). * Design integrations between NetSuite and related systems, including CRM, project management, and accounting tools, using RESTlets, REST and SOAP web services, and integration platforms. * Establish engineering standards for the NetSuite environment, including naming conventions, script architecture, error handling, logging, code review, and release practices. **Development and Customization** --------------------------------- * Develop and enhance NetSuite functionality for job costing, project tracking, procurement, inventory, billing, revenue, and financial close processes. * Create Suitelets, RESTlets, and custom portlets that give project teams and management reliable, role\-appropriate access to operational data. * Build reports, saved searches, workbooks, and dashboards that improve visibility into project performance, labor, materials, and billing. * Where required, support lightweight connections to Salesforce or other CRM tools so customer and project data stays consistent with NetSuite as the system of record for ERP. **Technical Support and Optimization** -------------------------------------- * Troubleshoot and resolve defects, script governance and performance issues, integration failures, and user\-reported problems in the NetSuite environment. * Optimize existing scripts, workflows, searches, and roles to improve usability, speed, and data quality for electrical project teams and management. * Protect data integrity and security across the platform, including role design, permissions, audit trails, and compliance with internal controls and applicable requirements. **Collaboration and Requirements** ---------------------------------- * Work with stakeholders in project management, accounting, pre\-construction, operations, and leadership to gather requirements and translate them into technical designs. * Recommend how NetSuite can reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency in the electrical contracting business. * Document technical specifications, solution designs, deployment notes, and user guides for developed solutions. **Innovation and Continuous Improvement** ----------------------------------------- * Stay current on NetSuite releases, SuiteCloud capabilities, and platform best practices, and recommend features worth adopting. * Propose and implement automation that reduces manual tasks for field crews and office staff. * Participate in code reviews and contribute to a culture of sound engineering and continuous improvement. *Ferguson Electric recognizes the value of diversity in our workforce. We are committed to equal opportunity. We consider all qualified employment applicants without regard to race, religion, color, gender, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, partnership status, protected veteran status, disability, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law. Individuals who hold legal work authorization applicable to employment at Ferguson Electric in the United States will be considered without regard to citizenship/alienage.* Requirements:**About Your Qualifications** ============================= * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of software development experience, with a primary focus on NetSuite design, development, and engineering. * Strong proficiency in SuiteScript 2\.x (and working knowledge of SuiteScript 1\.0\), RESTlets, Suitelets, SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, and the SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF). * Solid JavaScript skills, including modern syntax, modular design, and debugging, plus working knowledge of SQL, HTML, and CSS. * Experience designing and building integrations with REST/SOAP APIs and tools such as Celigo, Boomi, MuleSoft, or similar iPaaS platforms. * Understanding of ERP workflows, particularly project\-based, job\-cost, construction, or service\-industry processes. * Strong grasp of object\-oriented programming principles, design patterns, and how to apply them within NetSuite’s governance and platform constraints. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple priorities. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to explain technical design choices to non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * NetSuite certifications (for example, SuiteFoundation, SuiteCloud Developer, or ERP Consultant). * Experience with Agile development methodologies. * Familiarity with source control, continuous integration, and SDF\-based deployment pipelines. * Exposure to Salesforce or another CRM as an integration endpoint, not as the primary development platform. * Additional languages such as Python or Java. * Experience in construction, electrical contracting, or another project\-based trade, including job cost, change orders, or progress billing.

The ideal candidate is a hands\-on data engineering leader with expertise in cloud\-based data platforms, data warehousing, ETL/ELT development, and modern data engineering practices. This individual will be responsible for delivering scalable data solutions utilizing AWS Services, Snowflake, dbt, Python, SQL, and related technologies while mentoring team members and driving engineering excellence. As part of our growing Cloud Data and AI Platform organization, you will lead and collaborate with a talented team of engineers, product partners, and business stakeholders to deliver enterprise data products and cloud\-based data solutions. This role offers the opportunity to mentor engineering talent, drive engineering best practices, and support the adoption of modern data engineering capabilities across the organization. Responsibilities \& Qualifications: **Duties and Responsibilities:** The successful candidate will have experience working in large enterprise environments and partnering with cross\-functional teams to deliver trusted data products that support strategic business objectives.* Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise data solutions utilizing AWS Services, Snowflake, dbt, Python, SQL, and related cloud technologies. * Develop and support data warehouses, Operational Data Stores (ODS), and ETL/ELT pipelines that enable analytics, reporting, and operational data capabilities. * Design and implement batch and real\-time data processing solutions using modern streaming and event\-driven architectures. * Partner with business stakeholders, analysts, and technology teams to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions. * Define and promote data quality strategies, testing standards, governance practices, and compliance controls across the data platform lifecycle. * Establish enterprise testing practices, including data validation frameworks, dbt testing standards, and quality controls to support trusted data products. * Define monitoring, observability, and operational reliability standards, including dashboards, alerts, service\-level objectives (SLOs), and service\-level agreements (SLAs) for enterprise data platforms. * Establish deployment strategies, environment promotion standards, and release governance practices that support secure and reliable delivery across enterprise data platforms. * Contribute to technical discussions, peer reviews, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives across the data engineering team. * Leverage AI\-powered development and productivity tools to accelerate solution delivery, improve code quality, and enhance engineering productivity **Qualifications:** Bachelor's Degree and 6 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, Cloud Data Platforms, or related technology disciplines. OR High School Diploma or GED and 10 years of experience in the same areas. **Preferred Qualifications*** Advanced experience with cloud platforms such as **AWS**, Azure, or GCP. * Advanced experience with modern data warehousing and large\-scale data processing technologies such as **Snowflake,** Spark, or equivalent platforms. * Advanced proficiency in **Python and SQL**. * Advanced experience designing, developing, orchestrating, and supporting **ETL/ELT** pipelines and data integration solutions using tools such as **dbt, Apache Airflow**, Astronomer, or equivalent cloud\-native data engineering technologies. * Advanced experience with data modeling, data warehousing, and data engineering best practices. * Experience designing, developing, and supporting scalable, reliable, and high\-performing data engineering solutions in enterprise environments. * Experience collaborating with business and technology stakeholders to deliver data\-driven solutions. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. **Following qualifications are a plus** ======================================= * Advanced experience with enterprise ETL/ELT tools such as DataStage, SAP BODS, SSIS, Informatica, or equivalent technologies. * Experience developing and supporting **Operational Data Stores (ODS)**, analytics platforms, and data products. * Experience with Snowflake Cortex, Change Data Capture (CDC), streaming, and real\-time data ingestion technologies including Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Qlik Replicate, Snow pipe Streaming, or equivalent platforms. * Experience integrating data across AWS, on\-premises, and Snowflake environments, with exposure to enterprise security, governance, and compliance frameworks. * Experience with Data Vault modeling and modern data warehousing methodologies. * Experience leading technical initiatives, mentoring team members, and promoting engineering best practices. * Experience within Financial Services, Banking, or other highly regulated industries. * Familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, or other analytics and visualization platforms. * Experience using AI\-powered development and productivity tools to improve engineering efficiency and delivery outcomes. * AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional, SnowPro Core Certification, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer Certification, or equivalent cloud and data platform certifications. \#LI\-DNI Additional Information: This job posting is expected to remain active for 45 days from the initial posting date listed above. If it is necessary to extend this deadline, the posting will remain active as appropriate. Job postings may come down early due to business need or a high volume of applicants. If hired in North Carolina, the base pay for this position is generally between $128,935 and $168,000\. Actual starting base pay will be determined based on skills, experience, location, and other non\-discriminatory factors permitted by law. For some roles, total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment. Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at https://jobs.firstcitizens.com/benefits.

jobs.title: Mid-Level Full-Stack AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **About AlarisPro** AlarisPro is the aviation industry’s only aviation\-minded, cloud\-based UAS fleet management platform. It replaces spreadsheets and disconnected tools with one powerful system that unifies safety, compliance, and operational intelligence through centralized tracking of flights, maintenance, parts, and aircraft configuration. Now we are building the future of Preventive Maintenance Artificial Intelligence. AlarisPro is evolving from a data provider into an AI solutions integrator—turning trusted operational data into intelligence, recommendations, and better decisions for UAS operators. **The Opportunity** We are looking for a hands\-on, growing engineer who can strengthen the platform we operate today while helping build the intelligent products of tomorrow. This is not a narrow database, front\-end, or AI role. Working with experienced technical and product leaders, you will contribute across the current Microsoft\-based application stack, modern cloud services, APIs, user experiences, and emerging AI capabilities. You will be successful if you enjoy modernizing real production systems, learn the aviation domain, use AI coding tools fluently, and work with product and design partners to move from raw information to trusted decisions. **What You Will Build** * **Evolve the current platform.** Develop, optimize, secure, and maintain AlarisPro’s MSSQL, ASP.NET/.NET, IIS, API, and React capabilities. * **Create the modern AI stack.** Contribute to cloud\-native services, AI\-enabled workflows, retrieval and reasoning capabilities, model integrations, evaluation approaches, and production\-ready data pipelines. * **Turn information into decisions.** Build experiences that surface risks, identify patterns, recommend actions, and support preventive maintenance and operational decision\-making. * **Connect the ecosystem.** Design secure, documented REST APIs and integrations that allow internal services, customers, partners, and AI agents to work with AlarisPro data and capabilities. * **Build usable front ends.** Create responsive, accessible interfaces that make complex safety, compliance, maintenance, and fleet intelligence understandable and actionable. * **Use AI\-assisted engineering responsibly.** Apply Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable tools to accelerate discovery, prototyping, refactoring, testing, documentation, and delivery—with human review and production engineering discipline. **Core ResponsibilitiesProduction Platform \& Data** * Develop and optimize T\-SQL stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, schemas, indexes, and execution plans. * Monitor reliability and performance; troubleshoot deadlocks, blocking, long\-running queries, resource utilization, and application/database issues. * Maintain data integrity, security, availability, backup/recovery practices, and compliance controls. * Develop, debug, refactor, review, deploy, and support ASP.NET/.NET applications and IIS\-hosted services. **AI, Cloud \& Integration** * Prototype and productionize AI capabilities that use AlarisPro’s trusted operational data to improve maintenance, safety, compliance, and fleet decisions. * Build and consume secure REST APIs using appropriate authentication patterns, including JWT, OAuth 2\.0, API keys, and related controls. * Contribute to cloud architecture, deployment automation, observability, CI/CD, testing, and scalable service design, with an emphasis on AWS environments. * Help evaluate new models, frameworks, and coding agents; document findings, technical decisions, and measurable product outcomes. **Product, Design \& Collaboration** * Partner with customers and stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, risks, and decisions—not simply requested features. * Use Design Thinking and product management methods to frame problems, prototype quickly, test assumptions, prioritize value, and iterate from evidence. * Translate between aviation operations, product goals, user experience, data, and engineering constraints. * Contribute to roadmaps, requirements, acceptance criteria, code reviews, technical documentation, testing, and release readiness. **What We Are Looking ForRequired Experience** * Hands\-on development with C\# or VB.NET and ASP.NET Web Forms, MVC, .NET Core, or a comparable .NET application environment. * Experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with cloud\-hosted applications, databases, or services. * Front\-end development experience; HTML, JavaScript, CSS, React or comparable modern frameworks are strongly valued. * Practical experience using Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools to deliver working software. * Working knowledge of Git, testing, secure development, code review, deployment, and production troubleshooting. * Ability to contribute across the stack, communicate clearly, ask good questions, document work, and deliver reliably in a fast\-moving environment. **Preferred Experience** * 3\+ years of professional software or data\-platform engineering experience, including meaningful hands\-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL. * AWS architecture, application/API hosting, WebSocket’s, managed databases, serverless or containerized services, and cloud observability. * SQL Agent automation, Microsoft SQL database administration, IIS configuration, high availability, and performance engineering. * Applied AI/ML, LLM integrations, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, model evaluation, or MLOps/LLMOps. * Product discovery, Design Thinking, user research, prototyping, backlog prioritization, or product management practices. * Aviation, UAS, fleet operations, preventive maintenance, safety, regulatory compliance, or other high\-reliability domains. **How We Think About AI\-Assisted Development** We value speed, curiosity, and strong tool fluency. We also expect engineering judgment. AI\-generated code must be understood, reviewed, tested, secured, documented, and operated like any other production code. The goal is not to generate more code; it is to deliver better outcomes faster. **Success in This Role** * Your contributions make the existing platform more reliable, maintainable, secure, and easier to evolve. * You help move new AI capabilities from prototype toward production using clear evaluation criteria and measurable user value. * Customers spend less time interpreting records and more time acting on trusted intelligence. * Engineering, product, design, and aviation stakeholders share a clearer path from data to preventive decisions. **Why Join AlarisPro** This is a chance to help shape an important technical and product transition at the intersection of aviation, operational safety, cloud software, and applied AI. You will work on a proven platform with valuable real\-world data while helping create a new generation of decision\-support and preventive\-maintenance capabilities. Pay: Up to $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid sick time * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Baltimore, MD 21224

jobs.title: Help Desk Support Engineer I
jobs.description: **Job Summary** The Help Desk Support Engineer I is responsible for providing technical support across Fleet Response’s end\-user technology environment. This role helps ensure the reliable operation of computer systems, telephony, collaboration tools, endpoints, identity services, and other technologies employees rely on to perform their responsibilities. The Help Desk Support Engineer I receives, prioritizes, documents, troubleshoots, and resolves end\-user support requests using diagnostic tools, ticketing systems, technical documentation, and hands\-on or remote support. This position also supports device deployment, user access, employee onboarding and offboarding, technology asset management, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** Includes, but is not limited to, the following: * Respond to incoming end\-user support requests submitted by telephone, email, ticketing portal, or other approved support channels in a courteous and timely manner. * Gather and document relevant end\-user information, including name, department, contact information, affected systems, and details regarding the technical issue or request. * Build rapport with end users and ask appropriate questions to accurately identify and understand technical problems. * Prioritize and schedule support requests based on urgency, impact, and business needs. * Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the appropriate technical team member or leader when necessary. * Record, track, and document troubleshooting steps, actions taken, decisions made, and final resolutions within the help desk ticketing system. * Use diagnostic tools and technical resources to identify and resolve hardware, software, application, connectivity, and other technology issues. * Research software updates, drivers, knowledge bases, support agreements, FAQs, and other technical resources to support issue resolution. * Maintain working knowledge of the software, hardware, systems, and services used and supported by Fleet Response. * Ensure documented security practices, access requirements, and technology procedures are followed during all support activities. * Perform hands\-on desktop and endpoint support, including installing and upgrading software, installing hardware, configuring applications, performing backups, and reformatting devices when necessary. * Deploy and manage company devices and technology services for end users. * Support secure onboarding and separation activities for company, client, and partner accounts. * Administer user and application access rights and escalate access requests when additional authorization is required. * Perform preventative maintenance and routine checks of workstations, printers, peripherals, and other supported technology equipment. * Test implemented fixes to confirm issues have been fully resolved. * Conduct post\-resolution follow\-up when appropriate to confirm user needs have been met. * Develop and maintain help sheets, FAQs, procedures, and other user\-friendly support documentation. * Maintain and audit Fleet Response’s technology asset inventory. * Coordinate work with other IT teams, vendors, supervisors, managers, and business partners as needed. * Conduct basic technical research, gather data, prepare reports, and support department surveys or operational analysis. * Create, document, and communicate efficient procedures for assigned areas of responsibility. * Provide presentations, technical guidance, or user education when appropriate. * Maintain organized technical documentation, reference materials, procedures, and knowledge resources to support continuity within the department. * Provide high\-quality customer service and communicate accurate and timely information to employees and other groups supported by Information Technology. * Identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement and recommend changes to procedures, systems, or support practices. * Maintain confidentiality of sensitive company, employee, customer, legal, financial, and other protected information encountered through job responsibilities. * Support other Information Technology team members and departmental priorities as business needs require. * Maintain consistent and timely attendance. * Perform additional technology\-support duties and initiatives as assigned. *The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Employees may be required to perform duties outside their normal responsibilities as business needs dictate.* **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * High school diploma or equivalent. * One or more years of experience with computer\-related configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, or technical support. * One or more years of experience supporting Microsoft Office 365/Microsoft ence supporting and administering antivirus or endpoint\-security platforms. * Experience supporting 3CX, PBX, or comparable telephony systems. * Experience with PowerShell, Python, or other automation scripting languages. * Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve difficult network and system\-related problems using troubleshooting and decision\-making skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or Grok to assist with analyzing and resolving technical issues. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** * Strong customer\-service orientation with the ability to support users professionally and respectfully. * Strong troubleshooting, diagnostic, and technical problem\-solving skills. * Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows environments, Active Directory, and general end\-user technology support. * Ability to deploy, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, applications, peripherals, and related end\-user technology. * Knowledge of user provisioning, access administration, and secure onboarding and offboarding practices. * Ability to maintain accurate ticket documentation and technology asset records. * Understanding of escalation practices and the ability to recognize when an issue requires support from another technical team. * Ability to create clear, user\-friendly technical documentation, procedures, FAQs, and knowledge resources. * Familiarity with scripting, automation tools, or AI\-assisted troubleshooting methods used to improve help desk efficiency. * Strong organizational and prioritization skills. * Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. * Ability to explain technical information clearly to users with varying levels of technical knowledge. * Ability to work independently while remaining collaborative and responsive to team needs. * Ability to coordinate effectively with vendors, technical teams, supervisors, and business partners. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate documentation. * Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive information. * Strong sense of ownership, accountability, follow\-through, and continuous improvement. **Physical Demands \& Work Environment** * Work is performed primarily in a professional office and technology\-support environment. * Requires prolonged periods of sitting, typing, computer use, and telephone communication. * Requires the ability to move throughout the workplace and position oneself to access computers, equipment, files, and office machinery. * Requires close visual attention when diagnosing system issues, reviewing technical documentation, and working with computer equipment. * Regular use of wrists, hands, and fingers is required for computer, phone, and equipment\-related tasks. * Must be able to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, through remote\-support tools, and through electronic communication. * Must occasionally be able to lift, transport, or reposition technology equipment weighing up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation. * May occasionally be exposed to moving equipment components or elevated noise levels associated with technology devices and systems. * Occasional travel is required for workshops, seminars, training, presentations, consulting or advising activities, and visits to branch or extension sites. **Work Schedule** This is a full\-time, non\-exempt position working approximately 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday. Work hours may vary based on operational needs and will be determined by department leadership. This position may occasionally require off\-hours work to support configuration or installation of servers, network devices, security appliances, and related technology components. Occasional schedule flexibility or additional hours may be required to address system issues, technology deployments, maintenance activities, or other operational needs.

jobs.title: Sales Account Executive, New Business - Energy & Utilities
jobs.description: #### **About FOCUS Performance** FOCUS Performance (formerly FOCUS Learning) is the leading technology partner purpose\-built for the critical, rapidly growing energy industry, safeguarding its highly complex regulatory environment and ensuring the industry operates more safely and efficiently. For nearly four decades, nuclear generating stations, transmission and distribution utilities, renewable energy operators, and system operators have used our industry\-leading platforms to connect job tasks, training, qualification, scheduling, and compliance auditing into one defensible record. Backed by The Brydon Group and scaling fast, we're expanding our go\-to\-market team and looking for a dynamic, full\-cycle Account Executive who wants ownership, autonomy, direct line to revenue impact, all while rapidly accelerating their career as we continue to accelerate our growth. #### **Position Summary** We're looking for a self\-starting hunter who gets energized by building pipeline from zero. This is a high\-impact, full\-cycle sales role for someone who can run complex, multi\-stakeholder deals in long sales cycles, and who wants to help define what GTM looks like at a company still writing its playbook. You'll own net\-new logo growth across the public sector, education, energy, and government verticals, with the autonomy of a start\-up and the backing of an established, trusted brand with a key investment partner. #### **What You'll Do** ###### **Pipeline Generation** * Identify and engage net\-new utility and energy accounts (IOUs, co\-ops, munis, nuclear operators, IPPs) and build relationships with training, operations, and compliance leaders. * Build a self\-sourced pipeline through outbound prospecting, events, channel partners, and inbound leads — no single channel is your safety net. ###### **Deal Execution** * Run the full sales cycle end to end: discovery demo business case procurement/RFP, security, and legal review close — using mutual action plans to keep momentum and shorten time\-to\-signature. * Tailor your approach to complex buying groups with multiple stakeholders and long evaluation windows. * Partner closely with Solutions Engineers, Product, and Client Success to keep every deal aligned to what the customer actually needs. ###### **Forecasting \& Process** * Keep deal stages and forecasts accurate and current in HubSpot CRM. * Lead with Question\-Based Selling (QBS): use strategic, well\-sequenced questions to uncover pain, build credibility with technical and operational buyers, and earn mindshare that moves deals forward. Use MEDDPICC as a secondary framework to qualify opportunities with discipline. * Meet and exceed quota and performance KPIs, consistently. #### **What You Bring** * 5\+ years of full\-cycle SaaS sales experience within GovTech, energy, or public\-sector with utility experience strongly preferred. * A track record of self\-sourcing pipeline and closing net\-new logo business, not just managing inbound, and of shortening long, complex sales cycles through executive alignment, mutual action plans, and urgency tied to compliance or operational risk. * Sharp discovery, objection\-handling, and multi\-threading instincts across complex buying committees. * Hands\-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable CRM. * Comfort operating in a lean, scale\-up environment where you help build the process, not just follow it. #### **Why Join Us** * Uncapped earning potential with a lucrative base plus commission structure. * Real autonomy — build your territory and your pipeline your way, backed by a team that wants you to win. * A mission that matters: our software helps ensure the lineworkers, operators, and technicians running critical infrastructure are qualified to do it safely. * The growth trajectory and resources of a private\-equity\-backed company, without the bureaucracy of a large enterprise. * A fully remote role with a team that collaborates like it's in the room. #### **Our Values** *Our values are the North Star for our decisions, the yardstick for our team members, and the guidebook for how we deliver value to the customers and the industries we serve.* * View obstacles as opportunities — make it happen, and be creative. * Own it — take pride in what you do, and hold yourself and each other accountable. * Embrace curiosity — be a learn\-it\-all instead of a know\-it\-all, and have fun doing it. * Steward the future — add value for our customers and the industries we serve; make it scale. Apply for this job
