jobs.title: Creative Lead
jobs.description: We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime. At Wizards of the Coast, we connect people around the world through play and imagination. From our genre\-defining games like Magic: The Gathering® and Dungeons \& Dragons® to our growing multiverse, we continue to innovate and build new ways to foster friendship and connection. That’s where you come in! We’re looking for a Creative Lead to join our Digital Ventures team, reporting to the Head of Franchise Development. You’ll guide the creative direction of a slate of video games based on Wizards IP, built with external developers across mobile and PC/console. The role covers a range of creative and management skills: strategy development, project leadership through external partners, incubation and prototyping. Because this work spans several projects at once, it depends on relationships: earning the trust of partner studios and Wizards teams and leading with integrity on both sides. You’ll bring a clear point of view on the IP and the quality bar and share it in a way partners can build on. This is a hybrid role requiring three days a week in our Renton, WA office, with occasional travel. **What You’ll Do:** * Set and maintain the creative vision for each game, grounded in what players love about our brands, from early concept through launch. * Lead and manage projects through multidisciplinary partner teams across game design, narrative, UX, art and audio, with clear feedback, reviews, and approvals. * Advocate for quality by setting creative intent and world\-class standards for each project. * Incubate and prototype new play experiences with our IP, and champion them inside Wizards, from early concepts and pitches through development. * Translate franchise direction into materials partners can build from, such as aspirational targets, kickoff guides, guardrails and franchise bibles. * Help develop strategy for Wizards IP in games, including which opportunities to pursue, which partners to build them with, and the frameworks Wizards uses to evaluate and support them. **What You’ll Bring:** * 5\+ years of director\-level creative leadership (creative, design, UX, or a similar role) working with internal and external partners to ship titles on mobile or PC/console. * A developer’s understanding of how games are made, from design methodology to craft, and the hands\-on design, narrative or art skills to contribute directly when a project needs it. * A track record of managing projects through external developers and building strong relationships with them, adapting your direction across studios, cultures, time zones, and matrixed organizations. * Sharp judgment on authenticity and quality, and the ability to explain them clearly to partners and leaders. * A working knowledge of game industry trends, market analysis, and emerging technology (including AI). * Experience turning existing IP into new game concepts and familiarity with Magic: The Gathering, Dungeons \& Dragons, or both. * Comfort moving between blue\-sky concepting, incubation and prototyping, strategy and execution. * A self\-directed multi\-tasker with strong organizational skills and a healthy relationship with feedback. **Nice to have:** * Experience on the licensor or publisher side of a game partnership. * Experience with live\-service games. * A love of our fandoms and the communities around them. * Interest in using and learning AI tools like Claude. Pay Range $150,500 \- $235,200 USD Employees may be eligible for annual and long\-term incentives as part of their overall compensation package, depending on role, location, and eligibility. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: **ROLE OVERVIEW** As a Senior Security Engineer at HealthVerity, you will help design, implement, and evolve security capabilities that protect our workforce, customers, cloud environments, and products. You will work across multiple security domains, with a particular focus on Identity and Access Management (IAM), cloud security, security architecture, and automation. You will play a key engineering role in HealthVerity's IAM program, including workforce and customer identity. You will help design and implement secure authentication, authorization, federation, provisioning, and identity lifecycle capabilities, with Okta serving as a key component of our identity architecture. Beyond IAM, you will work closely with Security, IT, Engineering, Product, and Cloud teams to design and implement security solutions across our AWS environments and broader technology ecosystem. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on building scalable security capabilities, integrating security technologies, solving complex technical problems, and automating security processes. Security is a foundational component of HealthVerity's products and infrastructure. This role will help mature our security architecture while ensuring security controls support business growth, usability, and healthcare security and compliance requirements. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Design, implement, and mature security solutions across IAM, cloud security, security architecture, and related security domains. * Engineer and enhance workforce and customer identity capabilities, including authentication, authorization, federation, provisioning, and identity lifecycle management. * Design, implement, and support Okta integrations, policies, workflows, and security controls. * Develop and maintain identity federation and integration solutions leveraging SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SCIM, and related technologies. * Design and automate Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver lifecycle processes, provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, and other identity workflows. * Implement and enhance MFA, adaptive authentication, access policies, and privileged access controls. build integrations between security platforms, cloud services, and enterprise systems. * Design and implement security controls and architecture across AWS and cloud environments. * Develop security tooling and automation using APIs, scripting, infrastructure as code, and other engineering approaches. * Assist in implementing and maintaining security controls supporting FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2, and other regulatory and compliance requirements. * Perform security architecture reviews and assessments of applications, cloud environments, and technology solutions. * Mentor junior engineers and analysts and contribute to security engineering standards, patterns, and best practices. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required** * 7\+ years of experience in Security Engineering, Identity Security, Cloud Security, or related disciplines. * Strong hands\-on experience engineering and administering Okta environments. * Strong understanding of workforce identity and customer identity architectures and security controls. * Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, federation, SSO, MFA, and identity lifecycle management. * Hands\-on experience with SAML 2\.0, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SCIM. * Experience designing and implementing identity integrations for enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, APIs, and cloud services. * Experience designing and implementing security controls in AWS environments. * Strong understanding of cloud security architecture, IAM, least privilege, and security design principles. * Experience developing security automation and integrations using Python, PowerShell, APIs, Terraform, or similar technologies. * Experience supporting security and compliance requirements such as FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2\. **Preferred** * Experience with Active Directory and traditional enterprise identity infrastructure is beneficial but not required * Experience with Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), privileged access management, and Zero Trust architectures is preferred. * Healthcare industry experience is a plus. Base salary for the role is commensurate with experience and can range between $145,000 \- 175,000 \+ annual bonus opportunity. ### **Hiring Locations** Our main office is located in Center City, Philadelphia, where we operate on a hybrid model with in\-office work required three days a week for local employees. By enabling access to the industry’s largest RWD ecosystem, HealthVerity supports critical applications in clinical development, commercial strategy, regulatory decision\-making, and public health. To learn more about HealthVerity, visit healthverity.com. **Why you'll love working here** **We are making a difference** – Our technology is at the forefront of some of the biggest healthcare challenges in the world. **We are one team** – Our people define our culture and always will. jobs.title: Scheduling Engineer II

jobs.title: Utility Operations & Financial Analyst
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Homes of America, LLC (“HOA”), which was formed in 2020, is a nationwide owner and operator of manufactured housing communities. The firm is focused on opportunistically acquiring, improving, and operating manufactured housing communities in primary, secondary, and tertiary markets across the United States. Our leadership team has decades of experience acquiring, improving, and operating businesses and assets across a myriad of industries and asset classes. Homes of America is well on its way to becoming the country’s premier owner and operator of manufactured housing communities with one of the industry’s largest and most diverse portfolios. To date, HOA has invested in and currently manages approximately 15,500 home sites across 155 communities and 19 states. **Position Summary** We are seeking a Utility Operations \& Financial Analyst to support utility management, infrastructure projects, and cost recovery across a portfolio of more than 170 manufactured housing communities. **Key Responsibilities** **Utility Analysis \& Cost Recovery** * Analyze utility consumption, billing, expenses, revenue, and resident recapture across the portfolio. * Identify revenue leakage, billing discrepancies, unusual consumption, meter issues, and opportunities to improve utility recovery. * Reconcile utility invoices, consumption data, and resident billings and investigate variances. * Analyze utility rates, usage trends, occupancy, and other factors affecting utility costs and recovery. * Develop and maintain Excel\-based models, dashboards, reports, and KPIs. * Assist with utility forecasting and financial analysis and quantify the impact of utility initiatives. **Operations, Project Management** * Work with engineers, utility providers, submetering companies, contractors, vendors, and property teams to resolve utility and infrastructure issues. * Coordinate utility and infrastructure projects from initial analysis and scoping through implementation and completion. * Assist with project scopes, budgets, timelines, milestones, inspections, and deliverables. * Track project progress, risks, outstanding issues, and action items and follow up with responsible parties. * Partner with field personnel and engineers to investigate issues identified through financial and operational analysis. * Review vendor, contractor, and engineering proposals, invoices, reports, and deliverables for accuracy and completeness. **Process Improvement \& Cross\-Functional Support** * Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and increased utility recapture. * Develop business cases and financial analysis for proposed utility initiatives. * Help establish consistent processes and controls for utility billing, data collection, reconciliation, and project execution. * Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Property Management, IT, Accounts Payable, and other departments on cross\-functional initiatives. * Support implementation of new systems, technologies, vendors, and operational processes. **Reporting \& Communication** * Prepare recurring and ad hoc management reports, analyses, and professional PowerPoint presentations. * Present findings, project updates, trends, and recommendations to internal stakeholders and management. * Translate complex financial, operational, and utility information into clear, actionable recommendations. * Effectively communicate with engineers, vendors, contractors, property managers, field personnel, and senior stakeholders. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Engineering, Operations, or a related field. * 2–5\+ years of experience in financial analysis, utility operations, project management, property operations, infrastructure, accounting, or a related field. * Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/INDEX\-MATCH, SUMIFS, data analysis, reconciliation, and reporting. * Ability to effectively use AI tools to support analysis, research, reporting, process improvement, and productivity. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, and communication skills. * Ability to work with large datasets, manage multiple priorities and projects, and collaborate across departments. * Strong PowerPoint skills and ability to present information clearly and professionally. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with water/wastewater utilities, infrastructure, submetering, resident utility billing, or utility cost recovery. * Experience with manufactured housing, multifamily housing, or property management. * Knowledge of water meters, distribution systems, wells, pumps, sewer systems, lift stations, or related infrastructure. * Experience coordinating engineers, contractors, vendors, or infrastructure projects. **What Success Looks Like** The successful candidate will help the organization: * Increase utility cost recovery and reduce revenue leakage. * Improve utility data accuracy, reporting, and visibility. * Identify and resolve billing, consumption, metering, and infrastructure issues. * Effectively coordinate utility and infrastructure projects. * Improve accountability among engineers, contractors, vendors, and internal teams. * Reduce manual work through improved processes, AI, and automation. * Deliver measurable financial and operational results and clear, data\-driven recommendations. \*\*Salary to commensurate with experience. Pay: From $85,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance * Work from home Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI Data Engineer
jobs.description: Primary Work Address: 4000 Jones Bridge Road, Chevy Chase, MD, 20815 HHMI is focused on supporting and moving science forward in a variety of different ways ranging from conducting basic biomedical research, empowering educators, inspiring students, developing the next generation of scientists – even stretching into film and media production. Our Headquarters is in the greater Washington, DC metro area and is home to over 300 employees with expertise in investments, communications, digital production, biomedical sciences, and everything in between. The work housed here supports and augments the groundbreaking research conducted in HHMI labs across the nation. As HHMI scientists continue to push boundaries in laboratories and classrooms, you can be sure that your contributions while working here are making a difference. The AI Accelerator exists to turn AI into daily reality across HHMI’s administrative and operational functions. This role builds the data\-engineering foundation every AI application and knowledge layer at HHMI runs on. The work is hands\-on. This person implements the pipelines, transformation patterns, and orchestration framework that turn HHMI’s institutional content into governed, AI\-ready data. They own the day\-to\-day execution of the data\-engineering side of the AI fabric — pipeline development, medallion curation, workflow\-orchestration framework, and governance implementation — under the design authority of the Principal Knowledge \& Data Architect. This role works closely with the Principal Knowledge \& Data Architect (who owns the knowledge and retrieval layer’s design), the AI Developer (who consumes what this role builds), and Operations Capabilities’ Data Integration Engineer (who lands source\-system data at the interface). The AI Data Engineer is the seat that connects those layers into working data flow. HHMI’s Principal K\&D Architect designs the knowledge and data foundation for institutional AI, but the foundation only comes to life when someone builds and operates the pipelines that carry data through it. Without this role, our AI systems either wait on data that isn’t ready or consume content whose quality can’t be guaranteed. This role is what makes the K\&D Architect’s design real day\-to\-day — and it’s the same role that keeps it working over years, as content evolves and models change. **This position works on a hybrid schedule, reporting in\-person three days a week to our headquarters in Chevy Chase, Maryland.** **We encourage qualified candidates who are eligible to work in the United States to apply. Please note, we are not able to sponsor a visa for this position at this time.** **What you will do** * **Build the AI\-facing data pipelines:** ingestion from the landing zone Operations Capabilities delivers, transformation through raw bronze silver gold, and serving of governed, AI\-ready content for downstream consumption. * **Implement the medallion architecture:** design patterns from the K\&D Architect become working pipelines, tables, and materialization schedules. Delta Lake tables designed with partitioning, optimization, and evolution in mind. * **Own the** **workflow\-orchestration** **framework:** Databricks Workflows, Delta Live Tables, retry policies, alerting routes, run history, cost tags. * **Implement governance patterns:** Unity Catalog structure, sensitivity classification, access control, and audit for AI\-facing data assets. Design comes from the K\&D Architect; day\-to\-day implementation lives here. * **Build and operate retrieval\-supporting infrastructure:** embedding pipelines, vector store maintenance, reindexing when models upgrade, retrieval evaluation frameworks. * **Partner with Operations Capabilities on source\-system contracts:** define what the AI Fabric consumes at the landing zone — schema, cadence, SLA, quality thresholds. Own the platform\-side of that contract. * **Design and operate data quality:** data\-quality checks, freshness monitoring, drift detection, and the alerting that surfaces issues before they hit AI users. * **Support AI Developer velocity:** when AI Developers deploy into product teams, this role is the data engineer they turn to when a use case needs specific data. * **Contribute to and consume the reference\-pattern library:** reusable pipeline patterns, code templates, and standards live in the shared platform layer. This role uses them, contributes new ones, and evolves them as we learn. **What We Are Looking For** * **Hands\-on production data engineering:** at least four years designing, building, and operating production data pipelines. Not a Databricks\-course track record — real production experience where you owned the pipeline through breakage, iteration, and recovery. * **Databricks and Spark depth:** Delta Lake, medallion architecture, Delta Live Tables, Workflows, Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog. Comfortable at the layer where code meets platform. * **Python and SQL fluency:** PySpark, ETL pa assification, and designs pipelines with access control and audit in mind from the first commit. * **AWS foundations:** IAM, S3, KMS at the level needed to work in a Databricks\-on\-AWS environment. Not required to be a cloud architect; required to be productive. * **Communication:** works productively with the K\&D Architect on design, AI Developer on integration, and Operations Capabilities on contracts. Explains data\-engineering trade\-offs to non\-engineers. * **Education and experience:** bachelor’s degree or equivalent, plus at least four years of hands\-on data\-engineering experience with meaningful exposure to AI or knowledge\-management use cases. **Nice to Have** * Prior experience with knowledge graphs (Neo4j or comparable), entity resolution, or semantic data models. * Experience with the modern data stack alongside Databricks\-native tooling. * Familiarity with LLM\-based extraction, chunking, and evaluation frameworks. * Background in research, academic, or mission\-driven institutional environments. * Experience with cross\-platform data engineering (Snowflake, BigQuery) — cross\-platform judgment is useful even when Databricks is the primary tool. **What This Role Is Not** * **Not a Data Platform Architect:** design authority for the Databricks\-on\-AWS platform sits with Platform Architects. This role builds AI\-facing data pipelines on that platform. * **Not the Knowledge \& Data Architect:** the K\&D Architect owns the design of the knowledge and retrieval layer; this role implements against that design. Required to be a strong hands\-on builder, not an architect. * **Not an AI/ML engineer:** the AI Developer owns model access, orchestration, and application delivery. This role builds the data layer AI Developers consume. * **Not a warehouse or BI data engineer:** traditional analytics warehouses and BI\-facing pipelines belong to Operations Capabilities. This role is AI\-facing. **Practical Details** This role is hybrid, with three days per week in\-person at HHMI’s offices in Chevy Chase, Maryland. It reports to the Director of AI Enablement. HHMI is not able to sponsor a visa for this position at this time. **Physical Requirements** Remaining in a normal seated or standing position for extended periods of time; reaching and grasping by extending hand(s) or arm(s); dexterity to manipulate objects with fingers, for example using a keyboard; communication skills using the spoken word; ability to see and hear within normal parameters; ability to move about workspace. The position requires mobility, including the ability to move materials weighing up to several pounds (such as a laptop computer or tablet). Persons with disabilities may be able to perform the essential duties of this position with reasonable accommodation. Requests for reasonable accommodation will be evaluated on an individual basis. **Please Note:** This job description sets forth the job’s principal duties, responsibilities, and requirements; it should not be construed as an exhaustive statement, however. Unless they begin with the word “may,” the Essential Duties and Responsibilities described above are “essential functions” of the job, as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act. \#LI\-RK1 **Compensation and Benefits** Our employees are compensated from a total rewards perspective in many ways for their contributions to our mission, including competitive pay, exceptional health benefits, retirement plans, time off, and a range of recognition and wellness programs. Visit our Benefits at HHMI site to learn more. *Hiring Pay Range* $128,816\.80 \- $161,021\.00 Pay Type: Annual The posted range reflects HHMI’s good faith estimate of the anticipated hiring salary range for this role at the time of posting. Actual hiring compensation is determined by a candidate’s qualifications, experience, and internal equity. **HHMI is an Equal Opportunity Employer** We use E\-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $106,900 \- $147,000 per year This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.**Description of Benefits** Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole\-person well\-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short\-term and long\-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.**About Us** ============ About Humana: Humana Inc. (for example, but not limited to, linear motors, sensors, bearings, gearboxes, belts, seals, servo motors, pneumatic and hydraulic components, etc.) as well as material selection and application of design standards. * Well\-rounded – hands\-on mechanical ability and passion for interests and hobbies outside of work. jobs.title: HPC System Architecture
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- The HPC System Architect is the senior technical lead responsible for defining the next generation of Intel's leading\-edge high\-performance computing systems. Reporting directly to Nic Dube, Corporate Vice President and General Manager of Data Center Systems and Solutions, this position owns forward\-looking HPC system architecture from concept through committed definition. You will work directly with Intel's CPU and GPU teams to architect the systems that follow today's products \- shaping silicon requirements, and defining system\-level architecture for the large\-scale, scale\-out clusters that characterize production HPC. The role spans full\-system definition: compute node design, memory and I/O balance, scale\-out fabric and topology, and the software stack that determines delivered application performance at scale. You will engage directly with the customers that set the leading edge of HPC \- DOE national laboratories and their exascale and post\-exascale programs, financial services institutions, oil and gas operators, and major academic and government research computing centers \- translating their workload and facility requirements into system architectures Intel can build, and Intel's roadmap into system concepts they can commit to. Responsibilities Own system\-level architecture for next\-generation HPC clusters: node definition, CPU and GPU configuration, memory bandwidth\-to\-capacity balance, I/O and parallel storage architecture, and scale\-out fabric and topology. Define scale\-out interconnect architecture \- fabric selection, network topology, bisection bandwidth and blocking ratios, collective and communication performance, and resilience at thousands\-of\-node scale. Partner with the CPU and GPU teams to define product requirements for future HPC systems, bringing system\-level and workload evidence into silicon definition while requirements remain open. Build performance models that project delivered application throughput at scale on unreleased silicon and use them to drive configuration and roadmap decisions. Lead architecture co\-design and benchmark definition with leadership HPC customers, including acceptance criteria for standard and customer\-proprietary application suites. Drive HPC requirements into Intel's CPU, GPU, platform, and software roadmaps across DCG and the product and design organizations. Evaluate emerging technologies for next\-generation HPC systems, including advanced memory, Ultra Ethernet and other scale\-out fabric standards, optical interconnect, and heterogeneous accelerator integration. Produce reference architectures and system specifications that platform teams, OEM and ODM partners, and system integrators can build to. Grow and lead HPC architecture capability within the team, providing technical direction and mentorship to architects and engineers. Successful Candidate Profile Deep expertise in HPC system architecture at cluster scale, spanning CPU and GPU configuration, memory subsystem design, scale\-out interconnect, and parallel storage. Demonstrated experience defining systems around unreleased silicon and influencing CPU or accelerator requirements from a system and workload perspective. Fluency with HPC workload characteristics and performance analysis, including quantitative reasoning about scaling behavior, communication patterns, and bottlenecks at scale. Working knowledge of the HPC software stack \- MPI, OpenMP, GPU programming models, schedulers, and math and communication libraries. Proven credibility with sophisticated technical customers in high\-stakes procurement and co\-design settings. Strong understanding of the competitive HPC landscape, including alternative CPU and accelerator architectures, fabric options, and system vendor positioning. Excellent written and oral communication skills, effective with both deep technical audiences and executive stakeholders. Comfort with high ambiguity and a track record of driving clarity in undefined technical areas. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for customer engagements and technical conferences. **Qualifications:** ------------------- ***Minimum Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field. 10\+ years of experience in HPC, data center, or server system architecture, design, or engineering. 5\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing or externally\-facing technical role. Demonstrated experience defining or deploying large\-scale compute clusters. ***Preferred Qualifications*** Master's degree or PhD in a relevant technical discipline. Experience defining next\-generation systems in partnership with CPU or GPU product and design teams. Experience supporting DOE national laboratory or comparable large\-scale public\-sector HPC procurements. Domain experience in a definitional HPC vertical: financial services, oil and gas and seismic processing, weather and climate, computational chemistry or biology, or manufacturing and CAE. Hands\-on experience with scale\-out fabrics including InfiniBand, Ultra Ethernet, or other high\-performance interconnect. Experience with system\-level performance modeling and workload characterization at scale. Experience with converged HPC and AI system design. **Job Type:** ------------- Experienced Hire **Shift:** ---------- Shift 1 (United States of America) **Primary Location:** --------------------- US, California, Santa Clara **Additional Locations:** ------------------------- US, Oregon, Hillsboro **Posting Statement:** ---------------------- All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. **Position of Trust** --------------------- This role is a Position of Trust. Should you accept this position, you must consent to and pass an extended Background Investigation, which includes (subject to country law), extended education, SEC sanctions, and additional criminal and civil checks. For internals, this investigation may or may not be completed prior to starting the position. For additional questions, please contact your Recruiter. **Benefits** ------------ We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel . Annual Salary Range for jobs which could be performed in the US: $220,920\.00\-311,890\.00 USD The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your preferred location during the hiring process. **Work Model for this Role** This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on\-site at their assigned Intel site and off\-site. \* Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change. * ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - FE
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit Mailchimp is a leading marketing platform for small businesses. We empower millions of customers around the world to build their brands and grow their companies with a suite of marketing automation, multichannel campaigns, CRM, and analytics tools. Forms are where a huge share of that growth starts. Signup forms, embedded forms, landing page forms, and the pop\-ups our customers put in front of their own audiences are the front door to list growth on Mailchimp, and they are rendered across an enormous surface area: inside our own app, and inside millions of third\-party websites we do not control. We are looking for a Staff\-level frontend engineer to set technical direction for that platform. This role is about depth, not breadth of headcount. You will own the architecture of a schema\-driven, micro\-frontend\-based forms platform: the contracts that describe a form, the runtime that renders it, the composition layer that lets independently deployed teams ship into a shared experience, and the operational discipline that keeps all of it fast and reliable on somebody else's page. You will do that alongside product, design, and engineers across the Forms, and you will be the person other engineers come to when a rendering, contract, or performance decision needs to be made well the first time. **How you'll work** ------------------- Our Core Leadership Behaviors are the observable and measurable leadership actions and skills that contribute to our effectiveness and success in our roles. * **Thriving in Complexity:** You unravel and make sense of potentially sophisticated, incomplete, and contradictory information to effectively solve problems. * **Nimble Learning:** You tackle problems with experimentation, using successes and failures to inform future decisions. * **Expecting the Best:** You hold yourself and others accountable to meet commitments. * **Collaborating Courageously:** You build partnerships across the company and work collaboratively with others to meet strategic goals. * **Cultivating Candor:** You act with integrity and earn the confidence and trust of others through honesty and authenticity. * **Inclusive Leadership:** You recognize the value diversity brings to our organization and leverage different perspectives to enhance organizational culture and drive performance. * **Customer Obsessed:** You listen hard to customers, understand their challenges, develop relationships with them, and deliver products that remove their obstacles. * **Action Oriented:** You initiate new opportunities and face tough challenges with a sense of energy, enthusiasm, and service. **Responsibilities** * Set the technical direction for the Mailchimp Forms frontend platform, micro\-frontend boundaries, module federation and composition strategy, versioning and rollback, and the migration path off legacy rendering paths in the monolith. * Own the schema contracts that drive our form experiences end to end: the schema definition, validation, versioning and backward\-compatibility strategy, and the renderer that turns schema into accessible, performant UI without a code change per field type. * Drive operational excellence as a first\-class deliverable SLOs and error budgets for a client\-side product, real\-user performance monitoring, Core Web Vitals, structured client\-side telemetry, alerting that pages on customer\-visible degradation rather than noise, and blameless postmortems that actually change the system. * Be the technical lead across the full lifecycle: scoping, design, implementation, testing, documentation, rollout, and long\-term maintenance, including the unglamorous parts. * Raise the bar for other engineers through design reviews, pairing, and written architecture guidance covering integration, performance, accessibility, and scalability and find the balance between writing code yourself and creating room for others to grow. * Extend and contribute back to our design system: component APIs, design tokens, and theming that hold up when a customer embeds our form into their own brand and stylesheet. * Own accessibility as a requirement, not a cleanup task — WCAG 2\.2 AA conformance, keyboard and screen\-reader behavior, and automated a11y checks wired into CI. * Use AI coding agents and GenAI\-assisted development as part of how you work, and help the team establish what good looks like: where agents accelerate us, where they need guardrails, and how review standards adapt. * Share production ownership and on\-call rotation with the rest of the team. **Qualifications** * You have significant experience designing and implementing frontend architectures at scale and writing code that is maintainable, performant, and observable, not just code that ships. * You have built or substantially evolved a **micro\-frontend architecture** in production: independently deployable frontends, shared dependency and runtime strategy, cross\-team contracts, isolation and blast\-radius control, and the versioning discipline that keeps it from turning into distributed spaghetti. You can speak candidly about what went wrong and what you would do differently. * You have deep expertise in **schema\-driven / config\-driven UI;** JSON Schema or an equivalent contract language, dynamic form rendering, declarative validation, schema evolution and backward compatibility, and codegen from contracts. You understand where schema\-driven design pays for itself and where it becomes an abstraction tax. * You hold a high bar on **software engineering fundamentals and operational excellence**: testing strategy that gives real confidence, CI/CD and progressive delivery, feature flags, instrumentation and observability, incident response, and a track record of owning what you ship in production. * You are fluent in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and a major component framework (React preferred), and you understand the browser deeply enough to reason about bundle size, hydration, rendering performance, and third\-party embedding constraints. * You treat accessibility and design\-system consistency as part of the definition of done. * You know when to introduce new technology and when to make do with what we already have. You know which corners can be safely cut to hit a date, and you go back and fix them. * You are comfortable resolving ambiguity and excited about shaping both what we build and how we build it, prioritizing work, identifying dependencies, and facilitating technical decisions across teams. * You communicate clearly in writing. Design docs, ADRs, and review comments are a core part of how you lead. * You are comfortable working in a distributed team, and you actively build an inclusive environment for the people who join after you. *Nice to have:* experience with widgets or SDKs embedded in third\-party sites, large\-scale monolith\-to\-modular migrations, edge rendering, or design\-system stewardship across multiple consuming teams. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: New York $202,500 \- $274,000

jobs.description: #### **What is Jedox?** At Jedox, we offer cutting\-edge Performance Management Platform and Solutions that enable businesses to plan, analyze, and optimize their financial and operational performance. Our B2B Platform\-as\-a\-Service offering consists of various components \- sophisticated data representation and data collection, a powerful planning engine, and data integration \- developed by our specialized product teams. To drive our “Digital Business Partner” vision, we’re expanding our Engineering team and looking for a Full\-Stack Software Engineer to help design and build the next generation of our platform services and applications. #### **Your Responsibilities** As a Support Engineer, you will be a trusted partner for our customers, serving as their first point of contact and helping to deliver an outstanding support experience. By utilizing AI\-powered tools, you will quickly triage, investigate and resolve issues, while also reviewing and validating solutions to ensure the highest level of quality before they are shared with customers. * **Ticket Management:** Respond to tickets in accordance with SLAs, setting the correct priority on submission. * **Case Triage \& Classification:** Triage, classify and enrich incoming tickets to ensure they are followed up in a timely and effective manner. * **AI Solution Validation:** Validate and review AI\-generated solution proposals before sharing them with the customer. * **Customer Communication:** Provide positive and informative communication in writing and verbally (email, phone and video). * **Cloud Administration:** Implement configuration changes for cloud customers, providing information on Jedox Cloud settings and creating customer portal accounts. * **Escalation Management:** Check support responsibility for new tickets and escalate to the senior expert pool when needed. * **Case Ownership:** Take ownership of escalations, follow up on them and resolve them satisfactorily, and manage your queue proactively. * **Knowledge Sharing \& Process Improvement:** Contribute to the knowledge base and the continuous improvement of support processes. #### **Your Profile** * Over three years' experience in Experience of working in SaaS/technical support in a fast\-paced environment. * Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or commensurate experience in software. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, combined with excellent interpersonal, organisational and customer skills * Solid technical expertise in Windows and Linux systems, web servers, cloud services, databases and Excel, ideally complemented by experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Azure, ITIL, SRE practices and Salesforce Service Cloud. * Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. * Availability to work primarily during Pacific Time business hours to support customers and teams across the Americas (no shift work required) #### **Transparency Note: Use of Artificial Intelligence** As a tech\-driven company, Jedox uses modern technologies — including AI — to continuously improve our processes. In recruiting, AI may support us in screening and structuring applications. It does not replace human judgment, but helps us reduce bias and ensure a consistent candidate experience. Of course, you can also contact us at any time if you have any questions. #### **About us** Jedox is a leading software solution that enables business planning, budgeting, and forecasting for finance, sales, and other business functions with leading\-edge technology to drive Digital Transformation and provide tangible customer value. Constant innovation has made us a leader in the Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) sector. **Our Values** At Jedox, we pride ourselves on our core corporate values, which drive our success as a team. Our growth mindset encourages us to constantly learn, evolve and innovate, pushing ourselves to new heights. We execute with precision and hold ourselves to the highest standards of excellence, ensuring that we deliver impactful results that exceed our customers' expectations. Our focus on people centricity ensures that our employees are at the heart of everything we do, enabling us to attract and retain top talent. We believe that effective communication and engagement are key to building strong relationships, both internally and with our customers, partners and stakeholders. **Why should you join our team?** At Jedox, we want our customers to achieve \#Superplännen. It is that exhilarating feeling when an organization performs how it envisioned it. When you plan for the future and achieve your goals, we call it Superplännen, and we want you to achieve the same. This is why at Jedox our culture is shaped by our global collaboration, passion for people and development, diversity, and commitment to innovation. We refer to it as our \#OneTeam mantra, which is ingrained in everything we do. We believe in lifelong learning and encourage team members to pursue personal and professional development, including internal \& external training and certifications. We also enjoy meeting regularly (online or in persona) with each other all across the world for work, team events, to spend quality time together \& have fun, or even do sports together. The same effort and attention are being given to ensure employee satisfaction in an out of the office. Some of those perks include: * **Flexible work:** we love to work together in the offices as \#Oneteam, but we also enjoy the possibility of working from everywhere and owning working hours. * **Take time to care for yourself:** We offer generous vacation time and comprehensive health benefits plans, including Pension plans. * **Plan for your future:** Planning means something different to everyone. jobs.title: GAIT Director (School of Government and Policy)
jobs.description: Affiliated Office Address Washington, DC, United States Requisition ID 122654 Date Created October 02, 2026 Job Family Finance \& Business Job Subfamily Business Ops\-Fin Mgmt Job Function Program Management Exempt Status Exempt Shift Type Full Time Schedule Monday\-Friday 8:30am\-5pm Worksite 01\-DC:District of Columbia Work Modality On\-site: 90\-100% of hours worked on\-site Governing the AI Transition (GAIT) is a new initiative housed in the School of Government and Policy (SGP) that aims to establish Johns Hopkins as the world leader for cross\-disciplinary research, training, and practice on the challenges of governing the societal\-scale transition that powerful AI will precipitate. GAIT's focus is on the frontier of AI research, and transformative capabilities that are on the horizon, including the prospect of AI systems that meet or exceed median human performance across a broad set of cognitive functions, often described as Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). GAIT will develop foundational and applied research leading to concrete, implementable, and politically viable approaches to the governance of, with, and in response to AI, and will train people to put those approaches into practice across industry, government, civil society, and academia. The initiative is organized around three core activities: research (AI alignment and governance scholarship, fellowships, and field\-building infrastructure such as conferences and journals); training (AI governance coursework, a planned Master’s degree, and executive education); and outreach (translating research into practice through convening stakeholders, public\-interest deployment of AI agents, and third\-party evaluation of frontier AI models). GAIT is building a Washington, D.C.\-based community of researchers and practitioners working at the center of frontier AI policy, with close ties to frontier AI labs, government, and civil society. We are seeking a ***GAIT Director*** who will lead operations for the GAIT initiative, in support of Faculty leadership. This position will advance policy and outcomes through stakeholder engagement, capacity building, and program development. The candidate will oversee multi\-year, multi\-million\-dollar initiatives, supporting interdisciplinary research teams and managing operations staff, contributing to grant and gift acquisition and program design to implementation and dissemination of findings. Johns Hopkins’ first new academic division since 2007, the School of Government and Policy is anchored at the Hopkins Bloomberg Center in the nation’s capital. It draws on the university’s 150\-year research tradition to develop innovative, evidence\-based solutions and prepare the next generation of policy and public sector leaders to advance evidence\-based solutions for the policy and governance challenges that matter most. The person filling this position will be working in a start\-up environment – creating processes and procedures, navigating unexpected obstacles, and adapting to change frequently. An agile mindset and flexible approach to daily responsibilities is needed as we define new ways of working within a well\-established university. We are seeking a solution\-focused person with a demonstrated ability to create new paths to achieve results. **Specific Duties \& Responsibilities** *Program Leadership and Management* * Support faculty strategic leadership of GAIT by executing large\-scale projects in alignment with the School’s strategic goals. * Ensure initiatives meet sponsor deliverables, compliance requirements, budgets, and deadlines. *Policy* * Work across teams to support translation of complex policy issues into clear, actionable strategies. * Monitor legislative developments. * Foster relationships with stakeholders and align advocacy efforts. *Program Implementation* * Support faculty strategic leadership in executing data\-driven initiatives to implement programs and deliver outcomes in partnership with and to external stakeholder organizations. *Team Management* * Supervise multidisciplinary teams of engineers, analysts, and support staff. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior staff. *Stakeholder Engagement* * Build and maintain partnerships with federal, state, and local government agencies; community\-based organizations; and policymakers, to translate complex program outcomes into actionable policy. *Grant Management* * Identify grant funding opportunities, write grant proposals, and manage budgets to ensure project sustainability. * Manage relationships with funding agencies. *Fundraising* * Identify potential donors, build healthy donor relationships, and generate revenue from donor gifts in partnership with the School’s development officer. *Policy Translation* * Support GAIT faculty in realizing program outcomes through policy recommendations to academic, governmental, and public forums. *Reporting and Dissemination* * Support faculty dissemination of research through a communica yees' health, life, career and retirement. More information can be found here: https://hr.jhu.edu/benefits\-worklife/. ***Education and Experience Equivalency*** Please refer to the job description above to see which forms of equivalency are permitted for this position. If permitted, equivalencies will follow these guidelines: JHU Equivalency Formula: 30 undergraduate degree credits (semester hours) or 18 graduate degree credits may substitute for one year of experience. Additional related experience may substitute for required education on the same basis. For jobs where equivalency is permitted, up to two years of non\-related college course work may be applied towards the total minimum education/experience required for the respective job. ***Applicants Completing Studies*** Applicants who do not meet the posted requirements but are completing their final academic semester/quarter will be considered eligible for employment and may be asked to provide additional information confirming their academic completion date. ***Background Checks*** The successful candidate(s) for this position will be subject to a pre\-employment background check. Johns Hopkins is committed to hiring individuals with a justice\-involved background, consistent with applicable policies and current practice. A prior criminal history does not automatically preclude candidates from employment at Johns Hopkins University. In accordance with applicable law, the university will review, on an individual basis, the date of a candidate's conviction, the nature of the conviction and how the conviction relates to an essential job\-related qualification or function. ***Diversity and Inclusion*** The Johns Hopkins University values diversity, equity and inclusion and advances these through our key strategic framework, the JHU Roadmap on Diversity and Inclusion. ***Equal Opportunity Employer*** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. ***EEO is the Law*** https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023\-06/22\-088\_EEOC\_KnowYourRights6\.12ScreenRdr.pdf ***Accommodation Information*** If you are interested in applying for employment with The Johns Hopkins University and require special assistance or accommodation during any part of the pre\-employment process, please contact the Talent Acquisition Office at jhurecruitment@jhu.edu. For TTY users, call via Maryland Relay or dial 711\. For more information about workplace accommodations or accessibility at Johns Hopkins University, please visit: https://accessibility.jhu.edu/. ***Vaccine Requirements*** Johns Hopkins University requires all faculty, staff, and students to receive the seasonal flu vaccine. Exceptions to the flu vaccine requirements may be provided to individuals for religious beliefs or medical reasons. Requests for an exception must be submitted to the JHU vaccination registry. ***The following additional provisions may apply, depending upon campus. Your recruiter will advise accordingly.*** The pre\-employment physical for positions in clinical areas, laboratories, working with research subjects, or involving community contact requires documentation of immune status against Rubella (German measles), Rubeola (Measles), Mumps, Varicella (chickenpox), Hepatitis B and documentation of having received the Tdap (Tetanus, diphtheria, pertussis) vaccination. This may include documentation of having two (2\) MMR vaccines; two (2\) Varicella vaccines; or antibody status to these diseases from laboratory testing. Blood tests for immunities to these diseases are ordinarily included in the pre\-employment physical exam except for those employees who provide results of blood tests or immunization documentation from their own health care providers. Any vaccinations required for these diseases will be given at no cost in our Occupational Health office.

jobs.description: **About Johnson Controls** Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. Are you passionate about designing the intelligent control systems that power today's industrial technologies? Join Johnson Controls and play a key role in developing innovative control solutions that drive efficiency, reliability, and performance. As an Electrical Designer Drafter, you'll design, develop, and document industrial control systems utilizing PLCs, embedded computer control platforms, and associated electrical systems. Collaborating closely with engineering, manufacturing, project management, and field teams, you'll transform concepts into high\-quality, cost\-effective solutions that make a real impact. This position is based onsite at our FRICK manufacturing facility in Waynesboro, PA. Candidates must be commuting distance to the facility, or able to relocate. **Only US Citizens and/or Permanent Residents will be considered for this position.** **How you will do it** * Design and develop electrical control systems for industrial equipment and automation applications. * Create and maintain electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, terminal plans, and bills of material using Autodesk Electrical. * Develop PLC and embedded computer hardware documentation for new product designs and customer\-specific projects. * Select and specify electrical components including PLCs, HMIs, industrial computers, power supplies, circuit protection devices, communication hardware, sensors and instrumentation * Ensure compliance with applicable electrical codes, standards, and company design practices. * Support engineering change requests and update design documentation. * Coordinate with engineers, production personnel, and suppliers to resolve design and manufacturing issues. * Assist in panel layout optimization for manufacturability and serviceability. * Generate accurate documentation packages for manufacturing, testing, and field installation. * Participate in project review meetings and design reviews. * Provide technical support during system integration, testing, startup, and troubleshooting activities. * Maintain project schedules and deliver assigned tasks within established deadlines. * Support continuous improvement initiatives related to design processes, standards, and documentation practices. * Provide support for the controls panel shop to clarify specifications and adapt engineering changes if needed. **What you will need** **Required** * Associate Degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering Technology, or a similar discipline, or 5 years of professional experience in lieu of a degree. * 2\+ years of experience in electrical controls design, industrial automation, or related engineering design activities. **Preferred** * Proficiency with Autodesk Electrical. * Understanding of industrial control systems and electrical design principles. * Knowledge of PLC hardware platforms and industrial control architectures. * Familiarity with embedded computer control systems and industrial networking. * Ability to create and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, control system documentation, and industrial Refrigeration P\&ID’s * Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP/IP, Profinet, and serial communications * Knowledge of electrical codes and industry standards including NFPA 70, NFPA 79, and UL508A control panel requirements. jobs.description: **Kalamazoo Mechanical, Inc.** **Job Description: Project Coordinator** **Location:** Kalamazoo, MI **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Reports To:** Project Management Team **About Kalamazoo Mechanical, Inc.** Locally owned and operated since 1985, Kalamazoo Mechanical, Inc. jobs.title: Senior Data Visualization & Grafana Engineer
jobs.description: Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Data Visualization \& Grafana Engineer to design and improve analytical and operational dashboards used by business and technical users. Grafana is our primary visualization platform. While Grafana is traditionally associated with observability and system monitoring, we also use it to visualize operational data, trends, events, KPIs, historical information, and analytical insights. The ideal candidate combines strong data visualization and analytical thinking with hands\-on Grafana experience. We are open to candidates who have built sophisticated analytical solutions using other visualization platforms and have solid experience working with Grafana. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and enhance Grafana dashboards for operational and analytical use cases. Work directly with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into meaningful visualizations. Build dashboards for: Real\-time and historical trends Operational KPIs and metrics Time\-series and event\-based data Alerts and exceptions Summary and detailed analytical views Filtering, navigation, and drilldowns Improve existing dashboards with a focus on usability, performance, consistency, and user experience. Determine the most effective visualization for different types of data and business questions. Develop Grafana variables, transformations, calculations, queries, filters, links, and interactive dashboard capabilities. Troubleshoot dashboard, query, data\-source, and performance issues. Work with engineering teams to understand underlying data models and improve how data is presented to users. Develop reusable dashboard templates, visualization standards, and best practices. Required Qualifications Strong experience building data visualizations and analytical dashboards. Hands\-on experience developing dashboards in Grafana. Experience with one or more additional visualization/analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Kibana, or similar tools. Strong SQL and data\-querying skills. Experience working with time\-series, event\-based, operational, or high\-volume datasets. Good understanding of dashboard design, data visualization principles, and user experience. Ability to take business requirements and independently translate them into effective dashboards. Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot data and visualization issues. Preferred Qualifications Advanced Grafana experience including variables, transformations, drilldowns, dashboard linking, annotations, and performance optimization. Experience with time\-series databases such as InfluxDB, Amazon Timestream, Prometheus, or similar technologies. Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms. Experience integrating visualization platforms with APIs and multiple data sources. Experience with IoT, telemetry, transportation, manufacturing, or other operational data environments. Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript or Grafana plugin development is a plus. What We Are Looking For We are not looking only for a traditional observability engineer who has primarily built infrastructure monitoring dashboards. We are looking for someone who understands how to present complex data in a way that helps users identify trends, investigate issues, understand what is happening, and make informed decisions. Deep analytical dashboard experience in Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms combined with solid Grafana experience is acceptable. The ability to understand the data, work with users, and design an effective analytical experience is more important than expertise in every individual Grafana feature. Pay: From $65\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Product and Privacy Counsel
jobs.description: **Kikoff: The Fintech Powering Financial Security at Scale** Kikoff is a profitable, pre\-IPO fintech company on a mission to empower everyone to achieve financial security. With record revenue growth in 2025 and a unicorn valuation, we've built a suite of products that help millions of people build credit, access liquidity, and save money. We're scaling fast. Join us if you want to build something meaningful and help millions of people move forward financially. **Why Kikoff:** This is a consumer fintech startup, and you will be working with serial entrepreneurs who have built strong consumer brands and innovative products. We value extreme ownership, clear communication, a strong sense of craftsmanship, and the desire to create lasting work and work relationships. Yes, you can build an exciting business AND have real\-life real\-customer impact. ### **The Role** We are looking for a talented, curious lawyer to serve as a legal partner to our product, engineering, and business teams. You will work across Kikoff's growing product ecosystem — including credit\-building products, earned wage access (EWA), and new product lines in development — to help us move fast while staying on the right side of a complex and evolving regulatory landscape. This role is a fit for someone who is early enough in their career to still be building depth, but far enough along to own problems end to end. You will have real ownership over your matters from day one and a direct line of sight into how legal decisions shape the product. You should be comfortable operating in areas of legal ambiguity, eager to learn both bank\-partnered and direct\-to\-consumer product structures, and excited by the intersection of consumer financial services and technology. ### **What You'll Do** * Act as a day\-to\-day legal advisor to product and engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept through launch and iteration, escalating novel or bet\-the\-company questions as appropriate. * Advise on the design, structuring, and regulatory implications of consumer financial products, including credit\-building tradelines, earned wage access, lending, and new product concepts. * Research and apply federal and state consumer financial regulations. * Advise on data privacy and consumer data protection requirements. * Provide guidance on marketing and communications. * Track regulatory developments and translate them into practical, actionable product guidance. * Support state licensing applications, renewals, and compliance filings. * Draft, review, and negotiate consumer\-facing terms and disclosures, a variety of different marketing materials, and commercial agreements. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with compliance, risk, marketing, and operations to embed legal guardrails without slowing the pace of innovation. * Use AI to make the Legal function more effective and efficient. ### **What We're Looking For** * J.D. from an accredited law school. * Be an active member of the California state bar or registered in\-house counsel in California. * 5\-8 years of legal experience, including meaningful time in litigation, product counseling, or regulatory practice. A mix of law firm and in\-house experience is a plus, but we are open to candidates coming directly from a firm. * Comfort operating in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments, and a track record of turning legal research into clear, practical guidance rather than a memo full of caveats. * Good judgment, intellectual honesty about what you do and do not know, and a bias toward enabling the business rather than only identifying risk. * Eagerness and curiosity in learning new substantive areas of the law. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex legal concepts for non\-legal audiences. * Experience and interest in the use of AI to support legal functions. * Enthusiasm for Kikoff's mission and the opportunity to expand access to financial services for underserved consumers. ### **Nice to Have** * Knowledge of federal consumer finance statutes (TILA, ECOA, FCRA, EFTA) and a willingness to build depth quickly in state lending and money transmission frameworks. * Familiarity with consumer data privacy laws (CCPA/CPRA, GLBA), or the appetite to get up to speed on advising product teams on data collection, use, and sharing practices. * Exposure to at least one of: credit\-building or credit reporting products, earned wage access, consumer lending through bank partnership models, or payments. * Exposure to multi\-state licensing or regulatory examination processes. ### **Why This Role** This is a high\-ownership seat on a small legal team at a company shipping real consumer financial products. You will not be a cog reviewing a queue of contracts. You will sit with product managers and engineers while decisions are being made, own your own regulatory questions, and grow into a subject\-matter owner across one or more of our product lines. US salary range: $225,000 – $275,000 base \+ equity Medical, dental, vision — Kikoff covers the full cost for employees, 50% for dependents RSU's Visa sponsorship available Base Range $225,000 \- $275,000 USD Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Kikoff Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to complying with all federal, state, and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and considers qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class. .

The need to act on climate change has never been clearer so we incorporate sustainability into everything we do by \#InvestingInBetter \- creating innovative products that enhance product protection, shelf life and contribute to reducing the overall carbon footprint. At kp, we are passionate about ensuring our customers' satisfaction, and we strive to achieve this goal by focusing all our efforts on meeting their evolving needs. Our dedication to drive a positive change in the packaging industry with a focus on quality and sustainability has earned us a reputation as a trusted partner for businesses worldwide. **Position Summary** ==================== The Maintenance Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating all maintenance activities at the Greenville, Ohio facility to ensure the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of production equipment, facility systems, and utilities. This position provides leadership to the maintenance team while supporting both day\-shift and night\-shift operations and partnering closely with Production, Quality, Safety, and site leadership. The Maintenance Manager will lead a team of approximately 3–4 maintenance employees and is responsible for establishing work priorities, coordinating preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting equipment issues, improving equipment reliability, and minimizing production downtime. This position requires strong mechanical and electrical knowledge, including the ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, technical manuals, and equipment blueprints. resources to identify and resolve equipment and facility concerns. **Essential Responsibilities** ============================== * Lead, supervise, develop, and support a maintenance team of condition, safety concerns, preventive maintenance schedules, and work orders. * Schedule and coordinate the repair, maintenance, troubleshooting, and installation of production machinery, tools, equipment, and facility systems to support continuous manufacturing operations. * Provide technical direction and troubleshooting support for mechanical and electrical equipment issues. * Maintain a managers, Engineering, Quality, HSE/Safety, and other departments to troubleshoot equipment concerns, minimize downtime, and improve equipment performance. * Develop, implement, maintain, and conformance with operational, safety, and performance standards. * Lead root\-cause analysis of recurring equipment failures and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions. * Identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability, operational efficiency, maintenance effectiveness, and overall equipment utilization. * Plan, develop, and implement maintenance methods and procedures improvement of machinery, tooling, and equipment to support existing and new production requirements. * Review new equipment, product, and process plans and collaborate with Engineering, Production, and other stakeholders regarding equipment requirements, modifications, installation, and commissioning. * Direct maintenance activities involving facility and utility systems to support the continuous and reliable supply of electrical power, compressed air, heating, cooling, and other utilities required for operations. * A s experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment
