jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description: **WHO WE ARE** KNAPP brings new technology to warehouse automation. The KNAPP Group is a global provider of intelligent automation solutions for intralogistics and manufacturing, specializing in the sectors healthcare, fashion/apparel, general retail, food retail, industry and service. We live and breathe automation. We, more than 8,000 employees of the KNAPP Group in over 60 locations worldwide, shaping the future\-oriented industry of intralogistics are dedicated to making complexity simple. One of KNAPP’s primary goals is to use continuous innovation to drive warehouse automation forward, always with the specific needs of the customers in mind. KNAPP Group’s unrelenting development activity is evident in everything from automated order picking systems and continuing refinement of container handling technology to its state\-of\-the\-art, industry leading software solutions. **WHAT YOU GET TO DO** ASenior Project Manager is expected to manage multiple projects of moderate to high complexity concurrently and without direct supervision. Projects falling within the responsibilities of Senior Project Manager may have some, but not all, of the following characteristics: * Manage 3\+ projects up to $150 million in value or a single project up $100 million * Expected project margins less than 10% * Manage retrofits, greenfield or brownfield project(s) for new or existing Knapp customers * Expected to manage a reference project for a new customer or Knapp product line * Integration of scope from 2 or more Knapp Group subsidiary companies * Integration of 3rd party equipment with significant portion of overall project scope * Projects may have moderate to high contractual and schedule risks (new Knapp customer, accelerated schedule, unique customer specific contract terms, significant penalties) * Project may require significant software development of established Knapp products or introduction of a Knapp software product * May be asked to lead a global program within the Knapp Group A Senior Project Manager is expected to perform the following responsibilities in completion of his/her work: * Ensure all required communication between project stakeholders, Knapp resources, suppliers, etc., occurs in a time frame and to the level of detail necessary for a successful project * Steer all project related activities and ensure they occur in a time frame necessary for a successful project * Produce, distribute, and file documentation as required to ensure contractual requirements are met and all possible risk to Knapp is mitigated. A partial list of documentation produced by a Project Manager may include: + Meeting minutes with action items + Confirmation of discussion + Meeting agendas + Critical path schedules + Project risk register + Commercial correspondence (Customer and Supplier) + Cost analysis and project forecast + Status reports (internal and external) + Open Issues lists * Know and understand which issues need to be escalated, when, and to whom, to eliminate negative impact to a project * Operate and negotiate independently within Knapp policies, procedures, and directives * Champion a project within the Knapp Group * Develop and maintain good lines of communication with Knapp team members, stakeholders based at Knapp AG (parent company) or other Knapp subsidiaries, and the Site Manager and Implementation Team Leads onsite * Ensure all necessary information flows between Knapp AG, other Knapp subsidiaries, and the Customer * Have overall responsibility for all commercial items * Create, maintain, and track project schedules, using critical path methodology * Maintain project budget forecast, in coordination with Project Controlling * Manage the Customer contract * Coordinate change order pricing and proposals * Evaluate Requests for Quote (RFQs) and subcontracts for major buy\-out/3rd party components and systems, in coordination with Procurement and Final Engineering * Manage sub\-contracts for 3rd party equipment and service providers * Coordinate with resources for the project with managers of internal teams (Installation, Commissioning, Product, etc.) * Drive resolution of all project\-related open issues * Manage multiple projects simultaneously * Manage project teams, which may or may not include a Project Manager I, Site Manager, Installation Supervisors, and Commissioning Engineers * A Senior Project Manager is expected to be a knowledge leader within Knapp US and the global Knapp project management organization. As such, they are likely to be designated as a process owner for one of Knapp’s core project management tools * Occasionally, serve as a mentor to either Project Manager I or II, coaching on Knapp processes and general project management skills **WHAT YOU HAVE*** Authorization to work in the U.S. * Passport or ability to obtain passport * Travel required up to 50% + quarterly international travel * Professional office etiquette is required at all times * Physical requirements may include: + sitting, squatting, walking, reaching out to arm’s length, reaching over\-head, lifting between 50\-100 pounds, and reading **WHAT YOU WILL GET** * 2 remote days per week * Half day Fridays * A beautiful new, state\-of\-the\-art, office complex in Kennesaw, GA * Industry competitive compensation * Great benefits with better than average employer contributions, including health, dental, vision, life insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts, Short \& Long Term Disability and more! * 401k with a very generous employer match and no vesting! * Paid Vacation \& Holidays * Profit Sharing * Paid Parental Leave * Subsidized Daycare * Tuition Reimbursement * Pet Insurance * Subsidized food delivery * Monthly celebrations * Quarterly employee events * Corporate Social Responsibility including recycling, sustainability and volunteering *KNAPP is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status or any other basis protected by law.* *Due to the safety\-sensitive nature of this position, strict adherence to KNAPP’s drug\-free workplace policy is required. All candidates will be subject to drug\-screening in accordance with the policy and will be expected to remain drug\-free during their employment. There will be no exception if recreational or medical use of marijuana is permitted in the location of employment and/or residence or if use of marijuana is only during “off\-hours.”*

jobs.title: Entry Level Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **Manufacturing Engineer, Entry\-Level** **SUMMARY** Sentient Energy is seeking a highly motivated and enthusiastic **Entry\-Level Manufacturing Engineer** to join our growing team. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early\-career professional to gain hands\-on experience in a dynamic manufacturing environment, contributing to the production of cutting\-edge technology that is transforming the energy industry. In this role, you will work closely with experienced engineers and cross\-functional teams to create and optimize manufacturing processes, improve product quality, and increase efficiency. You will be involved in various stages of the product lifecycle, from design to production, and will have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on our operational success. . **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** · Assist in the development, implementation, and optimization of manufacturing processes, procedures, and equipment both in\-house and at Contract Manufactures · Contribute to the design and development of new products and product enhancements, focusing on manufacturability and cost\-effectiveness. · Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including lean manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies, to reduce waste and improve efficiency. · Collect and analyze manufacturing data to identify trends, pinpoint areas for improvement, and track key performance indicators (KPIs). · Collaborate with R\&D, Quality, Supply Chain, and other departments to ensure seamless product development and production. · Assist in the creation and maintenance of manufacturing documentation, including work instructions, process flows, and training materials. · Conduct time studies and capacity planning to optimize production schedules. · Learn and apply industry best practices for safety, quality, and environmental compliance. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with keen attention to detail. * Basic understanding of manufacturing principles, processes, and equipment. * Familiarity with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) is a plus. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment and collaborate with diverse groups. * Proactive and eager to learn new technologies and processes. * Ability to adapt to a fast\-paced and evolving work environment. Job Type: Full\-time \- **This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship** Salary and Benefits Commensurate with Experience. **CULTURE AND TOTAL REWARDS** Sentient Energy, Inc. offers full\-time employees a significant Total Rewards Package, including: * Medical insurance plan options and other standard employee benefits, including dental insurance, vision benefits, life insurance, disability insurance, and more! * 401(k) Plan (plus company match) * Paid time off – including holidays and vacation. * Above all, a company culture that prioritizes the growth of its employees technically, professionally, and financially. Work Location: Frisco, TX It is the policy of Sentient Energy, Inc. not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or any employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **About the Role** The Kohl’s Fraud and Privacy Team is responsible for the technology backing fraud detection and mitigation, and privacy compliance at kohls. We focus on building tools to detect and mitigate bad actors who are attempting to misuse kohls accounts for fraudulent reasons (Account takeover, Credit Card Testing, Rewards abuse and theft). The privacy team focuses on compliance with state regulations (DSAR, CPRA/CCPA), and confirming that customers pii is protected, and managed in accordance with both state regulations, and kohls internal policy. **What You’ll Do** * You will be expected to work with other engineers to identify gaps in protection, and add new features and fix bugs in our existing fraud platform.. * Assist with the development of high\-quality, robust, observable, and measurable applications using a user\-centric approach. * Contribute across the stack (but primarily on the back end), developing business logic with Java/Spring Boot on the backend and building intuitive user interfaces with React on the frontend. * Participate in the entire Agile application lifecycle in collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers. * Leverage critical thinking, experimentation, data, and industry best practices to implement desired business outcomes. * Facilitate team ceremonies and actively give and receive feedback that is empathetic, actionable, and specific. * Interact with vendors to help understand integration gaps, and **What Skills You Have** **Required Skills:** Java **Preferred** * Springboot,Redis, Data analysis (big query), Kafka, Cloud engineering (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD, Git, SWIFT, Kotlin/Android development

jobs.title: Associate Packaging Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Ready for more than just a job? Build a career with purpose. At Lactalis in the USA, we’re committed to providing meaningful opportunities for our people to learn, grow, and thrive—whether you’re just starting your journey with us or looking to take the next step in your career. From day one, we offer the tools and support to help you succeed. As the world leader in dairy, Lactalis is a family\-owned company with over 85,000 pragmatic and ambitious professionals across the globe. Each day, we’re proud to produce award\-winning dairy products that bring people together. In the US, we proudly offer an unrivaled house of beloved brands, including Galbani® Italian cheeses and ricotta, Président® specialty cheeses and butters, Kraft® natural and grated cheeses, Breakstone’s® cottage cheese, Cracker Barrel®, Black Diamond® cheddar, and Parmalat® milk. Our yogurt portfolio includes siggi’s®, Stonyfield Organic®, Brown Cow™, Oui®, Yoplait®, Go\-Gurt®, :ratio®, Green Mountain Creamery®, and Mountain High®, along with a growing family of ethnic favorites like Karoun®, Gopi®, and Arz®. At Lactalis, we live by our core values—Ambition, Engagement, and Simplicity. We foster a workplace where innovation thrives, diverse perspectives are celebrated, and everyone’s unique background and ideas are valued. Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. We want to hear about your PASSION, your STORY, and how your EXPERTISE can help us shape the future of dairy. **From your PASSION to ours** Lactalis USA, part of the Lactalis family of companies, is currently hiring a Associate Packaging Engineer based in Buffalo, New York. Working closely with Marketing, R\&D, Plants, Quality, Engineering, and Purchasing teams, the Associate Packaging Engineer is responsible for developing, evaluating, and implementing packaging solutions that support new product launches, business continuity, operational efficiency, and sustainability objectives. The role provides technical expertise in package design, material selection, performance testing, and manufacturing implementation. The Associate Packaging Engineer collaborates with internal and external partners to standardize packaging systems where appropriate, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure packaging solutions meet business, regulatory, quality, and operational requirements. Frequent travel to manufacturing facilities and supplier locations is required. **From your EXPERTISE to ours** *Key responsibilities for this position include:* * Work on cross\-functional teams (Marketing, R\&D, Quality, Plants, Engineering and Purchasing) to develop, design, test and make packaging recommendations for new and existing (line extensions) products * Develop, revise, and maintain packaging die lines, pallet configurations, and related technical documentation to ensure accuracy and manufacturing readiness. May require use of computer systems (AUTOCAD / CAPE / TOPS) to complete the process. * Identify, evaluate, and implement packaging and process improvements that deliver cost savings while maintaining product quality, performance, and operational efficiency. * General knowledge of packaging machinery, material handling, and automation that relates to Packaging. * Lead manufacturing trials, collect data, and provide technical recommendations based on trial results. * Support manufacturing sites in addressing packaging performance, material, and supply\-related challenges to ensure operational efficiency and product quality. * Source and investigate new innovative ideas throughout the industry to inform Marketing and plants of the newest innovations that may benefit our product lines. This process can be done through publications, shows, networking with Suppliers, product displays in the marketplace. Will continually assess Suppliers to ensure that our company receives updated innovations and new packaging ideas. * Act as a key member of Lactalis’ sustainability initiatives. To identify opportunities, quantify achievements, and ensure timely execution of projects at our plants, co\-packers, and for imported products. * Exchange information within LAN Packaging R\&D team to benefit in package designs, specifications, and machinery. * Lead the technical implementation of packaging changes associated with supplier transitions, manufacturing transfers, and business continuity initiatives. * Technically assist in sourcing and qualifying Suppliers. This will include regular visits to production plants and suppliers. The Associate Packaging Engineer will establish a qualification procedure for evaluation and implementation. * This job description outlines the primary responsibilities of the role and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties that may be assigned. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these Essential Duties and Responsibilities. * Ability to travel to various North American Lactalis sites in the United States and Canada (up to 30% travel required). This travel will require overnight stays depending on the manufacturing site being supported. Requirements: **From your STORY to ours** *Qualified applicants will contribute the following:* *Education:* * Bachelors degree in Packaging Science or related field preferred *Experience* * At least one year of experience in Packaging or related field required through work or internship *Competencies* * Effective and proficient communicator, written and verbal * Business acumen to include problem solving and analysis * Able to manage time through efficient planning an organizing * OSHA, Food Safety, FDA and UDSA * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, manufacturing and business systems and packaging\- related software; experience with CAD drafting and palletization software preferred *At Lactalis, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards Program with a variety of affordable benefits and coverage options. We support insurance costs significantly, contribute generously to retirement plans, and offer Paid Time Off from day one. We are committed to your professional growth, providing training and development opportunities, including Education Reimbursement. Join us and grow your career.* *Lactalis is an equal employment opportunity employer. We will not discriminate against applicants with regard to any legally\-recognized basis including, but not limited to: veteran status, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, sexual orientation, and physical or mental disabilities. Further, any division of the Company that is an Affirmative Action Employer will comply with all related legal obligations.*

That allows us to build closely with customers while creating repeatable products that can be taken broadly to market. We are forming small, highly capable product teams to do this. These teams bring product management, design, and engineering together with the autonomy to move quickly, make decisions, and own outcomes from the earliest prototype through production and scale. This is a software engineering role within a permanent product team. It is not a consulting delivery, data engineering, product management, or forward\-deployed engineering role. **You Are** You are an exceptional AI\-native software engineer who has built and shipped production products across the full stack. You combine strong engineering fundamentals with product judgment, systems thinking, and a high bar for quality. You are comfortable beginning with an ambiguous customer or business problem, shaping the technical approach, and turning it into software that real users rely on. AI is central to both what you build and how you build. You use coding agents and other AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow. You know how to decompose work, provide the right context and constraints, establish tests and evaluations, and review generated output with rigor. You use AI to increase your leverage while retaining full accountability for the architecture, security, reliability, and quality of the product. You are energized by zero\-to\-one work, small teams, high autonomy, and the opportunity to help define how a new product engineering organization should operate. **What You Will Do** **Build and ship across the full stack.** Own meaningful product capabilities end to end, including application architecture, data models, backend services, APIs, integrations, AI systems, and user experiences. Work directly with product managers and designers to turn customer problems into simple, high\-quality products. Move comfortably between prototyping and production engineering, making thoughtful decisions about when to optimize for speed and when to invest for scale, security, and reliability. **Build AI\-native products.** Design and implement agentic systems, including model interactions, tool use, retrieval, orchestration, state management, evaluations, observability, and guardrails. Build products that perform reliably against complex, real\-world industry workflows rather than only in controlled demonstrations. Evaluate model and system behavior rigorously, understand failure modes, and improve the product through evidence. **Work in an AI\-native engineering model.** Use coding agents and AI development tools extensively throughout the engineering lifecycle. Create the context, specifications, tests, development environments, CI pipelines, and evaluation systems that allow agents to produce high\-quality work safely and efficiently. Direct multiple streams of agent\-assisted work where appropriate, review outputs critically, and remain accountable for everything that reaches production. **Set technical direction.** Translate ambiguous product opportunities into clear technical approaches and executable plans. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Mobile Apps
jobs.description: **Innovate in Charlotte** Thank you for dedicating your time and talent to Lowe’s. We want to give you more opportunities to learn and grow, so if you find a position you’re interested in below, we encourage you to apply! **Your Impact** The Principal Software Engineer \- Mobile Apps will influence a wide variety of business and technology decisions. This role will design, implement, and deliver cross\-functional solutions for highly complex problems. This role will provide technical direction for an organization and set up an excellent engineering culture. **Where You’ll Be** Associates are required to relocate to the Lowe's Tech Hub Charlotte NC to foster collaboration and support. The ideal candidate must be willing to work in the office at our Charlotte Tech Hub, office location, 5 days per week. Most business meetings are planned around the Eastern time zone. **Work with a Winning Team** As part of a Fortune 500 company and retail leader, your work can change an entire industry. Our CEO is a forward\-thinker when it comes to tech, and with one of Forbes Top 50 CIOs leading the charge, you can come to work knowing you’ll have access to the data, tools, and support that few other companies can offer. We also know what it takes to create an inclusive culture that supports you. Our teams are structured around the engineer, giving you the support you need to do your best work. Since we’ve been in business for over 100 years, we’ve built an excellent track record of growth and success. There’s peace of mind knowing you have the stability and resources you need to focus on solving tough challenges. And as you solve these challenges, know you’ll be surrounded by supportive associates with curious minds who listen to you, respect you, and recognize your hard work. **What You Will Do** **1\. Mobile Architecture \& Technical Strategy** * Define and execute mobile technology strategy aligned with retail business objectives and senior leadership priorities. * Own end\-to\-end solution architecture across mobile and backend systems, balancing stability, scalability, security, and cost. * Simplify complex technical challenges into scalable solutions that evolve with business needs. **2\. Mobile Engineering \& Development** * Provide technical leadership across Android, iOS, and cross\-platform mobile development. * Architect shared business logic using Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and dynamic experiences using Server\-Driven UI (SDUI). * Drive native development using Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose) and iOS (Swift, UIKit, SwiftUI). **3\. Backend Integration \& Quality** * Integrate mobile applications with Spring Boot, Java 21, REST APIs, microservices, and core services including SearchNav, ProductGateway, and TypeAhead. * Drive high\-quality design, automated unit and integration testing using JUnit 5, XCTest, MockK, Espresso, and XCUITest. * Champion modern software engineering methodologies and secure development practices, including SAST and DAST. **4\. Mobile Delivery, Performance \& Reliability** * Drive mobile delivery using Fastlane, TestFlight, Firebase App Distribution, and automated deployment pipelines. * Monitor performance using GCP Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus, and distributed tracing across mobile\-to\-backend journeys. * Lead troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution of complex production issues and critical outages. **5\. Technical Leadership \& Collaboration** * Proactively identify customer, engineering, and business challenges and drive clarity, convergence, and closure. * Partner with product owners, engineers, and stakeholders to ensure successful deployment and adoption of mobile solutions. * Evaluate technical tradeoffs and drive engineering decisions that deliver scalable, reliable, and high\-performing mobile experiences. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer information systems (CIS), or related field or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable * 10 years of experience in software development or related field * 8 years of experience in any of the following: software engineering competencies frontend technologies (UI/UX), middleware (microservices and APIs), database technologies, DevOps * 8 years of experience working on project(s) involving the implementation of solutions applying development life cycles (SDLC) **Preferred Skills/Education** * Master’s degree in computer science, CIS, or related field * Proven track record of executing a major technology renovation or modernization strategy (preferably containing SDUI, KMP, and GraphQL BFF elements). * Expert knowledge of microservices, server\-side design patterns, and high\-performance, multi\-layered JVM in\-memory caching. * Practical, hands\-on experience using GenAI APIs, LLM prompt engineering, and code\-generation tools/agents to accelerate development. **Benefits** * 401k with up to 4\.25% match * Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan (15% discount of strike price) * Tuition\-Free Education * 10\-week Maternity/Parental Leave * 10% Associate Discount For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits **About Lowe’s** Lowe’s Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company with total fiscal year 2025 sales of more than $86 billion. Lowe’s employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,750 home improvement stores, 540 branches and 120 distribution centers. Lowe’s is a core value S\&P 500 equity stock and a dividend aristocrat. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com. *Lowe’s is an equal opportunity employer and administers all personnel practices without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, gender, age, ancestry, national origin, mental or physical disability or medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other category protected under federal, state, or local law.* Pay Range: $142,400\.00 \- $270,600\.00 annually Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. For information regarding our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: We believe homeownership is one of the most powerful ways people can build long\-term wealth. Our mission at Lower is to make that path simpler, more accessible, and more connected. We’re building a one\-stop shop homeownership platform that brings together real estate, mortgage lending, technology, and local expertise. Through Lower’s direct\-to\-consumer lending business, our nationwide retail branches, and our real estate platform Movoto, we meet people wherever they are in the homeownership journey. We innovate through technology, but human expertise is what sets us apart. Our approach combines a seamless online experience with experienced people. Whether someone wants to handle most of the process online or work directly with a local loan officer or real estate agent, we’re building a platform that gives them the tools, expertise, and support to move forward with confidence. **Job Description:** Lower is building technology that powers digital mortgage, home finance, automation, and AI\-powered experiences across the homeownership journey. As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll solve complex technical problems, design scalable systems, and work closely with engineers, Product, Design, QA, and other partners to deliver reliable software that improves how people experience homeownership. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with sound technical judgment, curiosity, and a collaborative mindset. You should be comfortable working across modern technologies, learning new frameworks and languages when needed, and using AI\-assisted development tools to increase the speed and effectiveness of how you design, build, test, and maintain software. You’ll have meaningful ownership of the systems and projects you work on while contributing to the technical decisions, engineering practices, and team culture that help Lower build great software at scale. **Work Location**: Hybrid in either Columbus, OH (preferred); Austin, TX**Work Type:** Full\-time W2 employment, visa sponsorship is not available for this position at this time. **What you’ll do:*****Technical Skills**** **System design \& architecture:** Design scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems, evaluating tradeoffs across performance, complexity, cost, and long\-term maintainability. * **Full\-stack development:** Design, develop, test, and maintain reliable software across frontend, backend, APIs, services, and data layers. * **Code quality \& testing:** Build well\-tested software using unit, integration, end\-to\-end, and other appropriate testing approaches while maintaining a high bar for code quality. * **Performance optimization:** Profile, debug, troubleshoot, and optimize application and system performance. * **DevOps \& CI/CD:** Contribute to deployment pipelines, monitoring, observability, release management, and the ongoing operation of production systems. * **Security awareness:** Apply secure development practices and consider security, privacy, and compliance throughout the development lifecycle. * **Data \& APIs:** Design and consume APIs and work effectively with relational, document, or other data stores appropriate to the problem. * **Tooling, automation \& AI\-assisted development:** Use AI\-assisted development tools and automation to accelerate implementation, debugging, testing, documentation, research, and technical problem solving while applying strong engineering judgment to validate correctness, maintainability, security, and architectural fit. ***Collaboration \& Leadership**** **Stakeholder communication:** Translate business and product needs into thoughtful technical solutions, clearly communicating technical approaches, tradeoffs, risks, and dependencies. * **Mentorship:** Support other engineers through technical guidance, pairing, design discussions, and knowledge sharing. * **Code review:** Promote readability, maintainability, reliability, and scalability through thoughtful and constructive code reviews. * **Engineering influence:** Contribute to technical design discussions and engineering decisions, helping teams evaluate options and make sound technical choices. * **Cross\-functional collaboration:** Work closely with engineers, Product, Design, QA, and business partners to build solutions that meet both customer and technical needs. ***Project \& Execution**** **Project ownership:** Own meaningful features and technical projects from discovery and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. * **Risk management:** Identify technical risks, dependencies, scalability constraints, and sources of technical debt early and help determine appropriate solutions. * **Tradeoff negotiation:** Make pragmatic tradeoffs between speed, quality, complexity, cost, and long\-term maintainability and clearly communicate the reasoning behind technical decisions. * **Documentation:** Produce and maintain clear technical documentation for systems, designs, processes, and important engineering decisions. * **Continuous improvement:** Identify opportunities to improve engineering practices, developer workflows, tooling, automation, and system quality. ***Strategic Impact**** **Technical direction:** Contribute to architectural and technical decisions within your area of ownership while considering how those decisions affect adjacent systems and teams. * **Innovation:** Proactively identify new technologies, AI capabilities and skills, frameworks, tools, or approaches that can improve engineering effectiveness or create business value. * **Quality bar setting:** Advocate for engineering excellence while balancing delivery speed with reliability and maintainability. **Who you are:*** **Full\-stack expertise** with proven ability to deliver high\-quality backend and frontend solutions. * **Problem solver and innovator** with a track record of implementing new ideas and tackling complex technical challenges in design and architecture. * **Proficiency in our stack**—TypeScript, React, AWS, Next.js, Node.js, C\#/.NET, Go and Postgres—or the ability to quickly learn new languages, frameworks, and tools. * **AI\-assisted development:** Experience leveraging AI\-assisted software development tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, debugging, testing, and developer efficiency. * **Strong computer science foundations**, including algorithms, data structures, concurrency, parallelism, asynchronous programming, networking, and system design. * **Project ownership:** Demonstrated ability to independently solve complex technical problems and own meaningful features or projects through design, development, deployment, and production support. * **Excellent communication and collaboration skills**—someone who brings strong opinions held loosely, engages debate without ego, gives and receives feedback constructively, and helps foster a supportive engineering culture. We’re looking for someone people want to design alongside. * Prior experience in fintech, lending, or consumer financial products is a plus, but not required. **What You’ll Get*** Full benefits: medical, dental, vision, paid holidays, PTO, parental leave * Life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability, 401(k) * Corporate wellness program * Employee discount on home mortgage purchases and refinances *Lower provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.* *This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

Proven experience optimizing performance for large\-scale consumer applications (millions of users). * Hands\-on experience improving Core Web Vitals (LCP, FCP, CLS, INP, TTFB). * Strong experience jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: MEDvidi is an AI\-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes\-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow\-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality. We're looking for an **Engineering Manager** to join the leadership of one of our engineering tracks. This is a leadership role, not delivery management. People management is the baseline here, not the job. What we are actually hiring for is the person who sees what needs to change across the engineering organization and changes it, without being asked and without waiting for permission. Requirements: * 3\+ years managing engineers in a product company (not agency, not outsourcing). * Two or three examples of engineering or process change you started yourself, drove end to end, and measured, where the effect reached beyond your own team. * Comfortable being hands\-off: no code, no architecture ownership, no technical authority, and you won't miss it. * Experience working without a layer of team leads and architects between you and the engineers, or experience removing that layer yourself. * You have handled underperformance early and transparently, and you have grown senior\-level engineers. * Agentic AI is already part of how you work, and you have driven its adoption beyond yourself. * You make decisions without complete information, prioritize sharply, and say so when you have taken on too much. * You communicate openly: full context, your own mistakes named first, correctness over personal preference. * Decisions grounded in logic, data and multiple perspectives; "best practice" is not an argument until you explain why it applies here. * Fluent Russian. Responsibilities: * **Drive engineering\-wide initiatives.** Technical and non\-technical, beyond the boundary of your own teams. You spot what is slowing the organization down, you take it, you change it, and you can show the before and after in numbers. * **Enable engineers instead of directing them.** Our engineers own their delivery, their hiring decisions and their technical direction. Your job is to create the conditions where good ideas surface, get heard and move forward, and to remove what blocks them, not to become the layer they route through. * **Own the people baseline.** Hire, onboard, grow engineers at multiple levels. Set a clear bar for individual performance and address underperformance early, openly and fairly. This part is expected to be solid, and it is not what makes the difference in this role. * **Make AI a lever for the organization, not for yourself.** Every engineer here generates most of their code with agents. You are expected to push that further: adoption, practices, and what we can do now that we could not do a year ago. * **Partner with product managers** to ship user experiences that are intuitive, reliable and well built, while teams stay autonomous in how they execute. **﻿****This role is not for you if** * You measure your success as an EM by delivery timelines and sprint velocity. * You want to review code, own architecture, or be the technical authority. * You need a task list from leadership, or a PM/BA layer to hand you requirements. * You expect team leads, architects, or a management layer to work through. * Your background is primarily delivery management, project management, or agency work. * You don't use AI agents in your daily work and don't want to. * Your strongest impact story is about getting people to talk to each other. What we offer: * **High\-impact environment:** A chance to contribute to a product\-driven company in the medical tech space. * **Growth \& compensation:** Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package. * **Remote\-first:** Fully remote long\-term collaboration under a B2B model. * **Health \& wellness:** Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports \& wellness compensation. * **Career development:** Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply. * **Time off:** 22 paid vacation days annually, 5 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days. * **Culture:** Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events. **Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.** **﻿** *MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*

What we offer: * **High\-impact environment:** A chance to contribute to a product\-driven company in the medical tech space. * **Growth \& compensation:** Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package. * **Remote\-first:** Fully remote long\-term collaboration under a B2B model. * **Health \& wellness:** Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports \& wellness compensation. * **Career development:** Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply. * **Time off:** 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days. * **Culture:** Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events. **﻿Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.** *﻿MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. We're looking for a **Systems Engineer II** who will deliver world\-class high\-performance power systems, test systems, and motion simulators that drive product innovations across automotive, aerospace, and motorsports markets. This role sits at the intersection of systems engineering and project engineering: the person in this seat partners with a Technology \& Market Manager to take a new product concept from market opportunity to fielded system, leading the technical team through requirements, architecture, and execution along the way. Areas of Accountability:** ---------------------------------- * Partner with the Technology \& Market Manager to understand customer and market requirements for new products and translate them into clear engineering requirements. * Bring together the relevant engineering teams and subject matter experts to lead discussions on system requirements, architecture, and design trade\-offs for new product development programs. * Own the system requirements for assigned programs, and drive the allocation of those requirements down to the sub\-system level in collaboration with the engineering team. * Work with subject matter experts across disciplines (controls, electrical, mechanical, hydraulics, software) to define system architecture options and assess technical risk and feasibility. * Maintain a technical risk registry for assigned programs, and drive mitigation actions to protect schedule, cost, and performance. * Drive execution of the project end\-to\-end, coordinating across engineering, the Technology \& Market Manager, and other stakeholders to keep the program on schedule and aligned to requirements. * Support proposal development for new opportunities, including technical scope, specifications, and input to schedule and cost estimates. * Conduct or coordinate design reviews to validate that system and sub\-system designs meet requirements before proceeding to the next phase. * Determine and control system interfaces between sub\-systems to ensure intended operation and interoperability. * Guide the team through the validation process, confirming that system elements deliver the function intended before release or delivery to the customer. * Build and maintain strong cross\-functional communication among engineering, project management, and commercial teams throughout the product life cycle. **Best in Class Benefits:** --------------------------- * Affordable medical, dental, and vision insurance: http://myitwhr.com/ * HSA/FSA with a jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: ***About Manifest*** -------------------- Manifest OS is an AI\-native company on a mission to replace the billable hour and make legal services more accessible for American businesses and consumers. We power the next generation of AI\-native law firms with one unified global brand, a proprietary technology platform, and a centralized back office — enabling lawyers to eliminate the administrative burden and focus on delivering exceptional outcomes for their clients. Manifest OS has raised a $60M Series A from Menlo Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, First Round, and Quiet Capital. ***About the Role*** We're looking for a Design Engineer to help build the legal tech platform powering the next generation of AI\-native law firms. You care as much about how software feels as how it works. You'll own the development of secure client portals and enterprise\-grade systems \- from architecture to production. This opportunity is ideal for engineers who want broad scope, high ownership and move nimbly across lanes. You'll work across AI systems architecture and full\-stack engineering \- eval systems, retrieval, agent orchestration, and optimization, alongside the APIs, data models, and systems that power the core platform. This is an in\-person role \- you'll be on\-site at our NYC office 5 days a week. ***What You’ll Do*** **Design System Engineering** * Evolve the design system into scalable components and tokens that make every project fast to ship and beautiful by default, whether a person or an agent is building it. * Spot patterns that keep recurring across the platform, and promote them into tested, documented primitives that designers and engineers can compose without reinventing. * Build the guardrails that keep the product on\-system as it scales, including token linting, visual regression testing, and component documentation that AI coding tools can read and follow. **Frontend Architecture** * Translate the design system into components and tokens that make the next screen fast to ship and beautiful by default, by a person or an agent * Partner with design on what AI\-native interfaces should be in a high\-stakes domain: progressive disclosure, streaming states, and the patterns nobody's figured out yet * Define the contracts between backend and UI \- data fetching, caching, state boundaries, the choices that make the design hold up against real data * Own the screens clients and attorneys live in, where a well\-set page turns a dreaded process into one that actually feels good to use * Build loading, empty, error, partial, and permission\-restricted states as first\-class parts of every feature, so nothing ships with only the happy path. * Treat accessibility, performance, and failure recovery as acceptance criteria, not polish. A failed document upload the night before a filing deadline should tell the user exactly what happened and what to do next. **Product Engineering** * Own end\-to\-end features across our legal tech platform \- client portals, case management, and the workflows lawyers and clients depend on daily * Design production\-grade APIs, data models, and permission systems for a regulated, high\-trust domain **Agent Platform** * Eval systems, retrieval, and agent orchestration \- building the infrastructure that measures and improves how our AI agents perform * Harness engineering \- building the tooling and guardrails that let the rest of the company build securely, reliably, and self\-serve ***What We're Looking For*** **Must\-haves:** * 7\+ years building production software, with demonstrated depth in at least one area (backend systems, infra, ML/AI systems, frontend or similar) * Built or meaningfully shaped a production design system, including component APIs, tokens, theming, and documentation, that other engineers adopted and shipped with * Proven track record delivering features that produce measurable business outcomes * Comfort with relational database design and data modeling * Hands\-on experience deploying and operating services on a major cloud platform * Fluent with AI coding tools as a core part of your daily workflow * A track record of self\-teaching your way into unfamiliar systems and shipping there * First\-principles and systems thinking: you can reason about a system you didn't build, from the database up through the API to the product surface * Familiarity with our stack \- TypeScript, React, GCP, PostgreSQL **Nice\-to\-haves:** * Experience making a design system legible to AI coding tools, through machine\-readable documentation, token linting, or visual regression testing that keeps generated UI on\-system * Deeply engaged with the AI tooling ecosystem \- you follow new model releases, experiment with new tools as they land, and stay current out of genuine curiosity * Experience with eval systems, retrieval, agent orchestration OR ML in production * Background building client portals, CRMs, or case management systems * Familiarity with legal tech or other regulated industries ***This is for you if....*** You treat AI tools as core to how you architect and ship software. You have real depth in at least one area, plus the self\-teaching ability to pick up unfamiliar systems and contribute there competently. You move with speed, thrive with ownership, and prefer outcomes over process. You want to build infrastructure that makes legal services more accessible to people. ***This is not for you if....*** You do your best work with clear processes and defined guardrails already in place. You're earlier in your journey with AI\-augmented development and want more time to build that muscle first. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Network Engineer 1
jobs.description: **Network Engineer I** Marucci Sports was founded by two former MLB players and their athletic trainer who began handcrafting bats for some of the best players in the game from their garage in 2004\. Fast forward to today, that dedication to quality and understanding of players’ needs has turned Marucci into an All\-American success story, the number one bat preferred by players and The Official Bat of Major League Baseball (MLB). **Position Summary:** Marucci Sports is looking for a Network Engineer to join our team in Baton Rouge, Louisiana! You will be responsible for providing technical support, troubleshooting network issues, and assisting with network infrastructure projects. You will work closely with senior network engineers to learn and grow your skills in a fast\-paced environment. **Position Responsibilities:** * Provide first and second\-level technical support for network issues, including hardware and software problems. * Troubleshoot network connectivity issues, such as latency, packet loss, and routing problems. * Configure and maintain network devices, including routers, switches, and firewalls. * Monitor network performance and identify potential problems. * Assist with network infrastructure projects, such as network expansions and upgrades. * Document network configurations and procedures. * Stay up\-to\-date with the latest networking technologies and trends. **Specific Knowledge, Skills or Abilities Required:** * Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, and switching. * Experience with network troubleshooting tools and techniques. * Knowledge of network security concepts and best practices. **Position Qualifications:** **Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. **Experience:** * 0\-2 years of experience in network engineering or a related field. * Certifications such as CCNA or CompTIA Network\+. (Preferred) * Experience with Auvik, Ubiquiti, Fortigate, Ticketing Software, and asset tracking. (Preferred) * Knowledge of cloud networking concepts and technologies. (Preferred) **Work Environment and Physical Requirements:** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. * Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times. *Disclaimer: This list does not represent all physical demands. Descriptions are representative of those that must be met by employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the jobs’ essential functions.* Note: Marucci Sports provides equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age, physical disability, mental disability, results of genetic testing, or service in the military, or any other characteristic protected by the laws or regulations of any jurisdiction in which we operate. We base all employment decisions \-including recruitment, selection, training, compensation, benefits, discipline, promotions, transfers, layoffs, terminations and social/recreational programs \- on merit and the principles of equal employment opportunity. Marucci offers an excellent compensation package and wide\-ranging opportunities for professional development. Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending and Dependent Care Savings Accounts, Disability and Life Insurance benefit programs are available, as is a 401k plan with employer matching. Eligibility for all benefit programs is defined by the applicable plan document or employee handbook.

jobs.title: Manager Software Engineering
jobs.description: **Our Purpose** *Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.* **Title and Summary** Manager Software Engineering Overview Leads a team of software engineers delivering enterprise integration solutions across cloud\-based platforms while remaining hands\-on in Core Java development, software architecture, automation, and delivery. Provides technical leadership while actively contributing to complex engineering initiatives, including Java application development, automation strategy, test automation frameworks, and scalable solution delivery. Drives large\-scale initiatives and ensures high\-quality, secure, reliable, and automated software delivery aligned to business priorities. Shapes engineering strategy, fosters an enterprise mindset, and leads teams through complexity and change while maintaining a strong focus on execution and customer outcomes. Key Responsibilities Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing engineering team while actively contributing to technical solutions and engineering delivery Drive end\-to\-end delivery of complex integration and full\-stack engineering initiatives through hands\-on development, technical guidance, and collaboration with engineering teams Design, develop, and enhance scalable software solutions across cloud\-based platforms, including integration and automation capabilities Manage configuration and integration of cloud\-based applications across the enterprise Provide hands\-on technical leadership in architecture (microservices, APIs, scalable design) and system design decisions Design, implement, and improve automation frameworks and testing solutions to increase efficiency, reliability, and software quality Drive automation throughout the software development lifecycle, including testing strategy, execution, validation, and continuous improvement Oversee execution of projects, balancing scope, timeline, quality, and technical excellence Ensure adherence to enterprise standards including secure coding, testing, automation, and operational best practices Review and contribute to technical designs, code, configurations, and automation solutions Partner with stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions Drive quality through strong testing strategy, automation, code reviews, and performance validation Implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, automation, reliability, and engineering excellence Apply strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures and design principles, to develop scalable and maintainable solutions Shape and communicate the engineering vision and roadmap, aligning technology investments and team priorities with enterprise and customer outcomes Foster an enterprise mindset by connecting engineering initiatives and team objectives to broader business goals and customer impact Navigate ambiguity and complex technical challenges by creating clarity, aligning stakeholders, and driving informed technical and business decisions Lead organizational and technical change initiatives, driving adoption of new technologies, modern engineering practices, and continuous improvement efforts across the team Required Skills Strong software design and architecture experience (microservices, APIs, scalable systems) Strong Core Java experience Deep familiarity with test automation frameworks and modern automated testing practices Strong understanding of test strategy and design, including defining coverage, test cases, and quality metrics Strong understanding of automation architecture, including framework design, scalability, and maintainability End\-to\-end understanding of the testing lifecycle, from planning and design through execution, defect management, and release validation Exposure to AI concepts or tools, with the ability to understand and apply AI within a software testing or engineering context Deep knowledge of software development, testing (unit, functional, integration), and performance engineering Experience with secure coding practices and code quality standards Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills Ability to design systems with operability, monitoring, reliability, and maintainability in mind Strong understanding of data structures, software engineering principles, and scalable application design Leadership \& Experience Proven experience leading and mentoring software engineering teams while maintaining hands\-on technical expertise Track record delivering large, complex technical solutions in agile environments Experience contributing to software development, automation, architecture, and engineering best practices Strong cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills Ability to drive continuous improvement and engineering excellence Experience defining technical strategy and translating long\-term business objectives into scalable engineering roadmaps Proven ability to influence across organizations, build alignment among diverse stakeholders, and drive outcomes in complex environments Demonstrated success leading technical and organizational change while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). Mastercard is a merit\-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable\_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.**Corporate Security Responsibility** All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: * Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; * Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; * Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and * Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro\-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best\-in\-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on\-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on\-site fitness facilities in some locations.

jobs.title: Security Operations Analyst
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE ROLE** *"You'll be the first line of defense, turning raw alerts into real threat intelligence for a platform that keeps thousands of trucking and logistics fleets moving."* As a Security Operations Analyst on Mastery's Information Security team, you'll monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts across our enterprise and Azure\-native infrastructure. You'll work alongside our Security Operations Engineer and Team Lead to protect MasterMind, our transportation management platform, and the infrastructure it runs on from threats and attackers—following established playbooks to contain and escalate real threats, and building the pattern\-recognition instincts that come from doing this work every day. This role is ideal for a curious, detail\-oriented analyst who's already spent time in a SOC or similarly alert\-driven environment and wants to keep sharpening their craft. You don't need to walk in knowing everything — but you should already know what it feels like to work a queue under pressure. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN** **Alert Triage \& Investigation** * **Monitor and investigate:** actively work security alerts across Microsoft Sentinel and Mastery's Azure environment, distinguishing real threats from noise. * **Follow the playbook:** execute documented triage and escalation procedures, taking containment or remediation action when appropriate. * **Document clearly:** write investigation notes that are clear and defensible enough for anyone on the team, an auditor, or a customer to follow. **Threat Awareness \& Escalation** * **Recognize patterns:** apply Cyber Kill Chain and MITRE ATT\&CK concepts to identify what an alert is actually telling you. * **Escalate what matters:** know when and how to hand off to the Security Operations Engineer or Team Lead, with the context they need to act fast. **Team Contribution** * **Support detection tuning:** flag false positives, missed detections, and visibility gaps back to the team that builds and tunes the rules. * **Grow with the team:** take on stretch assignments — basic scripting, log analysis, evidence collection — that build toward more senior SecOps work. **WHAT YOU BRING** **Experience** * 2\+ years of experience in security operations, IT, or a related alert\-driven, shift\-based role — not a recent graduate, but not necessarily a career SOC veteran either. * Familiarity with SIEM platforms (Microsoft Sentinel or comparable) from hands\-on work or coursework. * Working knowledge of MITRE ATT\&CK and Cyber Kill Chain frameworks. **Skills \& Approach** * **Eager and coachable:** genuinely wants to grow technically and takes feedback well. * **Clear communicator:** can write and speak about technical findings in a way both teammates and non\-technical stakeholders can follow. * **Even\-keeled under pressure:** stays methodical when the queue is full or an alert requires immediate action. **Nice to Have** * Basic scripting exposure (Python or PowerShell). * Security\+, SC\-200, or a comparable entry\-level certification. * Exposure to Azure or another major cloud platform. * Experience with case management or ticketing tools (Jira or similar). **HOW YOU'LL KNOW YOU'RE SUCCEEDING** * **Alerts are triaged accurately and fast:** real threats are never missed, and false positives don't stand in the way of investigating what matters. * **Investigation notes stand on their own:** any teammate, auditor, or the Team Lead can pick up exactly where you left off. * **You're building toward more:** each quarter you're taking on more complex investigations and contributing real feedback to detection tuning. **ABOUT MASTERY** Most TMS platforms are tolerated. We've proven a better way — one platform built for every facet of transportation: shippers, carriers, private fleets, and brokers, all under one roof. Built to be loved. We're still the only ones who mean that. Mastery Logistics Systems exists because the transportation industry deserves better. For too long, shippers and carriers have been forced to stitch together a patchwork of outdated, inadequate systems — one for dedicated fleet, another for brokerage, another for LTL, another for intermodal — none of them talking to each other, all of them slowing things down. Mastermind TMS changes that: one platform for every mode, every function, every stakeholder. Flexibility, visibility, and control — finally in one place. The timing matters. Global supply chains are under pressure like never before, and the transportation industry is at the center of it. We're building the platform that helps this industry move faster, smarter, and more efficiently — tackling everything from AI\-powered data ingestion to intelligent automation. We are a masterful mosaic of specialists, builders, and genuinely good people. Different backgrounds, different talents, one shared obsession: creating something the industry has never had. We believe in diversity of thought, deep respect for each other, and the relentless pursuit of getting it right. We're small enough that every person makes a real impact — technically and culturally — and deliberate enough that we only add people who make the whole better. If you're passionate about humanizing a complex industry, building for scale, and touching every corner of the global economy — welcome home. Let's build a masterpiece. **BENEFITS — BECAUSE YOU SHOULD LOVE WHERE YOU WORK AND HOW YOU'RE TAKEN CARE OF** We don't do "bare minimum" here — not in the product, not in the culture, and definitely not in how we take care of our people. Mastery's benefit package is built to give you real coverage, real flexibility, and real peace of mind. ### **Medical, Dental \& Vision** Comprehensive health coverage so you can focus on the work, not the what\-ifs. ### **️ Life \& AD\&D Insurance** Company\-paid life insurance at 1× your salary, plus AD\&D and additional voluntary coverage options. * **️ Legal \& Employee Assistance** Legal assistance and employee support programs — for life's messier moments, big and small. ### **401(k) with 4% Match** We invest in the platform and in your future. Save for retirement with a competitive company match. ### **️ Flexible PTO** Manage your life and your schedule. We trust you to do great work and take the time you need to recharge. ### **❤️ Giving Back — St. Jude Children's Research Hospital** Our philanthropic partner is St. Jude Children's Research Hospital. Because doing good work and doing good in the world aren't mutually exclusive. **Robust benefits. Real flexibility. A team that has your back. That's the Mastery standard.**

jobs.title: Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE ROLE** *"You'll build the detections that catch what alerts alone would miss, and the automation that keeps a lean team ahead of the threats."* As a Security Operations Engineer on Mastery's Information Security team, you'll own detection engineering and SOAR automation for MasterMind, our Azure\-native transportation management platform. You'll design and tune the analytics rules running in Microsoft Sentinel, build automated response workflows that cut manual triage time, and close visibility gaps across our AKS, endpoint, and network telemetry as we bring new log sources online. This role is ideal for a deeply technical engineer who wants to build and ship detections and automation — not manage people or run the team's day\-to\-day. If you'd rather spend the day in KQL and automation workflows than in a status meeting, this is built for you. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN** **Detection Engineering** * **Build real detections:** design, write, and tune analytics rules and correlation logic in Microsoft Sentinel, aligned to MITRE ATT\&CK. * **Close the gaps:** identify and close visibility blind spots across our infrastructure and telemetry as new log sources come online. * **Reduce the noise:** continuously validate and refine detections to cut false positives without losing real signal. **Automation \& Response** * **Automate the busywork:** design and build SOAR playbooks and workflows that automate triage, enrichment, and response, freeing the analyst team to focus on real investigations. * **Integrate the stack:** build and maintain integrations across Sentinel, Defender, and other security tooling via APIs and scripting. **Technical Depth \& Threat Context** * **Translate intel into detections:** turn emerging threats and adversary TTPs into actionable, tuned detection logic. * **Stay hands\-on:** keep pace with evolving attacker techniques and Sentinel/SOAR platform capabilities through direct, ongoing technical work. **WHAT YOU BRING** **Experience** * 4\+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or a closely related technical security role. * Demonstrated, hands\-on experience building or substantially tuning detection rules and correlation logic in a SIEM (Sentinel strongly preferred). * Experience building SOAR playbooks or comparable security automation workflows. **Skills \& Approach** * **Deep query language fluency:** comfortable writing and debugging complex KQL (or equivalent SIEM query language) without hand\-holding. * **Scripting and API proficiency:** Python or PowerShell for automation, with experience integrating tools via REST APIs. * **Self\-directed technical focus:** prefers to own and ship technical work independently over managing people or processes. **Nice to Have** * Experience in an Azure/AKS or other Kubernetes\-based cloud environment. * Experience supporting SOC 2 or similar compliance audits from a technical evidence standpoint. * Familiarity with Sentinel Logic Apps or another SOAR automation platform. **HOW YOU'LL KNOW YOU'RE SUCCEEDING** * **Detection coverage measurably improves:** new log sources come online with real,
