jobs.title: Manager, Critical Operations
jobs.description: **Who we are:** =============== As a global leader in digital infrastructure, QTS designs, builds and operates advanced data centers that support strategic AI, cloud and digital transformation initiatives. We are driven by a mission to connect the world for good and our people make it possible. Every single day, the creativity, dedication and genuine care for our communities are what push us forward and make this a truly special place to be. The Manager, Critical Operations is responsible for the Data Center facility technical strategy, continuous improvement, and development support. This role will support the electrical, mechanical, FLS (Fire, Life, Safety), and DCIM (Data Center Infrastructure management) platforms, and building and housekeeping items from a site operations standpoint. This role will collaborate with the Engineering Manager on technical operations and daily facility needs. This role will own the strategic projects and continuous improvement site items. This leader should have experience with mechanical and electrical data center infrastructure, codes, regulations, required and applied safety standards and practices, as well as data center remote hands and customer support. This role will oversee the teams who perform preventative and corrective maintenance on critical mechanical and electrical equipment. This role will suggest, plan, and implement measures that increase the energy efficiency of the facility. This role requires on\-site work hours to support a 24X7X365 data center environment and is not eligible for remote and/or hybrid work. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES \- Other duties may be assigned. Maintain, establish, and implement facility policies, procedures and organizational structure within the boundaries established by senior management team and corporate policy while ensuring no contradiction in federal, state, and local operating regulations or laws. Develop and maintain efficient maintenance matrixed operations utilizing maintenance governance, standards utilizing in\-house staffing and vendor support to provide 100% up\-time of all mechanical, electrical, life safety, monitoring, and control systems. This includes, but is not limited to, developing, and coordinating maintenance agreements, maintenance procedures, testing procedures, inspections, reporting, and accounting practices. Development of emergency response planning, response management and reporting of incident and emergency situations for all mechanical, electrical, associated controls and plumbing systems. Develop, direct, and monitor short\-term and long\-range business plans consistent with overall profit and growth objectives of the company that establishes operations standards for cost control, waste reduction, quality, safety, and an environmentally friendly community partner. Manage and oversee the execution of building and site cleanliness and preservation operations. Development and management of an effective operating and capital budget. Oversee operations budget to ensure compliance with organizational expenditure requirements. Partner with Development, Sales, Implementation, and Solutions Engineers to deploy and maintain customer environments. Conduct Sales and Customer tours and audits. Ensure the pro\-active delivery of corporate services support, power services, COT (Critical Operations Technicians) headcount projections, planning, budgeting, capital projects, maintenance, and business continuity/disaster recovery. Help negotiate improvement project contracts as needed on leased and owned real estate. Confer with professional operations staff subject matter experts (SME’s) to find resolution to operational problems, develop and authorize operational procedures and approve all major estimates. Utilize comparative evaluations between mechanical, electrical, and controls systems performance and key performance indicators to monitor the effectiveness of operational programs through benchmarking and the utilization of best practices. Ensure facilities’ mechanical, electrical, controls, monitoring, and fire\-life safety systems compliance with all governmental regulatory operating guidelines. Obtain and keep current all necessary licenses, permits and certifications as required. Supervise, train, develop and coach employees. Works with direct reports to establish performance goals, monitors progress, and advises on ways to enhance their professional development and success. Facilitate Data Center space and cable plant design, implementation, and maintenance. Ensure teams performing equipment installs, managing tickets, communicating, completing tasks pertaining to computer hardware and/or software, and all incidents are resolved in a timely manner. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Five or more years workplace or professional equivalent experience. Five or more years people leadership experience. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Seven or more years data center environment or professional equivalent experience. Five or more years people leadership experience in a data center environment. Bachelor or Master degree in Business, Engineering, Architecture, Military Schooling, or professional equivalent experience KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES Exceptional customer service Ability to analyze the operation of various systems, determine the cause of any problems or malfunctions and take corrective action as required. Ability to manage complex situations during off management hours \- single point of contact. Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills Ability to effectively lead a team environment. The ability to acquire and apply job\-related knowledge within set guidelines and expectations. Position may involve frequent typing, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, bending, reaching and lifting. Lifting requirements may range from 10 lbs. \- 50 lbs. on a regular basis, with heavier weights done in conjunction with other individuals or lifting aids. TOTAL REWARDS This role is also eligible for a competitive beneﬁts package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; paid time off; paid volunteer days; employee assistance program; tuition assistance; parental leave; military leave assistance; QTS scholarship for dependents; wellness program, and other company beneﬁts. This role may be bonus and equity eligible.**In addition to a variety of benefit packages, QTS goes above and beyond for our employees:** * Roth and Traditional 401(k) matching contributions with immediate vesting * Every employee is bonus or commission eligible * Generous PTO, Paid Volunteer Days Plus Floating Holidays * Stock Purchase Plan (SPP) * 11 paid Holidays Annually/Holiday compensation when worked * Pet and Legal Insurance * Q\-Rest Sabbatical Program * Q\-Anniversary Service Award Program * Parental Leave * Military Benefits Package * QTS Charitable Matching Gift Program * QTS Scholarship for Employee Dependents * QTS Crisis Fund * Wellness Program * Tuition Reimbursement Program **QTS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best\-in\-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second\-largest distributor of roofing products, the second\-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com. What you will do:: **ABOUT THE ROLE** Every roof, wall, and floor starts with a takeoff: measuring a project from plans, drawings, and imagery to determine exactly what materials it needs. Across our industry, that work is still largely done by hand. QXO is building the technology\-forward leader in building products distribution, and takeoff is one of the first places we intend to change how the industry works. As a Senior Software Engineer on our new Takeoff team, you will be one of the first engineers building the systems that measure a building and forecast what it takes to build it. You will build AI\-powered products that turn an address, a set of plans, or an image into an accurate bill of materials, and take them from prototype to production across roofing, insulation, and exterior building products. The team is small by design, and the problems span computer vision, geometry, LLMs, and high\-scale estimation. You will build the way we build: AI\-native. AI agents are a core part of how you design, write, test, and ship software, and you will help shape how the team does the same. **WHAT YOU WILL DO*** **Build the measurement engine.** Design, build, and own core components of the systems that extract measurements from aerial imagery, plans, drawings, and 3D models, and turn them into accurate, explainable quantities. * **Forecast what it takes to build.** Build and tune the models that translate measurements into materials, including quantities, waste, and complementary products, and that improve as actual orders and job outcomes flow back in. * **Put AI into production.** Ship LLM, machine learning, and computer vision features to production with clear accuracy targets, evaluation harnesses, and human review where it matters. * **Build for scale.** Build services that handle high volumes of measurement and estimation requests with low latency, high reliability, and cost discipline, and expose them to web, mobile, internal tools, and partner platforms. * **Expand across lines of business.** Deliver takeoff features for roofing, insulation, siding, waterproofing, decking, and beyond, building reusable components so each new line of business ships faster than the last. * **Engineer AI\-native.** Use AI agents across the software lifecycle, from design and code to testing and operations, and contribute the tooling and patterns that make the team faster without lowering the bar. * **Work close to the customer.** Partner with product, UX, and sales engineering and with the takeoff experts who do this work today to understand the workflow and turn it into working software. * **Own what you ship.** Write design docs, review code, mentor engineers, and own the accuracy, quality, and operations of your systems in production. What you will bring:: **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS*** 5\+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production software systems, including leading the design and delivery of significant features or services. * Hands\-on experience building and shipping AI or machine learning features in production, including practical experience with LLMs. * Experience building measurement, estimation, or forecasting systems at scale, including tracking accuracy and improving it over time. * Solid foundation in distributed systems, data pipelines, and service design for high\-volume, low\-latency workloads. * An AI\-native engineering practice: daily use of AI coding agents and tools, and experience applying evaluations or guardrails to AI features. * Ability to take a loosely defined problem to a working design and explain tradeoffs to engineering and business partners in plain language. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Experience in construction technology, building products, estimating, or takeoff. * Background in computer vision, photogrammetry, or aerial and geospatial imagery. * Experience with computational geometry, CAD, or 3D modeling, and with delivering those experiences across web and mobile clients. * Experience with demand or quantity forecasting, probabilistic modeling, or time series methods. * Experience as an early engineer on a new product or team in a high\-growth environment. * Advanced degree in computer science, machine learning, or a related field. What you will earn:: * Base pay range: $138,000 \- $235,000 * Annual performance bonus * Long term incentive (equity/stock) * 401(k) with employer match * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * PTO, company holidays, and parental leave * Paid Time Off/Paid Sick Leave: Applicants can expect to accrue 15 days of paid time off during their first year (4\.62 hours for every 80 hours worked) and increased accruals after five years of service. * Paid training and certifications * Legal assistance and identity protection * Pet insurance * Employee assistance program (EAP) ***QXO is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** *We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.* To comply with Pay Transparency laws, employers must disclose an annual salary range. Actual offers depend on factors such as location, experience, skills, and market data. This position may also offer variable compensation. Please contact careers@QXO.com if you have any questions related to this job posting. Salary Range: USD $138,000\.00 \- USD $235,000\.00 /Yr. Pay Range: USD $138,000\.00 \- USD $235,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Machine Learning Engineering ( Agentic AI SW )
jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Machine Learning Engineering **General Summary:** Qualcomm AI Research is seeking an experienced software engineer to help advance state\-of\-the\-art AI technologies on edge devices. This is an opportunity to join a world\-class team developing industry\-leading Generative AI solutions, model optimization technologies, and AI runtime software that enable deployment of cutting\-edge models on edge devices with optimal performance, power efficiency, memory utilization, and computational efficiency. In this role, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team that has consistently delivered industry\-first innovations on Qualcomm AI accelerators. Recent achievements include the world's first on\-device text\-to\-image generation using Stable Diffusion, power\-optimized Vision Language Models (VLMs), and on\-device large language model deployment, including 7B\-parameter class models. You will contribute to the design, development, optimization, and deployment of next\-generation AI and agentic AI technologies that push the boundaries of on\-device intelligence. The ideal candidate will possess a strong software engineering background with experience leading complex technical initiatives, mentoring engineers, and collaborating across research, software, and hardware organizations. The role is accountable for its robust, tested, deployable skills that deliver measurable business outcomes through the engagement lifecycle. **Overall Aims:** * Design and implementation of governed AI workflows delivered against approved use cases which are defensible under client scrutiny. own build execution within the agreed architectural pattern. * Partner with the Business Analyst on requirements translation and with the Operations SME on domain understanding. * Demonstrate working skills live to client stakeholders including senior operational and technical audiences. * Coordinate with the Integration Engineer on data pipelines, upstream systems, and deployment infrastructure. * Contribute technical input to scope and value conversations; flag build feasibility, timeline realism, and platform limits early. **Craft Development** * Develop deep AiVA platform fluency; contribute back to platform tooling and to the wider AI Workflow Engineer community through structured knowledge sharing. **Continuous Improvement \& Capability** * Contribute reusable patterns, prompt templates, and evaluation frameworks to the platform capability library that compounds across engagemen nd AiVA platform governance across all skills built. **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of software engineering, applied AI or machine learning, or automation platform development experience. * Demonstrated experience building production\-quality AI applications, including prompt engineering, tool integration, and evaluation. * Familiarity with modern LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and orchestration platforms; willingness to develop deep AiVA platform fluency rapidly. * Experience working in client\-facing or client\-adjacent delivery roles preferred; comfortable presenting technical work to senior audiences. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. * Strong written and verbal communication skills; can explain technical decisions to non\-technical audiences. * Comfortable working across geographies and time zones (US, UK, EMEA clients). * Operational or process\-oriented background is highly desirable: experience working in, alongside, or embedded with an operational team with exposure to how workflows actually run, including where they break. * Process mindset: designs skills that anticipate exceptions, handoffs, and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns rather than just the happy path. Comfortable modeling a workflow as it is actually performed, including the parts that don't appear in the spec. **Personal Attributes** * Strong technical builder mindset with the discipline to ship rather than to perfect. * Comfortable operating under sustained pressure in client\-facing rooms; builds live, demonstrates live, iterates in real time. * Deep interest in AI\-enabled automation as a craft; keeps up with the platform, the model landscape, and the prompt engineering community. * Process instinct: notices where a workflow breaks in practice, not just where it's defined to break. Thinks about exception handling, human touch\-points, and handoffs as central to skill design rather than as edge cases. * Collaborates well across technical and non\-technical disciplines; comfortable translating between architecture, requirements, and domain conversations. * Resilient under change; iterates gracefully when client feedback shifts a requirement mid\-build. * Continuous learner; adapts patterns based on what works and what does not. * Quality\-first orientation; treats evaluation and guardrails as first\-class deliverables, not afterthoughts. * Comfortable working across geographies (US, UK, India) and across sectors including legal and professional services. **Additional Information** RRD's current salary range for this role is $107,000 to $171,200/ year. jobs.title: Fullstack Senior Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. **Who We Are** At Realtor.com, we are building products that empower millions of home buyers, renters, and real estate professionals. Our mission is to simplify the home buying/selling process and help more people achieve the dream of home ownership. We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join the News \& Insights team. The team builds the platform behind Realtor.com’s high\-traffic news experience, serving millions of readers and distributing content to major publishing partners. This is a backend\-heavy full\-stack role for an engineer who can own server\-side systems while contributing to frontend features. You will work across APIs, data integrations, React and Next.js product surfaces, caching, and platform reliability while partnering with Product, editorial stakeholders, and other engineers. The role will also contribute to the AI\-powered Hyperlocal content experience. Cloud delivery, CI/CD, and operational reliability are important parts of the work, but the role is not primarily a DevOps position. **What You’ll Do:** Full\-Stack Product Development * Build and expand consumer\-facing features across the frontend and backend. * Contribute to React and Next.js features, especially when work spans both sides of a product feature. * Own full\-stack work from technical design through testing, release, and production support. Backend Systems \& APIs * Design, build, and scale backend services and APIs supporting the News \& Insights platform. * Develop and maintain Node.js and TypeScript services, GraphQL schemas, persisted queries, and RESTful APIs. * Own server\-side data flows and make sound decisions around service boundaries, performance, and maintainability. Platform Performance \& Reliability * Improve caching and delivery strategies, including CDN or edge caching, object caching, and incremental rendering. * Contribute to logging, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and production reliability. * Support automated testing, CI/CD, and safe, repeatable releases in partnership with platform and infrastructure teams. Hyperlocal \& Collaboration * Contribute to the backend services, integrations, and data flows supporting the AI\-powered Hyperlocal content platform. * Work closely with Product, editorial stakeholders, and engineering partners to shape technical priorities. * Communicate technical trade\-offs clearly and contribute to design discussions, code reviews, Agile ceremonies, and roadmap planning. **What You'll Bring** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong backend foundation and meaningful frontend experience. * Experience owning full\-stack features or product areas from design through production. * Strong JavaScript or TypeScript experience; Node.js is strongly preferred. * Experience building frontend features with React, Next.js, or a comparable modern framework. * Experience designing and operating RESTful APIs, GraphQL APIs, or comparable service interfaces. * Experience with automated testing, production troubleshooting, and reliability\-focused engineering decisions. * Familiarity with cloud deployment, CI/CD, AWS, or comparable platform practices. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. **Technical Skills:** * Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frontend testing. * Backend: Node.js, GraphQL, REST APIs, service integrations, and data modeling. * Performance: CDN or edge caching, object caching, application caching, and incremental rendering. * Platform: AWS, CI/CD, containerized deployments, logging, monitoring, and incident response. * AI and content systems: Practical use of AI coding tools; experience with content, publishing, media, SEO, or localized content systems is helpful. Direct WordPress experience is not required. More important is the ability to work effectively across frontend and backend systems and contribute to a high\-traffic consumer platform. **How We Work:** We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. **How We Reward You:** Realtor.com® is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals.

jobs.title: Staff Architect, EPC
jobs.description: **About Redwood Materials** **Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co\-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium\-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end\-of\-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second\-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in\-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.** Redwood Materials is currently seeking a Staff Architect to join our Infrastructure Development team. This role is at the center of our activities focused on creating a sustainable circular economy for lithium\-ion batteries by transforming recycled materials into battery materials for new lithium\-ion battery production. In this role you will lead architectural design and code compliance for large\-scale industrial battery recycling facilities from concept through construction. You will serve as Architect of Record on designated projects, act as a primary liaison to Authorities Having Jurisdiction, and mentor a growing internal design team. **Staff Architect, EPC** **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Lead code analysis and life safety design and documentation, including occupancy classification, control areas and maximum allowable quantities for hazardous materials, egress, and fire\-resistance\-rated construction, through permit approval * Serve as a primary architectural liaison to Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs); develop and document permit exemption lists, lead Alternate Materials and Methods (AMM) requests and variances, and shepherd permitting processes with local officials * Develop architectural concepts and designs across various project types, producing detailed drawings, plans, and models using Revit and related BIM tools throughout all project phases — from concept through construction administration * Collaborate with design teams, leadership, consultants, contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders to ensure the successful integration of project objectives, particularly in scope and space optimization * Lead design coordination by working closely with design managers on project package structures, conducting field walks, and gathering stakeholder input * Scope, select, and manage external architectural consultants, including proposal review, deliverable quality, and schedule performance * Lead planning efforts by developing and updating concept plans, conceptualizing future needs, gathering feedback from key stakeholders, and ensuring alignment with company objectives * Develop process improvements, workflows, and templates to increase design productivity * Serve as Architect of Record on designated projects, stamping construction documents in Nevada and as required, in other project states * Provide construction observation and contract administration: RFI and submittal review, site observation reports, punch list, and closeout * Mentor junior architectural staff and support their path to licensure, including verification of NCARB AXP hours * Participate in project scheduling and cost estimating **Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities** * Professional degree in Architecture (B.Arch or M.Arch) from a NAAB\-accredited program, or a degree path accepted by NCARB for licensure * 10\+ years of professional architectural experience, including at least 5 years on industrial, manufacturing, or process facility projects * Licensed Architect in Nevada, or currently licensed in another U.S. jurisdiction with an active NCARB Certificate and the ability to obtain Nevada licensure within six months of start * Proficiency in 2D and 3D software, especially Revit and Bluebeam Revu; experience with Navisworks and Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma) preferred * Strong working knowledge of the IBC, IFC, and ADA, construction documentation, detailing, and various project delivery methods, with relevant experience in sectors like manufacturing, pharmaceutical, food processing, or chemical/refining strongly preferred * Experience with hazardous materials code application — H\-occupancy classification, control area design, and MAQ analysis — is a significant differentiator * Experience with design\-build, progressive design\-build, or EPC delivery on fast\-track schedules * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple large projects and teams concurrently, meeting aggressive deadlines while resolving complex design and construction challenges * Willingness to drive projects to completion through innovative solutions * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders, engineers, contractors, and regulators while navigating conflicts * Experience in construction administration, ensuring quality control, problem\-solving, and design solutions through all phases of a project * Highly organized with outstanding prioritization skills. The position is full\-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience. We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy\-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

jobs.title: Cyber Defense DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: Thank you for your interest in a career at Regions. At Regions, we believe associates deserve more than just a job. We believe in offering performance\-driven individuals a place where they can build a career \-\-\- a place to expect more opportunities. If you are focused on results, dedicated to quality, strength and integrity, and possess the drive to succeed, then we are your employer of choice. Regions is dedicated to taking appropriate steps to safeguard and protect private and personally identifiable information you submit. The information that you submit will be collected and reviewed by associates, consultants, and vendors of Regions in order to evaluate your qualifications and experience for job opportunities and will not be used for marketing purposes, sold, or shared outside of Regions unless required by law. Such information will be stored in accordance with regulatory requirements and in conjunction with Regions’ Retention Schedule for a minimum of three years. You may review, modify, or update your information by visiting and logging into the careers section of the system. **Job Description:** At Regions, the Cloud DevSecOps Engineer contributes to the advancement of cloud strategy. The primary focus of this role includes developing, communicating, and implementing robust and secure cloud continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. This role works closely with stakeholders to create fully automated pipelines which support current DevSecOps best practices. Primary Responsibilities Assists with releasing candidate CI/CD pipelines as a mechanism to communicate the states and steps necessary to determine a release candidate for each application and service Designs and develops fully autonomous CI/CD pipelines which facilitate cloud deployments which includes automation of all infrastructure, services and application build and deployment Ensures that all parts of the pipeline follow good software engineering practices to include automated tests and infrastructure tests Builds tools which reduce errors and improve our overall customer experiences Assists in troubleshooting of production issues and ensure pipeline and infrastructure produces clear documentation and metrics which enables Root Cause Analysis Develops and tests – Ansible Playbooks, Terraform Scripts, Packer Scripts and establish immutable infrastructure such that patches are an artifact of the past Works with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security (InfoSec), Software Delivery, and Quality Assurance to enable the organization to move to the cloud using complete automation Ensures compliance with risk management programs, rules and regulations, and cybersecurity practices; identifies opportunities for and supports process improvements; applies disciplined change management practices This position is exempt from timekeeping requirements under the Fair Labor Standards Act and is not eligible for overtime pay. Requirements High School Diploma or GED and six (6\) years of related post\-secondary education and/or experience in Information Security or Information Technology Preferences Two (2\) years of relevant DevSecOps experience AWS DevOps certification or Azure DevOps certification Experience in building / deploying cloud native applications – OpenShift, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Experience with interfacing with secrets management solutions like Hashicorp Vault Familiar with implementing Chaos engineering principles in the pipeline to determine weak links and suggest solutions. Familiar with testing tools used to facilitate automation and integration of the tools into CI/CD pipelines Skills and Competencies Ability to interpret and ensure compliance with applicable rules, regulations, and industry guidance Excellent knowledge of Cloud infrastructure, networking, services, and cloud architectural patterns; specifically, compute using virtual machines, managed infrastructure, containers, serverless, as well as database services, security services, and application services Proficient in python programming language Understanding of Shift Left principles and facilitation technologies Working Knowledge of Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Ansible, Terraform, Packer, Git, ServiceNow a big plus **Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications:** Administer and maintain enterprise endpoint detection and response (EDR), endpoint privilege management (EPM), and secure browser/secure access platforms to support cyber defense operations. Monitor, investigate, and respond to security events, alerts, and incidents across endpoints, user environments, and remote access technologies. Implement security policies, system configurations, and access controls to enhance endpoint protection and reduce organizational risk. Develop, automate, and maintain security workflows, integrations, and operational processes using PowerShell and Python scripting. Utilize Git\-based source control platforms to manage code, configuration baselines, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) repositories. Create and maintain Ansible playbooks and automation solutions to streamline security administration, deployments, and remediation activities. Collaborate with engineering, operations, and security teams to design, test, and improve cyber defense capabilities within a DevSecOps environment. Develop technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and security implementation guides to support ongoing operations and compliance requirements. Analyze system and security telemetry to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and opportunities for continuous improvement. Support vulnerability remediation, configuration management, and security hardening initiatives across enterprise systems and platforms. Prior SOC, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, or Cyber Defense Operations experience preferred. This position is currently offsite, preferably close to a Regions office within our retail branch footprint (click here to see our locations). Associates will work from their home primarily and may be expected to go on site for meetings or other events as needed. Regions will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position at this time. Applicants for this position must currently be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis Position Type Full time Compensation Details Pay ranges are job specific and are provided as a point\-of\-market reference for compensation decisions. Other factors which directly impact pay for individual associates include: experience, skills, knowledge, contribution, job location and, most importantly, performance in the job role. As these factors vary by individuals, pay will also vary among individual associates within the same job. The target information listed below is based on the Metropolitan Statistical Area Market Range for where the position is located and level of the position. **Job Range Target:** **Minimum:** $109,086\.45 USD **Median:** $142,750\.00 USD **Incentive Pay Plans:** This job is not incentive eligible. Benefits Information Regions offers a benefits package that is flexible, comprehensive and recognizes that "one size does not fit all" for benefits\-eligible associates. Listed below is a synopsis of the benefits offered by Regions for informational purposes, which is not intended to be a complete summary of plan terms and conditions. Paid Vacation/Sick Time 401K with Company Match Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits Disability Benefits Health Savings Account Flexible Spending Account Life Insurance Parental Leave Employee Assistance Program Associate Volunteer Program Please note, benefits and plans may be changed, amended, or terminated with respect to all or any class of associate at any time. To learn more about Regions’ benefits, please click or copy the link below to your browser. https://www.regions.com/about\-regions/welcome\-portal/benefits Location Details Riverchase Operations Center **Location:** Hoover, Alabama Equal Opportunity Employer/including Disabled/Veterans Job applications at Regions are accepted electronically through our career site for a minimum of five business days from the date of posting. Job postings for higher\-volume positions may remain active for longer than the minimum period due to business need and may be closed at any time thereafter at the discretion of the company.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced engineers to join our backend team. The team builds the infrastructure and APIs the rest of the first\-party product and third\-party development community runs on. You'll work with our lead architect on the data model and API contracts, and frontend team builds on what you ship. Our stack is intentionally boring technology and a minimal\-dependency monorepo: Go, SQLite, TypeScript/React. We'd rather have one well\-structured service than ten fragile ones. **Responsibilities** * Social graph and identity. Build the graph: users, profiles, friends and follows, guilds, roles, permissions and moderation. It has to stay correct under concurrency and abuse, and fast as the graph grows. * Financial and cosmetic economy. Take point on implementing currencies, balances, drops, crafting, cosmetics and entitlements, including reconciliation with on\-chain assets and commerce. Every transaction must be idempotent, auditable and reversible. * Social product. Chat, timelines, feeds and notifications, built as reusable backend capabilities rather than one\-off features. rather than one\-off features. * API model. Implement contract\-first, versioned APIs, and help evolve the contracts with the architect so frontends, mobile and third\-party clients can build on them. * Raise the bar. Bring hard\-won experience to design reviews, testing and code review, and mentor others on the team. **What we're looking for** * A portfolio of serious backend work you can walk us through in depth * Years of experience building and running production systems. You've been the person others go to when correctness or scale gets hard. * You've built something where correctness around value mattered: payments, ledgers, marketplaces, virtual economies, entitlements * You've built social systems: graphs, permissions, feeds, chat, moderation * Strong relational data modeling: schema design, indexing, query design, migrations on live data * You write clearly. Specs and design docs are part of the job. **Good to have** * In\-game economies or live\-ops: drop tables, sinks and faucets, exploit response * Real\-time systems (WebSockets, SSE) * Web3 identity and assets: wallet signatures, on\-chain indexing * Founding\-engineer or 0 1 experience * Systems programming (C/C\+\+/Rust/Zig) **Us:** * Independent and well\-capitalized * Engaged alpha user community * High\-autonomy teams inside a growing org * Ambitious Xanadu/Semantic Web inspired vision **Benefits:** * Seed stage equity * Learning/health/culture stipends, PTO, health insurance * Creative studio environment All roles in\-office (Irvine, California). To apply: include a portfolio of work, ideally including a system you designed and would do differently today. Compensation Range: $115K \- $220K

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer III
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY:** The Full Stack Engineer III serves as a lead technical resource and participates in all phases of the development life cycle. The Full Stack Engineer III analyzes complex business logic and technical challenges and will shape and deliver the Company’s future. The Full Stack Engineer III analyzes, configures, and tunes applications and is knowledgeable in digital technologies. The Full Stack Engineer III also creates and enforces software development standards and general best practices for web development. **PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Leads the development of the next generation of responsive web applications. * Analyzes, configures, and tunes digital applications. * Builds applications across a full stack of technologies * Designs component solutions that minimize maintenance and increase speed to market. * Leverages new technologies to develop and solve problems to achieve business outcomes. * Works cross\-functionally with various teams including Integration, QA, Operations and the business to help drive results. * Provides solutions throughout IT organization to deliver on business objectives and initiatives. * Mentor and coach junior engineers to uphold standards and best practices. * Performs other job\-related duties as assigned or apparent. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Experience with agile scrum software development methodologies. * Experience in all aspects of the software development lifecycle: design, functional and technical requirements, coding, debugging, testing, release, and operational support. * Lead team using the following technologies such as: * JavaScript, Typescript, Node.js, Java, Bootstrap or Material Design, CSS, HTML, SASS, Node **MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:** * 4 \- 7 years experience in software development, information systems, or equivalent technical environment, including experience in development of highly transactional, mission critical applications in environments/architectures for multi\-user systems. * 2 \- 4 years of experience with cloud technologies needed This role is primarily remote; however, candidates should be located within commuting distance of our Phoenix, AZ. Occasional in\-person attendance may be required for team meetings, training, or business needs. Please note, this position is not sponsorship eligible. Rewarding Compensation and Benefits **Eligible employees can elect to participate in:** * Comprehensive medical benefits coverage, dental plans and vision coverage. * Health care and dependent care spending accounts. * Short\- and long\-term disability. * Life insurance and accidental death \& dismemberment insurance. * Employee and Family Assistance Program (EAP). * Employee discount programs. * Retirement plan with a generous company match. * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). * Paid Time Off (PTO) * Benefits: https://jobs.republicservices.com/us/en/about\-us/benefits The statements used herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed by an employee in this position, and are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required by an incumbent so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the Company. **EEO STATEMENT:** Republic Services is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, relationship or association with a protected veteran (spouses or other family members), genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1\-866\-3\-AWARE\-4\. ABOUT THE COMPANY **Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE:** RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry\-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world. In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16\.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5\.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills. Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day\-to\-day opera  it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it. **Our company values guide our daily actions:** * Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities. * Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations. * Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment. * Driven: We deliver results in the right way. * Human\-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person. We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86\. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5\.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods. STRATEGY Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets. We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation. With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers. Recycling and Waste We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick\-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross\-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs. Environmental Solutions Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need. Sustainability Innovation Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth. The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle\-to\-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America. Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year). RECENT RECOGNITION * Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies * CDP Discloser * Dow Jones Best\-In\-Class Indices * Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies * Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies * Great Place to Work * Sustainability Yearbook S\&P Global

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description: **Overview** Revelia is seeking an experienced **Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** to lead the company’s technology vision, product engineering, AI capabilities, platform architecture, technical execution, and technology organization. The CTO will work closely with founders and functional leaders to ensure Revelia’s technology strategy supports product innovation, user growth, scalability, operational efficiency, and an exceptional consumer experience. This role requires a senior technology leader who combines strong technical judgment with strategic thinking and execution discipline and is comfortable operating in a fast\-moving, AI\-enabled consumer technology environment. The CTO will help define Revelia’s long\-term technical roadmap while ensuring that Engineering, AI, Product, Data, Infrastructure, Security, and related technology functions remain aligned with the company’s business and product priorities. Key ResponsibilitiesTechnology Vision \& Strategy * Define and execute Revelia’s technology vision and technical strategy in alignment with company goals and product priorities. * Translate business and product objectives into scalable technology roadmaps, architecture decisions, engineering priorities, and investment requirements. * Advise founders and senior leadership on technology opportunities, risks, tradeoffs, priorities, and strategic decisions. * Establish a scalable technical foundation that supports product innovation, customer growth, and international expansion. * Evaluate existing platforms, systems, architecture, and development practices to identify areas for improvement. * Balance speed of innovation with scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and operational efficiency. * Ensure long\-term technical decisions support both immediate product needs and future growth. Product Engineering Leadership * Lead the technical strategy and execution behind Revelia’s consumer\-facing digital products. * Partner closely with Product, Design, AI, Growth, Marketing, and Operations teams to translate product vision into technical solutions. * Guide development across mobile applications, web platforms, backend systems, APIs, subscription capabilities, payments, analytics, and third\-party integrations. * Ensure engineering teams deliver high\-quality, reliable, scalable, and maintainable products. * Establish clear technical priorities, development standards, engineering practices, and architectural principles. * Improve product development speed and delivery predictability while maintaining strong technical quality. * Support product launches, feature releases, platform improvements, and major technology initiatives. AI \& Emerging Technology Leadership * Provide technical leadership for Revelia’s AI\-powered product capabilities. * Work closely with Product and AI teams to identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully improve personalization, user experience, engagement, and operational capabilities. * Guide the development, integration, and evolution of AI\-enabled features within Revelia’s products. * Evaluate AI technologies, platforms, models, APIs, and third\-party solutions based on business value, performance, reliability, scalability, and cost. * Establish appropriate engineering and technical practices around AI integration and deployment. * Ensure AI capabilities are developed with appropriate attention to quality, reliability, performance, and user experience. * Continuously evaluate emerging technologies that may strengthen Revelia’s products or technology foundation. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Cloud
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the Data Cloud Team** ----------------------------- Rippling Data Cloud is a new suite of products that aggregates data from across your company into Rippling, connects it to worker identity, and makes it available for analysis, visualization and action. It preserves and enriches data context to enable precise and accurate answers to your most important and nuanced business questions. It's a complete data stack including data connectors, transformations, visualizations, AI\-powered analytics, and even inbound Zero\-Copy. It understands how all of that data relates to employees, managers, departments, locations, cost centers, permissions, and historical changes in your ever\-changing business. That makes it possible to ask questions that traditional BI systems struggle to answer correctly. **Data Cloud as the foundation for Rippling AI** ------------------------------------------------ Data Cloud and AI are deeply connected in Rippling. Data Cloud is the data infrastructure layer that powers Rippling AI. Here's how they relate: **Data Cloud provides the unified data that AI reasons over:** Rippling AI leverages the Employee Graph and all platform data (payroll rules, earnings types, deduction logic, permissions, etc.) as its source of truthBecause Rippling is a unified platform rather than stitched\-together acquisitions, the data is clean, consistent, and complete which makes AI answers accurate and context\-awareAI respects the same permissions model as the rest of the platform, so it only surfaces data the user is authorized to see **The Rippling AI unlocks advanced Data Cloud capabilities:** * AI Dashboards: build dashboards from scratch using natural language prompts * Transformations: full publish access * Pipelines: ingest data via managed connectors * Lineage \& Catalog: explore data lineage for reports * Advanced features: parameters, SQL queries, and the ability to incorporate third\-party data **Why this matters** Most HR/Finance systems weren't built for AI. Their data is messy and fragmented. Rippling AI is described as the first "context\-aware, senior analyst" for HR and Finance teams because it sits on top of a unified data model (Data Cloud \+ Employee Graph) that actually understands your business logic end\-to\-end. **What We Build** ----------------- The team is focused on the following core domains: * **Analytics** – Focuses on the reporting and dashboarding products that enable users to visualize and analyze data within Rippling. * **Data Access** – Owns the query engine (RQL, Rippling Query Language) that powers data retrieval across the platform. This area includes sub\-teams responsible for query execution, data ingestion, and query history. * **Data Management** – Owns the metadata and data catalog layer, including how data assets are discovered, governed, and documented. * **Ingest \& Prep** – Responsible for bringing external data into Rippling. This area includes Managed Connectors (pre\-built integrations with third\-party systems) and Transformations (data shaping and preparation). * **Insights** – A newer area within Data Cloud focused on surfacing actionable insights from data. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Work on distributed processing engines and distributed databases * Develop high\-quality software with attention to detail using tech stacks like Python, MongoDB, CDC, and Kafka * Leverage big data technologies like Aurora, Trino, Presto, Pinot, Iceberg, Flink and more. * Build custom programming languages within the Rippling Platform * Create data platforms, data lakes, and data ingestion systems that work at scale * Design, develop, code, and test software systems, improvements, products, and user\-facing experiences * Work alongside software architects and senior developers doing state\-of\-the\-art development work * Contribute to product design and implementation discussions * Find and build unique solutions to implement projects from the idea phase to production **What You'll Need** -------------------- * 6\+ years experience in backend engineering roles * Experience writing testable and performant backend code * Experience working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment * Experience mentoring less\-experienced developers * Ability to thrive in an environment that grants you a lot of autonomy to explore creative solutions **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US San Francisco Bay Area) 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Palo Alto, California **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Technology and InnovationArchitecture, Systems, and Controls **Compensation** ---------------- * $213,000 – $292,950 • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • This role has an annual bonus target of 20% The posted salary represents the lowest and highest ranges RV Tech reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position. Any posted salary range pertains only to the estimated starting pay for the role. Actual starting pay is based on a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, skillset, qualifications, specific competencies, relevant education, and location. **About Us** ============ Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software\-defined vehicles around the world. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. **Role Summary** ================ RVT vehicles for Volkswagen Group programs combine RVT zonal and platform ECUs with secondary ECUs (2nd ECUs) supplied by the VWG brands. Every RVT domain team has to integrate against those 2nd ECUs, and all of it depends on a shared network interface definition. Today that definition is largely handed to us by VWG and our domains are mainly taking in what they receive. We need to move to a world where each RVT domain owns its interfaces and changes flow incrementally rather than in large releases. You will join the SW Systems Architecture team and partner with the interface architecture leads to run the network interface program inside RVT, drive the transition from consuming VWG's definition to domain owned interfaces, roll out the frameworks the architects define for 2nd ECUs, and give domain teams and leadership one current view of where each 2nd ECU stands. The architects set the technical direction. You turn it into a plan, a cadence and a set of artifacts the organization can execute against. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Own the program plan for taking the RVT network interface to a fully defined and versioned baseline for each VWG program (Package 1, Package 2\.1, Package 2\.2 and beyond). * Map out and drive the transition plan, per domain and per program, for moving interface ownership from VWG into the RVT domains, including what has to be true at each step and where the interim dependencies on VWG remain. * Document and roll out the workflow the architects define for network interface versioning and change management inside RVT, including how incoming VWG interface changes are reviewed, how deltas reach the domains and how changes get closed out. * Run the domain review cadence for interface changes and chase open items to closure across the domain teams. * Coordinate network definition change requests from VWG, making sure impact is assessed by the right RVT owners and the outcome gets back to VWG. * Roll out the framework the architects define for what has to be captured per 2nd ECU (functional spec, network interface needs, SW and HW version plan, OTA compliance, integration prerequisites), drive the domains to fill it in, and roll up the results. * Maintain the up to date view of 2nd ECU maturity and risk per program that can be jobs.title: Lead Enterprise Application Engineer
jobs.description: Roadrunner’s enterprise applications connect the systems, teams, and third\-party platforms that power the business. As the application environment grows in scale and complexity, disciplined ownership is critical to maintaining reliability, strengthening integrations, and ensuring technology investments deliver measurable operational value. The Lead Enterprise Application Engineer owns the performance and evolution of key vendor applications across their full lifecycle. This role serves as the senior escalation point for complex application issues, leads implementations from requirements through stabilization, and aligns business needs with secure, scalable technical solutions. Success means building an application function that operates with greater visibility, stronger controls, faster issue resolution, and clear accountability. It also means improving how Roadrunner evaluates vendors, manages application roadmaps, executes technical initiatives, and develops future engineering leadership.\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **What you’ll do** ================== **1\. Own enterprise application reliability** ---------------------------------------------- * Serve as the final internal escalation point for complex third\-party application issues, driving incidents through root\-cause analysis and resolution. * Coordinate development, infrastructure, network, security, and vendor teams to resolve issues that cross systems or technical domains. * Establish and improve service\-level expectations, escalation paths, support runbooks, and operating procedures for assigned applications. * Monitor application health, recurring incidents, vendor performance, and operational risk to identify opportunities for proactive improvement. * Maintain strong access controls and support regular audits to ensure applications operate in alignment with security requirements. **2\. Lead software implementations and technical initiatives** --------------------------------------------------------------- * Lead vendor application implementations and major upgrades from requirements and solution design through configuration, integration, testing, cutover, and hypercare. * Own project scope, timelines, dependencies, resources, risks, and stakeholder communication for assigned technical initiatives. * Translate business requirements into practical technical options, including recommendations on when to configure, integrate, automate, or build. * Define clear success criteria and ensure delivered solutions meet business, operational, security, and supportability requirements. * Drive implementation decisions with urgency while maintaining appropriate technical discipline and change control. **3\. Strengthen integrations and technical architecture** ---------------------------------------------------------- * Partner with development teams to deliver reliable APIs, EDI connections, data feeds, and other system integrations. * Assess how proposed solutions fit within Roadrunner’s broader application, infrastructure, data, and security ecosystem. * Establish documentation and support standards that improve integration reliability, troubleshooting, and long\-term maintainability. * Identify technical dependencies and risks early, then coordinate the right teams to address them before they affect delivery. * Use SQL, scripting, application logs, and integration tools to investigate issues and improve operational visibility. **4\. Drive product ownership and vendor performance** ------------------------------------------------------ * Act as product owner for assigned vendor platforms, maintaining the roadmap, backlog, priorities, and release plans. * Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate demand, clarify tradeoffs, and prioritize work based on operational value and risk. * Manage day\-to\-day vendor relationships, including service performance, SLAs, release management, renewals input, and issue escalation. * Evaluate vendor solutions for functional fit, technical compatibility, security risk, total cost, and long\-term scalability. * Hold vendors accountable for commitments while maintaining productive relationships focused on business outcomes. **5\. Build a scalable application engineering function** --------------------------------------------------------- * Lead, mentor, and develop a junior application engineer through clear expectations, technical guidance, and consistent accountability. * Establish standards for documentation, knowledge management, change control, and operational execution. * Partner with subject matter experts to improve user guides, training materials, system documentation, and knowledge base content. * Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support and operational work, including responsible uses of AI\-enabled tools. * Take on broader technical and people leadership responsibilities as the application engineering function evolves. **What you bring** ================== * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering out creating operational chaos or unnecessary technical debt. * You communicate clearly, directly, and decisively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * You understand when to solve an issue independently and when to mobilize the broader organization. * You document decisions and create processes that make the team stronger after the immediate work is complete. * You hold yourself, internal partners, and vendors accountable for commitments. \&\#xa; **Compensation \& Setup** ========================= * **Compensation:** $110,000 annual base salary * **Location:** Hybrid \| Downers Grove, IL * **Benefits:** Competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), paid time off, and growth opportunities **Physical Demands and Work Environment** ========================================= The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Physical Demands** -------------------- * Sedentary physical activity performing non\-strenuous daily activities of an administrative nature. * While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to sit, walk, stand, reach and handle items, work with the fingers, and talk and hear others in conversations by phone or in person. **Work Environment** -------------------- * The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. * Regular onsite presence is required based on the team’s hybrid work schedule and business needs. * The above statements reflect the general details necessary to describe the principal functions of the position and are not intended to be all inclusive. The position and any of the requirements listed above are subject to change at any time according to the changing needs of the company. * Roadrunner is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. * We will not accept unsolicited candidates from external recruiters or recruiting agencies. Thank you! \#LI\-HybridDowners Grove, IL \&\#xa; **About Roadrunner** ==================== **Roadrunner is for ambitious, smart people who excel at execution over talking about it, and who would rather invent the next standard in freight than accept the status quo.** We are looking for the Best of the Best. Action driven leaders who want to be part of real change and help design the future of LTL in the U.S. This is a place where high performers can grow, influence outcomes, and make an impact while working directly with executives and smart people from across industries. We bring a winner mindset. We take ownership, raise the bar, and measure ourselves by results. We Run Safe. We Run Smart. We Run Together. These principles create an environment of high standards, clear ownership, and direct collaboration. We trust data over intuition, move with urgency, and hold each other accountable because winning requires it. Roadrunner exists to prove that LTL can be better than the industry has settled for. To be the best means we need to think bigger, look outside the box, and question every assumption: too many handoffs, limited visibility, and the quiet belief that “this is just how it works.” We rejected that story. We built a proprietary Smart Network™ for direct, long haul, metro to metro service that delivers fewer touches, faster transit, real time visibility, and genuine accountability. We are the most tech forward company in LTL, and we are not finished widening the gap. The foundation is already strong. Recognized as one of Built In Chicago’s Best Large Places to Work. Earning top marks for improvement, quality, and service. The real opportunity is still ahead: helping invent what comes next. If you want to be evaluated among the Best of the Best and help set the new standard in LTL, we should talk.
