jobs.title: Software Engineer - Product Platform Security
jobs.description: **About the Team \& Role** -------------------------- The Platform Security Engineering team builds the security features and frameworks that every Rubrik product runs on protecting **hundreds of petabytes of data across thousands of enterprise customers globally**, from encryption and certificate management to access control and platform hardening at scale. We're a small team with massive impact: the problem space covers the entire Rubrik portfolio, from performant core backend architecture to the AI\-powered engineering workflows we and the rest of Rubrik now build with daily. This is a strong opportunity for new grads and early\-career engineers who want real ownership on security\-critical systems. You'll help solve problems like: * How do we roll out post\-quantum cryptography across the backup data path before it's an industry requirement? * How do we let customers manage sessions and access against compromise, at enterprise scale? * How do we build an access control engine that holds up against dynamic, customer\-defined policies unique to a data management platform? * How do we secure the AI agents and agentic developer workflows that are now embedded in how Rubrik engineers ship code? You'll work alongside experienced engineers and deeply technical managers who will mentor you as you grow, on a roadmap with genuine business impact. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Security feature development** * Design and steer AI to write clean, well\-tested code in Go, Scala, or Python for scalable, secure platform services. * Collaborate with senior engineers on system design and architecture decisions. * Identify attack surfaces and build solutions to harden Rubrik products. * Triage, debug, and drive product/system issues to resolution with clear ownership. * Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as a core part of your daily engineering, while learning to treat AI\-generated code as untrusted input that gets the same security scrutiny as any other contribution. **Security code and design reviews** * Review code and design docs from other teams to flag security concerns before they ship. * Help extend our review practices to cover AI\-powered features and AI agents as they become part of Rubrik's product surface. * Contribute to secure coding guidelines and evangelize them across engineering. **Team collaboration** * Partner with Product Management, UI/UX, docs, InfoSec, and support to turn security requirements into shipped features. * Participate in planning, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. **How We Build and Secure with AI** ----------------------------------- AI isn't a side note for this team, it's part of the job on both sides: * **As builders:** you'll use AI coding assistants and agentic tools as part of your normal workflow, the same way the rest of Rubrik engineering does. * **As security engineers:** you'll help define what "secure" means for AI\-generated code, AI\-powered features, and autonomous agents acting inside Rubrik's infrastructure, an active, fast\-moving part of our roadmap. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required** * Bachelor's degree in CS, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 0\-2 years of software development experience (internships, personal projects, and bootcamps count). * Strong fundamentals in at least one language (Go, Java, Python, C\+\+, or similar) and in data structures, algorithms, and testing. * Genuine interest in security, curious about how systems break and motivated to build things that don't. * A proactive, self\-directed learning style; comfortable asking questions and diving into ambiguity. **Preferred** * Coursework, personal projects, or internships in cybersecurity, cryptography, or systems security. * Comfort with Linux/Unix, Git, and basic networking (TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS). * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). * Hands\-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic dev tools (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar). * Interest in open\-source security tooling or the broader security community. **What Makes a Great Candidate** -------------------------------- Beyond the qualifications above, the traits that predict success on this team: * **Thinks critically** \- can analyze problems and reason through potential security implications, not just implement what's asked. * **Collaborates well** \- enjoys working with others and learning from teammates across disciplines. * **Pays attention to detail** \- understands that small details matter in security. **Growth \& Mentorship** ------------------------ You'll be paired with senior engineers who invest directly in your growth. Over time, expect to build real depth in: * Applied cryptography, secure protocol design, and threat modeling. * Distributed systems, API design, and system\-level security testing. * Security code review — spotting vulnerability patterns in both human\- and AI\-written code. * Technical co -------------------- The best entry point into security engineering we know of: direct ownership on mission\-critical production systems that safeguard **Fortune 500 enterprises and critical infrastructure worldwide**, mentorship from veteran security architects, and a forward\-looking roadmap spanning post\-quantum cryptography to AI agent security that puts you at the absolute forefront of enterprise security engineering. The minimum and maximum base salaries for this role are posted below; additionally, the role is eligible for bonus potential, equity and benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the role based on U.S. location. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US Pay Range $131,400—$197,200 USD **Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation** ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. **Inclusion @ Rubrik** ---------------------- At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data. Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential. ### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:** * Our Company: We are committed to building a merit\-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here. * Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries. * Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities. **Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled** ------------------------------------------------ Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer Co-Op
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY**At **S\&C Electric Company** , a 100% employee\-owned company, we help keep the lights on for people and businesses worldwide. Our manufacturing roles build the equipment that protects the critical infrastructure of the power grid, and each of our team members lends their unique skills to this crucial mission. We empower our people by providing pathways to a long\-term career and support them in their professional growth by sustaining a culture founded on respect, strengthened by collaboration, and measured by our shared successes. The manufacturing industry is booming with opportunities to learn new things, expand your skills, and build a long\-term career. Join S\&C to make an impact on tomorrow’s energy challenges and become an employee\-owner! **Available Shift:**1st shift: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm, Monday – Friday **Full\-Time Fall 2026 Co\-Op**At S\&C, we are dedicated to providing competitive and equitable compensation for all our team members, and we are committed to transparency in our pay practices. **The estimated per hourly range for this position is $22 \- 30 per hour based on experience.****Competitive Weekly Pay Period**S\&C Electric Company is looking for an Electrical Engineer Co\-op to support the New Product Validation and Reliability team in Chicago, Illinois. This role provides hands\-on experience in planning, designing, executing, and reporting reliability tests for electrical, electronic, and electromechanical products used in power distribution and smart grid applications. The co\-op will work under the guidance of experienced engineers and mentors while contributing to Design for Reliability activities, reliability test planning, test automation, fixture design, data collection, and technical reporting. The co\-op will report to the Senior Manager – New Product Validation \& Reliability and will work primarily on\-site at S\&C’s Chicago facility. **The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to, the following:*** Assist in the development and execution of Design for Reliability plans for new product development programs. * Support reliability test planning by helping estimate sample sizes, test durations, acceleration factors, test conditions, and required test resources. * Participate in reliability activities such as environmental stressor assessment, accelerated step\-stress testing, accelerated life testing, temperature cycling, temperature\-humidity testing, vibration testing, and reliability demonstration testing. * Design, build, modify, and document test fixtures used to operate and monitor products during reliability testing. * Develop embedded or microcontroller\-based test automation to sequence tests, control fixtures, collect measurements, and improve repeatability. * Support circuit board layout, prototype wiring, sensor integration, signal conditioning, and test interface development. * Set up and operate test equipment such as thermal chambers, humidity chambers, vibration shakers, power supplies, data acquisition systems, oscilloscopes, multimeters, and automated test systems. * Collect, organize, and analyze test data to identify trends, anomalies, failure modes, and potential design weaknesses. * Document test procedures, test setups, observations, results, and conclusions in clear engineering reports. * Work closely with reliability engineers, design engineers, test architects, laboratory personnel, and cross\-functional project teams. * Follow laboratory safety practices, test procedures, calibration requirements, and documentation expectations when working around electrical and mechanical test equipment **To select this job as one of interest to you, at a minimum, you must have the following:*** In\-progress degree program from an accredited university/college program with a concentration in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline and returning to school after the work session. * Interest in reliability engineering, product validation, test engineering, embedded systems, power electronics, electromechanical systems, or automation. * Coursework or experience with circuit analysis, electronics, microcontrollers, programming, sensors, instrumentation, or data acquisition is preferred. * Familiarity with programming languages or tools such as C, C\+\+, Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, Arduino, or similar platforms is helpful. * Ability to read schematics, perform basic electrical measurements, troubleshoot test setups, and work with laboratory equipment. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document test results clearly and accurately. * Curiosity, attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to work safely in a hands\-on engineering environment. **MAJOR PHYSICAL DEMANDS*** Office\-based analysis and documentation with laboratory\-based test setup, troubleshooting, and execution. * May work near energized equipment, moving mechanical systems, environmental chambers, and vibration equipment. Ready to make an impact and become an employee\-owner? Apply now to join our inclusive and innovative team! Explore open positions. S\&C Electric is committed to equal\-opportunity employment. All employees and applicants will be considered without regard to age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. Stord is backed by top\-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures. Stord is building the operating system for the modern supply chain — a unified platform handling Order Management, Warehouse Management, Transportation, and Consumer Experience for brands doing over $10B in commerce annually. We're standing up a net\-new Software Engineer in Test (SET) function — not to take quality ownership away from engineering, but to build the automation infrastructure that enables engineering teams to execute on ownership at scale. Today, E2E coverage, regression testing, API/contract testing, and performance testing all have inconsistent or no systematic owner or methodology — engineers patch these gaps ad hoc, on top of their feature work. This role sits embedded within \[Product Group], partnering directly with engineers and EMs who remain accountable for coverage, CI gates, and test strategy. You build the frameworks and AI\-assisted tooling that make that accountability sustainable at scale. This role is for an engineer who thinks about testing as a systems\-building problem, not a checklist. You'd rather write the automation that catches a regression before a human ever sees it than manually re\-verify a happy\-path scenario on every release. If you want to build test infrastructure from the ground up, with real budget and executive sponsorship behind it, this role gives you the mandate to do exactly that. Why This Role Your work directly affects release velocity and confidence for a large\-scale, high\-growth platform. By assisting in the development of net\-new frameworks and tests, you'll directly impact the Engineering organization's long\-term ability to meet high standards in customer satisfaction. AI\-assisted test generation — turning acceptance criteria into automated scripts — is a live, unsolved problem here, not a vendor tool you're asked to babysit. You'll take a cutting edge approach to automated testing in the 21st century and be encouraged to cultivate and sharpen those skills. You work alongside a SET Lead defining cross\-org framework standards from day one, so you're shaping how quality standards and methodologies land in practice, not just inheriting a rulebook. You're closing gaps across the entire test pyramid — E2E, regression, contract testing, performance testing — that Stord's own testing charter explicitly flags as unowned today. What You'll Build Full\-Suite Test Automation * Build and maintain scripts across every layer of the test pyramid: API, integration, end\-to\-end and load tests. * Partner with PMs to convert their most critical smoke suite user flows into automated coverage * Build Playwright\-based E2E suites covering \[Product Group]'s golden\-path user journeys * Wire test suites into GitHub Actions CI, gating releases on passing coverage * Own suite health standards and outcomes — flake reduction, runtime, and reliability as coverage grows AI\-Assisted Workflow Optimization * Build and refine tooling that turns acceptance criteria and user stories into test plans and automated test scripts * Evaluate and integrate AI\-assisted test generation tools into the team's day\-to\-day workflow * Cut the manual effort required to interpret execution results, validate outcomes, triage suites, and keep coverage current as product ships features Regression \& Coverage Infrastructure * Build and maintain a regression test register mapping critical paths to automated coverage * Wire coverage reporting into a shared dashboard and keep the dashboard accurate as coverage expands Load \& Performance Testing * Build load and performance test frameworks that engineers can employ in a variety of applications * Partner with engineers to define and validate performance thresholds before release * Ensure critical services are load\- and soak\-tested ahead of peak season Experience We're Looking For Required * Test automation frameworks — You've built and maintained production E2E suites (Playwright or equivalent), not just written individual test cases. * CI/CD integration — You can wire test suites into GitHub Actions (or equivalent) and configure release gates that actually block bad merges. * Programming proficiency — JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar. You write test automation as real software: structured, reusable, maintainable. * API/contract testing — Hands\-on experience with contract test tooling (e.g. Pact) or API test tooling (e.g. Postman). * Load/performance testing — Experience with load testing tools (e.g. k6, Locust) or equivalent. * Directed AI\-assisted development — You use AI coding tools as a productivity multiplier while keeping your own technical judgment in the loop. * CLI\-native workflow — You operate primarily from the terminal and script your own tooling rather than relying on GUI test recorders. Required Soft Skills * Ownership \& Accountability — You own features end\-to\-end and take pride in what you ship. You follow through from design to production and don't drop things. * Strong Communication — You can explain technical decisions and trade\-offs to engineers, PMs, and stakeholders. You ask good questions and listen well. * Collaborative Approach — You work well with others, give constructive code review feedback, and actively seek input from teammates. * Production Mindset — You prioritize reliability and user impact. You think about failure modes, monitoring, and operational concerns as part of your design process. * Learning Agility — You're comfortable with rapidly evolving AI/ML technologies and tools. You stay current without chasing hype. Strongly Preferred * Experience building a test automation function from scratch, not just extending an existing one * Experience partnering directly with PMs on acceptance criteria and Golden Path journey definition * Familiarity with coverage tooling and using coverage data to prioritize test investment * Hands\-on exposure to AI\-assisted test generation tooling specifically, not just general\-purpose AI coding assistants Nice to Have * Experience in e\-commerce, logistics, or supply\-chain domains * Familiarity with \[Shopify / WMS\-TMS / billing systems] * Experience with security/dependency scanning tools in CI **What Success Looks Like** **30 days:** Has audited existing test coverage against \[Product Group]'s happy\-path / sad\-path scenarios, identified the top gaps, provided a test plan, and shipped at least one new automated test into CI. **90 days:** Regression test register live and passing threshold criteria is gating releases; contract/API test tooling in place for at least one major service boundary; AI\-assisted test generation piloted with at least one team. **6 months:** Load/performance test framework in active use by engineers on applicable stories; \[Product Group]'s release process clears Stord's Definition of Done quality gates without manual rework surfacing at UAT.

jobs.title: Energy & Utility Consulting Manager -- Renewables
jobs.description: Responsibilities: **This position is based on a hybrid work schedule and will require in\-office work 3 days per week.** The Sargent \& Lundy Consulting (SLC) group provides comprehensive technical, financial, and strategic advisory services for energy sector clients, including utilities, independent power producers (IPPs), project developers, lenders, investors, government agencies, and system operators. As part of our team, you will help clients navigate the energy transition from new generation and grid modernization to data center energy campus development and strategic planning. You will lead high\-impact projects, collaborate with industry\-leading technical experts, and build a career in energy and infrastructure consulting. In this role, you will help clients define and execute strategies for new and existing power projects and support clients with improving their business operations. You’ll lead multidisciplinary teams that combine consulting and engineering expertise to deliver rigorous analysis and practical recommendations. This position will require a great deal of interaction with power project developers, utilities, investors, legal advisors, and financial institutions during the execution of consulting services work for the firm. Key responsibilities may include: * Leading strategic planning consulting projects, including market, technology, and policy assessments. * Leading and contributing to project economic and cost analyses, risk assessments, and contracting strategies. * Managing technical due diligence and owner’s engineering reviews for power and energy projects, including reviewing deliverables such as reports and studies. * Providing client program and project management support, including improving governance, business processes, controls, and stakeholder alignment. * Developing conceptual plans in coordination with Sargent \& Lundy’s technical teams to meet clients’ needs. * Preparing and presenting project implementation strategies and plans to client executives and project teams. * Translating complex technical findings into clear, client\-ready deliverables, including presentations and written reports. * Leading discrete workstreams within larger client engagements. * Coordinating day‑to‑day activities of junior team members, providing clear instruction including technical approaches, and managing hours and work performed to budget and scope. * Developing staff expertise through training and mentoring. * Contributing to business development, including proposal preparation and client relationship building. The successful candidate will bring prior consulting experience, strong analytical skills, and energy\-sector knowledge to help clients navigate an evolving energy landscape. You will lead projects involving utility planning and advisory, new generation portfolio development, grid modernization, and new energy campus planning, with exposure to both technical details and executive\-level decisions. This is a full\-time, client\-facing position with extensive exposure to technical experts across the firm. Qualifications: **We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.** * Bachelor's degree in electrical, mechanical, or civil engineering (other engineering disciplines or finance/economics may be considered) with 15 or more years of experience in the power industry. * Experience and technical knowledge in multiple power generation technologies, including conventional and renewables. * Experience managing teams of engineers and/or consultants. * Prior management consulting or advisory experience with a consulting firm, advisory practice, or consulting role within an engineering firm or energy company, including direct client interaction and responsibility for analytical work products. * Demonstrated experience working with electric or gas utilities, independent power producers, project developers, grid operators, or energy investors. * Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, including comfort working with quantitative models, large data sets, and financial or economic analysis. * Proven ability to produce clear, well‑structured deliverables (Excel models, PowerPoint decks, and written reports) and to communicate complex topics to non‑technical audiences. * Experience leading client meetings, workshops, or presentations; comfort engaging directly with client stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast\-paced, project\-based consulting environment. * High level of initiative, ownership, and accountability, with a track record of delivering quality work products with limited supervision. **Valued but not required skills and experience:*** Experience in technical due diligence and owner’s engineering design reviews of power projects. * Understanding of power plant operations and performance, including key operational and financial drivers. * Understanding of electric utility business models, planning processes, and operations. * Experience with economic evaluation, cost analysis, and contract development (e.g., PPAs, EPC contracts, O\&M agreements). Technology \& Innovation: Sargent \& Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high\-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology\-assisted tools. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description. About Sargent \& Lundy: At Sargent \& Lundy, we care about the health and well\-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work\-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award\-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024\. **Health \& Wellness** **Financial Benefits** **Work\-Life Balance** * Health Plans: Medical, Dental, Vision * Life \& Accident Insurance * Disability Coverage * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Back\-Up Daycare * FSA \& HSA * 401(k) * Pre\-Tax Commuter Account * Merit Scholarship Program * Employee Discount Program * Corporate Charitable Giving Program * Tuition Assistance * First Professional Licensure Bonus * Employee Referral Bonus * Paid Annual Personal/Sick Time (PST) * Paid Vacation * Paid Holidays * Paid Parental Leave * Paid Bereavement Leave * Flexible Work Arrangements Compensation Range: $145,310\.00 \- $222,001\.00 Transparency Statement: Sargent \& Lundy discloses compensation ranges that comply with all local and state regulations. The total compensation package for eligible positions will include a base salary or an hourly rate and a comprehensive benefits package, reflecting our commitment to rewarding performance and supporting the overall well\-being of our employees. Individuals may also be eligible to participate in our yearly discretionary bonus. Equal Opportunity: Sargent \& Lundy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any protected status as defined by applicable law.

jobs.description: Responsibilities: Due to continued growth, our Grid Group is seeking an experienced Gas Insulated Substation (GIS) Lead Electrical Engineer. * This position offers you the opportunity to work in a project team environment with other engineers and designers involved in the detailed electrical design and project management of distribution and transmission substation projects. * Specifically, this position is intended to function as a Subject Matter Expert for Gas Insulated Substation projects. * Active participation in industry code and standards committees/associations like IEEE or CIGRE as well as other similar organizations. * As a Lead GIS Engineer, you will take an active role in project conceptualization, work planning, and project execution for gas insulated substation projects as well as select air insulated substation projects. * You will work on challenging assignments that include investigating, trouble\-shooting, and solving a wide variety of electrical engineering and design issues. * As a Lead Substation Gas Insulated Engineer, you will prepare specifications, reports and support project deliverables that present technical and project information in a clear and concise manner and meet client requirements and S\&L formats. jobs.title: Renewable Senior Performance Engineer
jobs.description: Responsibilities: **This is a remote/virtual position. Candidate can be based anywhere within the United States.** Sargent \& Lundy’s Consulting group is seeking a senior performance engineer with experience performing solar PV energy yield assessments on utility\-scale solar projects. Candidate will specialize in solar PV and battery energy storage performance modeling while getting the opportunity to expand their expertise across CSP, wind, geothermal, simple‑ and combined‑cycle gas, RICE, and fuel cell projects—building client\-facing experience with utilities, developers, IPPs, and data center developers on complex, high‑visibility consulting engagements. This position in Sargent \& Lundy’s Consulting group will require you to do the following:* Perform solar resource assessments considering both satellite\-based and ground\-based data * Analyze operational production and performance data and climatic data from solar projects * Lead and mentor a team of performance engineers responsible for modeling, design review, and technical optimization across the solar, wind and battery energy storage projects. * Conduct long\-term solar PV energy production assessments using PVsyst and Excel\-based post\-processing tools. * Primarily focus on utility\-scale solar assessments but support work across all scales including residential, commercial, and industrial * Predict energy production * Perform uncertainty analysis to determine probabilities of exceedance (e.g., P90, P95, P99\) * Conduct statistical uncertainty analyses, clipping adjusted degradation analysis * Participate in energy yield assessment process improvement initiatives and process validation * Write technical due diligence reports and communicate results to clients and key stakeholders including developers and financiers * Incorporate appropriate PV modeling assumptions and inputs into simulation * Communicate with clients to answer technical questions with regard to solar resource and energy yield In addition to performing PV energy yield assessments, candidate will be expected to support S\&L’s independent engineering and technical due diligence services for project financing or asset acquisition of new solar projects. Common tasks include:* Evaluating solar equipment selections / technologies * Evaluating project execution plans from EPC contractors * Reviewing project contracts including PPA, EPC, and O\&M agreements * Reviewing project CAPEX, OPEX, and performance parameters in financial models Other job duties may also include:* Preparing and reviewing engineering deliverables such as reports, studies, and calculations * Knowledge of NEC, IEEE, UL, and IEC standards related to solar design and performance * Collaborating with teammates to define project execution plans * Monitoring project schedules and budgets * Supporting multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring a high quality standard is met * Interfacing with clients to understand requests and confirm successful project execution * Familiarity with inverter/load ratio strategies, bifacial gain considerations, and soiling/loss estimation * Preparing proposals for new business development opportunities * Traveling occasionally to visit project locations and client offices. Qualifications: **We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.** This position requires a Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a science discipline such as chemistry, physics, materials science, or a related field and a comprehensive understanding of solar resource assessment and energy yield prediction methodology. jobs.title: Renewable Senior Performance Engineer
jobs.description: Responsibilities: **This position is based on a hybrid work schedule and will require in\-office work 3 days per week.** Sargent \& Lundy’s Consulting group is seeking a senior performance engineer with experience performing solar PV energy yield assessments on utility\-scale solar projects. Candidate will specialize in solar PV and battery energy storage performance modeling while getting the opportunity to expand their expertise across CSP, wind, geothermal, simple‑ and combined‑cycle gas, RICE, and fuel cell projects—building client\-facing experience with utilities, developers, IPPs, and data center developers on complex, high‑visibility consulting engagements. This position in Sargent \& Lundy’s Consulting group will require you to do the following:* Perform solar resource assessments considering both satellite\-based and ground\-based data * Analyze operational production and performance data and climatic data from solar projects * Lead and mentor a team of performance engineers responsible for modeling, design review, and technical optimization across the solar, wind and battery energy storage projects. * Conduct long\-term solar PV energy production assessments using PVsyst and Excel\-based post\-processing tools. * Primarily focus on utility\-scale solar assessments but support work across all scales including residential, commercial, and industrial * Predict energy production * Perform uncertainty analysis to determine probabilities of exceedance (e.g., P90, P95, P99\) * Conduct statistical uncertainty analyses, clipping adjusted degradation analysis * Participate in energy yield assessment process improvement initiatives and process validation * Write technical due diligence reports and communicate results to clients and key stakeholders including developers and financiers * Incorporate appropriate PV modeling assumptions and inputs into simulation * Communicate with clients to answer technical questions with regard to solar resource and energy yield In addition to performing PV energy yield assessments, candidate will be expected to support S\&L’s independent engineering and technical due diligence services for project financing or asset acquisition of new solar projects. Common tasks include:* Evaluating solar equipment selections / technologies * Evaluating project execution plans from EPC contractors * Reviewing project contracts including PPA, EPC, and O\&M agreements * Reviewing project CAPEX, OPEX, and performance parameters in financial models Other job duties may also include:* Preparing and reviewing engineering deliverables such as reports, studies, and calculations * Knowledge of NEC, IEEE, UL, and IEC standards related to solar design and performance * Collaborating with teammates to define project execution plans * Monitoring project schedules and budgets * Supporting multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring a high quality standard is met * Interfacing with clients to understand requests and confirm successful project execution * Familiarity with inverter/load ratio strategies, bifacial gain considerations, and soiling/loss estimation * Preparing proposals for new business development opportunities * Traveling occasionally to visit project locations and client offices. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer P.E.
jobs.description: Schendt Engineering Corporation is seeking a senior Electrical Engineer with the ability to both design and manage projects. Duties include full project design responsibilities to include power, lighting, and fire alarm design, equipment selection, plan layout, conducting investigative field surveys of existing electrical systems, specification writing, cost estimating, coordination with other consultants, client interaction, and contract administration services. This position involves working on several projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment. Some local and state travel will be required to perform field investigations, coordinate design requirements, and to build client relations. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Architectural Engineering with an emphasis on Electrical Engineering. * P.E. license mandatory. · **United States Citizenship is required to obtain a valid DOD Identification Card in order work at US military and federal facilities.** Please note that employment is contingent upon verification of your identity and eligibility to work in the United States, as required by federal law. · **This position requires a valid driver’s license with a clean record, and the ability to obtain a state of Colorado driver’s license within 45 days of start date.** * **Background checks shall also be conducted to access state correctional facilities.** · This position requires the ability to climb ladders to access equipment platforms and carry tools weighing up to 25 pounds as part of the essential project site investigative functions. * BICSI Registered Communications Distributions Designer (RCDD) preferred but not required. * Candidate shall have a minimum of five years consulting engineer design experience in the “built environment”, i.e., educational, government, military, commercial, retail, religious, hotel, multi\-family and healthcare facilities. * Design experience in building electrical systems including but not limited to selecting and specifying low voltage (less than 600 V) distribution switchgear and panelboards, lighting systems including controls, fire alarm/life safety, and telecommunications. Medium voltage distribution design experience (\>601V) is considered a plus. * Strong working knowledge of the NEC (NFPA 70\), NFPA 72, and other industry related standards. * Strong personal work ethic and ambition to be a team player and provide guidance and mentoring to less experienced engineers. * Ability to manage multi\-discipline projects, i.e., mechanical, structural, and electrical. * Self\-motivated with the ability to develop approaches to projects independently and perform detailed execution of electrical design. * Communicates well verbally, in writing, and graphically, with other engineers, clients, and code authorities. * Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, Easy Power, SKM, MS Office, and other design related software. **About Us** We are an aggressive small consulting firm with a reputation for providing quality design services. These quality design services have allowed us to build relationships and maintain loyal repeat clients. Our clientele includes federal, military, state, and city agencies, colleges and universities, industrial, and several Fortune 500 companies. The majority of our project experience is as the prime consultant allowing us to select the best sub\-consultants to support our clients’ needs. This aspect of our services allows us to take on complex, multi\-million\-dollar projects and complete them effectively, on time, and on budget. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance License/Certification: * Professional Engineer (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Thermal System DRE
jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! #### **Position Overview** * The Thermal Systems Design Release Engineer (DRE) is responsible for the design, development, validation, and release of thermal management components and subsystems for vehicle programs. This includes cooling modules, HVAC systems, refrigerant circuits, battery thermal systems, pumps, valves, heat exchangers, lines, and related hardware. The DRE ensures that all components meet OEM performance, durability, cost, quality, manufacturing, and timing requirements from program kickoff through Job 1 and lifecycle support. #### **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: Thermal Component \& Subsystem Ownership * Serve as the engineering owner ("single point of responsibility") for assigned thermal hardware within an OEM vehicle platform. * Translate program\-level vehicle thermal targets into component specifications and technical requirements. * Maintain system compatibility with vehicle\-level architecture, controls, electrical interfaces, and packaging constraints. OEM Design \& Release Execution * Create and maintain CAD models, 2D drawings, specifications, and engineering documents in the PLM system. * Drive part number creation, BOM updates, and engineering releases through all OEM gateway milestones. * Lead design reviews with cross\-functional OEM engineering teams. Supplier and Sourcing Interface * Act as the primary technical lead for supplier interactions, communicating requirements and performance expectations. * Review and approve supplier DFMEAs, DV plans, drawings, and material selections. * Support sourcing activities with Purchasing and track tooling, PPAP, and launch readiness. Validation \& Vehicle Build Support * Develop and execute DVP\&R for thermal components. * Support prototype, mule, VFF, and production build phases at facilities. * Resolve issues identified during thermal testing, weather trips, and wind tunnel evaluations. Quality, Manufacturing, \& Launch Readiness * Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to ensure designs meet plant requirements. * Support PFMEA, control plan reviews, and PPAP documentation. * Address launch issues such as leaks, NVH, restricted flow, and supplier non\-conformances. **Location \& Travel Expectations**: * This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in **Novi, Michigan.** * This role requires 4\-5 days per week in the office, with regular in\-person meetings and events. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. #### **What you'll bring** We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or related field. * 4 years' experience in automotive thermal systems. * Strong understanding of heat transfer, fluid dynamics, and thermal system behavior. * Proficiency with OEM CAD and PLM systems. * Ability to lead component design in a complex OEM environment. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with EV thermal architectures and advanced cooling systems. * Familiarity with APQP, PPAP, DFMEA, and DVP\&R. * Knowledge of heat exchanger, pump, valve, and hose manufacturing processes. * Strong supplier management and launch experience. #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? We’re building intelligent products that bring generative AI into the physical world. As a Software Engineer, you will play a central role in developing the platforms, APIs, and systems that bring large language models and other generative technologies into real\-world applications. Our systems span the software\-hardware boundary, combining low\-latency inference pipelines, robust cloud infrastructure, and tightly integrated product experiences. You’ll work closely with engineers and research team and convert ideas to well functioning code. This role blends product engineering with systems design and offers the opportunity to shape how users interact with AI, not just behind the scenes, but directly through the products they use. **You’ll make an impact by:*** Design and build distributed services that are performant and maintainable * Own projects end\-to\-end, from design to deployment and monitoring * Collaborate with ML engineers, product managers, and infrastructure teams * Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical deep dives * Contribute to team standards and continuously improve system reliability and performance Technologies We Use * Languages: Python, Go, TypeScript * ML: PyTorch, HuggingFace, ONNX Runtime, LangChain * Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Redis, Postgres, S3, Terraform * DevOps \& Observability: GitHub Actions, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus We do not expect deep experience with every tool, but we are looking for engineers who have repeatedly solved difficult problems at scale, and who know how to make good technical decisions under uncertainty. **You will win us over by having the following qualifications:** Basic Qualifications* 3\+ years of professional software development experience * Experience building and operating backend systems or distributed services * Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Python, Go, or Java * Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design Preferred Qualifications * Experience working with machine learning pipelines or AI infrastructure * Familiarity with cloud\-native systems (e.g. Kubernetes, serverless, event\-driven architectures) * Ability to take a problem from design through to production independently * Prior experience mentoring junior engineers or leading small technical efforts **About the Team:** We are an early\-stage engineering team solving hard technical problems at the intersection of AI, systems, and real\-world interaction. We operate with high autonomy, collaborate closely across functions, and maintain high technical standards. Software Engineers at our company are expected to lead by example, model engineering excellence, and shape both what we build and how we build it. **Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:** We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. $137,210 $185,191 10%

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer II
jobs.description: **Sierra Space Careers:** ========================= At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth. Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond. Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission\-ready throughout space. We are mission\-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team. **About the Role** ================== The Cybersecurity Engineer II is a mid\-level position responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining advanced security measures to protect the organization's information systems. This role involves working with various security technologies, including encryption, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), and multi\-factor authentication. They will have a solid understanding of computer networking concepts, protocols, and network security methodologies, as well as an understanding of cybersecurity and privacy principles, secure software development and cyber supply chain threat monitoring. The Cybersecurity Engineer II will work closely with senior engineers and cross\-functional teams to ensure the security and integrity of the organization's information systems. This position offers the opportunity to work on complex security projects, stay updated with the latest industry trends, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the organization's security posture. In this role, you will design, implement, and maintain advanced security measures, including firewalls, encryption, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), and multi\-factor authentication. You will assist in the configuration, deployment, and management of security tools and technologies, while implementing and managing network security measures to protect data, systems, and networks. Conducting vulnerability assessments and penetration testing to identify and mitigate security risks will be a key responsibility, along with developing and maintaining security policies, procedures, and documentation. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate security best practices into system designs and deployments, monitor and respond to security incidents and alerts, and provide technical support and troubleshooting. Staying updated with the latest industry trends, emerging threats, and regulatory requirements will be essential, as will participating in security audits and assessments to ensure compliance with cybersecurity frameworks. Additionally, you will apply secure software development practices to enhance application security, monitor and address cyber supply chain threats to protect the integrity of the organization's supply chain, and provide input on cybersecurity requirements for new projects and technologies.**About You** ============= Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space\-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission. (Cisco Certified Network Professional), or SANS level 200 courses. * Knowledge of secure software development. * Knowledge of cyber supply chain threat monitoring. **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Certifications: CySA\+, GSEC, CCSP, CISA, CISM, CISSP. * Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) tools. * Familiarity with cloud security platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Knowledge of network security protocols and practices. * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Excellent communication and teamwork skills. * Familiarity with the system development lifecycle. * Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash for automation of security tasks. * Experience with endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions. * Understanding of regulatory compliance requirements such as GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI\-DSS. * Experience with identity and access management (IAM) solutions. * Knowledge of threat intelligence platforms and their integration into security operations. * Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and tools. * Experience with incident response and digital forensics. * Understanding of zero trust architecture principles. **Compensation****:** --------------------- Pay Range: $96,402\.00 \- $132,552\.00 Your actual base compensation will be determined on a case\-by\-case basis and may vary based on job\-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, internal equity and market competitiveness. **Elevate Your Career** ======================= At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations. We also offer a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, and more. Sierra Space is an industry\-leading space and defense technology company providing satellites, spacecraft, and enabling mission systems and components. We deliver mission\-proven technologies to our customers that safeguard our nation, protect space\-based assets and enable space exploration. *Application Deadline: This role will remain posted until a qualified pool of candidates is* *identified.* ***Please note: Sierra Space does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to Sierra Space team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of Sierra Space, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.*** Sierra Space Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need special assistance or a reasonable accommodation related to applying for employment with Sierra Space or at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us. ### **About Us** **About Sierra Space** ====================== Headquartered in Colorado, Sierra Space is a mission\-proven Defense Tech company delivering satellite platforms, critical subsystems, reusable spaceplanes, hypersonic technologies, propulsion systems, and infrastructure for the nation’s most critical missions. With more than three decades of heritage and a record of flight\-proven success in space, Sierra Space is trusted by U.S. National Security, Civil customers, and global allies. Our technologies safeguard our nation, sustain human exploration in space, and ensure the freedom of operations beyond Earth. Sierra Space is defining the new era of Space Defense, strengthening deterrence today and preserving freedom of action for generations to come.

We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. A key area of focus is driving Snowflake's product\-led growth (PLG) motion and developer adoption initiatives for Cortex Code, our AI\-powered development environment. We design in\-product discovery mechanisms, intelligent prompts, and contextual starter experiences that guide users to relevant workflows and deepen engagement. We balance rigorous platform engineering with fast\-paced product iteration, caring deeply about building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and observable. jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Culver City , California;** **(Hybrid)** ------------------------------------------ **REQ ID** JR114829 **About the Team** The Enterprise Intelligence Platform (EIP) builds and operates the AI platform that powers Sony Pictures Entertainment and drives AI Development Life Cycle (AI\-DLC) adoption across the studio; it allows application teams to ship faster by using AI in the build process. EIP partners with IT and with business groups to deliver production AI applications and to compress the build cycle through AI\-DLC practice. The Forward Deployed Engineer sits inside EIP and is how both the platform and the practice reach the work. **About the Role** This Principal Forward Deployed Engineer role is a newly created role, and this person will help define its future from day one. As one of the first to step into this function, this person will play a pivotal role in building the team, shaping the work that the team delivers, and establishing new ways of partnering with the business to bring AI into production. This person will be deeply embedded with teams across Sony Pictures and help pioneer the AI\-DLC that will underpin our next generation of solutions. This Principal Forward Deployed Engineer is a full\-stack senior engineer who partners with other parts of IT and with SPE business teams to ship full applications end to end. The role uses the AI Development Life Cycle (AI\-DLC), which is AI\-assisted development tooling and practice, to compress the build cycle dramatically. Each engagement runs from scoping through prototype, production hardening, and handoff to the incumbent application team that owns the application long\-term. Reusable patterns from every engagement flow back into the EIP platform so successive projects compound. This person will report directly to the SVP of Enterprise Intelligence Platform. This is a write, ship, and own role: production code, AI\-DLC practice, and platform feedback. It is not a consulting or solution\-architect role. Some of the applications you ship will include LLM inference at runtime (RAG, agents, prompt\-based interactions). Production\-LLM capability is part of the kit, but the dominant value of the role is shipping the application faster than traditional development cycles allow. **Responsibilities:** * Embed with IT and business teams on priority SPE projects and ship full applications end to end (data layer, backend services, AI integration where the application needs it, user\-facing surface), using AI\-DLC to compress the development cycle dramatically. * Lead AI\-DLC adoption in your partner teams: coach the team into team\-tier self\-sufficiency on AI\-assisted development so they continue using the practice after you roll off. * When the application requires inference at runtime, build production LLM components on the EIP platform (RAG, agentic orchestration, prompt architecture, evaluation frameworks, observability, and guardrails). * Work directly with non\-technical business stakeholders, from frontline operators and analysts through senior executives, to draw out what they actually need, shape a solution together, and translate it into a decomposed, shippable plan in real time. * Harvest reusable patterns from every engagement back into the EIP platform backlog so what you build becomes platform capability and successive engagements compound. * Hold the line with senior stakeholders when the request needs to change, and own what you ship through the handoff to the incumbent application team. **Qualifications:** * Full\-stack production engineering experience across the whole application stack: object\-oriented development proficiency, backend services, data pipelines, user\-facing application surfaces (web UIs, internal tools, integrations), cloud (AWS and / or Azure), containers, and infrastructure\-as\-code. You ship every layer, not just the AI components. * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted development tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, or equivalent) to ship production code at meaningfully faster cycle times than traditional development. Comfort generating, reviewing, and iterating on AI\-generated code at velocity, with the judgment to know what to keep and what to throw away. * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Some production experience with LLM\-based systems (RAG, agents, prompt architecture, evaluation frameworks), applicable to the subset of engagements where the application includes runtime AI. * A track record of satisfying enterprise security, governance, and data\-handling requirements when shipping software in regulated or rights\-sensitive domains. * Strong stakeholder communication. You can sit with a non\-technical business partner, draw out what they actually need beyond the surface ask, propose a solution with them, and own translating it into a decomposed, shippable plan in real time. The same skill carries from frontline operators through senior executives. * Comfort operating with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast\-moving engagements. You write, ship, and own production code; you do not hand off recommendations. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Prior Forward Deployed Engineer or embedded senior engineer experience. * Deep experience with AI\-assisted development workflows in a production setting (not just experimentation). * Experience coaching teams through methodology shifts (DevOps adoption, agile transformations, AI\-assisted development rollouts). * Prior experience in media, entertainment, or other rights\-sensitive industries. * Experience with the EIP foundation platforms (Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI APIs) or with Moveworks / Agentic Foundation. * Cloud platform certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and / or production\-AI / MLOps certifications. The anticipated base salary for this position is $195,000\-$270,000\. This role may also qualify for annual incentive and/or comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including without limitation, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and if applicable, the location of the position. Sony Pictures Entertainment is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or other protected characteristics. SPE will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable law. To request an accommodation for purposes of participating in the hiring process, you may contact us at SPE\_Accommodation\_Assistance@spe.sony.com.

jobs.title: District Integration & Support Engineer (Systems Engineer I) - 61161120
jobs.description: **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ ***The mission of the South Carolina Department of Education (SCDE) is to serve students, support teachers, empower parents, and engage the community so that every student graduates prepared to reach their full potential.*** **Job Purpose:** The South Carolina Department of Education is seeking a District Integration \& Support Engineer to serve as a hands\-on, technically skilled member of the team. This role blends the capabilities of a forward\-deployed engineer such as building integrations, writing automation and integration code to automate repetitive work, and solving complex data and systems problems, with the responsiveness of a front\-line support engineer who answers calls and tickets, walks districts through resolution steps, and delivers training where it is needed. You will work across pre\-K\-12 student information systems, educational technology platforms, and data\-exchange processes (including Ed\-Fi and rostering), diagnosing issues that span district data entry, system configuration, application dependencies, vendor systems, and integrated applications. You will write and maintain automation and integration code, troubleshoot and resolve operational issues, and turn recurring, manual support tasks into reliable, repeatable processes. Equally important, you will engage directly with district staff and vendors clearly, patiently, and professionally as the technical face of the team. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between the terminal and the phone: writing SQL and Python one hour, leading a district troubleshooting call the next, and building a training walkthrough the same afternoon. You bring genuine technical depth, a service orientation, and the initiative to improve the systems and processes you support. This role collaborates with SCDE IT teams, as well as district technology staff and vendors, to ensure all work meets SCDE governance, security, and compliance requirements. **Responsibilities:** **Systems Integration \& Data Exchange —** Support and maintain integrations across educational technology systems, including rostering and information\-exchange processes. Assist districts with routine data processing, publishing, and synchronization, and monitor system status, processing queues, dependencies, and error\-reporting tools. **Automation \& Process Improvement —** Identify repetitive support and operational activities suitable for automation and build solutions that reduce manual effort. Write production\-quality SQL and Python, use version control (Git), and follow code and security standards. Participate in proof\-of\-concept projects involving automation, process simplification, and operational efficiency, and recommend improvements that strengthen customer support services. **System Analysis \& Development —** Independently analyze, develop, test, implement, and maintain moderately complex web, client\-server, and/or cloud\-based solutions that support district operations. Modify software and configurations, develop tooling for monitoring and reporting, and consult with IT staff on system design, performance, and feasibility. **District Support \& Ticket Response —** Serve as a technical contact for districts participating in SCDE\-supported services. Respond to calls and tickets promptly, diagnose issues, and drive them to resolution. Participate in support calls with districts, vendors, and SCDE staff, and document findings and resolutions clearly. **Troubleshooting \& Root\-Cause Analysis —** Determine whether issues originate from district data entry, system configuration, application dependencies, data\-exchange processes, vendor systems, or other integrated applications. Research data\-validation errors and operational issues, analyze dependency chains that block processing of records and transactions, and investigate missing or inaccurate student, staff, course, section, and school information across connected systems. **Training \& District Enablement —** Walk district staff through resolution steps, publishing and synchronization activities, and best practices. Develop and deliver training, walkthroughs, and documentation that help districts operate confidently and reduce repeat issues. Document escalation paths and recommended solutions for recurring problems. **Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing —** Prepare clear technical documentation, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge\-base articles. Categorize and track common data\-quality problems so the team and districts can resolve them faster over time. **Data Confidentiality \& Security —** Work with sensitive student data while maintaining confidentiality and security controls. Follow all SCDE IT policies, data\-classification standards, and regulatory requirements (FERPA, etc.). Access and responsibilities are governed by district participation and SCDE security procedures. Perform other duties as assigned. This position is located in the Office of Information Technology. **Minimum and Additional Requirements** --------------------------------------- A bachelor's degree in computer science or related field and experience in computer system development and modification in either an on\-premises, cloud\-based, or hybrid environment. Relevant experience may substitute for the bachelor's degree on a year\-for\-year basis. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- **Preferred Qualifications:** Working proficiency in SQL: writing queries, investigating data issues, and understanding relational data structures. Hands\-on scripting or development experience in Python (or a comparable language) for automation, data processing, and API integration, using version control (Git). Demonstrated troubleshooting and root\-cause\-analysis skills across multiple systems, platforms, and vendors. Familiarity with the Ed\-Fi data standard and K\-12 student information systems (PowerSchool, Infinite Campus, etc.). Experience with rostering, data validation, and information\-exchange processes between educational systems. Experience with cloud data warehousing (Snowflake preferred, or Redshift, BigQuery, Azure Synapse). Experience with data\-pipeline or workflow\-automation tools (Apache Airflow, dbt, Prefect, or equivalent). Experience building BI/visualization or self\-serve reporting solutions (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Superset, or similar). Experience with data integration or API platforms (MuleSoft, Talend, or similar) and with Salesforce. Experience delivering technical training, walkthroughs, or documentation to non\-technical stakeholders. Experience automating workflows or providing technical support in educational or government environments. Familiarity with data governance, data\-quality frameworks, and managing sensitive data in production systems. Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. Strong customer\-service orientation with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical audiences, in writing and by phone. Ability to work independently, follow established procedures, and manage multiple concurrent support requests. **Additional Comments** ----------------------- As a part of a generous compensation package, we offer comprehensive benefits that include generous paid time off, preeminent health care benefits, professional development opportunities, pension, a 401(k), and a hybrid work schedule with opportunity for remote work. The South Carolina Department of Education offers an exceptional benefits package that includes: * Health, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance for Employee, Spouse, and Children. * 15 days annual (vacation) leave per year. * 15 days sick leave per year. * 13 paid holidays. * State Retirement Plan and Deferred Compensation Programs. ONLY THOSE APPLICANTS CHOSEN FOR AN INTERVIEW WILL BE NOTIFIED BY LETTER THAT THE POSITION HAS BEEN FILLED. http://www.ed.sc.gov/jobs/human\-resources/title\-ix\-nondiscrimination/

jobs.title: Structural Engineering Internship
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ **What Does Steel Dynamics Do?** Steel Dynamics is a leading industrial metals solutions company that produces lower\-carbon, high\-quality steel products primarily from recycled scrap. Operating through a circular manufacturing model, the company manufactures a wide range of steel products including flat roll, structural, and long products for industries such as construction, automotive, energy, and manufacturing. In addition to steel production, Steel Dynamics operates metals recycling facilities, steel fabrication plants, and aluminum production operations, serving customers across North America with a focus on innovation, efficiency, and sustainability. **This is a New Millennium Position. Who is New Millennium?** A division of Steel Dynamics Inc. (SDI), New Millennium was founded in 1999 in Butler, Indiana, with one clear mission: To be a trusted collaborator for the design, engineering, and supply of structural steel joists and deck. Today, 25 years later, we’re one of the largest providers of high\-performance structural steel joists, joist girders, and deck solutions for commercial steel construction projects. **What Makes This Internship Different?** The Structural Engineering Internship at Steel Dynamics is unique because interns are not limited to observing or performing routine tasks, they are directly involved in projects that impact production, safety, and long\-term infrastructure reliability. Unlike many programs that focus solely on classroom\-style assignments, SDI interns gain hands\-on experience in both design and field work, from analyzing and drafting structural components to inspecting and reinforcing critical infrastructure in active industrial environments. This combination of office and on\-site project involvement provides students with exposure to the full lifecycle of civil engineering work in a manufacturing setting. Many interns also work alongside contractors, operators, and engineers, giving them a broader perspective of how civil engineering integrates with operations and business strategy. The result is an experience that goes beyond traditional internships by preparing students to solve real\-world challenges and contribute measurable value from day one. **Internship Location** This internship is located at the New Millennium \[Location Name] facility located in \[City Name]. This internship will take place in \[insert timing]. **Internship Benefits** * **Furnished Housing Free of Cost** + Provided for interns living more than 50 miles from their work site, including essential furnishings to ensure a comfortable stay during the internship. * **401(k) \& Company Match** + Eligibility to participate in the company 401(k) plan with a 10–50% company match that vests immediately. * **Employee Discounts** + Access to discounts on hotels, vehicles, and other goods and services through Steel Dynamics’ nationwide partner network. * **Employee Assistance Program** + Up to five free visits per issue, per year for counseling, legal advice, financial guidance, and other daily living resources. * **Intern Extravaganza** + A two\-day event at company headquarters featuring facility tours, networking with company leaders, cultural immersion, and connecting with other interns from across the country. * **Competitive Pay** + Competitive hourly wages for all internship positions, rewarding the value interns bring to the company. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **What Are My Responsibilities as a Structural Engineering Intern at Steel Dynamics?** * Apply engineering principles to support ongoing design, analysis, and construction projects ranging from community churches, schools, offices and retail buildings to athletic facilities and
