jobs.title: Senior Manager or Director, Engineering
jobs.description: **A note on level:** We're evaluating this role at both the Senior Engineering Manager and Director of Engineering level, depending on the candidate's experience and readiness. The scope and core responsibilities described below are the same either way — what differs is title, seniority expectations, and compensation, which will be discussed directly during the interview process. For someone joining as Senior Engineering Manager, there is a path to Director as they grow into the full scope of the role. **About the Role** The growth is proven. Stratus has built a platform customers depend on and a market that is accelerating. The next chapter is scale and compounding value: more customers, deeper workflows, and an AI layer that gives MEP fabrication shops capabilities they could not build on their own. You will be among the first engineering leaders to put a genuine AI agent into a fabrication workflow that a real shop floor runs on. That has not been done at scale. This role is where it gets built. And you will build it while keeping the core product shipping to a rapidly growing customer base. You will need to hold both. You will report to the CTO, peer with Directors and Senior Directors across engineering, and partner day to day with the Head of Product and GTM leadership. This role is fully remote. We meet quarterly as a leadership team and make regular visits to customer shop floors. You will know what your software looks like when it is running in a real fabrication environment. Lead product focused teams delivering against the Stratus roadmap, bringing engineering and AI capability together to ship what customers depend on. We are early in this build and you will shape how it goes. This is a lean, senior\-IC\-adjacent role: the person in this seat is expected to be the anchor — consistently available during core working hours, with occasional availability for production escalations outside business hours (realistically once a month or less, not frequent late nights.) MEP industry experience is a strong plus. ### **Success in This Role Looks Like** * Customers notice the difference: core platform improvements and AI capabilities that address real workflow problems, solutions that fabrication shops come back for and build their operations around. * AI shipped to production that sticks. Not a proof of concept. Something a shop floor runs on. * Teams that raise their delivery bar consistently and a team stronger than when you found it. * A seat earned in the architecture conversations that shape the platform because you brought engineering judgment and customer insight in equal measure. ### **What You Will Own** * Engineering delivery. Own what ships. Lead PODs that build solutions customers notice and rely on. Favor working software and live demos over status decks. Set the cadence, clear the path, hold the bar. * Customer empathy and connection. Your customers work on a fabrication shop floor. Getting close to them means product conversations, design reviews grounded in real workflows, and staying present when a production issue reaches a customer. Build genuine understanding of what they are trying to accomplish and let that shape how your teams think and build. * Product solutioning. Work alongside Product and users to translate real workflow problems into solutions that stick. The solutions you build will be used on a shop floor by someone who needs them to work every time. Bring engineering judgment to what gets built: knowing when a targeted feature solves the problem, when a deeper architectural change is what is actually needed, and when the right answer is to simplify rather than add. * Technical architecture partnership. Work with the CTO and engineering leadership on platform decisions across our Azure and MongoDB Atlas stack and the move toward agentic surfaces. Full partner in the decisions and fully accountable for how your teams deliver them. * AI era engineering culture. Every stage of the development cycle, from a design whiteboard to a production deploy, should have AI making the team faster and the output better. You build that culture and you go first. * Engineering standards. Leaves the codebase, the process, and the people in better shape than you found them: CI/CD, code review culture, observability, and incident learning treated as foundations, not afterthoughts. * Cross\-functional execution. Partner with Product, Data, and Customer Success to ship what customers depend on. Bring what you learn in the field back into how your teams build. ### **What You Bring** * AI forward and pragmatic engineering. Has led a team shipping AI\-enabled product features that customers depend on in production, or has otherwise demonstrated strong, hands\-on AI/ML depth and sound judgment about where AI adds real value. Agentic\-specific experience is a strong plus but not required. Knows what it takes to keep AI reliable in production, makes the right build versus buy call, and focuses on shipping AI customers trust rather than infrastructure for its own sake. * Technical depth. Cloud native SaaS architecture with Azure experience preferred. Comfortable in C\# or .NET. MongoDB or document database experience is a plus. "Hands\-on" here means staying close to the work — engaging in design reviews, working through technical roadblocks with engineers, and participating in PRs — not necessarily writing production code day to day. * Experience. 10 or more years in software engineering, ideally including experience building and shipping AI\-enabled products, with 5 or more in engineering leadership at a SaaS product company (for Director\-level candidates; somewhat less leadership tenure may be appropriate for candidates joining at the Senior Engineering Manager level with a path to Director). Has shipped in an environment where the customer base was growing fast enough that a bad release had real consequences. Has taken on a team, nurtured it to higher impact and done it without losing what was already working. Has hired at least one person who became exceptional and can explain exactly why. * Delivery discipline. Real planning, tracking, and follow\-through — knows how to hit dates or surface risk early, rather than discovering a miss after the fact. This is the single biggest gap we're solving for with this hire. * Customer and product orientation. Can sit in a customer conversation, find the real problem beneath the stated request, and carry that signal back to the teams. Thinks first about what outcome the customer needs, then about how to deliver it. Measures success in value shipped, not tasks completed. * Leadership experience, including strong communication skills and ability to work with a distributed team and cross functional teams. * Domain (strong plus). MEP, fabrication, or construction technology experience lets you challenge product and architecture decisions with domain intuition and build customer credibility faster. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with Autodesk or similar * Exposure to manufacturing, supply chain, or field operations software. * Hands on experience with LangGraph, MCP, or agentic orchestration frameworks. **Benefits** ------------ * Comprehensive and competitive health benefits plan * Matching 401k contributions * 20 days annual PTO * Primarily remote work with occasional annual team onsites. **E\-VERIFY STATEMENT** *Stratus participates in E\-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I\-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post\-hire only — we never use E\-Verify to pre\-screen applicants.* *E\-Verify Notice* *Right to Work Notice*

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive
jobs.description: Stratus, is the leading cloud\-based platform for MEP contractors. We’re on a mission to revolutionize the construction industry by providing innovative data driven solutions that seamlessly layer across a contractor’s entire workflow from design, to fabrication, to installation. **The Role** This is a quota\-carrying role focused on Stratus's most important relationships: the 50 largest MEP contractors in North America. These organizations rarely buy as one company. They are parent companies with multiple operating companies underneath, each with its own leadership, processes, and buying authority. Your job is to understand how each one actually makes decisions, win the operating companies, and turn that footprint into enterprise\-wide licensing agreements worth seven figures. You'll own a focused book of named strategic accounts and be backed by Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Product, and direct access to our executive team. We're still building our strategic accounts motion. If shaping how Stratus partners with the biggest names in MEP excites you, you'll thrive here. If you need a fully built\-out program on day one, this probably isn't your seat. **What You'll Do** * Own a named book of strategic accounts within the top 50 MEP contractors and consistently exceed a \~$2M annual quota * Map multi\-layered account structures (parent companies, operating companies, regional divisions, and acquired businesses) and understand where decisions are made centrally versus locally * Land and expand across operating companies, then convert those deployments into enterprise\-wide licensing agreements negotiated at the parent level * Lead seven\-figure, multi\-year deals from strategy through signature, including pricing structure, ramp schedules, rollout plans, and commercial terms * Build executive relationships at both the parent and operating company level: CEOs, CFOs, COOs, and CIOs at the top, with operating company Presidents, VPs of Operations, and VDC/BIM and fabrication leaders as champions * Navigate enterprise procurement, legal, IT, and security reviews, and manage MSA and enterprise agreement negotiations alongside finance and legal partners * Build and maintain strategic account plans covering relationship maps, whitespace by operating company, competitive position, and a multi\-year expansion strategy * Quantify value at enterprise scale, from standardizing workflows and data across operating companies to giving parent company leadership visibility into fabrication and field performance * Orchestrate the full Stratus team, including Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Product, and executive sponsors, to deliver a coordinated experience for every account * Forecast accurately on longer, multi\-quarter sales cycles and keep Salesforce clean, current, and forecast\-ready * Bring the voice of our largest customers back to Product and Leadership; what you learn will directly shape our roadmap **What You'll Bring** * 7\+ years of quota\-carrying B2B sales experience, including 2\+ years managing strategic, named, or major accounts * A documented track record of closing seven\-figure deals * Proven experience converting existing customers or business\-unit deployments into large, organization\-wide enterprise licensing agreements * Experience navigating complex, multi\-layered organizations: holding companies, parent and operating company structures, PE\-backed platforms, or acquisition\-driven roll\-ups * Experience selling operational, multi\-stakeholder software (think construction technology, ERP, project management, manufacturing, or industrial) where you built ROI cases and ran a real value\-selling motion * Executive presence and credibility in the boardroom, with the ability to align C\-suite stakeholders who don't always agree * Strong commercial and negotiation skills, including multi\-year agreements, enterprise pricing structures, and working through redlines with procurement and legal * The patience to run long, complex cycles combined with the urgency to keep them moving * Fluency in MEDDPICC or a similar qualification methodology * A data\-driven approach and enthusiasm for using AI to work smarter (it's core to how we operate and what we sell) * Proficiency in Salesforce (or similar CRM) and a knack for picking up new tools quickly * Open to \~40% travel, including on\-site executive meetings and operating company visits **Bonus Points** * Existing relationships within the top MEP, mechanical, electrical, or plumbing contractors in North America * Experience selling into construction, contractors, or the built environment * Experience selling into PE\-backed platforms or companies growing through acquisition * Prior strategic or enterprise sales success at a growth\-stage SaaS company **Why Stratus** At Stratus, you'll own the relationships that define our company's future. You'll work directly with our executive team, help build our strategic accounts program from the ground up, and see your customers' feedback show up in the product. This fully remote opportunity lets you balance work and life while making a tangible impact on the largest contractors in the industry. As a Strategic Account Executive, you'll play a crucial role in helping drive our mission to transform the construction industry. Grow with us as we make an impact! **E\-Verify Statement** Stratus participates in E\-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I\-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post\-hire only \- we never use E\-Verify to pre\-screen applicants. *E\-Verify Notice* *Right to Work Notice*

jobs.title: Automation Specialist II
jobs.description: **Job Summary** The Automation Specialist II is responsible for optimizing an organization’s operational systems by reviewing, testing, repairing, and maintaining them, with a focus on computer networks, manufacturing processes, and related mechanisms. This role involves designing automation and control solutions for new equipment and upgrading existing systems, while managing small projects or multiple tasks within their area of expertise. **Duties** * Collaborate with Distributed Control Systems (DCS), various Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) systems, and industrial process instrumentation to support automated operations. * Planning and scheduling tasks to ensure timely execution. * Field wiring corrections and testing on various instrumentation. * Conducting basic calibration of instrumentation using appropriate tools and best practices. * Monitor, manage, and communicate with production teams regarding automation equipment issues and concerns. * Collaborate with the maintenance team to ensure timely completion of preventive maintenance tasks on automation equipment and perform preventive maintenance as needed. * Coordinate with operations teams to schedule and implement automation solutions effectively. * Provide technical guidance and support to Level 1 engineers and other team members. * Develop and maintain project timelines to meet organizational goals. * Validate automation software performance against established guidelines and standards. * Read and interpret electrical schematic drawings to determine automation component interfaces. * Demonstrate expertise in programming and configuration of DCS platforms (DeltaV preferred). * Focus on configuration, programming, installation, maintenance, testing, startup, upgrading, and troubleshooting of automation systems. * Design, develop, test, and deploy new PLC programs and user interfaces ensuring they meet operational and safety standards. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team. * Conduct and support rigorous testing and validation of new and modified control systems. * Analyze and optimize existing control systems to improve performance, efficiency, and reliability. **Qualifications** **Education** * Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. **Experience** * 4\-7 years of experience in automation systems design, programming, and maintenance, preferably in the pharmaceutical, medical devices, or manufacturing industries. * Knowledge of instrumentation, control wiring/panels, fieldbus communications and basic Ethernet networking. * Must be able to interpret/follow electrical drawings. * Proper and safe use of electrical hand tools. **Skills** * Technical knowledge with proficient computer skills. * Fluent in both English and Spanish. * Proficient in writing in English with a focus on formal and technical contexts. * Must have strong analysis and problem\-solving skills. * Knowledge of PLC, VB, SQL, SCADA, VFD, Operator interfaces, and Man\-Machine interfaces. * Full mastery of PLC programming is not required, but the candidate should demonstrate growth and acceleration of learning in this skill. * Knowledge in reporting tools and data collection systems like databases and historians. * Knowledge of CGMPs, FDA regulations, and regulatory policies related to computer systems validation. * Computer system design knowledge. * Highly motivated with strong communication skills and the ability to work independently. * Ability to adhere to quality standards in a professional and safe manner. * Ability to follow instructions and prioritize work activities effectively. * Attention to detail with excellent communication and collaboration skills. **Othe** **r requirements** * Travel Requirements: Candidates must be willing and able to travel to the United States as needed. * Sitting: Frequently * Standing/ Walking: Frequently * Lift/ Carry over: Able to manually lift/carry weights in accordance with OSHA (Occupational Safety \& Health Agency) regulations. * Repetitive motions: Typing on a keyboard – Frequently. * Must be willing and able to enter confined spaces in compliance with established safety standards. * Work Schedule: Require flexible time, including the capacity to work overtime, different schedules, and holidays or weekends as needed. **Equal Opportunity Statement** Synerlution is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, or veteran status. We feel that having a diverse staff increases our capacity to drive synergy through solutions for our clients. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which all employees feel comfortable sharing their unique ideas and talents. Synerlution strictly condemns all forms of discrimination and harassment and provides a respectful, supportive, and bias\-free workplace. We value all forms of diversity and are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for employees to advance and grow professionally. \*\*If you are passionate about automation technology and eager to contribute to innovative solutions in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.\*\* Job Type: Full\-time Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Director, Technical Sales, 3DIC Solutions
jobs.description: Sunnyvale, California, United States **Category** Sales **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 19032 **Base Salary Range** $186000\-$280000 **Date posted** 10/05/2026 **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. **You Are** You have spent years in the EDA world, likely starting as an Applications Engineer or Product Specialist, and you have learned that the best technical wins come from understanding the customer's business problem before you ever open the demo. You know how to sit across from a VP of Engineering at a major semiconductor company and map their 3DIC roadmap to a multi\-quarter technical campaign that actually closes. You do not just hand off to the AE team and disappear. You stay in the room, manage the strategy, connect the dots between what the customer needs and what your R\&D team is building, and drive alignment when things get messy. You have seen enough long sales cycles to know that relationships matter more than slide decks. Building trust with a design director in Taiwan or a packaging architect in California is how you get the call when budgets open up or when a competitor stumbles. You are comfortable traveling to customer sites, sitting through technical deep dives, and translating what you hear into a plan that your internal teams can execute against. At Synopsys, you will work on 3DIC solutions that are shaping the future of semiconductor design, and the accounts you manage will be the ones driving that future forward. **What You'll Be Doing** * Lead technical sales campaigns for 3DIC solutions across strategic semiconductor accounts, managing complex, multi\-quarter engagements from discovery through close * Drive customer discovery sessions to uncover technical requirements, business drivers, and solution fit, then translate those into actionable engagement strategies * Serve as the primary business and sales focal point for 3DIC opportunities, coordinating across sales teams, Applications Engineers, Product Management, and R\&D to keep campaigns on track * Build and maintain executive and technical relationships across customer organizations, from engineering leads to business stakeholders, ensuring alignment at every level * Work directly with Applications Engineering teams to align proof\-of\-concept activities, evaluations, and deployments with customer success criteria and timelines * Track campaign progress, opportunity health, and forecasting accuracy using Salesforce and internal sales processes, providing regular executive updates on key engagements * Represent Synopsys at customer meetings, industry conferences, technical workshops, and executive briefings, positioning 3DIC solutions in the context of customer roadmaps **The Impact You Will Have** * Expand 3DIC solution adoption across strategic accounts, directly driving revenue growth in one of the fastest\-moving segments of semiconductor design * Shape customer roadmaps by identifying opportunities early and aligning Synopsys capabilities with their long\-term technical and business objectives * Accelerate deal cycles by managing complex technical campaigns with clarity, keeping internal and external stakeholders aligned on next steps and success criteria * Influence product direction by feeding market requirements, competitive insights, and customer feedback directly to Product Management and R\&D teams * Build lasting customer relationships that create pipeline visibility and repeat business across multiple product lines and design teams * Strengthen cross\-functional collaboration between Sales, Applications Engineering, Product Management, and R\&D, ensuring technical campaigns are executed with precision * Position Synopsys as the trusted partner for 3DIC innovation, helping customers solve advanced packaging challenges that define the next generation of semiconductor products **What You'll Need** * 5\+ years of experience in EDA sales, Applications Engineering, or Product Specialist roles with a strong technical foundation in semiconductor design or advanced packaging technologies * Direct experience in the 3D IC market segment, including familiarity with chiplet architectures, advantage packaging (interposer) and substrate design, and System Technology Co\-Optimization (STCO). * Proven ability to manage long\-term enterprise sales engagements, including multi\-quarter technical campaigns with multiple stakeholders and complex decision cycles * Strong relationship\-building skills with a track record of developing executive and technical relationships across customer organizations * Ability to collaborate internally with Product Management and R\&D teams to align customer requirements with product capabilities and roadmaps * Willingness to travel up to 30% to customer sites, industry events, and internal meetings * Experience using CRM systems like Salesforce to track opportunities, forecast accurately, and provide visibility into campaign progress **Who You Are** * You can walk into a technical deep dive with a customer's design team, absorb what matters, and walk out with a clear campaign plan that your AE team can execute * You know how to manage a sales cycle that spans six months or more without losing momentum, keeping internal teams aligned and customers engaged at every milestone * You push back when a technical proposal does not match the customer's actual problem, and you work with internal teams to find a better answer or set realistic expectations * You are comfortable navigating complex organizational dynamics, both inside Synopsys and at customer sites, to drive alignment and move deals forward * You treat customer feedback as product intelligence, not just sales noise, and you know how to package it in a way that R\&D and Product Management can act on * You do not wait for perfect information to move, you ask the right questions, align stakeholders, and create clarity where there was ambiguity **The Team You'll Be Part Of** Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus, equity, and other discretionary bonuses. Synopsys offers comprehensive health, wellness, and financial benefits as part of a competitive total rewards package. The actual compensation offered will be based on a number of job\-related factors, including location, skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details on the total rewards package upon request. The base salary range for this role is across the U.S.

jobs.title: Research & Development Engineer - Robotics, Machine Vision & Precision Automation (PhD)
jobs.description: If your PhD sits at the intersection of robotics, perception, controls, and real hardware, this role is designed for you. TE Connectivity’s Passive Optics organization is building the precision automation needed to manufacture the next generation of optical interconnects for AI and hyperscale computing. You will work on problems where coordinate frames, motion, vision, sensing, process physics, and software all have to agree in the real world — not just in simulation. This is an intentionally high\-bandwidth early\-career role. You will work directly with a senior technical authority, first learning and codifying advanced methods, then taking increasing ownership of new robotics, machine\-vision, measurement, and equipment concepts. The goal is not to maintain yesterday’s equipment; it is to invent and prove the methods that become tomorrow’s equipment. **Why This Role Matters** As optical connectivity moves to higher density and tighter precision, manufacturing becomes a robotics and measurement problem as much as a product\-design problem. We need machines that can find, align, inspect, join, and verify extremely small features repeatably — and we need the science behind those machines to be understood well enough to scale. Your work will bridge fundamental engineering with production reality: build the model, write the algorithm, instrument the experiment, integrate the hardware, and prove the result. **\*THIS POSITIION IS 100% ON\-SITE AT THE ROCHESTER FACILITY\*** **Job Requirements** -------------------- **What You’ll Research, Build \& Prove** **Robotics, Motion \& Coordinate Systems** * Kinematics \& Geometry: Develop forward/inverse kinematics, rigid\-body transformations, coordinate\-frame architectures, calibration methods, and geometric error models for precision equipment. * Motion \& Control: Design and evaluate motion strategies, servo behavior, trajectory generation, active alignment, and closed\-loop control for precision positioning tasks. * Calibration \& Registration: Create robust methods for hand\-eye calibration, sensor\-to\-machine registration, multi\-axis alignment, and recovery from drift or reconfiguration. Machine Vision, Sensing \& Measurement * Machine Vision: Develop 2D/3D vision methods for feature detection, pose estimation, inspection, alignment, and process feedback; select and optimize cameras, lenses, illumination, and acquisition strategies. * Sensing Architecture: Integrate cameras, position sensors, force/other sensors, and process signals into coherent measurement systems; use sensor fusion and estimation where it adds value. * Precision Metrology: Develop methods for repeatability, reproducibility, uncertainty, drift, calibration, correlation, and machine\-to\-external\-metrology validation. Treat measurement as an engineered system, not just a sensor choice. **Difficult Process\-Control \& Equipment Problems** * Closed\-Loop Process Control: Attack hard problems in precision alignment, fiber handling, stripping/cleaving, laser joining/welding, inspection, and other processes where motion, sensing, timing, and process physics interact. * Next\-Generation Equipment Concepts: Take new equipment ideas from first principles through benchtop prototype, algorithm development, hardware selection, integration, and technical proof\-of\-concept. * Prototype to Scale: Partner with equipment, manufacturing\-process, optics, mechanical, controls, and software engineers to turn successful prototypes into robust, maintainable production capability. **Software, Experiments \& Technical Rigor** * Algorithms \& Code: Develop research and prototype software in Python, C\+\+, MATLAB, or similar environments; move critical algorithms into production software in partnership with the software team. * Experimental Science: Design experiments that separate mechanism from noise, build error budgets, quantify uncertainty, and use data to challenge assumptions before they harden into equipment architecture. * Technical Communication \& IP: Document methods and design decisions clearly; contribute to invention disclosures, patents, internal technical standards, and external technical communication where appropriate. **What your background should look like** ----------------------------------------- * Education: PhD completed by the start date in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Science, Applied Physics, or a closely related field. * Research Depth: Doctoral research demonstrating depth in at least two of the following: robot kinematics/dynamics/control; machine/computer vision; calibration/metrology; robotic manipulation; sensing/state estimation; precision automation; process control. * Real Hardware: Hands\-on experience building, integrating, calibrating, or debugging physical robotic, mechatronic, imaging, or automated systems. We are looking for someone who enjoys making hardware work. * Programming: Strong tech  subsystem. * High\-Quality Mentorship: Learn directly from experienced technical authorities while being expected to develop your own point of view and technical ownership quickly. * Work on AI Infrastructure: Apply robotics, sensing, and precision engineering to optical connectivity technologies serving rapidly evolving AI and hyperscale\-computing architectures. * Rochester Engineering Ecosystem: Build your career in one of North America’s deepest optics, photonics, imaging, and precision\-engineering communities, with extensive academic and industrial expertise in the region. * Relocation Support: This role is based in Rochester, NY because the work is hands\-on with equipment and laboratories. TE will provide relocation assistance for the selected candidate. **Career Development** ---------------------- * Apprenticeship to Ownership: Start with close technical mentorship, then expand into independent ownership of new measurement, vision, robotics, and equipment capabilities as you demonstrate readiness. * Broad Technical Range: Build depth across robotics, machine vision, metrology, software, precision mechanics, optics, and manufacturing rather than being locked into a single academic specialty. * Technical Career Path: Develop toward senior technical roles in robotics, automation, sensing/metrology, advanced equipment development, or broader system architecture. * Innovation Visibility: Opportunities to create intellectual property and contribute to technical communities, conferences, and standards where appropriate to the work. **Competencies** ---------------- SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers) **ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY** TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next\-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more. Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter). **COMPENSATION** * Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $103,900 \- $155,900 (subject to change dependent on physical location) * Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity. * Total Compensation \= Base Salary \+ Incentive(s) \+ Benefits **BENEFITS** * A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits. **EOE, Including Disability/Vets** **IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD** TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity **never requests payment or fees** from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come **only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com**. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities. **Job Locations:** 780 Salt Road Webster, New York 14580\-9709 United States Posting City: Webster Job Country: United States Travel Required: Less than 10% Requisition ID: 159921 Workplace Type: Onsite External Careers Page: Engineering \& Technology

jobs.title: Microsoft Pre-Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** We are seeking a **Microsoft Pre\-Sales Engineer** to help customers translate business and technology needs into practical Microsoft\-based solutions. This customer\-facing role supports Technologent’s sales organization through technical discovery, solution architecture, customer presentations, and opportunity development. Working with Account Executives, Microsoft, technical teams, and delivery partners, the engineer develops recommendations across Microsoft cloud, infrastructure, productivity, identity, security, and management technologies, and supports opportunities from initial discovery through technical validation and close. * **Role:** Microsoft Pre\-Sales Engineer * **Experience:** 5\+ years in technical pre\-sales, solution architecture, systems engineering, consulting, or a similar customer\-facing technical role * **Location:** Nashville, TN * **Employment Type:** Full Time **Responsibilities** * Serve as a trusted technical advisor and partner with Account Executives to identify customer requirements, technical challenges, business priorities, and Microsoft solution opportunities. * Lead technical discovery workshops and assessments of customers’ Microsoft environments, architecture, licensing, security posture, cloud strategy, and infrastructure; translate findings into solution recommendations. * Engage customer stakeholders from engineers and architects to IT leaders and executives; communicate technical designs and business value clearly. * Support account planning and opportunity strategy, technical qualification, customer presentations, proposals, demonstrations, proof\-of\-concept activities, and responses to technical questions and objections. * Design high\-level solutions across Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Sentinel, Windows and Windows Server, Active Directory and hybrid identity, Azure Virtual Desktop, Teams, collaboration, Copilot, and relevant AI capabilities. * Account for hybrid and multi\-cloud environments and integration with customer data centers, networking, security, storage, and third\-party platforms; address scalability, resiliency, and operational needs. * Develop licensing recommendations, bills of materials, solution components, and implementation assumptions; help define requirements, scope, dependencies, assumptions, and exclusions for proposals and Statements of Work. * Maintain a working understanding of Microsoft licensing, subscriptions, cloud consumption, and partner programs; coordinate with sales, licensing, procurement, operations, and partner resources on configurations and pricing. * Identify opportunities to improve Microsoft adoption and customer investments through licensing optimization, cloud adoption, modernization, and improved utilization; identify related services, migration, managed services, and ongoing support opportunities. * Ensure proposed solutions are technically feasible and transition effectively to delivery; collaborate with Solution Architects, Professional Services, Managed Services, Security, Infrastructure, Operations, and Project Management teams. * Develop relationships with Microsoft sales, technical, and channel teams; coordinate partner expertise, funding, assessments, workshops, and other resources for customer opportunities. * Maintain knowledge of Microsoft products, roadmap, cloud services, security capabilities, licensing, and competitors; support internal sales enablement and maintain relevant technical certifications. **Requirements** * Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise technology sales and working directly with Account Executives and customers. * Strong working knowledge of Microsoft technologies, particularly Azure and Microsoft 365, and experience designing or presenting cloud, hybrid infrastructure, identity, endpoint, collaboration, or security solutions. * Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, including compute, networking, storage, virtualization, identity, security, backup, and disaster recovery. * Experience leading technical discovery and translating customer requirements into solution architectures. * Ability to communicate solution designs to technical and non\-technical audiences and support presentations, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, Statements of Work, solution estimates, and technical demonstrations. * Understanding of Microsoft licensing, subscriptions, Azure consumption, and cloud economics strongly preferred. * Experience with an IT reseller, VAR, systems integrator, Microsoft partner, or technology consulting organization strongly preferred. * Strong customer\-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem\-solving skills; ability to work with engineers, architects, IT leaders, and executives. * Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities in a fast\-paced environment and collaborate across sales, engineering, professional services, operations, and vendor teams. * Ability to travel locally and overnight to customer, vendor, and company locations and events as required. This is an in\-office position for employees who live within 35 miles of a Technologent office. **Education and/or Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience. * 5\+ years of experience in technical pre\-sales, solution architecture, systems engineering, consulting, or a similar customer\-facing technical role. * Relevant Microsoft certifications are strongly preferred, including Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Security Operations Analyst Associate, Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 credentials, or Applied Skills credentials relevant to Azure, Microsoft 365, Security, Copilot, or AI technologies. Technologent is an Equal Opportunity Employer \- EEO/AA Employer/Vet/Disabled \- for reasonable accommodations, please contact us at hr@technologent.com Technologent is a Global Provider of Edge\-to\-Edge℠ Information Technology Solutions and Services for Fortune 1000 and SMB companies. We offer a unique blend of business practices that are aligned to solve for top CIO concerns. Our core competencies focus on data center infrastructure, business continuity, data protection, service automation and orchestration, continuous intelligence, monitoring, connectivity, collaboration and cybersecurity. These practices are supported by our professional services, digital transformation services and financial services offerings. By providing custom solutions and services designed to fit your business needs, we enable your organization to be more agile, responsive and competitive. Technologent empowers your company to ascend to the next level in IT. Headquartered in Irvine, CA, Technologent has offices throughout the US and proudly serves clients around the world. When partnering with Technologent, organizations benefit from the highest caliber of professionals, committed to delivering exceptional business outcomes backed by unmatched service and support.

jobs.title: Senior Conversion Tracking & API Engineer
jobs.description: **Remote — International Hire ONLY \| Contract Full\-Time** **About TNT Growth** TNT Growth is a performance\-driven growth marketing agency that embeds directly into our clients' businesses to produce measurable outcomes across paid media, creative strategy, and analytics. We drive impact! **About the Role** We are looking for a senior Conversion Tracking \& API Engineer who can independently own complex, production\-grade tracking across browser, server, CRM, and ad\-platform APIs. You combine deep backend and data\-integration expertise with a practical understanding of paid\-media measurement and strong client\-facing communication. This is not a tag\-only or passive back\-end role. You will work directly with Growth Managers, Client Success, client engineering teams, and external platforms. You will own the path from consented browser and session capture through forms and CRM lifecycle events, event processing, ad\-platform delivery, diagnostics, reconciliation, and monitoring. If you can build reliable systems, prove that they work end to end, and explain them clearly to non\-engineers, this role was designed for you. **What You'll Do** * **Strong Communication** + Proactively flagging implementation gaps, risks, and unverified assumptions before a campaign goes live — and separating confirmed root cause from a working hypothesis + Writing implementation and QA summaries that a Growth Manager without an engineering background can read, understand, and act on + Responding to questions in Slack within a reasonable window during working hours + Asking a clarifying question rather than building the wrong thing for two days * **Conversion Tracking Architecture \& Identity** Design, build, and maintain client\-side and server\-side conversion tracking across Meta Pixel/CAPI, Google Ads API and Data Manager API, Enhanced Conversions and offline uploads, TikTok Events API, and other major platforms. Own signal design, event taxonomy, account and action routing, timestamps, value and currency, attribution windows, and accuracy from landing page to ad platform. * **CRM Integration \& Event Pipeline Management** Build and maintain integrations among client sites and forms, CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho, call\-tracking and scheduling tools, TNT infrastructure, and ad\-platform APIs. Use webhooks, change data capture, OAuth, and queues to deliver events with validation, idempotency, retries and backoff, dead\-letter handling, replay and backfill, and a complete audit trail. * **Browser, Identity \& Cross\-Domain Instrumentation** Implement and debug GTM, server\-side GTM, Google tag and GA4, platform pixels, deterministic dataLayer events, first\-party session IDs and cookies, URL propagation, and form injection across redirects, subdomains, SPAs, embedded forms, and booking tools. Preserve and validate GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID, FBCLID, FBP, FBC, TTCLID, MSCLKID, UTMs, and consent state through the funnel. * **Ad\-Platform API \& Payload Engineering** Build platform\-correct payloads and matching logic: normalize and hash permitted identifiers exactly once, send consent signals, pair browser and server events with stable event or order IDs, prevent double counting, handle adjustments and redactions, diagnose partial acceptance and attribution\-window failures, and improve match quality using platform diagnostics. * **End\-to\-End QA, Reconciliation \& Production Operations** Create synthetic tests that follow the real user journey from landing page through CRM and queue to the ad\-platform UI. Reconcile source, database, CRM, internal reporting, and platform counts; monitor match quality, attribution lag, and delivery failures; produce evidence, alerts, runbooks, and incident updates; and verify fixes after launch. * **TypeScript Development** Write clean, well\-tested TypeScript across the stack, including API clients, webhook handlers, and event workers. Own engineering quality through automated tests, code review, documentation, and maintainability. * **Data Layer \& Database Work** Design and operate PostgreSQL schemas for attribution sessions, identities, conversion events, attempts, and delivery status. Write diagnostic SQL, optimize queries and indexes, plan retention, and trace data from ingestion through reporting without exposing sensitive data. * **AI\-Assisted Development \& Tooling** Use AI systems (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and others) as force multipliers for debugging, code generation, documentation, and pattern recognition. Validate generated work and never trade tracking correctness, security, or maintainability for speed. * **Cross\-Functional Communication \& Ownership** Communicate clearly and proactively with Growth Managers, Client Success, client engineers, and platform support. Translate root cause, risk, evidence, dependencies, and ETA into updates non\-engineers can act on. Own incidents through verification and follow\-up, not just code deployment. Create reusable standards, runbooks, and guidance that raise the capability of the broader team. * **Version Control \& Collaboration** Own your work in Git. Strong branching strategy, meaningful commit history, clean PRs, and collaborative review habits. You treat version control as a professional practice, not a formality. **What We're Looking For** **Required** * Senior\-level, hands\-on production experience with complex conversion tracking across Meta Pixel/CAPI and Google Ads API or Data Manager API, including Enhanced Conversions and offline conversions; additional TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads, or Reddit CAPI experience is strongly jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Special Projects Group
jobs.description: **Project Coordinator, Special Projects Group** **Why Tarlton** Tarlton is a St. Louis\-based commercial, institutional, and industrial contractor. Our Special Projects Group handles the work that keeps our clients’ facilities running — renovations, upgrades, tenant work, and fast\-turn projects delivered under a Master Service Agreement (MSA) with a long\-standing client. The rhythm is different from a single large build. Several projects move at once, schedules are short, and the client counts on us being easy to work with. The Project Coordinator sits at the center of that: you set projects up, keep the paperwork and systems straight, and close them out. If you want to learn how a construction project actually runs from award through turnover, this is one of the best seats in the company to do it — and it is the first step in our project management career path. **Your Role** The Project Coordinator keeps project administration accurate and current so Project Managers, Project Engineers, and Superintendents can stay focused on execution. You will support projects from award through closeout — system setup, contract and financial paperwork, safety documentation, permitting, document control, and closeout records — across the Special Projects Group’s MSA portfolio. **What You'll Do** **Project Setup \& Systems** * Set up new projects in Viewpoint, Procore, and Egnyte, and keep records current as work progresses. * Upload drawings, specifications, and addenda, and distribute current revisions to the project team. * Maintain the project directory so subcontractor, vendor, and client contacts stay accurate. * Set up Building Connected sites and invite subcontractors. **Contract \& Financial Administration** * Track and file Owner Purchase Orders issued under the Master Service Agreement. * Support cost book setup and initial data entry with the Project Manager and Project Engineer. * Draft subcontract and purchase order requisition forms for Project Manager review. * Coordinate subcontractor pricing and draft proposals for approval before they go to the client. **Safety \& Site Access** * Schedule safety kickoff meetings and track Site\-Specific Safety Plans for each project. * Verify legal and OSHA\-required site postings are current, with the Safety Department and Superintendent. * Administer client badging and site access for Tarlton and subcontractor personnel, including logs, renewals, and client\-required training. **Documentation, Permitting \& Reporting** * Maintain submittal, RFI, and drawing logs. * Complete permit applications, track them through issuance, and distribute permit numbers to subcontractors. * Assemble quarterly client reporting across the MSA portfolio into a single master file. **Closeout** * Collect and file record drawings, warranties, and O\&M manuals. * Enter punch list items in Procore and assign them to subcontractors for review and distribution. * Support scheduling of pre\-commissioning, TAB, and final commissioning with the client, engineer, and subcontractors. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Experience** * Two or more years of administrative, project support, or coordination experience. Construction, engineering, or A/E industry experience preferred. * A track record of managing many small deadlines across concurrent projects without dropping items. * Comfortable working directly with subcontractors, vendors, and client contacts. * Construction management graduates and candidates with relevant internship experience are encouraged to apply. **Education \& Certifications** * High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Business, or a related field preferred. * Valid driver’s license required. * OSHA 10 required within the first six months — we will get you there. OSHA 30 available. * Procore Project Manager (Project Management) certification within the first year — free, self\-paced, and built for project coordinators. * AGC Project Manager Development Program (PMDP) supported for those who want to grow toward Project Engineer. **Tools \& Software** * Procore — project setup, drawings, submittals, RFIs, punch list (training provided). * Viewpoint Vista — project setup, cost book entry, requisition forms. * Egnyte — file structure and document storage. * Building Connected — bid site setup and subcontractor invitations. * Microsoft Excel at an intermediate level for multi\-project trackers and reporting rollups. Word, Outlook, and Teams. * Bluebeam Revu preferred. **Work Location, Environment \& Travel Requirements** * Work is normally performed in a typical interior/office work environment where the noise level is usually quiet. * If required, the employee may work from a jobsite trailer on occasion or owner\-designated office location. The noise level in the work environment can be loud due to heavy equipment, jack hammers, pneumatic tools, etc. These sounds can be non\-stop throughout the day. * Occasional local travel required between the office and project sites. * Occasional local or regional travel required for business or community events. **Tarlton Competencies** * **Leadership \& Team Development:** Provides clear direction, sets expectations, holds others accountable, and develops team members through coaching and support * **Stand Behind Our Word and Work:** Follows through on commitments, takes ownership of results, and ensures work meets high standards of quality and professionalism * **Cultivate Clients for Life:** Builds trust\-based relationships through responsiveness, clear communication, and understanding of client needs * **Build a Safe and Caring Environment:** Promotes a safety\-first culture, proactively manages risks, and looks out for others * **Gets the Job Done:** Takes ownership, removes obstacles, prioritizes effectively, and drives work forward to achieve results * **Communication and Collaboration:** Communicates clearly and works effectively across teams to build trust and alignment * **Develops and Adapts:** Seeks feedback, learns from experience, and adjusts to changing conditions and project needs **Why You’ll Like Working Here** * Complex, high\-impact projects with experienced teams * Strong partnership between field and project management * Safety\-first culture and high standards of quality * Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and long\-term career growth * A company proud to be STLMade and invested in the region **Let’s Build Together** If you’re interested in working on challenging projects with a collaborative, experienced team, we encourage you to apply. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Tarlton is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law. If you require assistance completing this application or need a reasonable accommodation, please contact recruiting@tarltoncorp.com or 314\.633\.3300 for support. Non\-Exempt

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI Infrastructure)
jobs.description: **Location:** Irvine, CA \| On\-site **Employment Type:** Full\-time **About the role** ------------------ You'll build the data systems and services behind our AI platform. You'll turn complex financial and case documents into structured, trustworthy data for our AI, analytics, and operational systems, and help build the real\-time services the organization depends on. You'll join a team that already has a working platform with design docs, tests, and CI, and help shape where it goes next. The work is hands\-on, from design through deployment. **What you'll do** ------------------ #### **Data** * Build batch and real\-time pipelines that bring in data from documents, APIs, CRM systems, and internal services. * Build document\-processing systems on OCR and AI models that stay accurate, reliable, and affordable as volume grows. * Design data models across relational databases, document stores, and data lake storage, and change them safely as the product evolves. * Give AI/ML teams clean, structured, accessible datasets, including training data. * Build data quality checks and monitoring so bad data is caught before anyone relies on it. #### **Platform and services** * Build and run APIs and background services, and own how they behave when the systems they depend on are slow, failing, or rate\-limited. * Maintain integrations with our CRM and other third\-party systems, and fix them when they break. * Help build real\-time sales tools where speed and correctness both matter, such as lead routing and live caller lookup. * Contribute to secure, controlled data exports to external partners. * Maintain older services and migrate them to our primary cloud where it makes sense. * Support the internal web tools our case and sales staff use. #### **Engineering practice** * Write design docs for your own work and contribute to architecture decisions. * Work in our infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD setup, changing it as your work requires. * Protect sensitive personal and financial data in code, logs, configuration, and third\-party integrations. * Mentor junior engineers and help improve our standards for code quality, CI, and releases, including guardrails for AI coding agents. **What You Bring** ------------------ We care more about fundamentals than any particular stack. In each area below, we're looking for someone who can explain why things work the way they do, not just name the tools. * **Experience.** 5\+ years building production backend or data systems, or equivalent depth: you've owned production systems end to end, made the design decisions, and handled the incidents. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Software engineering.** You treat engineering as more than programming. You frame the problem, weigh the options, write down the trade\-offs, and choose the simplest design that works. You ship code that's tested, observable, and easy to change. You measure before you optimize, and you own what you build after it ships. * **Languages.** Deep experience in at least one backend language. We work mostly in Python. * **Databases.** Strong SQL and data modeling across relational and document databases, and a clear sense of when to use which. You understand indexes and query plans, transactions and isolation, schema changes that don't break running systems, and keeping data consistent when it lives in more than one store. * **Data pipelines.** You've built pipelines over structured and unstructured data (JSON, PDFs) that are safe to rerun and backfill, and you understand how to model data for analytics. * **AI systems.** You've run LLM or OCR workloads in production and know how they behave: output that varies from run to run, structured output that needs validating, quality you have to measure, and latency and cost that grow with volume. * **Model deployments.** You understand how models are deployed and served: capacity and quotas, pinning versions and evaluating new ones before switching, rolling back, and falling back when a model or region is unavailable. * **Rate limits.** You understand rate limiting from both sides: how a client should handle a 429, how a service protects itself with quotas and backpressure, and the various 429 errors that can occur for LLM deployments. * **Distributed systems and contracts.** You treat APIs, events, and schemas as contracts between services and teams: versioned, backward compatible, and clearly owned. You design for partial failure: timeouts, idempotent retries, delivery guarantees, and what to do with work that will never succeed. * **Cloud and infrastructure.** Production experience on a major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), running services on serverless and container platforms. You understand what sits underneath (networking, DNS, private connectivity, identity, and permissions) and can read, change, and deploy it as code through CI/CD. * **Authentication.** You understand OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect, SSO and MFA, and how tokens are issued, validated, and expired. You follow current practice, such as short\-lived credentials and service\-to\-service auth without shared secrets. * **Authorization (RBAC).** You design access around roles and least privilege, scope permissions to the resources they cover, and enforce them on the server, not just in the UI. * **User management.** You understand the lifecycle of user and service accounts: provisioning, role changes, offboarding, and regular access reviews. * **Data protection.** You keep secrets out of code and personal data out of logs, and you treat customer and company information as strictly confidential. * **Communication.** Clear design docs, PR descriptions, and incident write\-ups. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with our stack: Python, Azure, React and TypeScript, and Google Cloud (where some older services still run). * Orchestration and data platform tools such as Dagster, Airflow, or Databricks. * Streaming systems such as Kafka. * Retrieval and vector search. * Distributed rate limiting or API gateway design. * CRM or third\-party integrations with fragile authentication. * Regulated or PII\-heavy domains such as tax or finance. Using AI coding agents in production work. * **What We Offer** ----------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Supplemental benefits like: Life Insurance, flexible spending, *and many more...* * 401k with a 4% employer match **Compensation:** $160,000 \- $180,000 per year, depending on experience *We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and encourage all qualified individuals to apply.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II
jobs.description: At Tecuity, we build the software that keeps state governments' business filings and public records running behind the scenes — real, meaningful infrastructure work from our tight\-knit team in Hyde Park, Utah. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer II, and while we'd love to find someone local to Cache County who can join us in office 4 days a week, we're just as glad to consider other Utah\-based candidates for a mostly remote setup with occasional office visits, or out\-of\-state applicants who could come on\-site around once a year, depending on our current employer status in that state. Sponsorship is not available for this position. The Senior Software Engineer II is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining internet applications and related systems. The Senior Software Engineer II leads by example, following industry best practices, standards, and patterns to design optimal solutions to complex problems and create innovative, high\-quality solutions that meet our clients’ business needs and objectives. The Senior Software Engineer II understands the business value behind the product and must be talented in problem\-solving and making well\-reasoned decisions about software design and implementation based on knowledge and a broad range of experiences with different roles, technologies, and situations. As a Senior Software Engineer II, you are expected to be a technical authority on the business rules behind a filing type and to own complex features end to end — requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. You will make and guide cross\-cutting and architectural decisions, serve as a Peer Advisor and/or Team Lead to other software engineers (including reviewing Senior Software Engineer I work), and be a technical resource to project managers and business analysts in technical meetings. About the Work Our product serves Secretary of State offices – state government agencies responsible for business filings and other public records \- which means real filing deadlines, statutory requirements and citizens who rely on a working system. All new development happens on our modern .NET platform. We also maintain established .NET Framework (legacy) implementations currently in production or being migrated onto the modern platform; depending on your assignment, you may work in one or both. This is a mature, multi\-tenant product rather than a blank page. You’ll build new modules and capabilities on a well\-established modern stack, typically supporting more than one client implementation concurrently – each with its own database, release calendar, and statutes. That means real ownership: knowing the product and the client well, understanding business rules, questioning requirements that do not hold up, writing acceptance criteria and testing instructions for your own work, guiding other engineers on theirs, and seeing changes through to production. AI\-assisted development is not a pilot program here \- it is in full use and is a standard part of our engineers’ daily workflow. Claude Code is used actively and its role is expanding. You will be expected to lean into these tools to learn their strengths and failure modes firsthand and verify output rather than accept it. Our engineers treat AI as a fast, tireless collaborator that still requires oversight, and they leverage it to move considerably faster without lowering their standards. As a Senior Software Engineer II, you will also help set the standard for how the team uses these tools, coaching other engineers on where they help and where they fall short. Essential Job Functions * Solve challenging problems by designing innovative, optimal solutions to complex problems. * Work closely with cross\-functional teams to gather and define requirements, determine level of effort, and contribute to user experience, design, and architecture decisions. * Serve as a key player in the implementation of software projects, including project schedules, milestones, and integration into the overall system. * Participate in all phases of the application development process. * Contribute quality code and strive for excellence within the team and company culture. * Lead the design and delivery of complex features and cross\-cutting or architectural changes across the web application, API, and database layers, with primary responsibility for their quality. * Translate business\-specific and statutory requirements into software components and applications, questioning requirements that do not hold up. * Serve as a Peer Advisor and/or Team Lead to other software engineers, providing technical guidance, mentoring, and support. * Participate in code review as both author and reviewer, including review of Senior Software Engineer I work, upholding Tecuity coding standards and Pull Request guidelines. * Write and maintain automated tests and keep changes passing pull request and build validation gates. * Use AI\-assisted developmen nctions * Experience with web technologies: ASP.NET, HTML5, JavaScript, AJAX, CSS, JSON * Practical experience with a component\-based JavaScript framework. (Our front end is React with Redux) * Experience designing, developing, and consuming REST APIs * Experience with Entity Framework Core, including migrations, alongside stored\-procedure based data access. * Experience writing automated unit tests and working in a codebase where tests gate the build. * Experience with Git in a branch\-and\-pull request workflow * Experience developing cross\-browser code and responsive CSS * Adept at database management, including designing and maintaining schemas across multiple client databases * Superior ability to write clear, concise, maintainable code * Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into functional products and solutions * Ability to efficiently identify and resolve issues that arise during the design, testing, and maintenance processes using superior problem\-solving skills * Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to ensure the success of the team and project * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including participating in technical meetings with project managers and business analysts and writing clearly for non\-technical stakeholders * Ability to thrive and be productive with little or no supervision as well as in a collaborative environment * Demonstrated ability to leverage AI\-assisted development tooling while retaining full ownership of correctness, and to help other engineers do the same Preferred Qualifications * Experience with the Agile software development methodologies * Experience maintaining and modernizing long\-lived applications * Experience with Microsoft Azure application hosting, such as App Services, Blob Storage, Key Vault, and managed identity\-based configuration. * Experience consuming and upgrading versioned internal NuGet packages, and reasoning about the impact of a change across a dependency graph * Experience with structured logging and application monitoring, such as Serilog or Application Insights. * Experience with modern authentication, such as OpenID Connect, OAuth, or JWT. * Experience with configurable multi\-tenant or white\-label software, driven by client specifications. * Experience with government, regulated, or compliance\-driven software, and handling personally identifiable information. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as Azure DevOps Pipelines. * Experience with web accessibility standards for public\-facing applications. * Experience with Windows desktop development, such as WinForms * Experience with reporting tools such as Active Reports Why Tecuity? Tecuity has spent more than 20 years building direct, long\-term partnerships with Secretary of State offices. You will get genuine ownership of your work, from requirements through production, on a modern stack — alongside a team that treats AI\-assisted development as a serious part of the craft, not an afterthought — and the opportunity to guide the team’s technical direction and help grow the engineers around you. Benefits include: * Company paid Medical/Vision/Dental/Life/Disability Insurance * Paid Time Off (Holidays, Personal) * 401k with Company Match About Tecuity Our passion is to deliver innovative technology solutions and services to government and citizens through seamless collaboration with an unwavering dedication to the success of our partners. We are proud to have over 20 years of experience working directly with Secretary of State offices. Our team provides our customers with direct access to experts who have in\-depth business and technical knowledge, and our relentless focus on our customers’ success has resulted in long\-term business relationships. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyde Park, UT 84318

jobs.title: Data Visualization Engineer
jobs.description: **Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?** Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence to deliver real\-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time. At Tempus, products are owned and developed by small, autonomous teams composed of developers, designers, scientists, clinicians, and product managers. You and your team set the goals, build the software, deploy the code, and contribute to a growing software platform that will make a lasting impact in the field of healthcare research and treatment. Tempus builds rich longitudinal datasets which enable research and product development. Our data and reporting infrastructure – using BigQuery (Google Cloud Platform) and Looker – allows product teams to deliver advanced insights with confidence, and at scale. As a **Data Visualization Engineer on the Tempus Next** **team**, you will work on solutions to synthesize clinical and enriched data from the Next product, which identifies patients with gaps in their clinical care. You will translate these into visually compelling dashboards for internal stakeholders, healthcare providers, and health system administrators at the point of care. As a Data Visualization Engineer, you will be responsible for: * Ensuring the quality, accuracy and timeliness of data products * Performing custom analyses to support account managers and clinical partners (e.g., identify patients that meet clinical trial inclusion/exclusion criteria) * Designing, building, and maintaining stand\-alone data visualizations and dashboards for both internal and external stakeholders * Empowering account and product managers to conduct their own data investigations, and build their own visualizations, by designing, creating, and maintaining data models, and writing supporting documentation (e.g., entity relationship diagrams, data dictionaries, data/dashboard inventories) Why we’re looking for you: * You have 3 or more years of hands\-on experience developing data visualizations * Strong experience with SQL and relational data * Deep understanding of Data Modeling patterns and best practices * Experience working with Looker or other Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI) * Excellent communication and presentation skills * You enjoy collaborating with a cross disciplinary team of account managers, product managers and engineers, and are comfortable interfacing with other teams * You write high quality, well\-documented code that is scalable, version\-controlled (GitHub) and easy to use by other team members. * Excellent time\-management skills (e.g., accurately estimating time to complete tasks, working with stakeholders to set deadlines and priorities) Bonus points for: * Experience working with clinical or healthcare data (especially if related to Cardiology or Oncology) * Experience working with dbt * Experience developing software in Python/R, Javascript (D3\.js), HTML, CSS * Experience working with APIs and API clients * Experience working with cloud service providers like Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e,g., Terraform) * Experience with Agile development methodologies (e.g., JIRA/Trello, RACI) \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-HR1 CHI: $70,000\-$90,000 The expected salary range may vary for other locations. Actual salary may vary based on qualifications and experience. Tempus offers a full range of benefits, which may include incentive compensation, restricted stock units, medical and other benefits depending on the position. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. ### **About Us** Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. Shortly after he founded the company in an effort to bring the power of technology and artificial intelligence to cancer care, he convinced Ryan Fukushima to join as the company’s first employee. Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics. We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives. ### **Why Work Here?** We’re looking for people who can change the world.
