jobs.title: Technical Director - Preclinical Imaging Core
jobs.description: **Department:** --------------- SOM KC Cancer Biology \- Bossmann **Position Title:** ------------------- Technical Director \- Preclinical Imaging Core **Job Family Group:** --------------------- Professional Staff **Job Description Summary:** ---------------------------- The Technical Director will provide scientific, technical, and operational leadership for the Preclinical Imaging Shared Resource (PISR) within the University of Kansas Cancer Center and the Department of Cancer Biology. The Technical Director will oversee the daily operation of the PISR and its portfolio of advanced pre\-clinical imaging technologies, including magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), micro\-computed tomography (micro\-CT), optical imaging, photoacoustic imaging, and quantitative image analysis. The Technical Director will report directly to the Director of the PISR and will supervise PISR scientific staff, including postdoctoral fellows, trainees, and other technical personnel as assigned. This position will work closely with investigators throughout the University of Kansas Cancer Center, the Institute for Advancing Medical Innovation, and collaborating institutions to design and execute sophisticated pre\-clinical imaging studies and to develop innovative quantitative and multimodal imaging methodologies. The position combines scientific leadership, advanced imaging expertise, personnel supervision, instrumentation oversight, investigator consultation, training, quality assurance, and collaborative research. The Technical Director will play a central role in the continued development and expansion of the PISR, including implementation of next\-generation ultra\-high\-field MRI and multimodal imaging technologies. **Job Description:** -------------------- **Key Roles and Responsibilities:** **Scientific and Technical Leadership** * Direct the day\-to\-day scientific and technical operations of the PISR under the supervision of the PISR Director. * Develop, optimize, validate, and maintain advanced preclinical imaging protocols. * Provide expert consultation to investigators regarding selection of imaging modalities, experimental design, longitudinal study design, quantitative endpoints, and image analysis. * Develop reproducible quantitative imaging workflows and imaging biomarkers. * Promote integration of MRI, micro\-CT, optical imaging, photoacoustic imaging, and other complementary imaging technologies. Evaluate emerging imaging technologies and recommend strategic implementation within the PISR. * **Personnel Supervision and Training** * Supervise PISR postdoctoral fellows and other scientific or technical personnel as assigned by the PISR Director. * Coordinate day\-to\-day scientific activities and establish priorities for PISR staff. * Train graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, research staff, faculty investigators, and other authorized users in imaging methodologies and appropriate instrument operation. * Ensure that users demonstrate appropriate competency before independent instrument use where applicable. Foster a collaborative, rigorous, service\-oriented environment within the Shared Resource. * **Instrumentation and Quality Assurance** * Oversee scientific operation, performance monitoring, and routine quality assurance of PISR imaging instrumentation. * Develop and maintain standard operating procedures for imaging systems and experimental workflows. * Troubleshoot technical problems and coordinate with institutional personnel, manufacturers, and service engineers when necessary. * Maintain documentation of instrument performance, maintenance, calibration, and quality\-control procedures. * Participate in planning for equipment upgrades, new instrumentation, software implementation, and facility expansion. Assist the PISR Director with strategic planning for future imaging capabilities. * **Ultra\-High\-Field MRI and Technology Development** * Lead technical implementation and validation of next\-generation MRI capabilities, including the forthcoming 18\.8 Tesla MRI platform. * Develop and optimize high\-field and ultra\-high\-field MRI protocols for preclinical applications. * Establish reproducible workflows for quantitative and longitudinal MRI. * Facilitate integration of MRI and NMR spectroscopy with optical imaging, micro\-CT, photoacoustic imaging, and other complementary technologies. Support development of advanced image reconstruction, quantitative analysis, and AI\-assisted imaging pipelines. * **Investigator and Collaborative Research Support** * Meet with investigators to define imaging objectives and develop technically rigorous experimental plans. * Support interdisciplinary cancer research involving tumor biology, therapeutic response, immunotherapy, drug delivery, pharmacokinetics, and related areas. * Participate in collaborative NIH\-, DoD\-, NSF\-, foundation\-, and industry\-funded research projects. * Assist investigators in developing imaging components of grant applications, includi perience in preclinical biomedical imaging and research that includes all of the following areas: + Experience that requires expertise in preclinical biomedical imaging, with significant experience in at least one advanced imaging modality. + Experience designing, conducting, and analyzing preclinical imaging studies. + Experience that required the capability to operate and troubleshoot sophisticated biomedical imaging instrumentation. Experience working with small\-animal models and familiarity with animal preparation, anesthesia, physiological monitoring, and longitudinal imaging studies. + **Preferred Qualifications** **Work Experience:** * Preclinical MRI experience, particularly high\-field or ultra\-high\-field MRI * Experience with Bruker MRI systems and ParaVision * Experience with MRI pulse sequence development, optimization, and troubleshooting * Experience with Quantitative MRI and development of imaging biomarkers * Experience with Micro\-CT * Experience in Optical imaging * Experience in Photoacoustic imaging * Experience with PET or SPECT * Experience with multimodal image registration and quantitative image analysis * Experience with Artificial intelligence or machine learning for biomedical imaging * Experience using Python, MATLAB, C\+\+, or related scientific programming environments * Experience with cancer biology, immunology, drug development, or neuroscience applications of imaging * Experience in management or operation of a shared research resource or biomedical imaging facility * Experience in the development of standard operating procedures, quality assurance programs, and reproducible imaging workflows * Experience with Collaborative NIH\-, DoD\-, NSF\-, or other federally funded research Experience with preparation of instrumentation or research grant applications * **Skills** * Communication * Collaboration * Leadership Organization * **Required Documents** Resume Cover Letter If selected as a final candidate for this position, you may be required to complete the Association of American of Universities Representations and Warranties document and sign a release of records that will allow the University of Kansas Medical Center to conduct a further background check with former employers. A copy of the Representations and Warranties document can be found here . **Comprehensive Benefits Package:** Coverage begins on day one for health, dental, and vision insurance and includes health expense accounts with generous employer contributions if the employee participates in a qualifying health plan. Employer\-paid life insurance, long\-term disability insurance, and various additional voluntary insurance plans are available. Paid time off, including vacation and sick, begins accruing upon hire, plus ten paid holidays. One paid discretionary day is available after six months of employment, and paid time off for bereavement, jury duty, military service, and parental leave is available after 12 months of employment. A retirement program with a generous employer contribution and additional voluntary retirement programs (457 or 403b) are available. https://www.kumc.edu/human\-resources/benefits.html **Employee Type:** ------------------ Regular **Time Type:** -------------- Full time **Rate Type:** -------------- Salary **Compensation Statement:** The pay range listed for this position is determined by our compensation program using market data and salary benchmarking. A combination of factors is considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, education, experience and training, qualifications relative to the requirements of the position, and funding. At the University of Kansas Medical Center, a reasonable estimate for the starting pay range will be the minimum to midpoint of the posted range, taking into account the combination of factors listed above. **Pay Range:** -------------- $103,014\.00 \- $164,822\.00 **Minimum** $103,014\.00 **Midpoint** $133,920\.00 **Maximum** $164,822\.00

jobs.title: Associate Professor / Full Professor, Social Work/Director of Faculty Development
jobs.description: The University of Nevada, Reno (UNR) appreciates your interest in employment at our growing institution. We want your application process to go smoothly and quickly. Final applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment. If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775\) 784\-1495 or jobs@unr.edu . **Job Description** The Director of Faculty Development is a key member of the Dean’s Office. This position provides strategic leadership for faculty development and advancement across the School of Social Work, strengthening support for full\-time faculty in teaching, research, and service while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, mentorship, and professional growth. This permanent academic faculty position is 12\-month and on\-site at the University of Nevada, Reno. **Position Responsibilities** In collaboration with the Dean’s Office, the Director will provide leadership in the following areas: * Faculty Development and Mentorship: Design, implement, and evaluate comprehensive faculty development initiatives aligned with the School’s mission, institutional goals, and strategic priorities. Develop structured mentoring and professional development opportunities that support faculty growth, retention, and career advancement. * Faculty Evaluation: Lead the School’s annual faculty evaluation processes, including annual performance reviews, ensuring consistency, transparency, fairness, and alignment with School and University policies and standards. * Faculty Orientation and Professional Growth: Develop and implement comprehensive faculty orientation programs and ongoing professional development and training opportunities for faculty across all ranks and career stages. * Promotion and Tenure: Support tenure\-track faculty in navigating the promotion and tenure process, including providing guidance on portfolio development, documentation, and preparation for retention, promotion, and tenure reviews. Provide similar career advancement support to non\-tenure\-track and teaching faculty. Facilitate the school's tenure and promotion processes. * Career Advancement and Mentoring: Provide direct mentorship to junior, teaching, and other full\-time faculty, with particular attention to professional development, career planning, advancement, and successful integration into the School. * Policy and Academic Leadership: Collaborate with the Dean and Associate Dean on faculty\-related policies, procedures, and initiatives that strengthen academic programs and promote effective faculty engagement and success. Assessment and Continuous Improvement: Contribute to a culture of assessment, innovation, and continuous improvement by evaluating faculty development initiatives and using findings to inform future programming and School\-level priorities. Will also be engage in Council of Social Work (CSWE) accreditation\-related assessment and activities. * **Teaching Responsibilities** In addition to administrative and faculty development responsibilities, the Director will contribute to the School’s instructional mission by teaching undergraduate and graduate Social Work courses across program modalities, including in\-person and online instruction. This position offers an experienced faculty leader a unique opportunity to shape the professional development and career advancement of faculty across all ranks while contributing to the School of Social Work's continued excellence, innovation, and growth. **Required Qualifications** * PhD in social work or related field. * Master of Social Work (MSW) from a CSWE\-accredited institution and 2 years of post\-MSW experience. * 5 years of progressively responsible academic leadership experience in higher education, with demonstrated experience in faculty development, mentoring, evaluation, and academic personnel processes. * Tenured or tenure\-eligible. * Experience with CSWE accreditation review. * Record of teaching and scholarly achievement commensurate with appointment at the Associate level or Professor level. * Excellent oral, written, interpersonal, and executive communication skills. * Ability to manage timelines, projects, documentation, and competing priorities with accuracy and discretion. * High level of professionalism, confidentiality, accountability, and service orientation. Demonstrated commitment to anti\-racism, diversity, equity, inclusion, and social justice. * **Preferred Qualifications** Knowledge of promotion and tenure standards and processes within a research\-intensive university, preferably an R1 institution. **Schedule and Travel Requirements** Travel occasional **Compensation** Associate Professor Full Professor To view the salary schedule for this position, please visit Salary Schedules and select (12\-month contract) Academic Faculty. **Perks of working at UNR** * Health insurance options including dental and vision \- Health Insurance * Generous future powered by knowledge. Founded in 1874 as Nevada’s original land\-grant university, the University serves more than 23,000 undergraduate and graduate students from all 50 states and 63 countries. Classified by the Carnegie® Classification of Institutions of Higher Education as an R1 (“Very High Research”) university, it is also recognized in the Carnegie® Community Engagement classification. The University is also ranked by U.S. News \& World Report among the “Best National Universities” and “Best National Public Universities.” It also ranks in the top tier of the WSJ/Times Higher Education World University Rankings and the New York Times’ “Top Colleges for Economic Diversity.” Since 2009, nearly $1 billion has been has invested in advanced labs, facilities, and residence halls on the main campus. The University is home to Nevada’s first medical school – the University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine and the Wayne L. Prim Campus at Lake Tahoe, where education, research, and creative work thrive in a stunning mountain setting. The University delivers on its original land\-grant mission with outreach across the state through the University of Nevada, Reno Extension, Nevada Agricultural Experiment Station, Nevada Bureau of Mines and Geology, Nevada Small Business Development Center, the Nevada Seismological Laboratory, and Wolf Pack Athletics. The main campus is in Reno, Nevada, a burgeoning global technology hub with a vibrant midtown and downtown. Found where the high desert of the Great Basin meets the High Sierra and Lake Tahoe, the beautiful, 290\-acre main campus is also a Nevada State Arboretum. The University’s physical infrastructure is expanding with ongoing construction of the newly named John Tullock Business Building, set to open in fall 2025\. Groundbreaking is also planned for a new State Public Health Laboratory Building on campus, alongside the recent acquisition of 16 parcels near campus, known as “University Village,” to provide affordable housing for graduate students and early career faculty. Collaborating with world\-renowned organizations, the University fosters innovation through initiatives such as the Digital Wolf Pack partnership with Apple, which ensures equitable access to technology for students, providing new incoming freshman or transfer students with an iPad Air and accessories. Google’s TechWise initiate is an 18\-month program that fully supports undergraduate students in becoming entry\-level software engineers by graduation. In 2023, the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Economic Development Administration (EDA) announced that Nevada – led by the University of Nevada, Reno – was named one of the inaugural 31 Regional Technology and Innovation Hubs (TechHubs). Nevada was selected from a competitive pool of 489 applicants from across the United States and its territories. Nevada’s Tech Hub will strengthen America’s lithium batteries, critical elements and other electric vehicle materials industry sectors within the state. Through its commitment to high\-impact education, world\-improving research and creative activity, and outreach that’s transforming Nevada’s communities and businesses, the University continues its 150\-year tradition of benefitting our state, nation and world. The University recognizes that diversity promotes excellence in education and research. The inclusive and engaged community on campus recognizes the added value that students, faculty, and staff from different backgrounds bring to the educational experience. Today, the University delivers on its original land\-grant mission of access to education and knowledge by investing in the academics, facilities, support, engagement and vibrant campus life that promote our diverse students’ cognitive growth and academic achievement – all while remaining one of the best values in American higher education. For more information, please visit the University’s website . **University of Nevada, Reno** ------------------------------

jobs.description: Posting Information **Department** Information Technology\-SOM \- 420401 **Career Area** Information Technology **Posting Open Date** 10/07/2026 **Application Deadline** 10/21/2026 **Position Type** Temporary Staff (SHRA) **Position Title** Data Engineer **Position Number** 20075448 **Vacancy ID** S028125 **Full\-time/Part\-time** Full\-Time Temporary **Hours per week** 40 **Work Schedule** **Position Location** North Carolina, US **Hiring Range** $45\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour **Proposed Start Date** **Estimated Duration of Appointment** 6 months or longer Position Information **Be a Tar Heel!** A global higher education leader in innovative teaching, research and public service, the **University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill** consistently ranks as **one of the nation’s top public universities**. Known for its beautiful campus, world\-class medical care, commitment to the arts and top athletic programs, Carolina is an ideal place to teach, work and learn. One of the best college towns and best places to live in the United States, Chapel Hill has diverse social, cultural, recreation and professional opportunities that span the campus and community. University employees can choose from a wide range of **professional training opportunities** for career growth, skill development and lifelong learning and enjoy **exclusive perks** that include numerous retail and restaurant discounts, savings on local child care centers and special rates for performing arts events. **Primary Purpose of Organizational Unit** Our mission is to improve the health and well\-being of North Carolinians and others whom we serve. We accomplish this by providing leadership and excellence in the interrelated areas of patient care, education and research. Patient care: We promote health and provide superb clinical care while maintaining our strong tradition of reaching underserved populations and reducing health disparities across North Carolina and beyond. Education: We prepare tomorrow\`s healthcare professionals and biomedical researchers from all backgrounds by facilitating learning within innovative and integrated curricula and team\-oriented interprofessional education to ensure a highly skilled workforce. Research: We develop and support a rich array of outstanding health sciences research programs, centers and resources. We provide infrastructure and opportunities for collaboration among disciplines throughout and beyond our university to support outstanding research. We foster programs in the areas of basic, translational, mechanistic and population research. **Position Summary** This temporary position provides short\-term support for data engineering, data integration, data modeling, and business intelligence activities within the School of Medicine Information Technology department. The role focuses on developing and supporting reliable data pipelines, curated data layers, and Power BI solutions using SQL Server and Azure\-based data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric or Azure Databricks. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: * Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL Server queries, views, functions, and stored procedures in support of operational and reporting needs. * Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks across source, transformation, and curated data layers. * Assist with data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes using Informatica (IICS), SSIS, or comparable ETL tools. * Support integration of data from multiple source systems into SQL Server environments. * Optimize SQL queries, transformations, data pipelines, and reporting datasets under the guidance of senior technical staff. * Develop, maintain, and support Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and data refresh processes using approved reporting and analytics tools. * Support data ingestion and transformation workflows that prepare curated data for Power BI reporting using Azure\-based platforms, including Microsoft Fabric or Azure Databricks. * Work with lakehouse and medallion architecture patterns, including Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers, to support reliable and reusable reporting datasets. * Assist with Power BI data modeling, DAX measures, Power Query transformations, row\-level security, refresh troubleshooting, and report performance optimization. * Prepare and maintain documentation for source\-to\-target mappings, data pipelines, transformation logic, curated datasets, semantic models, and scheduled processes. **Minimum Education and Experience Requirements** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Information Systems, computer science engineering or a closely related degree from an appropriately accredited institution; or a Bachelor’s degree from an appropriately accredited institution and one year of experience in operations/systems work or closely related area; or an * Associate’s degree in Computer Information Technology, Computer Engineering Technology or Networking Technology from an appropriately accredited institution and two years of experience in operations/systems work or closely related area; jobs.title: PRN Radiation Therapist
jobs.description: The Radiation Therapist is responsible for providing the highest level of care while delivering ionizing radiation to the patient in accordance with the prescription and instructions of the Radiation Oncologist and under the general supervision of the Physicist. Must be able to adhere to the Behavioral Expectations/Customer Service Standards, demonstrate knowledge and skills necessary to ensure safe operation of the facility, demonstrates compliance with HIPPA policies and procedures and an understanding of the population served. Maintains the integrity of radiation treatment processes: * Maintains the accuracy of the treatment chart including patient identity, treatment prescription, diagnosis, calculations, and thorough knowledge of Aria. * Document all parameters of simulation and treatment in ARIA * Follows proper protocols for procedures * Maintains technical/clinical competency in all routine procedures and on all equipment * Prepare room and equipment for patient according to physician instructions regarding immobilization devices, field size, treatment distance, etc * Ensures proper radiation doses are delivered and recorded daily * Ensures all images are taken and checked according to department standards. * Assists in scheduling patients for their appointments * Transfer patient safely to treatment couch, giving special care to catheters, intravenous drips, etc * Ensure patient treatment meets all expectations and safety guidelines * Deliver accurately the prescribed planned course of radiation therapy with minimal supervision * Maintain patient markings * Observe patient for unusual reactions and events and report accurate information to the nursing staff and/or Radiation Oncologist * Maintain a clean area including treatment rooms, console and patient changing rooms * Perform weekly chart checks to verify accuracy of documentation, billing and treatment * Submit appropriate CPT charges for services rendered * Simulate patients using CT simulator or clinical setup * Ensures equipment is warmed up every morning; Education and Experience: * Must have completed and Associate or a Bachelor’s Degree Program in Radiation Therapy. * Must have completed 12\-month certificate program in Radiation Therapy * Must have American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) certification * Have current licensure for state you will practice * Excellent interpersonal/communication skills * Ability to adapt to change readily * ARRT registered in Radiation Therapy * Certified Medical Radiological Technologist (CMRT) in Texas * Basic Life Support (BLS) * Automated External Defibrillator (AED) **Preferred Qualifications:** * Knowledge of ARIA, interfacing with Eclipse planning system * Experience with Varian Truebeam Linear Accelerator * CT Simulation setup experience

jobs.title: MRP Support/Data Entry
jobs.description: Under the direction of the Data Management Manager, the MRP/Data Entry shall perform a variety of functions relating to the processing of information in our MRP system. This includes managing part numbers and Bills of Material for new and existing products. * Process projects and drawing revisions. Coordinate projects with the responsible drafters and engineers. * Coordinate with Customer Service regarding custom parts and special requests, as directed. * Maintain part numbering systems and logs. Perform investigative and reference work as directed. * Assist Sales personnel in answering questions relating to basic unit design, part numbers, special requests, etc * Handling purchasing paperwork for both credit card users and ACH payment requests. jobs.title: Pr. Storage Administrator
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The Principal Storage Administrator serves as VUIT's recognized subject matter expert for enterprise storage and backup services across on\-premises and cloud environments. Working under minimal supervision, this role independently manages highly complex operational, engineering, and solution delivery challenges involving storage availability, performance, scalability, data protection, and recovery. The Principal Storage Administrator develops and refines operational standards, technical methodologies, and solution designs within the storage domain; leads complex implementations and service improvements; and provides advanced guidance to colleagues and infrastructure teams. The role improves service quality, resilience, operational efficiency, and user experience through expert analysis, engineering, continuous improvement, and resolution of the university's most complex storage and backup challenges. **About the Work Unit:** Vanderbilt University Information Technology is a human\-centric organization that advances our university by delivering innovative solutions and frictionless experiences through collaboration. **Key Functions and Expected Performance:** **Storage Operations, Engineering \& Platform Stewardship** * Serve as the technical lead for complex SAN, NAS, object, and cloud\-based storage environments, ensuring reliable, scalable, and efficient service delivery. * Design and implement complex storage, backup, replication, and recovery solutions that align with established architectural standards and operational requirements. * Lead major storage lifecycle activities, including platform upgrades, migrations, consolidations, refreshes, and service modernization efforts. * Develop and maintain advanced operational standards, configuration baselines, automation, and support procedures that improve consistency and maintainability. * Evaluate platform performance and operational practices, implementing improvements that enhance availability, scalability, and service quality. **Reliability, Monitoring \& Incident Management** * Lead investigation and resolution of the most complex storage, performance, replication, backup, and recovery incidents across multiple infrastructure domains. * Perform advanced root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions that reduce recurring issues and operational risk. * Establish monitoring approaches, alerting thresholds, and operational practices that improve proactive issue detection and response effectiveness. * Drive service reliability improvements through trend analysis, incident reviews, and operational optimization initiatives. * Provide expert guidance during major incident response and recovery activities to minimize service disruption and business impact. **Data Protection, Security \& Compliance** * Oversee advanced data protection operations, including replication, backup, recovery, retention, and disaster recovery processes aligned with university requirements. * Improve recovery readiness and resilience through testing, validation, and continuous process enhancement. * Ensure storage services operate in alignment with university security requirements, data classifications, and applicable regulatory obligations. * Lead technical analysis and remediation of storage\-related security, compliance, and audit findings. * Develop and promote best practices for data protection, encryption, access management, and operational risk reduction. **Collaboration, Technical Leadership \& Knowledge Sharing** * Serve as the primary storage and backup subject matter expert for infrastructure, security, research computing, application, database, and cloud teams. * Provide mentorship, technical coaching, and knowledge transfer to administrators and engineers to strengthen organizational capabilities. * Influence technical decisions and implementation approaches through expertise, analysis, and collaborative problem\-solving. * Develop and maintain advanced operational documentation, standards, troubleshooting guidance, and knowledge resources. * Facilitate effective coordination and communication during complex operational initiatives and cross\-functional projects. **Capacity Management, Optimization \& Vendor Engagement** * Analyze long\-term capacity, utilization, performance, and growth trends to identify operational risks and improvement opportunities. * Develop reporting and operational metrics that support informed decision\-making and service optimization. * Lead vendor engagement for complex troubleshooting, critical incidents, escalation management, and platform optimization activities. * Recommend and implement operational improvements based on technology capabilities, performance analysis, and emerging industry practices. Coordinate complex migration, consolidation, and decommissioning efforts to ensure reliable service delivery and minimal operational disruption. * **Working Conditions and Operational Requirements:** *Hybrid Work Arrangement:* This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule, combining on ‑ campus and remote work. Employees are expected to be on site at least one day per week and for activities that require in ‑ person presence, such as team collaboration, service delivery, or campus events. Specific on ‑ site expectations are determined in coordination with the supervisor and must align with departmental needs and institutional policy. Remote work privileges may be revoked at any time. *On\-call Responsibilities:* The position includes rotating on\-call duties for after\-hours incident response and requests. **Supervisory Relationships** **:** This position may provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to other administrators and engineers. The position may have formal supervisory responsibility. This position reports administratively and functionally to the Director of Open Systems and Storage. **Education and Certifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience is necessary * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred * Advanced storage, backup, cloud, or infrastructure certifications are preferred **Experience and Skills** **:** * 8\-10 years of relevant, progressive experience administering enterprise storage, backup, and data protection platforms in complex environments is necessary * Deep expertise in SAN, NAS, object storage, replication, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery technologies is necessary * Advanced ability to analyze and resolve complex storage, performance, availability, and data protection issues across multiple infrastructure domains is necessary * Experience designing and implementing enterprise storage and data protection solutions within established architectural frameworks is necessary * Demonstrated experience developing operational standards, automation, support practices, and service improvements that enhance reliability and maintainability is necessary * Strong communication, mentoring, and cross\-functional collaboration skills with the ability to influence technical outcomes without formal authority are necessary * Demonstrated commitment to VUIT’s Guiding Principles is necessary **Information Technology’s Guiding Principles:** * Trust and Respect\- VUIT cultivates a community built on trust, mutual respect, and inclusivity, where all members feel valued and supported. We prioritize honesty, dignity, empathy, and a willingness to listen and understand. * Professionalism\- VUIT strives to maintain a culture of maturity, accountability, and integrity to best represent the University and self. Have a sense of humility and poise in your work and daily interactions. * Collaborate\- VUIT commits to being inclusive in solution design where we value sharing within and partnering across the university. We are intentional about including our colleagues and preventing silos. * Bias\-to\-Action\- VUIT is seen as a changemaker by exhibiting a decisive, self\-starter, take\-action approach with a willingness to make decisions without excessive deliberation. Personal initiative is recognized as a key part of the creative process. * Communicate\- Communication (written, verbal and non\-verbal), within and outside VUIT, is open, thoughtful, welcoming, clear, proactive, concise yet complete, always honest, and delivered kindly. * Innovate\- VUIT pledges to be bold and challenge the status quo by inspiring a culture of creativity that promotes growth and advancement for the university. * Celebrate Each Other\- We are intentional in showing appreciation for the work of others by valuing and acknowledging meaningful contributions at all levels of the organization. * Optimize\- VUIT will practice continuous and thoughtful optimization of our solutions and services to increase our human and technological capacity. Capacity drives innovation.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer (hybrid)
jobs.description: Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. **Your Role:** Our PrisMax systems are used in intensive care units worldwide to support critically ill patients experiencing acute kidney injury and other conditions requiring continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT). As an Engineer I on the Embedded Software team, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of software that powers these life\-sustaining systems. Working alongside experienced software, systems, electrical, quality, cybersecurity, and verification engineers, you will help design, implement, test, and maintain embedded software solutions throughout the product lifecycle. This role is ideal for a recent graduate or early\-career engineer seeking hands\-on experience developing software for regulated medical devices. **What You'll Be Doing:** * Design, implement, and maintain embedded software features and enhancements for the PrisMax platform. * Support software development activities from requirements through implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. * Participate in software architecture discussions, design reviews, and code reviews. * Develop unit tests and support automated testing initiatives. * Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects using structured root cause analysis techniques. * Collaborate with systems engineers to understand product requirements and maintain traceability between requirements, design, implementation, and testing. * Support risk management activities including hazard analysis and software\-related mitigations. * Assist with software verification and validation activities in compliance with medical device regulations and standards. * Work closely with electrical and systems engineering teams to diagnose hardware/software integration issues. * Contribute to cybersecurity, reliability, and performance improvements across the platform. * Support design history file (DHF) documentation and engineering deliverables required within a regulated development environment. * Participate in Agile planning, estimation, and sprint execution activities. **What You'll Bring:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline. * 0\- 2\+ years of engineering experience, including internships, co\-ops, or academic projects. * Proficiency in C\+\+ and/or C. * Understanding of embedded software fundamentals including: Real\-time systems Microcontrollers and processors Hardware/software interfaces Debugging techniques Communication protocols * Demonstrated analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering team. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with RTOS\-based development or embedded Linux. * Familiarity with ARM\-based processors and embedded development tools. * Exposure to communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, USB, or Ethernet. * Experience with Git and modern software development workflows. * Knowledge of Python or scripting languages used for test automation. * Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and CI/CD concepts. * Understanding of cybersecurity concepts for connected medical devices. * Exposure to regulated industries such as medical devices, aerospace, automotive, or industrial controls. *Vantive is committed to supporting the need for flexibility in the workplace. We do so through our flexible workplace policy which includes a minimum of 3 days a week onsite. This policy provides the benefits of connecting and collaborating in\-person in support of our Mission.* *We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Vantive, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The estimated base salary for this position is $76,000 to $104,500 annually. The estimated range is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position. We may pay more or less than of the anticipated range based upon market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change. Individual pay is based on upon location, skills and expertise, experience, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses. For questions about this, our pay philosophy, and available benefits, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview.* **US Benefits at Vantive** This is where your well\-being matters. Vantive offers comprehensive compensation and benefits packages for eligible roles. Our health and well\-being benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage that start on day one, as well as insurance coverage for basic life, accident, short\-term and long\-term disability, and business travel accident insurance. Financial and retirement benefits include the Aon Pooled Employer Plan (“Aon PEP”), Vantive’s 401(k) retirement savings plan, to help you prepare for your future. The Aon PEP is designed to help improve retirement outcomes by providing retirement resources more efficiently. The plan offers a robust set of investment options, financial education, and a suite of resources to support your retirement goals. We also offer Flexible Spending Accounts, educational assistance programs, and time\-off benefits such as paid holidays, paid time off ranging from 20 to 35 days based on length of service, family and medical leaves of absence, and paid parental leave. Additional benefits include commuting benefits, the Employee Discount Program, the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and childcare benefits. Join us and enjoy the competitive compensation and benefits we offer to our employees. For additional information regarding Vantive’s US Benefits, please speak with your recruiter or visit our Benefits site: Benefits \| Vantive **Equal Employment Opportunity** Vantive is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior UI Developer (ReactJS)
jobs.description: **Role: Senior UI Developer (ReactJS)** **Location: Chicago, IL (Chicago, IL (Hybrid 3 Days From Office)** **Mandatory Skills:** React 18\+, Angular 18\+, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Angular Material, React MUI, Design Systems, Design Tokens, Storybook, WCAG 2\.1 AA, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Git, Automated Testing (Jest/Karma/Cypress/Playwright), AI\-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Codex, Claude Code) **Desired Skills:** Lit/Web Components, Shadow DOM, Micro Frontend Architecture, Nx Monorepo, Module Federation, npm Package Publishing, Azure Artifacts, GraphQL, Okta/OAuth2/OIDC, Visual Regression Testing, Healthcare Domain, HIPAA, SOC2 **Job Description:** In this role, you will build and maintain client's shared UI component libraries and the micro\-product experiences that compose into the VIP platform shell. You will work with UX, Product Management, Platform Architecture, and QA teams. Together you will deliver a framework\-agnostic web component toolkit alongside the existing Angular and React toolkits, and independently deployable micro\-product UIs that mount into a shared shell. You will also help set the component standards, design token architecture, and automation that keep the toolkits in parity and let product teams move faster. **Responsibilities:** Design, build, and maintain components across the Angular, React, and web component toolkits, keeping behaviour, accessibility, and styling in parity across all three. Build reusable UI components with Angular Material, React MUI, and Lit, working from Figma designs supplied by the UX team. Own and extend the shared design token layer that feeds every toolkit, and the theming that lets products adopt brand changes without rework. Build and extend micro\-frontend applications using Nx monorepo tooling and Module Federation, including runtime composition of multiple frameworks on a single page. Design component APIs for consumption by other teams: props and inputs, composition patterns, and controlled versus uncontrolled behaviour. Own versioning, deprecation, and migration guidance for every breaking change. Publish and maintain npm packages to a private Azure Artifacts feed, with semantic versioning and release notes that consuming teams can act on. Integrate micro\-product UIs with enterprise platforms, including Okta (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT bearer authentication) token flow across shell and products, and REST and GraphQL service layers. Keep quality high with automated testing: Jest and Karma for unit tests, Playwright or Cypress for end\-to\-end, and visual regression testing across every component on every deployment. Document components in Storybook across frameworks, and maintain the documentation site that designers and engineers both use. Build accessibility to WCAG 2\.1 AA into every component \- keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and focus management \- so consuming products inherit it rather than solving it independently. Maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions across dev, test, stage, and prod, with coverage and quality gates enforced. Take part in spec\-driven development: turn design and product requirements into technical designs, ADRs, and implementation plans. Use AI\-assisted engineering tools throughout. Mentor engineers, lead code reviews, and contribute to reference patterns, coding standards, and reusable components across the team. Evaluate new technologies and run proofs\-of\-concept to improve platform maturity and developer productivity. **Qualifications:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 5 or more years of professional front\-end engineering experience. 3 or more years of hands\-on experience with React (18\+) and TypeScript. 3 or more years of hands\-on experience with Angular (v18\+), including standalone components, signals, and RxJS. Strong JavaScript fundamentals: DOM, the object model, and modern ECMAScript. Strong HTML and CSS: layout, responsive breakpoints, and cross\-browser behaviour. Demonstrated experience building a shared component library or design system consumed by other teams. Hands\-on experience with Angular Material and React MUI, including theming and style overrides. Experience with design tokens and multi\-brand or multi\-theme styling. Experience with Storybook for component documentation and development. Working knowledge of WCAG 2\.1 AA accessibility and how to build to it. Experience writing automated unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests. Experience building CI/CD pipelines and working in Git\-based workflows. Daily working use of AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Codex, including writing effective prompts and repo\-level instruction files. **Preferred:** Experience with web components and Lit, including custom elements and Shadow DOM. Experience with micro\-frontend architecture, Nx, and Webpack or Rspack Module Federation, particularly with multiple frameworks composed on one page.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: Software Engineer II is an early\-career role for engineers who build and maintain Windows desktop applications in C\# and .NET. Engineers in this role work on their own on well\-defined features. They apply sound engineering principles to deliver reliable, performant, and maintainable desktop software. A Software Engineer II owns their technical decisions and shares responsibility for the quality of the product. That means writing tests, reviewing code, and working closely with QA to find and fix defects. Compared to a Software Engineer I, this role comes with more skill, more independence, and more responsibility. Engineers at this level also start mentoring and leading within their team. This position prepares engineers for senior engineering and technical leadership roles. **Development** * Write clean, well\-structured, testable, and maintainable C\# code that follows team coding standards. * Build desktop features on their own using WPF (and WinForms or WinUI where applicable), following MVVM and other established patterns. * Take ownership of well\-defined features or areas of the codebase, with little guidance. * Help design new features and refactor legacy desktop code, including migrating from .NET Framework to modern .NET. * Write responsive UI code that uses async/await correctly and keeps long\-running work off the UI thread. * Integrate the desktop client with backend services by consuming RESTful APIs and handling JSON and XML data. * Work with local and remote data stores using SQL, Entity Framework, or other data\-access approaches used by the team. **Quality** * Write and run unit, integration, and UI automation tests (for example xUnit or NUnit, Moq, FlaUI or WinAppDriver). * Diagnose crashes, memory leaks, and performance problems using the Visual Studio debugger, profilers, and dump analysis. * Work with QA to reproduce, triage, and fix defects, including ones that appear only in specific customer environments. * Use root cause analysis to fix the underlying cause of problems and to improve team processes. **Delivery** * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps that build, test, sign, and package desktop releases. * Support installer and deployment work (for example MSIX, WiX, or ClickOnce) and the auto\-update mechanisms used by the team. * Take part in agile ceremonies: stand\-ups, backlog refinement, planning, and retrospectives. **Collaboration** * Review code and give constructive feedback, and mentor more junior developers. * Build strong working relationships with developers, product managers, QA, UX designers, and automation engineers. * Identify and raise risks, blockers, and technical debt early. * Keep team documentation for assigned features up to date. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the team. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2–5 years of professional software development experience, or equivalent ability. * Strong proficiency in C\# and .NET (.NET 6\+ and/or .NET Framework 4\.x). * Hands\-on experience building Windows desktop applications with WPF, WinForms, or WinUI. * Solid understanding of MVVM, dependency injection, SOLID principles, and common design patterns. * Working knowledge of asynchronous programming, threading, and UI responsiveness in desktop applications. * Experience consuming RESTful services and working with SQL, JSON, and XML. * Proficiency with Visual Studio, Git, and CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps preferred). * Experience writing automated tests and debugging production issues. * Strong written and verbal communication, teamwork, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to manage day\-to\-day development tasks on their own with moderate supervision. * Commitment to continuous learning and a growth mindset. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience migrating applications from .NET Framework to modern .NET. * Familiarity with Windows platform APIs, P/Invoke, or COM interop. * Experience with desktop installers, code signing, and update or distribution mechanisms. * Experience with performance profiling and memory analysis tools (for example dotTrace, dotMemory, PerfView). * Exposure to cloud services (AWS or Azure) that support desktop clients. Experience with graphics, drawing, or document\-heavy desktop applications. * \#LI\-LM03 \#LI\-Hybrid For over 50 years, Verisk has been the leading data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry by delivering value to our clients through expertise and scale. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** ==================== We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer specializing in robust backend architecture and distributed systems. Expert in guiding technical direction, establishing engineering best practices, and partnering across product and infrastructure teams to build resilient, auto\-scaling applications. We’re an American manufacturer of advanced 48V centric DC\-DC converters with industry\-leading power and current density, enabling breakthrough power delivery performance. As an engineering\-focused company, we provide an opportunity to be part of the team that further innovates, markets, sells and supports the power modules that drive key advancements in AI, electric vehicles, and aerospace. **This position is 100% on site in Andover, MA** **Job Description** ------------------- * Deploy and maintain company LANs, WANs, Telecommunications, VOIP, Security and wireless networks, which include servers, routers, hubs, switches, firewalls, PBX equipment, IPS/IPD and other hardware. * Configure networks to ensure their smooth and reliable operation for fulfilling business objectives and processes. * Define and provide direction to our managed service providers (e.g. MSP, Telecom Carriers, Cabling, Build outs \&MAC vendors) consistent with best practices. * Monitor network performance and troubleshoot problem areas as needed. * Collaborate with other infrastructure engineering personnel to assess near\- and long\-term network capacity needs. * Create and maintain documentation related to network configuration, network mapping, processes, and service records. * Implement and maintain policies, procedures, and associated training plans for network administration and usage. * Conduct research on network products, services, protocols, and standards to remain abreast of developments in the networking industry and provide solution recommendations as needed to meet business or application needs. * Practice network asset management, including maintenance of network component inventory and related documentation. Monitor/test network performance and provide network performance metric reports. * Oversee new and existing equipment, hardware, and software upgrades. * Coordinate the establishment of processes, procedures and documentation to insure 7 x 24 availability of local/wide area network. * Assess impact of new versions of network operating systems and equipment and make recommendations for deployment. * Insure that appropriate network security measures are in place to protect corporate assets. * Interface with UNIX and Windows engineering personnel as necessary to achieve required connectivity and performance. * Working outside of normal hours should be expected along with providing on\-call support coverage. **Education / Qualifications** ------------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent and a minimum of 5 years of networking experience. Cisco or network certifications highly desirable * Detailed knowledge of cabling standards, TCP/IP, VLANS and routing protocols along with troubleshooting techniques with network management software. * Demonstrated experience with successful LAN, WAN, WLAN and WWAN design and implementation as well as experience with network capacity planning, network security principles, and general network management best practices. * Demonstrated ability in managing vendors and service providers is a must * Strong knowledge of network equipment, including Cisco routers and switches, Firewalls, Site\-to\-Site VPN, and TLS remote access required. Specific experience and strong technical knowledge working with Cisco product families Such as Nexus and Catalyst switch product families, Cisco routers, firewall Load balancers \& SSL remote access products. * Knowledge of Definity PBX and VOIP systems is a plus. * Competence with testing tools and procedures for voice and data circuits. * Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills and be highly self\-motivated and directed, with keen attention to detail \& customer focus * Able to conduct research into networking issues as required with proven analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Able to effectively prioritize tasks in a high\-pressure environment with strong customer service orientation and experience working in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Vicor is an EO employer – M/F/Veteran/Disability **Compensation Data** --------------------- Salary Range: $120,000 \- 135,000 Please note: This range is based on our current market driven pay structures. Individual salaries are determined based upon a variety of factors including but not limited to, a candidates overall qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience as well as company internal equity. **Nearest Major Market:** Boston

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level. Join us and let’s shape the future of data. **Job Description** We are seeking a Staff Full\-Stack Web Engineer to provide technical leadership in designing, building, enhancing, and supporting web applications and services that enable teams across engineering, quality, manufacturing, and customer support. This role is ideal for a highly experienced engineer who can drive architecture, lead complex initiatives across teams, and guide solutions from concept through deployment and long\-term evolution. The ideal candidate combines deep full\-stack engineering expertise with strong technical judgment, cross\-functional influence, and a practical approach to solving business problems at scale. jobs.description: **Location** ============ Remote, US **Scheduled Hours** =================== 40 **Position Summary** ==================== The Anastasio Laboratory at Washington University in St. Louis seeks a Staff Scientist to advance wave\-based tomographic image reconstruction, including photoacoustic and ultrasound computed tomography. The scientist will develop and investigate computational reconstruction methods and apply concepts from information theory and signal detection theory to assess image quality and guide improvements in imaging systems. Based in the Mallinckrodt Institute of Radiology and affiliated with the Center for Computational and AI\-enabled Imaging Sciences (C2AIS), the laboratory integrates imaging physics, computational mathematics, and artificial intelligence to address fundamental and translational challenges in biomedical imaging. The position offers opportunities to collaborate with imaging scientists, engineers, and clinicians to develop principled imaging methods with potential clinical impact. Designs research protocols. Assists in developing and conducting research projects, including experiment design, data analysis and documentation of experiment results. **Job Description** =================== **Primary Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Develops, implements, and evaluates image reconstruction methods for wave\-based tomography, including photoacoustic and ultrasound computed tomography. * Applies information theory and signal detection theory to assess image quality and guide improvements in imaging systems and reconstruction algorithms. * Designs and conducts computational studies, analyzes simulated and experimental data, and collaborates with multidisciplinary research teams. * Prepares manuscripts and technical reports, contributes to grant proposals, and mentors students and trainees. * Following instructions and discussions with the principal investigator, designs research protocols, including developing procedures for the collection, verification and management of data. * Assists with grant preparation and reporting. * Performs complex statistical analysis of data collected and writes interpretative reports. improvements. * Provide technical oversight for tooling, fixtures, equipment, work instructions, routing, and manufacturing process requirements associated with fabricated products. * Support the transfer of new products and processes from development into full\-scale production. * Partner with manufacturing teams to improve product quality, process capability, throughput, safety, cost, and consistency. * Investigate product, process, and field\-performance issues using structured problem\-solving and root\-cause analysis methods. * Identify and implement appropriate corrective and preventive actions and verify their effectiveness. * Establish and promote sound engineering standards, design practices, testing protocols, documentation requirements, and data\-analysis methods. * schedule commitments. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials Engineering, jobs.title: EVS Training Project Manager GA
jobs.description: ### **We are seeking Environmental Services Training Project Managers in GA** As a Project Manager, you may be called upon for various assignments to prospective, new, and existing accounts throughout the country. This position requires 100% travel. As a support resource, the Project Manager may be assigned to plan and execute start\-ups of new business; audit and/or re\-engineer existing accounts; perform other operations, program development, teaching, research, or troubleshooting assignments. The primary job responsibility is to assist in the management of an assigned hospital Environmental Services Department under the direction and guidance of the Environmental Services Department Director. Specific responsibilities include work scheduling of all department personnel, establishing and enforcing work standards in conjunction with the Department Director, monitoring overall inventory/equipment usage, troubleshooting/problem solving, orientation/training of Department Staff, customer relations, and special project work as requested. The purpose of this role is to prepare the incumbent to assume the operational duties of a department through hands\-on training and managerial experience under the direction of an experienced Department Director. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES \- ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** * Participate in staff selection process. Interview candidates as needed. Schedule days off, holidays and vacations, ensuring that the account’s needs are met in accordance with hours and position control. * Assign personnel to established work areas or project duties. * Conducts quality assurance checks and manages materials inventory as well as general use of equipment. * Ensure that staff receives proper orientation, initial training, and ongoing education. * Provide individual guidance and motivation to staff to enable each one to perform to his/her fullest potential. * Discipline associates when necessary according to progressive disciplinary guidelines. * Prepare associate disciplinary and variance reports and conduct follow\-up investigation as needed, reporting findings to the Department Director. Prepare disciplinary action notices and conduct follow\-up as required. Conduct disciplinary meetings with associates with guidance from the Department Director. * Maintain an environment that is in sanitary, attractive and orderly condition. * Demonstrate and promote the company’s culture, values, and management philosophy. * Demonstrate quality leadership in meeting performance plans. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS FOR CONSIDERATION:** * High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent required. College degree or equivalent work experience preferred. Must have one to three years of supervisory experience in a service\-related field with high customer/client contact. * Post\-Offer Medical, Background Screening, to include Department of Motor Vehicle check and Drug Test required * 10 days on 4 days off travel schedule * Local to the area **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:** * Strong service/quality attitude. * Ability to plan, organize prioritize, and achieve effective time management. * Ability to work under pressure and meet established goals and objectives. * Strong public speaking skills. * Sense of urgency and ability to meet deadlines; self\-directed. **PHYSICAL FUNCTIONS REQUIRED:** * Ability to walk or stand for prolonged periods. Requires bending, stooping, reaching up and lifting up to 50 pounds. Possible exposure to chemicals requiring special clothing or safety equipment. **COMPUTER SKILLS:** * Proficient in the use of Windows based office software including but not limited to Microsoft Office, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook. **Xanitos, Inc**. is a management company that provides hospital housekeeping, patient transport, and central laundries services. It is differentiated by its patented XRO System for cleaning patient rooms, its outstanding operations management team, and by being a private company whose priority is giving top quality service. The results are evident; at the hospitals it serves, Xanitos has improved the cleaning quality, increased HCAHPS scores, reduced the risk of HAIs, lowered bed turnaround time, and significantly reduced costs. #### **Education** Required* High School Diploma, GED or equivalent or better Preferred* Bachelors or better Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Transmission Planning Staff or Senior Engineer
jobs.description: Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) is a leading energy provider and Fortune 500 company, dedicated to serving millions of electricity and natural gas customers across eight states: Minnesota, Colorado, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota, New Mexico and Texas. We make energy work better for our customers, helping them thrive every day. That means always raising the bar \- delivering better service and providing more reliable, resilient, and sustainable energy. Xcel Energy is a place where you’ll have opportunities to grow, expand your skills, and help lead the clean energy transition. We offer meaningful rewards, recognition, and support to help you build your career and make an impact \- both on the job and beyond. Most importantly, it means you’ll be joining a company that knows employees are the driving force behind its success and is committed to helping you be your best. Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs. **The below job summary and responsibilities reflect the duties of the Transmission Planning Senior Engineer; Staff Engineer will differ as less skills and/or experience will be required. The successful candidate will be placed at a level that is commensurate with the candidate's skills and experience.** **Position Summary:** This role is within the Integrated Planning Delivery team and will be focused on understanding the current state of planning processes and driving toward integration through tools and automation. The engineer will collaboratively set assumptions and perform integrated technical analysis as a transmission planning subject matter expert to develop new insights, recommendations, and reports to support business decisions and major initiatives. In this role, the engineer will be expected to communicate technical concepts effectively, using appropriate data visualization. Applies extensive technical expertise and has full knowledge of other related disciplines. Performs as a staff advisor and consultant in a technical specialty, a type of facility or equipment, or a program function. Carries out complex or innovative assignments requiring the development of new or improved techniques and procedures. Work is expected to result in the development of new/improved techniques and procedures or new/refined equipment, materials, processes, products, and/or scientific methods. Represents the organization as the prime technical contact on contracts and projects and interacts with senior external personnel on significant technical matters often requiring coordination between organizations. Work is performed without appreciable direction and considerable latitude is exercised in determining technical objectives of assignment. Guidance relates largely to overall objectives, critical issues, new concepts and policy matters. Completed work is reviewed from a relatively long\- term perspective, for desired results. May assign tasks to and direct engineers, technicians, craft personnel and administrative staff, including coordination and review of work assignments. Responsible for (and may lead) multiple projects of moderate to large size or portions of major projects. This role requires a balance of technical acumen and strong communication skills, as the senior engineer will need to convey technical concepts clearly and effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Communication will occur in various formats, including in\-person meetings, virtual discussions, presentations to leadership, and written reports. **Essential Responsibilities:** * Power systems studies engineer: Leads and performs modeling and analysis activities for steady state and stability simulations * Transmission planning engineer: Develops scopes for studies to guide long\-range transmission system plans and coordinates with other Integrated System Planning departments to ensure assumptions align across subdisciplines * Effectively communicates the results of studies and department endeavors to a wide range of audiences through written and verbal means * Improves Integrated System Planning procedures and techniques through largely self\-directed work. Resolves difficult technical and business problems * Implements, without substantial direction, NERC and FERC compliance activities as an SME. Activities are coordinated through the Integrated System Planning department and with external entities * Assigns tasks to lower\-level engineers, interns and technicians. Mentors and provides training materials for less experienced engineers to ensure group development **Minimum Requirements: Senior Engineer ($97,000 \- $129,266\)** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and/or Physics from ABET accredited curriculum (or recognized equivalency). * 5\+ years with nationally recognized certification, 7\+ years without certification. * Experience with multiple power system transmission analysis tools such as PSSE, TARA, EMS, ASPEN, CAPE, PROMOD, PLEXOS, PowerWorld, PSCAD or other similar analysis software. **Minimum Requirements: Staff Engineer ($81,800 \- $106,266\)** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering and/or Physics from ABET accredited curriculum (or recognized equivalency). * 2\+ years of demonstrated experience. * Experience with at least one power system transmission analysis tool, such as PSSE, TARA, EMS, ASPEN, CAPE, PROMOD, PLEXOS, PowerWorld, PSCAD or other similar analysis software. * Demonstrates broad knowledge and proficiency in power systems studies or transmission planning, knowledge of related specialties, and general knowledge of other related disciplines. **Preferred Requirements** * EIT/FE (Engineer in Training/Fundamentals of Engineering and/or PE (Professional Engineer) registration. * Graduate degree in fields above. Our culture is grounded in shared values and employee commitments that guide how we work, support one another, and grow together. **Our Values** Connected, Committed, Trustworthy, Safe **Our Employee Commitments** * Work that makes a difference * A team you can count of * Opportunities to grow * Rewards that help you thrive Xcel Energy provides job applicants reasonable accommodations for disabilities throughout the application process. If you are in need of an accommodation to complete the application process, now or at any time in the future, please complete the Applicant Accommodation Request Form. Non\-Bargaining The anticipated starting base pay for this position is: $81,800\.00 to $145,400\.00 per year This position is eligible for the following benefits: Annual Incentive Program, Medical/Pharmacy Plan, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Dependent Care Reimbursement Account, Health Care Reimbursement Account, Health Savings Account (HSA) (if enrolled in eligible health plan), Limited\-Purpose FSA (if enrolled in eligible health plan and HSA), Transportation Reimbursement Account, Short\-term disability (STD), Long\-term disability (LTD), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Fitness Center Reimbursement (if enrolled in eligible health plan), Tuition reimbursement, Transit programs, Employee recognition program, Pension, 401(k) plan, Paid time off (PTO), Holidays, Volunteer Paid Time Off (VPTO), Parental Leave Benefit plans are subject to change and Xcel Energy has the right to end, suspend, or amend any of its plans, at any time, in whole or in part. In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age\-identifying information including but not limited to dates of school attendance and graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
